tldr: 通过引入等变性理论与交换理论，本研究发现并解决了视觉语言模型图表阅读中一致性检验的盲点，提出了无需训练的可靠性检测方法。
ai_comments: 该论文从交换理论（Commutation Theory）的视角深刻揭示并解决了视觉语言模型在图形阅读中无标签可靠性（label-free reliability）的一致性盲点，创新性地结合了等变性（equivariance）提出了Equivariance-Consistency Score，具有很强的理论深度和实用价值。
motivation: 视觉语言模型基于不变性的无标签可靠性方法存在系统性盲点，即扰动无法覆盖某些特定错误，因此本研究旨在从理论上刻画并消除这一盲点。
method: 提出交换理论（Commutation Theory），利用联合中心化器分析盲点，并结合互补的等变性关系，设计了Equivariance-Consistency Score（ECS）训练无关检测器，并构建了REND-EQUIV数据集进行验证。
results: 研究证明了两个匹配的编辑对于仿射阅读错误是完备的，且循环重标号弥补了标签置换的差距；基于该理论实现的Equivariance-Consistency Score在多个模型和真实样本上验证了预测的有效性。
conclusion: 本研究通过建立交换理论，证明了等变性与一致性的结合能够有效弥补视觉语言模型图表阅读中的盲点，并推出了REND-EQUIV数据集及Equivariance-Consistency Score检测器，提升了无标签可靠性检测的准确性。

title: DistMedVL: Distributional Vision-Language Alignment for Uncertainty-Aware Medical Image Segmentation
authors: Jiaxuan Li, Qing Xu, Xiangjian He, Yue Li, Daokun Zhang, Fiseha B. Tesema, Rong Qu
abstract: Cross-modal alignment of visual and textual representations is fundamental to multimodal medical image understanding, yet remains hindered by uncertainty in both modalities under real-world clinical conditions. Existing vision-language segmentation methods rely on deterministic cross-modal matching, which overlooks aleatoric uncertainty from ambiguous boundaries and epistemic uncertainty from limited training data, leading to fragile performance under domain shift. To address this issue, we propose DistMedVL, a probabilistic vision-language framework that introduces a lightweight Probabilistic Cross-Modal Adapter (PCM-Adapter) upon frozen encoders to explicitly model representational uncertainty. Specifically, the PCM-Adapter comprises two sequential modules for progressive probabilistic alignment. We first devise a Mahalanobis Alignment Module (MAM) that models textual tokens as Gaussian distributions and computes patch-text compatibility via Mahalanobis distance, yielding variance-conditioned matching that downweights unreliable feature dimensions. Moreover, we devise a Distribution Flow Module (DFM) that estimates modality-wise confidence parameters and performs vision-guided refinement of textual distributions, accommodating distributional variation across imaging modalities. Extensive experiments across eight medical segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that DistMedVL outperforms state-of-the-art methods with only 6.3M trainable parameters, exhibiting superior data efficiency, perturbation robustness and cross-dataset generalization.
zh_title: DistMedVL：用于不确定性感知医学图像分割的分布式视透语言对齐
translation: 视觉和文本表示的跨模态对齐是多模态医学图像理解的基础，但在真实临床条件下面临着双模态不确定性的阻碍。现有的视觉-语言分割方法依赖于确定的跨模态匹配，忽视了来自模糊边界的偶然不确定性和来自有限训练数据的认知不确定性，导致在领域偏移下性能脆弱。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了DistMedVL，一个概率视觉-语言框架，它在冻结编码器上引入了一个轻量级的概率跨模态适配器（PCM-Adapter）来显式建模表示不确定性。具体来说，PCM-Adapter包含两个用于渐进式概率对齐的连续模块。首先，我们设计了马氏对齐模块（MAM），将文本标记建模为高斯分布，并通过马氏距离计算图像块与文本的相容性，从而产生方差条件匹配并降低不可靠特征维度的权重。此外，我们设计了分布流模块（DFM），用于估计模态置信度参数并执行文本分布的视觉引导精炼，以适应跨成像模态的分布变化。在八个医学分割基准上的广泛实验表明，DistMedVL仅需6.3M个可训练参数即超越了最先进的方法，表现出优异的数据效率、扰动鲁棒性和跨数据集泛化能力。
tldr: 提出DistMedVL，一种不确定性感知的医学图像分割视觉-语言对齐框架，通过概率适配器显式处理模态不确定性，在多个基准上取得领先性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将概率建模引入医学图像的视觉-语言对齐中，通过马氏距离和分布流模块显式建模不确定性，兼顾了高效性（仅需少量可训练参数）与强大的泛化/鲁棒性，对临床不确定性场景下的图像分割具有重要价值。
motivation: 现有的视觉-语言分割方法依赖于确定性的跨模态匹配，忽视了真实临床条件下由模糊边界和有限训练数据带来的不确定性，导致在领域偏移下性能脆弱。
method: 提出DistMedVL框架，并在冻结编码器上引入轻量级概率跨模态适配器（PCM-Adapter），包含用于方差条件匹配的马氏对齐模块（MAM）和用于视觉引导文本分布精炼的分布流模块（DFM）。
results: 在八个医学分割基准测试中，DistMedVL仅需6.3M个可训练参数即优于现有最先进的方法，表现出卓越的数据效率、扰动鲁棒性和跨数据集泛化能力。
conclusion: DistMedVL通过轻量级概率跨模态适配器有效解决了医学图像分割中的模态不确定性与分布偏移问题，在多个基准测试中展现出卓越的性能和鲁棒性。

title: JoyAI-RA 0.5: Scaling Robot Manipulation Learning via Dual Action Alignment
authors: JoyAI-RA Team
abstract: Robot data is scarce, so generalist policies need to learn from heterogeneous sources, including human egocentric video, simulation, and real robots, which differ in supervision and embodiment, with action labels missing or mutually incompatible. Human egocentric data scale best but sit farthest from robot data, and naive pooling causes negative transfer rather than knowledge sharing. We propose JoyAI-RA 0.5, a generalist Vision-Language-World-Action (VLWA) framework that couples physical world-dynamics priors with visual semantics and scales manipulation learning across such data via dual action alignment. Implicit action alignment infers latent actions from visual transitions, enabling action-free human, simulation, and robot data to guide a latent-action-conditioned world model in learning physical dynamics. Explicit alignment grounds reliable human and robot trajectories in a unified physical action space through a canonical action representation and camera-frame chunk-relative end-effector actions. An inner-outer-loop reinforcement stage then pairs efficient task adaptation with foundation-policy improvement. On a real-world AgiBot benchmark, JoyAI-RA performs strongly on both seen tasks and unseen variations. The task score improves consistently as the volume of human egocentric pretraining data increases and shows no sign of plateauing at our largest scale. This suggests that abundant but weakly labeled human experience can be converted into a transferable training signal, making human video not merely a weak auxiliary source but a primary axis along which manipulation capability can be scaled. Project page can be found at https://joyai-ra-05.github.io/.
zh_title: JoyAI-RA 0.5：通过双动作对齐扩展机器人操作学习
translation: 机器人数据非常稀缺，因此通用策略需要从包括人类第一人称视频、仿真和真实机器人在内的异构来源中学习。这些来源在监督和具身方面存在差异，动作标签缺失或相互不兼容。人类第一人称数据的规模最大，但与机器人数据的差距也最大，简单地汇集数据会导致负迁移而不是知识共享。我们提出了 JoyAI-RA 0.5，这是一个通用的视觉-语言-世界-动作（VLWA）框架，它将物理世界动力学先验与视觉语义相结合，通过双动作对齐在这些数据中扩展操作学习。隐式动作对齐从视觉跃迁中推断潜在动作，使无动作的人类、仿真和机器人数据能够指导条件化的世界模型学习物理动力学。显式动作对齐通过规范动作表示和相机坐标系分块相对末端执行器动作，将可靠的人类和机器人轨迹基础化到一个统一的物理动作空间中。接着，内外循环强化阶段将高效的任务适应与基础策略改进相结合。在真实的 AgiBot 基准测试中，JoyAI-RA 在已知任务和未知变体上均表现强劲。随着人类第一人称预训练数据量的增加，任务得分持续提高，在我们的最大规模下没有表现出平台期。这表明丰富但带有弱标签的人类经验可以转化为可迁移的训练信号，使人类视频不仅成为一种弱辅助源，而且成为扩展操作能力的主要轴线。项目主页见 https://joyai-ra-05.github.io/。
keywords: 视觉-语言-世界-动作模型
tldr: 本文提出了 JoyAI-RA 0.5 框架，利用双动作对齐技术成功将海量人类第一人称视频转化为可扩展的机器人操作学习信号，显著提升了机器人的通用操作能力。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的双动作对齐机制（隐式与显式对齐），有效解决了机器人操作学习中多源异构数据（如人类视角视频、仿真和真实机器人数据）的负迁移问题，并通过内外部循环强化学习阶段实现了基础策略的持续改进，对利用海量人类弱标注视频扩展机器人操作能力具有重要意义。
motivation: 由于机器人数据稀缺，通用策略需要从人类视角视频、仿真和真实机器人等多源异构数据中学习，但这些数据存在监督和具身差异，且动作标签缺失或不兼容，直接混合会导致负迁移。因此需要一种能够有效整合异构数据并扩展学习能力的框架。
method: 提出了 JoyAI-RA 0.5 框架，通过隐式动作对齐（从视觉跃迁推断潜在动作）和显式动作对齐（将人类和机器人轨迹投影到统一的物理动作空间），结合内外部循环强化学习阶段进行任务适应和策略改进。
results: 在真实世界的 AgiBot 基准测试中，JoyAI-RA 在已知任务和未知变体上均表现优异，且随着人类第一人称预训练数据量的增加，任务得分持续提升，未出现平台期。
conclusion: JoyAI-RA 0.5 通过双动作对齐和强化学习，成功将人类视角视频转化为可扩展的机器人操作训练信号，在真实世界基准测试中展现出卓越的性能与扩展潜力。

title: Nonvisual Classification of Ground-Condition by Artificial Proprioception in an Amoeba-Inspired Autonomous Walking Robot
authors: Hyoto Yamaguchi, Zenji Yatabe, Seiya Kasai
abstract: Nonvisual classification of ground condition based on a multimodal sensing approach was investigated for an amoeba-inspired autonomous walking robot. To classify ground condition without image sensing and processing, we implemented artificial proprioception by integrating a three-axis accelerometer, eight foot pressure sensors, and reservoir computing (RC). Even when large fluctuations in the sensor outputs are caused by dynamic motions of a four-legged robot in walking, our system can classify the ground condition, flat or rough, with high accuracy. We demonstrate on-site switching of walking gait depending on ground condition in the robot. We also discuss the contribution of each sensor to ground condition classification.
comment: 5 pages, 7 figures, The paper has been submitted to IEEE SCIS ISIS 2026 for consideration
zh_title: 基于仿变形虫自主步行机器人人工本体感觉的地形非视觉分类
translation: 本文研究了变形虫启发的自主四足机器人基于多模态传感方法的非视觉地面状况分类。为了在没有图像感知和处理的情况下对地面状况进行分类，我们通过集成三轴加速度计、八个足底压力传感器和储层计算（RC）来实现人工本体感觉。即使四足机器人的动态运动导致传感器输出出现大幅波动，我们的系统也能以高精度对平坦或粗糙的地面状况进行分类。我们在机器人上演示了根据地面状况现场切换行走步态。我们还讨论了每个传感器对地面状况分类的贡献。
tldr: 该研究开发了一种无需视觉的人工本体感觉系统，结合多传感器与储层计算，使四足机器人能够高精度识别地面状况并自主切换步态。
ai_comments: 该论文巧妙地将生物学上的本体感觉与储层计算（RC）结合，应用于变形虫启发的四足机器人，实现了无需视觉的复杂地形分类与步态自适应切换，展现了软体机器人与具身智能在非视觉感知领域的潜力。
motivation: 旨在研究如何在不依赖图像传感与处理的情况下，为变形虫启发的自主四足机器人实现一种基于多模态传感方法的非视觉地面状况分类系统。
method: 通过集成三轴加速度计、八个足底压力传感器以及储层计算（RC）构建人工本体感觉系统，在无需图像感知的条件下对机器人行走过程中的传感器动态数据进行处理与地面分类。
results: 尽管四足机器人在行走时的动态运动会导致传感器输出出现大幅波动，该系统仍能以高精度对平坦或粗糙的地面状况进行分类，并成功演示了根据地面状况现场切换行走步态。
conclusion: 通过融合三轴加速度计、足底压力传感器与储层计算，变形虫启发的四足机器人实现了高精度的非视觉地面分类，并能根据地面状况实时切换步态，展示了本体感觉在复杂环境导航中的有效性。

title: Grounded Well-Condition Anomaly Detection on the Volve Field: Constructed Labels, a Baseline, and a Dual-Head Model
authors: Gospel Bassey, Vincent Fakiyesi
abstract: Most public benchmarks for machine-condition monitoring come from test rigs, where faults are induced on purpose and every event is known. Real production fields rarely offer that. They give you sensor histories with no fault log attached, which is exactly the situation where an anomaly-detection method has to invent its own labels, and where quiet assumptions can slip in unnoticed. We work with the open Volve field data released by Equinor and take two things seriously that such datasets usually skip. First, we build anomaly labels that are not just patterns in the numbers but are checked against what the field's own engineering documents say can physically go wrong, and we release the reasoning behind every label. Second, we test whether those constructed labels are learnable at all, using both an unsupervised baseline and a small dual-head model that marks when an event happens and what kind it is, an idea we carry over from earlier work on defect detection in metal parts. The results are honest. An unsupervised detector that never sees the labels still lands on the same regions our rules flagged, which tells us the labels are not arbitrary. A compact supervised model recovers event presence and event type well across wells it has never seen, and locates events in time only roughly. We report what worked, what did not, and every assumption in between. The dataset, grounded labels, per-label provenance, baseline scores, trained model, and code are released publicly under CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0.
zh_title: Volve油田的扎实井况异常检测：构建标签、基准与双头模型
translation: 大多数用于机器状态监测的公共基准都来自测试台，在这些测试台上，故障是故意诱发的，且每个事件都是已知的。真实的生产油田很少提供这样的条件。它们提供的传感器历史记录没有附带故障日志，而这正是异常检测方法必须自己发明标签的情况，在这个过程中，一些暗含的假设往往会在不经意间溜走。我们使用Equinor发布的公开Volve油田数据，认真对待了此类数据集通常忽略的两件事。首先，我们构建的异常标签不仅是数字中的模式，而且经过了该油田自身工程文档中关于物理故障可能性的核对，并且我们公开了每个标签背后的推理过程。其次，我们测试了这些构建的标签是否可以学习，我们使用了一个无监督基准和一个小型双头模型（该模型借鉴自早期关于金属零件缺陷检测的想法，用于标记事件发生的时间及其类型）。结果是诚实的。一个从未见过标签的无监督检测器仍然落在了我们规则标记的相同区域上，这告诉我们这些标签不是随意的。一个紧凑的监督模型在它从未见过的油井中很好地恢复了事件的存在性和事件类型，但在时间上只能粗略地定位事件。我们报告了哪些方法有效，哪些无效，以及介于两者之间的每一个假设。数据集、扎实的标签、每个标签的来源、基准分数、训练好的模型和代码均在CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0下公开发布。
tldr: 本文针对真实油田缺乏故障日志的问题，结合工程文档构建了物理可解释的异常标签，并通过无监督和监督模型验证了其有效性，开源了相关数据集和代码。
ai_comments: 该论文针对真实生产油田缺乏故障日志的痛点，创新性地结合工程文档构建了有据可查的异常标签，并验证了其可学习性，为工业异常检测提供了宝贵的数据集和基准。
motivation: 真实生产油田缺乏故障日志，导致异常检测方法需要自行构造标签且容易引入未察觉的假设；现有的公开基准多来自故意诱发故障的测试台，无法反映真实复杂情况。
method: 使用无监督基准和一个小型双头模型（用于检测事件发生的时间及其类型），结合基于工程文档构建的物理接地异常标签进行训练与测试。
results: 无监督检测器无需标签也能标记出规则标注的区域，证明了标签并非任意设定；紧凑的监督模型在未见过的油井上能较好地恢复事件存在性和类型，但时间定位较为粗略。
conclusion: 通过结合工程文档构建物理可解释的异常标签，并利用无监督基准和双头监督模型进行验证，证明了真实油田数据中异常标签的可学习性与有效性，并开源了全部数据与代码。

title: Answer First, Reason Later: Commitment Order in Diffusion LLMs
authors: Jewon Yeom, Jaewon Sok, Seonghyeon Park, Jeongjae Park, Hwiyeong Lee, Taesup Kim
abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can commit tokens in any order -- a freedom marketed as their core advantage over autoregressive decoding. We show that on reasoning tasks this freedom is instead the axis of failure. Logging every commitment during decoding of LLaDA-8B on GSM8K, we find that unconstrained (pure) decoding commits the final answer at 15-24% of the trajectory while half the reasoning region is still masked, and collapses to answer-only outputs on up to 90% of problems as the canvas grows. The cause is not the model's termination beliefs -- EOS "pressure" is nearly identical across decoders -- but reachability: whether the sampler may act on those beliefs at distant positions. A 2x2 prompt-decoder design shows that chain-of-thought helps only under ordered commitment (interaction +34.8 percentage points, 95% CI [26.8, 42.8]; without reasoning text the decoders are indistinguishable), an interaction we decompose into a collapse channel and an order channel and replicate on Dream-7B and MATH-500. A single-knob intervention -- frontier-gated commitment -- causally recovers the full gap (0.528 to 0.852) while preserving up to 4x parallel decoding, along a measured frontier whose optimal window flips from w=1 at full refinement to unconstrained at 8 tokens/step. Our results reframe existing window-style samplers, previously motivated by efficiency, as the minimal fix for a reasoning pathology they were never designed to address.
zh_title: 先答后因：扩散大语言模型中的承诺顺序
translation: 掩码扩散语言模型（dLLMs）可以按任意顺序承诺Token——这一自由度被视为其相对于自回归解码的核心优势。然而，我们发现，在推理任务中，这种自由度反而是导致失败的关键。通过记录LLaDA-8B在GSM8K解码过程中的每一次承诺，我们发现无约束（纯）解码在15-24%的轨迹处就承诺了最终答案，而此时一半的推理区域仍被掩码，并且随着画布的扩大，高达90%的问题会崩溃为仅有答案的输出。其原因不是模型的终止信念（EOS“压力的”解码器几乎完全相同），而是可达性：采样器是否可以在遥远的位置根据这些信念采取行动。一个2x2的提示-解码设计表明，思维链（CoT）只有在有序承诺下才起作用（交互作用+34.8个百分点，95% CI [26.8, 42.8]；没有推理文本时解码器之间无法区分），我们将这种交互分解为一个崩溃通道和一个顺序通道，并在Dream-7B和MATH-500上进行了复现。单参数干预——前沿门控承诺（frontier-gated commitment）——在保持高达4倍并行解码的同时，因果性地恢复了全部性能差距（从0.528到0.852），其最优窗口从完全精炼时的w=1翻转为每步8个 Token的无约束状态。我们的研究结果重新审视了以往出于效率动机而设计的窗口式采样器，它们其实是解决从未被设计解决的推理病理的最小修复方案。
tldr: 扩散大语言模型在推理任务中自由承诺Token会导致失败，而通过引入“前沿门控承诺”机制则可以有效解决这一推理病理，大幅提升模型性能。
ai_comments: 该论文深入剖析了掩码扩散大语言模型在推理任务中非自回归生成自由度带来的缺陷，并创新性地提出了前沿门控承诺机制，为扩散模型的推理能力提升提供了新的视角和解决方案。
motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型在任何顺序下承诺Token的自由度被视为核心优势，但在推理任务中这反而成为了导致失败的关键因素，本文旨在揭示并解决这一推理病理。
method: 通过记录LLaDA-8B在GSM8K解码过程中的承诺情况，分析无约束解码的缺陷，并设计2x2提示-解码实验（验证Dream-7B和MATH-500），进而提出“前沿门控承诺”这一单旋钮干预方法。
results: 纯扩散解码会导致提前输出最终答案或答案崩溃；而通过前沿门控承诺干预，模型在保持高达4倍并行解码的同时，成功恢复了推理性能（从0.528提升至0.852）。
conclusion: 扩散语言模型在推理任务中需要受到约束的有序承诺才能发挥作用，前端门控承诺机制是解决这一问题的有效途径。

title: ASIDE: From Conflict Participants to Co-Observers Through Dyadic Spectator Reflection
authors: Xinyi Zhang, Jingting He, Zicheng Zhu, Yuxin Su
abstract: When people argue over text, they share a record of what was said but may hold different accounts of what it meant. Existing AI reflection tools typically work from one person's account, while dyadic tools support co-expression without making interpretation gaps inspectable. We present ASIDE, a system for Dyadic Spectator Reflection (DSR). DSR follows the sequence externalize independently, then encounter together. From a past chat conflict, ASIDE creates a pixel-art theatrical replay with revisable AI-generated inner-state hypotheses. Partners first confirm hypotheses about themselves and separately edit their interpretations of the other. After both finish, they view the co-annotated scene together and review Divergence Cards that pair a confirmed account with the partner's reading at a specific conversational beat. In an exploratory study with 10 couples who revisited real text-based conflicts, participants described the theatrical replay as helping them step out of their roles and observe the conflict together. We contribute DSR as a reusable interaction structure for dyadic reflection and an exploratory account of how partners used it to revisit past text-based conflicts from a shared observer position.
zh_title: ASIDE：通过二元旁观者反思从冲突参与者转变为共同观察者
translation: 当人们通过文字争论时，他们分享了所说内容的记录，但对于其含义可能有不同的理解。现有的AI反思工具通常基于一个人的陈述工作，而二元工具支持共同表达，却无法使解释上的差距变得可检查。我们提出了ASIDE，这是一个用于二元旁观者反思（DSR）的系统。DSR遵循“先独立外化，再共同面对”的顺序。针对过去的聊天冲突，ASIDE创建了一个像素艺术的戏剧重播，并配有可修改的AI生成的内心状态假设。伴侣首先确认关于他们自己的假设，并分别编辑他们对对方的解释。双方完成后，他们一起查看共同注释的场景，并审查将已确认的陈述与特定对话节拍下的对方解读配对的发散卡片。在一项对10对重新审视真实文本冲突的伴侣进行的探索性研究中，参与者描述戏剧重播有助于他们走出各自的角色并共同观察冲突。我们将DSR作为一种用于二元反思的可重用交互结构，并对伴侣如何使用它从共享的观察者位置重新审视过去的文本冲突进行了探索性说明。
tldr: ASIDE通过像素艺术重演和AI辅助的观点对齐，帮助伴侣将文字冲突转化为共同观察的体验。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了像素艺术戏剧重播（theatrical replay）和二元旁观者反思（DSR）机制，将冲突参与者转变为共同观察者，有效弥补了现有AI反思工具在处理双方解释差距时的不足。
motivation: 人们在通过文本争吵时往往持有不同的理解，现有的AI反思工具通常只处理单方观点，而双人工具虽支持共同表达却无法检查解释上的差距，因此需要一种能让双方弥合解释差距的二元反思机制。
method: 提出ASIDE系统，采用二元旁观者反思（DSR）方法。具体流程为：独立外化，共同面对；生成基于像素艺术的戏剧重播以及可修改的AI内态假设；双方各自确认自身假设并编辑对对方的理解；最后共同查看注释场景并审阅发散卡片（Divergence Cards）。
results: 在对10对经历过真实文本冲突的伴侣进行的探索性研究中，参与者表示戏剧重播帮助他们跳出了冲突角色，能够共同观察冲突。
conclusion: ASIDE系统及其背后的DSR方法成功帮助伴侣通过共享的观察者视角重新审视文本冲突，跳出冲突角色，具有良好的应用前景。

title: SciQNet: Two-Stage Multimodal Adaptation for Scientific Image Quality Assessment
authors: Yin-Loon Khor, Yi-Jie Wong, Jing Jie Tan, Ming Jie Lee
abstract: Scientific images are essential for communicating experimental observations, quantitative evidence and conceptual knowledge. Unlike natural images, their quality depends on both visual clarity and scientific informativeness, making assessment challenging. In this work, we present SciQNet, a two-stage multimodal adaptation framework for scientific image quality assessment. The first stage performs domain-adaptive pretraining on scientific document images and the second stage conducts task-specific fine-tuning with joint scoring and understanding supervision. For scoring-oriented supervision, we combine instruction tuning with a Huber loss derived from rating-word logits, while understanding-oriented supervision is formulated as multiple-choice visual question answering. Experiments show that using a 40% stratified subset of the domain-adaptive data gives the best performance among the evaluated pretraining fractions, suggesting that pretraining-data relevance may be as important as pretraining-data scale. The final model achieves an SIQA-S score of 92.21, an SIQA-U score of 47.38 and a combined score of 69.80. This work presents our solution to the ICME 2026 Scientific Image Quality Assessment Challenge, which ranked 2nd in the scoring track.
zh_title: SciQNet：用于科学图像质量评估的两阶段多模态适配框架
translation: 科学图像对于传达实验观察、定量证据和概念知识至关重要。与自然图像不同，它们的质量取决于视觉清晰度和科学信息量，这使得评估具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了SciQNet，这是一个用于科学图像质量评估的两阶段多模态适配框架。第一阶段在科学文档图像上进行领域自适应预训练，第二阶段通过联合评分和理解监督进行特定任务的微调。对于评分导向的监督，我们将指令调整与源自评级词logits的Huber损失相结合；而理解导向的监督则表达为多选视觉问答。实验表明，使用领域自适应数据40%的分层子集可获得评估预训练比例中的最佳性能，这表明预训练数据的相关性可能与预训练数据的规模同样重要。最终模型取得了92.21的SIQA-S得分、47.38的SIQA-U得分以及69.80的综合得分。这项工作展示了我们对ICME 2026科学图像质量评估挑战赛的解决方案，在评分赛道中排名第二。
tldr: 本文提出了SciQNet——一个针对科学图像质量评估的双阶段多模态框架，通过结合领域自适应预训练与双重监督微调，在ICME 2026挑战赛中获得评分赛道第二名。
ai_comments: 本文提出了一种针对科学图像质量评估的双阶段多模态适配框架SciQNet，巧妙地结合了领域自适应预训练与包含评分和理解的双任务微调，在ICME 2026挑战赛中获得了优异成绩，展现了多模态大模型在科学领域的应用潜力。
motivation: 科学图像的质量不仅取决于视觉清晰度，还取决于科学信息量，现有的自然图像质量评估方法难以应对这一挑战，因此需要专门的科学图像质量评估框架。
method: 提出SciQNet框架，包含两个阶段：第一阶段在科学文档图像上进行领域自适应预训练；第二阶段进行特定任务的微调，结合评分导向的监督（指令微调与Huber损失）和理解导向的监督（多选视觉问答）。
results: 使用40%分层子集的预训练数据表现最佳，表明预训练数据相关性与规模同样重要；最终模型取得了SIQA-S得分为92.21，SIQA-U得分为47.38，综合得分为69.80，在ICME 2026科学图像质量评估挑战赛评分赛道中排名第二。
conclusion: SciQNet是一个高效的科学图像质量评估双阶段多模态适配框架，在ICME 2026科学图像质量评估挑战赛的评分赛道中获得第二名。

title: DreamGuard: Efficient Runtime Guardrail for LLM Agents via Risk-Aware World Model
authors: Wenhao Lin, Chenyu Yu, Xingwei Lin, Sicong Cao, Xiang Chen, Lei Xue, Le Yu, Letian Sha, Chunming Wu
abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents increasingly invoke external tools and interact with real-world systems, unsafe actions may cause irreversible consequences on external states, user data, and downstream services. Recent runtime guardrails mitigate such risks by checking proposed actions before execution, but many remain reactive: they primarily assess the apparent safety of the current action, lacking an explicit model of how risk evolves across the trajectory. This limitation creates a critical blind spot for long-horizon risks, where individually benign-looking actions can gradually drift the agent toward hazardous states. In response, we propose DreamGuard, a proactive guardrail for LLM agents built around a risk-aware world model. The world model maintains a compact recurrent latent state over the trajectory and predicts future latent states from which DreamGuard derives immediate-hazard and prefix-risk evidence. It then fuses these multi-horizon signals into intervention decisions before execution. Experiments across four benchmarks and an online guardrail evaluation show that DreamGuard outperforms generic, reactive, and proactive guardrail baselines, achieves the best safety-utility trade-off among evaluated guardrails, and maintains an average end-to-end latency of 25 ms per call.
zh_title: DreamGuard：通过风险感知世界模型实现高效的 LLM 智能体运行时防护栏
translation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地调用外部工具并与真实世界系统交互，不安全的操作可能会对外部状态、用户数据和下游服务造成不可逆的后果。近期的运行时防护栏通过在执行前检查拟议的动作来缓解此类风险，但许多防护栏仍然是反应式的：它们主要评估当前动作的表面安全性，缺乏对风险如何在整个轨迹中演化的显式模型。这种局限性为长视距风险造成了一个关键的盲区，在长视距风险中，单个看起来良性的动作会逐渐将智能体引导至危险状态。为此，我们提出了 DreamGuard，这是一种围绕风险感知世界模型构建的 LLM 智能体主动式防护栏。该世界模型在整个轨迹上维护一个紧凑的循环潜状态，并预测未来的潜状态，DreamGuard 从中推导即时危害和前缀风险证据。然后，它将这些多视距信号融合到执行前的干预决策中。四个基准测试和在线防护栏评估的实验表明，DreamGuard 优于通用、反应式和主动式防护栏基线，在评估的防护栏中实现了最佳的安全-效用权衡，并保持了每调用平均 25 毫秒的端到端延迟。
tldr: DreamGuard 是一种针对大模型智能体的高效前瞻性防护栏，通过世界模型预测未来风险，解决了长视距累积风险问题，实现了高安全性与低延迟的平衡。
ai_comments: 该论文针对大模型智能体在长视距任务中面临的累积风险问题，提出了一种基于风险感知世界模型的运行时防护栏（DreamGuard）。其创新点在于通过循环潜状态预测未来风险，兼顾即时危害与前缀风险，在保障安全性的同时保持了极低的延迟（25ms），具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地调用外部工具，不安全的操作可能会对外部状态、用户数据等造成不可逆的后果。现有的运行时防护栏大多是反应式的，只评估当前动作的表面安全性，缺乏对风险如何随轨迹演化的显式建模，从而在长视距风险（良性动作者逐渐漂移至危险状态）上存在盲区。
method: 提出 DreamGuard，核心是构建一个风险感知世界模型，该模型在轨迹上维护一个紧凑的循环潜状态，预测未来潜状态，并从中推导即时危害和前缀风险证据，最终融合多视距信号进行执行前的干预决策。
results: 在四个基准测试和一个在线防护栏评估中，DreamGuard 的表现优于通用、反应式和主动式防护栏基线，实现了最佳的安全-效用权衡，并保持了平均每调用 25 ms 的端到端延迟。
conclusion: DreamGuard 是一种高效且具备前瞻性的 LLM 智能体运行时防护栏，通过风险感知世界模型有效解决了长视距任务中的累积风险盲区问题，实现了优异的安全-效用平衡和低延迟。

title: TAU-Bench: From Anomaly Instance Tracking to Fine-Grained Video Anomaly Understanding
authors: Kepeng Yang, Dongxuan Liu, Rongxin Gao, Zixin Su, Rui Wu, Shuzhao Xie, Chenxin Li, Panwang Pan, Yuzhi Huang, Yue Huang, Jingyan Jiang
abstract: Humans understand anomalous events through a coherent perceptual process in which they identify the focal instance, follow its behavior as the event unfolds, and interpret why it violates the expectations of the surrounding scene. Video anomaly understanding (VAU) seeks to endow models with a similar capability, moving beyond deciding whether a video is anomalous toward explaining how the event develops and why it matters. Although recent vision--language models (VLMs) can generate detailed and plausible anomaly descriptions, their semantic fluency does not ensure that these interpretations remain grounded in the correct anomaly instance over time. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate tracking and semantic understanding through separate protocols, leaving such instance--semantic inconsistency largely unmeasured. We therefore introduce TAU-Bench, a track-centric benchmark for jointly evaluating anomaly instance tracking and fine-grained anomaly understanding. TAU-Bench contains 1,118 videos, 1,454 tracks, and 202,438 pixel-level masks spanning 49 event and 45 scene categories, together with track-centric annotations that connect instance-level identification, event-level understanding, and scene-level reasoning. To build TAU-Bench at scale, we developed an automated data engine integrating anomaly suitability filtering, anomaly instance track construction, hierarchical caption annotation, and human quality control. Evaluations across representative VLM families show that models producing plausible anomaly interpretations may still fail to localize and track the correct instance reliably, revealing a persistent gap between semantic reasoning and visual grounding. These findings therefore highlight instance-grounded evaluation as an important step toward more faithful and reliable VAU systems.
zh_title: TAU-Bench：从异常实例跟踪到细粒度视频异常理解
translation: 人类通过一个连贯的感知过程来理解异常事件：他们识别焦点实例，随着事件展开跟随其行为，并解释为什么它违反了周围场景的预期。视频异常理解（VAU）旨在赋予模型类似的能力，超越判断视频是否异常，转向解释事件是如何发展以及它为什么重要。尽管近期的视觉语言模型（VLM）可以生成详细且合理的异常描述，但它们的语义流畅性并不能确保这些解释随时间推移始终扎根于正确的异常实例。现有的基准通常通过独立的协议评估跟踪和语义理解，使得这种实例-语义的不一致性在很大程度上无法被衡量。因此，我们引入了TAU-Bench，这是一个以轨迹为中心的基准，用于联合评估异常实例跟踪和细粒度异常理解。TAU-Bench包含1,118个视频、1,454个轨迹和202,438个像素级掩码，涵盖49个事件和45个场景类别，以及连接实例级识别、事件级理解和场景级推理的以轨迹为中心的标注。为了大规模构建TAU-Bench，我们开发了一个集成异常适宜性过滤、异常实例轨迹构建、分层字幕标注和人工质量控制的自动化数据引擎。对代表性VLM系列的评估表明，产生合理异常解释的模型可能仍然无法可靠地定位和跟踪正确的实例，揭示了语义推理和视觉接地之间持续存在的差距。因此，这些发现突出了基于实例的评估作为迈向更忠实、更可靠的VAU系统的重要一步。
tldr: 本文提出了TAU-Bench基准，用于联合评估视频异常实例跟踪与细粒度理解，揭示了当前视觉语言模型在实例定位与语义推理之间存在显著差距。
ai_comments: 该论文引入了TAU-Bench，首次将视频异常检测中的实例跟踪与细粒度语义理解结合起来，揭示了当前视觉语言模型（VLM）在视觉接地（visual grounding）和语义推理之间存在的不一致问题，对推动更可靠的视频异常理解系统具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型虽然能生成流畅的异常描述，但其语义流畅性不能保证解释能随时间准确扎根于正确的异常实例；同时，现有基准将跟踪和语义理解分开评估，未能衡量实例与语义的不一致性。
method: 开发了一个包含异常适宜性过滤、异常实例轨迹构建、分层字幕标注和人工质量控制的自动化数据引擎，构建了包含1,118个视频、1,454个轨迹和202,438个像素级掩码的TAU-Bench基准。
results: 对代表性VLM系列的评估表明，能够生成看似合理的异常解释的模型，仍然可能无法可靠地定位和跟踪正确的异常实例，揭示了语义推理与视觉接地之间的持续差距。
conclusion: TAU-Bench的引入填补了联合评估视频异常跟踪与细粒度理解的空白，实验表明现有VLM模型在实例定位和语义推理之间存在显著差距，指出了未来视觉异常理解系统的改进方向。

title: Wireless Linear Computation Broadcast
authors: Shuo Tan, Syed A. Jafar
abstract: A linear computation broadcast (LCBC) problem comprises $K$ users (receivers) and a transmitter. The users wish to compute various (vector) linear functions of a common dataset, and possess in advance heterogeneous side information corresponding to various other linear computations. The goal for the broadcast transmitter, who knows the dataset and all desired and side-information functions, is to satisfy all demands as efficiently as possible. Prior work has explored the information-theoretic capacity of LCBC for zero-error finite-field computation over an ideal (noiseless) broadcast channel (BC). This paper develops a wireless LCBC (WLCBC) framework for the Gaussian MIMO BC with noisy receiver-side information under a transmit power constraint and arbitrary antenna configurations. In the WLCBC setting, a Gaussian source is linearly precoded for broadcast; each user requests a linear function of the source and forms an estimate by linearly combining its channel observation with its noisy side information. Assuming perfect channel state information, we cast the centralized joint linear transceiver design as a weighted sum-MSE minimization problem and propose an efficient alternating optimization algorithm. For a fixed precoder, the optimal decoders are the linear minimum mean-square error (LMMSE) estimators. For fixed decoders, the precoder update reduces to a convex quadratically constrained quadratic program which leads to a semi-closed-form solution parameterized by a single dual variable. The resulting algorithm guarantees a monotonic decrease in the objective and convergence of the weighted sum-MSE (WSMSE) objective sequence. Simulations demonstrate pronounced robustness gains over natural baselines obtained from prior works.
zh_title: 无线线性计算广播
translation: 线性计算广播（LCBC）问题包含 $K$ 个用户（接收端）和一个发射端。用户希望计算公共数据集的各种（向量）线性函数，并预先拥有对应于其他各种线性计算的异构侧信息。广播发射端知道数据集以及所有期望函数和侧信息函数，其目标是尽可能高效地满足所有需求。先前的研究探讨了理想（无噪）广播信道（BC）上零误码有限域计算的LCBC信息论容量。本文针对具有带噪接收端侧信息、发送功率约束和任意天线配置的高斯MIMO BC，构建了无线LCBC（WLCBC）框架。在WLCBC设置中，高斯信源被线性预编码以进行广播；每个用户请求信源的一个线性函数，并通过将其信道观测与带噪侧信息进行线性组合来形成估计。在假设完美信道状态信息的情况下，我们将集中式联合线性收发机设计构建为加权和均方误差（WSMSE）最小化问题，并提出了一种高效的交替优化算法。对于固定预编码器，最优解码器为线性最小均方误差（LMMSE）估计器；对于固定解码器，预编码器更新简化为凸二次约束二次规划（QCQP），从而得到由单个对偶变量参数化的半闭合解。所提算法保证了目标函数的单调递减和WSMSE目标序列的收敛性。仿真表明，相比于基于先前工作的自然基线，该方法具有显著的稳健性增益。
tldr: 本文提出了高斯MIMO信道下的无线线性计算广播（WLCBC）框架，通过交替优化和半闭合解求解联合收发机设计，实现了稳健的计算估计性能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将传统的理想信道线性计算广播扩展到了高斯MIMO无线信道，并考虑了带噪侧信息与功率约束等实际限制。提出基于WSMSE最小化的交替优化算法，结合LMMSE解码与凸QCQP的半闭合解，数学推导严谨且收敛性好。局限性在于其假设了完美信道状态信息（CSI），在实际信道估计存在误差时可能需要进一步探讨鲁棒设计。
motivation: 先前的线性计算广播（LCBC）研究主要针对理想无噪信道和有限域下的无差错计算，无法直接应用于包含加性噪声、功率约束以及带噪侧信息的高斯MIMO无线广播信道。
method: 将完美CSI条件下的集中式联合线性收发机设计建模为加权和均方误差（WSMSE）最小化问题，并提出交替优化算法：固定预编码器时采用LMMSE解码器；固定解码器时将预编码器更新转化为凸二次约束二次规划（QCQP），导出由单个对偶变量参数化的半闭合解。
results: 所提交替优化算法保证了目标函数的单调递减和WSMSE序列的收敛性；仿真实验表明，与基于先前研究建立的基线方法相比，该方案展现出了显著的稳健性增益。
conclusion: 本文成功建立了带噪侧信息下的高斯MIMO无线线性计算广播框架，并提出了收敛且高效的联合收发机优化算法，显著提升了无线计算系统的鲁棒性与性能。

title: G$^2$ARD-GS: Geometry-Guided Anchor-Regularized Gaussian Splatting Distillation
authors: Puyuan Zhang, Jianming Huang, Wenkai Ye, Wei Dong
abstract: Dense colored LiDAR maps provide accurate city-scale geometry, but lifting them into 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) retains millions of primitives, making the resulting models costly to store, transmit, render, and adapt. Aggressive primitive reduction alleviates this burden, but can remove the local surface support needed for stable novel-view synthesis and downstream geometric use. We introduce G$^2$ARD-GS, a geometry-guided distillation method that converts a dense Gaussian prior instantiated either as a training-free point-cloud lift or a trained GS model into a compact, reusable representation. G$^2$ARD-GS progressively consolidates the prior into surface-aware representatives, then recovers appearance on the resulting fixed topology under construction-time anchor constraints, with no primitives added or removed during recovery. Under limited supervision, geometry-aware view selection allocates the available view budget. On MatrixCity, G$^2$ARD-GS achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS across matched $5\times$--$30\times$ compression budgets, outperforming PUP by $3.2$--$6.8$,dB in PSNR. When reused as frozen geometry, the compact model improves off-trajectory appearance adaptation by $3.7$--$4.9$,dB over PUP 3D-GS and preserves image-to-model registration accuracy on Cambridge KingsCollege at $30\times$ compression. Project page: https://patrick1159.github.io/gardGS-page/.
zh_title: G^2ARD-GS：几何引导的锚点正则化高斯溅射蒸馏
translation: 密集彩色LiDAR地图提供了精确的城市级几何结构，但将其提升为3D高斯溅射（3DGS）会保留数百万个图元，导致所得模型的存储、传输、渲染和适应成本高昂。激进的图元约简可以减轻这一负担，但也可能会移除稳定新视点合成和下游几何应用所需的局部表面支持。我们介绍了G$^2$ARD-GS，这是一种几何引导的蒸馏方法，它将密集的高斯先验（实例化为免训练的点云提升或已训练的GS模型）转换为紧凑、可复用的表示。G$^2$ARD-GS逐步将先验合并为表面感知的代表，然后在构建时锚点约束下的固定拓扑上恢复外观，在恢复过程中不增加或减少图元。在监督有限的情况下，几何感知视点选择会分配可用的视点预算。在MatrixCity上，G$^2$ARD-GS在匹配的 $5\times$--$30\times$ 压缩预算下实现了最佳的PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS，在PSNR上比PUP高出 $3.2$--$6.8$ dB。当作为冻结几何复用时，紧凑的模型将离轨外观适应性比PUP 3D-GS提高了 $3.7$--$4.9$ dB，并在 $30\times$ 压缩下保持了剑桥KingsCollege上的图像到模型的配准精度。
tldr: 提出G2ARD-GS方法，通过几何引导蒸馏将城市级密集3D高斯模型压缩高达30倍，同时在渲染、外观适应和几何精度上超越现有方法。
ai_comments: 该论文针对城市级密集激光雷达地图在转换为3D高斯溅射时面临的存储和渲染开销大、图元数量多的痛点，提出了一种几何引导的锚点正则化蒸馏方法。其创新之处在于通过表面感知代表的逐步合并以及固定拓扑下的外观恢复，实现了高达30倍的压缩，同时在外观适应和几何精度上表现优异。
motivation: 将密集彩色LiDAR地图提升为3D高斯溅射（3DGS）会产生数百万个图元，导致存储、传输、渲染和适应成本高昂。虽然激进的图元约简可以缓解这一负担，但往往会移除稳定新视点合成和下游几何应用所需的局部表面支持。
method: 提出G2ARD-GS几何引导蒸馏方法：首先将密集高斯先验逐步合并为表面感知代表，然后在构建时锚点约束下于固定拓扑恢复外观（不增减图元），并结合几何感知的视点选择来分配有限的监督视点。
results: 在MatrixCity数据集上，在匹配的5×至30×压缩预算下，G2ARD-GS实现了最佳的PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS，PSNR比PUP高出3.2至6.8 dB；当作为冻结几何复用时，离轨外观适应性提升了3.7至4.9 dB，并在30×压缩下保持了剑桥KingsCollege上的图模配准精度。
conclusion: G2ARD-GS通过几何引导的蒸馏与锚点正则化策略，成功将高密度城市3DGS先验压缩为紧凑且可复用的模型，在大幅降低存储和渲染成本的同时，显著提升了新视点合成质量、跨轨迹适应能力和几何配准精度。

title: StreamArena: Toward Continuous, Interactive, and Long-Horizon Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
authors: Xichen Zhang, Guankai Li, Yinghao Zhu, Shijian Wang, Sitong Wu, Shaozuo Yu, Meng Chu, Yuan Lu, Jiaya Jia
abstract: Deploying autonomous multimodal agents in continuous, real-world environments requires them to ingest unbounded audio-visual streams and maintain hour-scale memory. However, current evaluations predominantly rely on brief clips and multiple-choice formats. This design allows minimal baselines that process only the last four frames to match or surpass complex streaming models, while answer options also expose language shortcuts. We introduce StreamArena, a benchmark for hour-scale, interactive streaming video understanding. StreamArena contains 243 full-length videos averaging 88.8 minutes and 3,646 rigorously annotated, open-ended question-answer pairs that evaluate real-time perception, historical retrospection, proactive interaction, and multimodal tool utilization. Evaluation across diverse systems exposes a tension between continuous interaction and long-horizon multimodal comprehension. Methods that retain only recent frames cannot recover distant events, methods that convert past observations into text lose visual evidence, and methods that repeatedly compress visual memory struggle to preserve fine-grained details over time. We address this tension with StreamMind, a two-tier architecture that assigns latency-critical interaction and proactive monitoring to independently scheduled frontend workers, while backend workers asynchronously construct persistent multimodal memory and perform historical recall and external search. StreamMind outperforms existing streaming baselines across all four capabilities and reduces query-to-answer latency by reusing persistent state.
zh_title: StreamArena：迈向持续、交互式与长视野的智能体流式视频理解
translation: 在连续、真实的环境中部署自主多模态智能体，要求它们能够摄取无界的视听流并维持小时级的记忆。然而，当前的评估主要依赖简短的剪辑和多项选择题。这种设计使得仅处理最后四帧的极简基线能够匹配甚至超过复杂的流式模型，同时答案选项也暴露了语言捷径。我们引入了 StreamArena，这是一个用于小时级、交互式流式视频理解的基准。StreamArena 包含 243 个全长视频（平均时长 88.8 分钟）和 3646 个经过严格注释的开放式问答对，用于评估实时感知、历史回顾、主动交互和多模态工具利用能力。对各种系统的评估揭示了持续交互与长视野多模态理解之间的张力。仅保留最近帧的方法无法恢复遥远的事件，将过去观察转换为文本的方法会丢失视觉证据，而重复压缩视觉记忆的方法难以随时间推移保留细粒度细节。我们用 StreamMind解决了这种张力，这是一个两层架构，它将延迟关键的交互和主动监控分配给独立调度的前端工作器，同时后端工作器异步构建持久的多模态记忆并执行历史回忆和外部搜索。StreamMind 在所有四项能力上均优于现有的流式基线，并通过复用持久状态降低了从查询到答案的延迟。
tldr: 本文推出了用于评估小时级流式视频理解的基准StreamArena以及创新架构StreamMind，有效平衡了实时交互与长时多模态记忆。
ai_comments: 本文针对当前流式视频理解评测局限于短片段和多项选择题的痛点，提出了StreamArena基准以及StreamMind两层架构。创新点在于通过长达数小时的连续、交互式、开放式评估暴露了现有模型的瓶颈，并利用前后端分离架构兼顾了实时交互与长期多模态记忆，具有很强的实用价值和启发意义。
motivation: 现有的流式视频理解评估主要依赖简短片段和多项选择题，导致当前基线模型忽略了长时记忆和连续交互能力。为了在真实连续环境中部署自主多模态智能体，需要一个支持小时级、交互式、长视野视频理解的基准和相应的系统架构。
method: 提出StreamArena基准（包含243个平均时长88.8分钟的完整视频和3646个开放式问答对）以及StreamMind架构（包含独立调度的前端工作器负责实时交互和主动监控，以及异步构建持久记忆和执行历史回忆的后端工作器）。
results: 对现有系统的评估暴露了连续交互与长视野多模态理解之间的矛盾；而StreamMind在所有四项能力上均优于现有的流式基线，并通过复用持久状态降低了查询到答案的延迟。
conclusion: StreamArena和StreamMind有效填补了连续、交互式、长视野代理流式视频理解评测与系统设计的空白，揭示并缓解了实时交互与长期多模态理解之间的固有矛盾。

title: SEAM: Global consistency beyond local accuracy in scientific machine learning
authors: Gnankan Landry Regis N'guessan, Bum Jun Kim
abstract: Scientific machine learning commonly validates models at the level of a subdomain, a benchmark split, or an explanation for one prediction. Yet such local checks cannot establish whether the resulting explanations can be assembled into one globally admissible explanation. We introduce Scientific Explanation-Admissibility Machines (SEAM), a generator-agnostic framework that makes this local-to-global consistency question computable across regions, sensors, regimes, and model components. The finite explanation-sheaf instantiation SEAM-$Ω$ represents each region by a structured explanation with state, closure, and observation channels together with optional contract metadata; compares neighboring explanations on their overlaps; and converts disagreement into a channel-resolved obstruction. This obstruction locates inconsistency and tests competing declared accounts by restricting each repair to the revisions that one account permits. Exact feasibility refutes or retains an account; when exact repair is unavailable, residual-aware regularized records provide a separately labeled empirical attribution. The framework also separates inconsistency from non-identifiability and monitors learned generators under distribution shift. We establish theorems for minimum-cost intervention and conservation-contract detectability, together with companion results for identifiability and closure recoverability. Across nineteen experiments involving synthetic partial differential equation systems and out-of-distribution Fourier neural operator (FNO) monitoring, SEAM detects incompatible explanations even when local predictions are accurate, and attributes failures to specific channels and overlaps. SEAM adds a global explanation-consistency audit to existing solvers and learning models, testing whether their local explanations form a coherent scientific account.
zh_title: SEAM：科学机器学习中超越局部准确性的全局一致性
translation: 科学机器学习通常在子域、基准划分或单个预测的解释层面上验证模型。然而，这类局部检查无法确立由此产生的解释是否能够组合成一个全局可采纳的解释。我们引入了科学解释可采纳性机器（SEAM），这是一个与生成器无关的框架，使得跨区域、传感器、机制和模型组件的“局部到全局”一致性问题变得可计算。有限解释-层实例化（SEAM-$\Omega$）通过状态、闭包和观测通道以及可选的契约元数据来表示每个区域的结构化解释，比较相邻解释的重叠部分，并将分歧转化为通道解析的障碍。该障碍可定位不一致性，并通过将每次修复限制在某个科学账户允许的范围内来测试竞争的声明账户。精确的可行性检验可以反驳或保留一个账户；当无法进行精确修复时，残差感知正则化记录提供了一个单独标记的经验归因。该框架还将不一致性与不可识别性区分开来，并监测分布偏移下的学习生成器。我们为最小代价干预和守恒契约可探测性建立了定理，并附带了关于可识别性和闭包可恢复性的结果。在涉及合成偏微分方程系统和分布外傅里叶神经算子（FNO）监测的十九项实验中，SEAM检测到了不兼容的解释（即使局部预测是准确的），并将故障归因于特定的通道和重叠部分。SEAM为现有的求解器和学习模型添加了全局解释一致性审计，测试其局部解释是否构成了连贯的科学账户。
tldr: SEAM是一个评估科学机器学习模型全局解释一致性的新框架，能够在局部预测准确时检测出全局物理或逻辑冲突。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将代数拓扑和层论（Sheaf theory）思想引入科学机器学习中，解决了长期以来局部预测准确但全局解释不一致的难题。通过引入SEAM框架，能够有效定位模型在区域、传感器或物理机制交界处的冲突，对科学机器学习的可靠性具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的科学机器学习通常在子域、基准集或单个预测层面验证模型，然而这些局部的检查无法确立这些局部的解释是否能够组合成一个全局可采纳的统一解释。
method: 引入了科学解释可采纳性机器（SEAM），使用有限解释-层实例化（SEAM-$\Omega$）表示区域解释，比较相邻重叠区域，将分歧转化为通道解析的障碍，并利用最小代价干预和守恒合同可检测性定理进行严格的可行性测试和正则化修复。
results: 在涉及合成偏微分方程系统和分布外傅里叶神经算子（FNO）监控的19项实验中，SEAM能够在局部预测准确的情况下检测出不兼容的解释，并将故障归因于特定渠道和重叠区域。
conclusion: SEAM框架成功将局部的科学机器学习解释转化为可计算的全局一致性审计，能够有效检测局部准确模型中的全局不一致性，并精确定位故障渠道。

title: Constrained Correlation Clustering: Towards Optimality
authors: Sina Azizeddin, Evangelos Kipouridis, Nithin Varma
abstract:
In the Correlation Clustering problem, we are given an undirected graph and are tasked with computing a clustering (partition of the nodes) that minimizes the number of violated pairs (edges across different clusters plus non-edges within clusters). In the constrained version of this problem, the goal is to compute a clustering that satisfies additional hard constraints mandating certain pairs to be in the same cluster and certain pairs to be in different clusters.
  In this work, we identify Constrained Correlation Clustering as a variant of Correlation Clustering for which optimal approximations might be within reach, and make progress towards this front. Constrained Correlation Clustering is APX-Hard, and the optimal approximation factor is known to lie in $(\frac{24}{23},3]$. We significantly tighten this gap, by showing that the optimal approximation factor lies in $[2,\frac{16}{7}-γ)$ for a small constant $γ>0$. Our lower bound of $2$ shows a separation between Correlation Clustering (which admits an $1.485+ε$ approximation) and Constrained Correlation Clustering\footnote{The same hardness result was obtained independently by Cao and Xu~\cite{cao2026clusterdeletionhardapproximate}.}. Our upper bound of $\frac{16}{7}-γ$ uses the Sherali-Adams relaxation and goes beyond straightforward Triangle-Based analysis; more precisely, our algorithm belongs to a natural class of pivoting algorithms for which we prove that a straightforward Triangle-Based analysis cannot prove a better-than-$\frac{16}{7}$ approximation.
  Finally, as a byproduct of our techniques, we completely resolve the approximability of Cluster Deletion. Cluster Deletion is a well-studied special case of Constrained Correlation Clustering for which a $2$-approximation algorithm is known. We show that this is optimal, as our lower bound holds even for this special case.
comment: The same hardness result was obtained independently by Cao and Xu~\cite{cao2026clusterdeletionhardapproximate}
zh_title: 受限关联聚类：迈向最优性
translation:
在关联聚类问题中，给定一个无向图，我们的任务是计算一个聚类（节点的划分），以最小化违背对的数量（跨不同聚类的边加上聚类内的非边）。在该问题的受限版本中，目标是计算满足额外硬约束的聚类，这些约束强制某些对必须在同一个聚类中，而某些对必须在不同的聚类中。
在这项工作中，我们认为受限关联聚类是关联聚类的一个变体，对于该变体，最优近似可能是触手可及的，并在这方面取得了进展。受限关联聚类是APX-Hard的，已知其最优近似因子介于 $(\frac{24}{23},3]$ 之间。我们通过证明最优近似因子介于 $[2,\frac{16}{7}-γ)$（其中 $γ>0$ 是一个小常数）之间，显著缩小了这一差距。我们的下限 $2$ 表明了关联聚类（允许 $1.485+ε$ 近似）与受限关联聚类之间的分离。我们的上限 $\frac{16}{7}-γ$ 使用了 Sherali-Adams 松弛，超越了直接基于三角形的分析；更确切地说，我们的算法属于一类自然的pivoting算法，我们证明了对于该类算法，直接的基于三角形的分析无法证明优于 $\frac{16}{7}$ 的近似。
最后，作为我们技术的副产品，我们完全解决了团删除（Cluster Deletion）的可近似性。团删除是受限关联聚类一个研究得很好的特例，已知存在一个 $2$-近似算法。我们表明这是最优的，因为我们的下限甚至对这个特例也成立。
tldr: 本文将约束关联聚类的最优近似比范围大幅收紧至 $[2, \frac{16}{7}-γ)$，证明了其下限为2，并彻底解决了Cluster Deletion问题的最优近似性。
ai_comments: 该论文在约束关联聚类（Constrained Correlation Clustering）领域取得了重要突破，通过改进下限和上限显著缩小了其最优近似比的差距，并彻底解决了经典问题Cluster Deletion的近似最优性。其方法超越了传统的基于三角形的分析，具有很高的理论价值。
motivation: 探究带有硬约束的关联聚类（Constrained Correlation Clustering）的最优近似边界，并理解约束条件对聚类问题近似难度的影响。
method: 利用Sherali-Adams松弛技术，超越传统的基于三角形的分析，并设计了一类自然的pivoting算法来推导上限；通过理论归约和构造证明下限。
results: 将约束关联聚类的最优近似比区间从 $(\frac{24}{23}, 3]$ 显著收紧至 $[2, \frac{16}{7}-γ)$，证明了其下限为2（与无约束关联聚类形成分离），并彻底解决并证明了Cluster Deletion问题2-近似的最优性。
conclusion: 本文显著收紧了约束关联聚类的近似比边界，证明了其下限为2（与无约束情况形成分离），并给出了基于Sherali-Adams松弛的改进上限，同时完全解决了Cluster Deletion问题的最优近似性。

title: Shaping Human-AI Interactions to Provide Improvement Pathways and Balance Competing Objectives
authors: Keziah Naggita
abstract: When an AI system is deployed, the individuals who use and or are evaluated by it form beliefs about how the system operates and use those beliefs to strategically present their preferences, behaviors, or attributes. The system then responds with feedback or a decision outcome, thereby creating a human-AI interaction loop. This thesis studies how to design and shape such interactions to achieve three goals: (1) help individuals develop accurate beliefs about the AI systems so they can improve and or secure favorable outcomes at minimal cost, (2) encourage improvement and or discourage gaming behaviors, and (3) ensure that the AI system continues to achieve its intended objectives, such as maximizing accuracy. To address these goals, the thesis is organized into three complementary parts that examine and study human-AI interactions from the perspectives of both evaluated individuals and AI systems. Together, the work presented in this thesis advances human-centered machine learning by providing principles and methods for designing AI systems that align with human needs, values, and capabilities. Methodologically, this thesis integrates theoretical analysis, data-driven modeling, human-subject experiments, and empirical evaluations on real-world and semi-synthetic datasets.
zh_title: 塑造人机交互以提供改进途径并平衡竞争目标
translation: 当AI系统部署后，使用或被其评估的个人会对其运作方式形成信念，并利用这些信念来策略性地展现其偏好、行为或属性。随后，系统通过反馈或决策结果进行响应，从而产生人机交互循环。本论文研究如何设计和塑造此类交互以实现三个目标：（1）帮助个人对AI系统建立准确的信念，以便他们能够以最小的成本改进和/或获得有利的结果；（2）鼓励改进和/或阻止博弈（欺骗）行为；（3）确保AI系统继续实现其预期的目标，例如最大化准确性。为了实现这些目标，本论文分为三个互补的部分，分别从被评估个人和AI系统的角度检查和研究人机交互。总之，本论文中呈现的工作通过提供符合人类需求、价值观和能力的设计AI系统的原则和方法，推进了以人为中心的机器学习。在方法论上，本论文整合了理论分析、数据驱动建模、人类受试者实验以及对真实世界和半合成数据集的实证评估。
tldr: 该论文研究如何设计人机交互机制，在确保AI系统目标实现的同时，帮助用户改进并抑制投机行为。
ai_comments: 该论文从人机交互的循环视角出发，创新性地平衡了AI系统效能与个体行为优化，对于构建更加公平、透明且高效的人机协作系统具有重要意义。
motivation: 研究在AI系统部署后，个体与AI形成交互循环时，如何设计和塑造这种交互，以帮助个体以最小成本获得有利结果、鼓励真实改进并抑制欺骗行为、同时确保AI实现其预期目标（如最大化准确性）。
method: 集成了理论分析、数据驱动建模、人类受试者实验以及在真实世界和半合成数据集上的实证评估。
results: 提出了能够帮助个体建立准确信念、鼓励实质性改进并维持AI系统预期目标的设计原则和方法，推进了以人为中心的机器学习领域的发展。
conclusion: 该论文通过理论与实证相结合的方法，为设计契合人类需求、价值观与能力的人机交互AI系统提供了关键的原则与方法论。

title: Spectral Aliasing Pretext: A novel task for Self-Supervised fault diagnosis in rotating machinery
authors: Victor Gialis, Maxime Metz, David Esteve, Abdenour Soualhi
abstract: Deep learning is a new way for machinery fault diagnosis but requires extensive labeled data, a scarce resource in industrial settings. We propose Spectral Aliasing Pretext (SAP), a self-supervised learning method that pretrains models on unlabeled vibration data by exploiting spectral aliasing. We deliberately undersample signals to create folded spectrum, then train a Transformer to reconstruct the original unfolded spectrum. This pretext task forces the model to learn frequency-domain invariants characteristic of mechanical faults, without potentially destructive augmentations. Experiments on the CWRU dataset show that SAP learns stable and highly discriminative representations. In a linear probing setting, SAP quickly achieves very high classification performance with only a small fraction of labeled data and low variance. In contrast, full fine-tuning, including fully supervised training, does not lead to more stable or better results. Overall, these findings suggest that SAP combined with linear probing can be more effective and reliable than fully supervised training for fault diagnosis with limited labeled data.
zh_title: 频谱混叠 pretext：旋转机械自监督故障诊断的新任务
translation: 深度学习是机械故障诊断的新方法，但需要大量的标记数据，这在工业环境中是稀缺资源。我们提出了频谱混叠预训练（SAP），这是一种通过利用频谱混叠在未标记振动数据上预训练模型的自监督学习方法。我们故意对信号进行欠采样以产生折叠频谱，然后训练Transformer来重建原始的未折叠频谱。这个预训练任务迫使模型学习机械故障特征的频域不变量，而无需进行潜在破坏性的数据增强。在CWRU数据集上的实验表明，SAP学习到了稳定且高度可区分的表示。在线性探测设置下，SAP仅用一小部分标记数据和低方差就迅速获得了非常高的分类性能。相比之下，全监督微调（包括完全监督训练）并没有带来更稳定或更好的结果。总体而言，这些发现表明，在标签数据有限的情况下，SAP结合线性探测比完全监督训练更有效、更可靠。
tldr: 提出了一种利用频谱混叠进行自监督预训练的新方法（SAP），在旋转机械故障诊断中，仅需少量标注数据即可实现高效且稳定的分类性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地利用了信号处理中的“频谱混叠”现象作为自监督学习的预训练任务，无需破坏性数据增强，即可让模型学习到机械故障的频域特征，非常契合工业界标签稀缺的痛点。
motivation: 工业环境中深度学习所需的标注数据严重匮乏，而现有的自监督方法可能需要破坏性的数据增强，因此需要一种更有效、更符合物理特性的无监督预训练方法来提升故障诊断的性能。
method: 提出一种名为Spectral Aliasing Pretext (SAP)的自监督学习方法，通过故意对振动信号进行欠采样以产生折叠频谱，并训练Transformer模型来重建原始的未折叠频谱。
results: 在CWRU数据集上的实验表明，SAP能够学习到稳定且极具区分度的表征；在仅需极少量标注数据的线性探测设置下，该方法迅速达到了极高的分类性能且方差较低。
conclusion: 结合SAP预训练与线性探测的方法，在旋转机械故障诊断任务中表现出优于全监督训练的高效性与鲁棒性，特别适用于小样本场景。

title: LAWM-3D: Learning 3D-Aware Latent Actions from Human Videos for Generalizable Robot World Models
authors: Jiarui Yang, Jiale Zhange, Jiawei Li, Hang Guo, Wen Huang, Jinpeng Wang, Peidong Liu, Shu-Tao Xia
abstract: World models enable agents to perform forward rollout and planning without real-world interaction. However, their application in open-world embodied intelligence remains limited by the high cost of action annotations and the heterogeneity of action spaces across platforms. Recently, latent action models (LAMs) have alleviated this bottleneck by learning action representations directly from unlabeled human videos in a self-supervised manner. Nevertheless, most existing LAMs rely on single-view inputs and operate primarily in 2D pixel space, raising a fundamental question: can simply incorporating multi-view videos into LAM training endow the learned latent actions with 3D-aware perception? Our study shows that the answer is negative. The primary reasons lie in future-frame appearance leakage as well as inter-camera appearance discrepancies and viewpoint variations. To address these issues, we propose LAWM-3D, which introduces three tightly coupled key designs: (1) a multi-view invariant unified action tokenization scheme for learning 3D-aware latent actions; (2) a geometric alignment constraint that anchors intermediate encoder features to a pretrained 3D foundation model, thereby explicitly providing cross-view geometric correspondences; and (3) a non-injective RGB-D joint reconstruction objective that prevents shortcut learning from future-frame appearance information, forcing the LAM to focus supervision on motion cues with geometric significance. Importantly, these components are not simply stacked but are tightly coupled through a unified motivation. Built upon a two-stage paradigm of large-scale human video pretraining followed by robot fine-tuning, extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed 3D-aware latent actions significantly improve world model performance, achieving SOTA results in generation quality, physical consistency, and generalization ability.
zh_title: LAWM-3D：从人类视频中学习3D感知的隐动作以构建可泛化的机器人世界模型
translation: 世界模型使智能体能够在无需与现实世界交互的情况下进行前向展开和规划。然而，它们在开放世界具身智能中的应用仍受到高昂动作标注成本以及跨平台动作空间异构性的限制。最近，隐动作模型（LAMs）通过直接从无标签人类视频中以自监督方式学习动作表示，缓解了这一瓶颈。然而，大多数现有的LAM依赖于单视图输入，主要在2D像素空间中运行，这引发了一个根本性问题：简单地将多视点视频纳入LAM训练能否赋予学习到的隐动作以3D感知能力？我们的研究表明答案是否定的。主要原因在于未来帧外观泄露以及相机间外观差异和视点变化。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了LAWM-3D，它引入了三个紧密耦合的关键设计：（1）用于学习3D感知隐动作的多视点不变统一动作标记化方案；（2）将中间编码器特征锚定到预训练3D基础模型的几何对齐约束，从而显式提供跨视点几何对应关系；以及（3）非单射RGB-D联合重建目标，该目标可防止从未来帧外观信息中进行捷径学习，迫使LAM将监督重点放在具有几何意义的运动线索上。重要的是，这些组件并非简单堆叠，而是通过统一的动机紧密耦合。基于大规模人类视频预训练后接机器人微调的两阶段范式，大量实验证明，所提出的3D感知隐动作显著提升了世界模型的性能，在生成质量、物理一致性和泛化能力方面取得了SOTA结果。
tldr: LAWM-3D通过引入多视点不变动作标记化、几何对齐和RGB-D联合重建，从人类视频中学习3D感知的隐动作，显著提升了机器人世界模型的泛化性和物理一致性。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将多视点视频与3D几何先验引入隐动作模型（LAM）中，通过提出LAWM-3D解决了未来帧外观泄露和跨相机视角变化带来的挑战，显著提升了机器人世界模型在泛化性与物理一致性方面的性能。
motivation: 现有的隐动作模型（LAMs）多依赖单视图输入并在2D像素空间中运行，而直接将多视点视频引入LAM训练无法自然带来3D感知能力（受未来帧外观泄露和跨相机外观差异等问题影响），因此需要设计一种专门的方法来学习具备3D感知能力的隐动作，以提升机器人世界模型的泛化能力。
method: 提出了LAWM-3D，包含三个核心设计：(1) 多视点不变的统一动作标记化方案；(2) 将中间特征锚定到预训练3D基础模型的几何对齐约束；(3) 防止未来帧外观泄露的非单射RGB-D联合重建目标。采用“大规模人类视频预训练+机器人微调”的两阶段范式。
results: 大量实验表明，所提出的3D-aware隐动作显著提升了世界模型的性能，在生成质量、物理一致性和泛化能力方面均达到了SOTA（最先进）水平。
conclusion: LAWM-3D通过结合多视点不变的动作标记化、几何对齐约束和非单射RGB-D联合重建目标，成功学习到了3D感知的隐动作，并在机器人世界模型任务中取得了SOTA的效果。

title: One Ranking, Any Budget: Matryoshka Evidence-to-Context Frame Selection for Long-Video Understanding
authors: Wang Chen, Yu Chen, Xiang Wang, Shuai Li, Jinfa Huang, Xiawu Zheng
abstract: Frame selection is essential for applying Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) to long videos due to severe frame redundancy and limited context windows. Since the appropriate frame budget varies with the downstream LMM, reasoning demands, and latency constraints, a practical selector should serve multiple budgets. However, existing methods typically optimize an isolated frame subset for each predefined budget: when the budget changes, previously selected evidence may be replaced rather than progressively augmented. Ranking frames by a fixed score would allow prefix reuse across budgets, but it ignores the distinct roles of different ranking positions. In this paper, we formulate long-video frame selection as a Matryoshka ranking problem: constructing a single priority sequence whose small prefixes concentrate query-conditioned evidence, while progressively larger prefixes preserve this evidence and add broader temporal context. Efficiently constructing such a ranking is itself challenging, as densely sampling long videos and evaluating frame-query relevance incurs substantial overhead. We therefore introduce Matryoshka Evidence-to-Context (MEC) Frame Selection, a training-free framework that builds a reusable sparse video index, discovers candidates through sparse probing and local zooming, and greedily constructs a position-adaptive ranking: early positions emphasize evidence; later positions progressively favor temporal coverage while preserving visual diversity. A single ranking can thus be truncated to any target budget without rerunning the selector. Across four benchmarks and six frame budgets, MEC improves average accuracy over uniform sampling by 3.77 percentage points, matches strong state-of-the-art selectors, and reduces end-to-end selection latency by 47.37-51.19%.
zh_title: 单一排名，任意预算：长视频理解的套娃式证据-上下文帧选择
translation: 由于严重的帧冗余和有限的上下文窗口，帧选择对于将大型多模态模型（LMMs）应用于长视频至关重要。由于适当的帧预算随下游LMM、推理需求和延迟约束而变化，一个实用的选择器应该服务于多个预算。然而，现有方法通常为每个预定义的预算优化一个孤立的帧子集：当预算改变时，先前选择的证据往往被替换而不是逐步增加。按固定分数对帧进行排序可以实现跨预算的前缀复用，但它忽略了不同排名位置的不同作用。在本文中，我们将长视频帧选择建模为一个套娃（Matryoshka）排名问题：构建一个单一的优先级序列，其较小的头部前缀集中了查询条件证据，而逐渐变大的前缀则保留了这些证据并增加了更广泛的时间上下文。然而，高效构建这样的排名本身就具有挑战性，因为对长视频进行密集采样和评估帧-查询相关性会带来巨大的开销。因此，我们引入了Matryoshka Evidence-to-Context（MEC）帧选择，这是一个无需训练的框架，它构建可重用的稀疏视频索引，通过稀疏探测和局部缩放发现候选帧，并贪婪地构建位置自适应排名：早期位置强调证据；后期位置在保留视觉多样性的同时，逐渐倾向于时间覆盖。因此，单个排名可以截断到任何目标预算，而无需重新运行选择器。在四个基准测试和六个帧预算下，MEC将平均准确率比均匀采样提高了3.77个百分点，匹配了强劲的最新选择器，并将端到端选择延迟降低了47.37-51.19%。
tldr: 提出了一种名为MEC的无训练长视频帧选择框架，通过生成一个“套娃式”的单一帧优先级序列，能够完美适应任意计算预算，在大幅降低延迟的同时保持高准确率。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的“套娃”式长视频帧选择方法，能够通过单一的优先级序列适应不同的计算预算，避免了为每个预算重新计算的开销，在保持甚至提升准确率的同时大幅降低了延迟，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有长视频帧选择方法通常针对每个预定义预算优化孤立的帧子集，无法在预算变化时复用先前选择的证据，而固定分数的排名又忽视了不同排名位置的独特作用，因此需要一种能适应任意预算的统一排名方法。
method: 提出Matryoshka Evidence-to-Context (MEC) 训练免费框架，构建可重用的稀疏视频索引，通过稀疏探测和局部缩放发现候选帧，并贪婪地构建位置自适应排名（早期侧重证据，后期侧重时间覆盖与视觉多样性）。
results: 在四个基准测试和六个帧预算下，MEC将平均准确率比均匀采样提高了3.77个百分点，匹配了当前最先进的选择器，并将端到端选择延迟降低了47.37%至51.19%。
conclusion: MEC框架通过构建套娃式证据-上下文排名，成功解决了长视频理解中多预算适应性与计算效率的矛盾，为大模型的高效视频处理提供了一个强大且无需训练的解决方案。

title: Multilayer Dual-polarized Microstrip Antenna Design by Topology Optimization with Enhanced Bandwidth
authors: Pan Lu, Eddie Wadbro, Viktor Lundström, Jonas Starck, Martin Berggren, Emadeldeen Hassan
abstract: Dual-polarized (DP) microstrip antennas are utilized in wireless systems for efficient data transmission. However, their bandwidth is typically very limited. In this contribution, we propose to design DP microstrip antennas with enhanced bandwidth using a density-based topology optimization approach. We formulate an optimization problem that simultaneously accounts for feeding port matching, the ports' isolation, and far-field dual-polarized performance. To enhance the bandwidth, we employ an FR4 stack-up, in which the copper on two layers is optimized simultaneously. We present two antenna designs operating around 5.7 GHz, which show a compromise in performance between a high isolation (more than 40 dB) and enhanced impedance bandwidth (around 10%). The optimized designs are experimentally validated, showing an excellent agreement between the simulated and measured performance.
comment: This work has been submitted to IEEE for possible publication
zh_title: 基于拓扑优化设计具有增强带宽的多层双极化微带天线
translation: 双极化（DP）微带天线被广泛用于无线系统中以实现高效的数据传输。然而，它们的带宽通常非常有限。在本研究中，我们提出使用基于密度的拓扑优化方法来设计具有增强带宽的DP微带天线。我们构建了一个优化问题，同时考虑了馈电端口匹配、端口隔离度以及远场双极化性能。为了拓宽带宽，我们采用了FR4多层堆叠结构，其中对两层铜箔进行了同时优化。我们展示了两个工作在5.7 GHz左右的天线设计，它们在高隔离度（超过40 dB）和增强的阻抗带宽（约10%）之间取得了良好的性能折中。优化后的设计经过了实验验证，仿真结果与实测结果表现出极佳的一致性。
tldr: 利用拓扑优化方法同时优化多层铜箔，成功设计出具有宽阻抗带宽和高端口隔离度的双极化微带天线。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将基于密度的拓扑优化方法应用于多层双极化微带天线的设计中，通过同时优化多层铜层并综合考虑阻抗匹配、端口隔离度和远场性能，成功突破了传统双极化微带天线带宽受限的瓶颈，具有较高的工程应用价值。
motivation: 双极化（DP）微带天线广泛应用于无线系统以实现高效数据传输，但其带宽通常非常有限，因此亟需通过有效的设计方法来增强其带宽。
method: 采用基于密度的拓扑优化方法，建立了一个同时考虑馈电端口匹配、端口间隔离以及远场双极化性能的优化问题，并在FR4多层堆叠结构中对两层的铜箔进行同步优化。
results: 提出了两个工作在5.7 GHz左右的天线设计，实现了高隔离度（大于40 dB）与增强的阻抗带宽（约10%）之间的性能折中，实验测量与仿真结果表现出极佳的一致性。
conclusion: 通过拓扑优化方法成功设计并实验验证了高性能、宽带宽的多层双极化微带天线，平衡了高隔离度与宽阻抗带宽的需求。

title: BlockPython: A Process-Aware Agent-Supported Platform for the Transition from Block-Based to Python Programming
authors: Jesse Yusuf Chan, Haoming Wang, Mingwei Xu, Xianlong Xu
abstract: The transition from block-based to text-based programming requires learners to convert visible program structures into abstract textual expressions, which may create a cognitive gap between understanding computational concepts and expressing them in Python syntax. To support this transition, we designed and implemented BlockPython. The platform centers on bidirectional translation between blocks and Python and guides learners through four stages: Task Decomposition, Block-Based Practice, Code Challenge, and Extended Interaction. Across these stages, learners progressively establish connections among program structure, runtime behavior, and textual code. During learning, the platform continuously collects process evidence, including block artifacts, code versions, run outcomes, use of support, and dialogue. Deterministic diagnosis, program visualization, and the learning assistant use this evidence to identify different difficulties in computational understanding and Python expression. The rule-based system is responsible for program execution, objective evaluation, and stage control, while the learning assistant uses verified evidence to provide explanations, prompts, and guiding questions. This report describes the design rationale, learning workflow, and process-aware support mechanisms of BlockPython and provides a system-design reference for supporting the transition from block-based to text-based programming and for analyzing learning processes.
zh_title: BlockPython：一个面向过程感知与智能体支持的从图形化到Python编程过渡平台
translation: 从图形化编程向文本编程的过渡要求学习者将可见的程序结构转化为抽象的文本表达，这可能会在理解计算概念与用Python语法进行表达之间产生认知鸿沟。为了支持这一过渡，我们设计并实现了BlockPython。该平台以图形块与Python之间的双向转换为核心，引导学习者经历四个阶段：任务分解、基于块的练习、代码挑战和扩展交互。在这些阶段中，学习者逐步建立程序结构、运行时行为和文本代码之间的联系。在学习过程中，平台持续收集过程证据，包括块产物、代码版本、运行结果、支持使用情况和对话。确定性诊断、程序可视化和学习助手利用这些证据来识别计算理解和Python表达方面的不同困难。基于规则的系统负责程序执行、客观评估和阶段控制，而学习助手则利用经过验证的证据提供解释、提示和引导性问题。本报告描述了BlockPython的设计原理、学习工作流和过程感知支持机制，并为支持从图形化到文本编程的过渡以及分析学习过程提供了系统设计参考。
tldr: BlockPython通过双向代码转换、四阶段工作流以及过程感知的智能体助手，帮助学习者填补从图形化编程到Python文本编程之间的认知鸿沟。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将过程感知（Process-Aware）证据收集与智能体（Agent）结合，提出了四阶段过渡模型以及图形块与代码的双向转换机制，有效降低了从图形化向文本编程过渡时的认知负荷。其重要性在于切中了编程教育中经典的“从Block到Text”过渡痛点。局限性在于本摘要主要阐述了系统设计原理与工作流，未提供具体的实证用户研究或量化评估数据。
motivation: 从图形化编程过渡到文本编程要求学习者将可见的程序结构转换为抽象的文本表达，这容易在理解计算概念与掌握Python语法表达之间产生认知鸿沟。
method: 设计并实现BlockPython平台，以图形块与Python代码的双向翻译为核心，包含任务分解、基于块的练习、代码挑战和扩展交互四个阶段；在学习过程中持续收集块产物、代码版本、运行结果等过程证据，利用基于规则的系统进行程序执行与客观评估，同时利用学习助手结合验证证据提供针对性的解释、提示和引导。
results: 阐述了BlockPython的设计原理、学习工作流和过程感知支持机制，为支持从基于块到基于文本的编程过渡以及分析学习过程提供了系统设计参考。
conclusion: BlockPython通过整合图形块与Python代码的双向翻译、渐进式四阶段工作流以及过程感知的智能支持，为解决从图形化到文本编程过渡中的认知鸿沟提供了有效的系统设计范式。

title: RA-CAD: Learning Post-Execution Critique for State-Aware Text-to-CAD Generation
authors: Shuhao Yan, Changhao He, Xi Peng, Peng Hu
abstract: Text-to-CAD generation translates natural-language design intent into editable and executable parametric computer-aided design (CAD) codes, reducing the expertise and effort required for manual modeling. Existing methods incorporate fixed, externally supplied, prompt-induced, or separately optimized critique mechanisms to optimize the generation process, but they do not necessarily optimize how feedback is interpreted and translated into effective corrective actions throughout the generation process. To bridge this feedback-utilization gap, we present RA-CAD (ReAct Agent for CAD), a state-aware agent that interacts with the CAD environment through a Generate--Execute--Critique--Rewrite loop. At each iteration, RA-CAD executes the current code and observes its outcome. Conditioned on the design instruction, current code, and execution feedback, the agent then generates an explicit post-execution critique as an intermediate policy action. This critique either validates the current result for termination or provides revision-oriented guidance that conditions the next rewrite. CAD Code Bootstrapping (CCB) first establishes fundamental parametric CAD coding capabilities through supervised fine-tuning. Feedback-Driven Agent Optimization (FAO) subsequently applies trajectory-level Group Relative Policy Optimization to both policy-generated code and critique sequences, assigning terminal F1 and Chamfer Distance rewards to the complete interaction trajectory. This formulation makes critique an outcome-aligned, learnable policy decision rather than an unoptimized auxiliary output. Experiments on CADFusion and Text2CAD show that RA-CAD achieves state-of-the-art execution validity and geometric quality compared with existing methods and strong proprietary language models, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed state-aware text-to-CAD agent.
zh_title: RA-CAD：学习用于状态感知文本到CAD生成的后执行批评
translation: 文本到CAD（Text-to-CAD）生成将自然语言设计意图转化为可编辑、可执行的参数化计算机辅助设计（CAD）代码，从而降低了手动建模所需的专业知识和工作量。现有方法结合了固定的、外部提供的、提示引导的或单独优化的批评机制来优化生成过程，但它们不一定能优化反馈在整个生成过程中如何被解释并转化为有效的纠正行动。为了弥补这一反馈利用鸿沟，我们提出了RA-CAD（用于CAD的ReAct智能体），这是一个通过“生成-执行-批评-重写”循环与CAD环境交互的状态感知智能体。在每次迭代中，RA-CAD执行当前代码并观察其结果。在设计指令、当前代码和执行反馈的条件作用下，智能体随后生成一个明确的后执行批评作为中间策略动作。该批评要么验证当前结果以终止循环，要么为下一次重写提供修订导向的指导。CAD代码引导（CCB）首先通过监督微调建立基础的参数化CAD编码能力。反馈驱动智能体优化（FAO）随后将轨迹级的群相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization）应用于策略生成的代码和批评序列，将终端F1和倒角距离（Chamfer Distance）奖励分配给完整的交互轨迹。这种公式化设计使批评成为一个与结果对齐、可学习的策略决策，而不是未经优化的辅助输出。在CADFusion和Text2CAD上的实验表明，与现有方法和强专有语言模型相比，RA-CAD实现了最先进的执行有效性和几何质量，证明了所提出的状态感知文本到CAD智能体的有效性。
tldr: RA-CAD是一个利用后执行批评和强化学习优化的文本到CAD生成智能体，显著提升了生成的CAD代码的执行率和几何质量。
ai_comments: 该论文引入了一种新颖的“生成-执行-批评-重写”循环机制，将批评作为可学习的策略决策，有效弥合了反馈利用鸿沟，在CAD生成任务中展现出卓越的执行有效性和几何质量。
motivation: 现有的Text-to-CAD方法缺乏对反馈如何被解释并转化为有效修正行动的优化（即存在反馈利用鸿沟），导致生成的CAD代码在执行有效性和几何质量上受限。
method: 提出RA-CAD状态感知智能体，采用“生成-执行-批评-重写”循环，结合CAD代码引导（CCB）进行监督微调，并通过反馈驱动智能体优化（FAO）利用轨迹级群相对策略优化（GRPO）联合优化代码与批评序列。
results: 在CADFusion和Text2CAD数据集上的实验表明，RA-CAD在执行有效性和几何质量方面均达到了最先进的性能（SOTA），超越了现有方法和强专有语言模型。
conclusion: RA-CAD通过引入基于状态的后执行批评和强化学习优化，有效解决了Text-to-CAD任务中的反馈利用问题，达到了当前的最先进性能。

title: Hyperelastic Membranes with Implicitly Defined, Continuously Embedded Fibers
authors: Michael Wolfgang Kaiser, Thomas-Peter Fries
abstract: A novel mechanical model and corresponding finite element method for anisotropic, hyperelastic, curved membranes are proposed. Hyperelastic fibers are embedded into the otherwise isotropic membrane, being relevant, for example, in reduced models for biological tissues and textiles. The geometrically nonlinear mechanics is formulated based on first principles of continuum mechanics (finite strain theory). The employed differential operators are formulated in a coordinate-free manner, through a framework known as tangential differential calculus. This enables a (semi-)implicit description of the fiber geometry through the intersection of level sets of some scalar function with the explicitly defined membrane surface. The mechanical model of the implicit fibers is then coupled to the mechanics of the membrane. For the numerical analysis, finite elements are applied such that the resulting scheme is a hybrid between classical Surface FEM and fictitious domain methods. For smooth physical fields, higher-order convergence rates are obtained and confirm the success of the numerical method.
