zh_title: 受林德布拉德启发的具有可分离旋转与耗散的多时间尺度储备池计算
translation: 回声状态网络通过固定循环动力学且仅训练线性读出层来实现高效的时序学习。然而，传统的储备池通常在一个单一的随机循环矩阵内兼顾信号混合、记忆保留和稳定性。现有的结构化设计改善了拓扑、范数保持、泄漏或深度，但通常无法同时提供可逆混合和不可逆遗忘的独立模态控制以及直接的全局稳定性保证。我们引入了一种经典的受林德布拉德（Lindblad）启发的、桥接开放系统动力学原理与结构化状态空间建模的多时间尺度储备池。循环算子由精确离散化的阻尼旋转模式组装而成，因此旋转和衰减成为控制相位混合和记忆丢失的独立设计变量。正交模式混合保持了正态性，而衰减谱则直接决定了回声状态的稳定性边界，无需进行事后谱半径重新缩放。我们在十个对齐的随机种子下，将该方法与标准储备池、渗漏储备池、深度储备池、正交储备池、循环储备池、下一代储备池以及一个紧凑训练的门控循环单元（GRU）进行了评估，测试涵盖线性记忆、非线性递归、混沌预测、延迟逻辑和真实传感器校准。在整个基准测试套件中，所提出的储备池在有界 NARMA-20 上实现了最佳的固定储备池性能，在 Lorenz-63 上取得了最低的平均误差，匹配了最强的线性记忆结果，并在广泛的基准测试中保持了广泛的竞争力。消融研究表明，旋转增加了状态多样性，而耗散提供了受控的遗忘并改善了预测条件。由此产生的框架提供了一个可解释的循环架构，其中混合、记忆和稳定性是显式且可独立调控的设计变量。
tldr: 提出了一种基于林德布拉德动力学的储备池计算方法，通过分离旋转与耗散实现了混合、记忆与稳定性的独立调控，显著提升了时间序列预测性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将开放量子系统中的林德布拉德（Lindblad）动力学原理引入经典储备池计算中，通过将旋转（可逆混合）与耗散（不可逆遗忘）解耦，实现了对状态空间建模的显式、独立调控和全局稳定性保证，具有较强的理论创新和优异的实证性能。
motivation: 传统的储备池通常在单个随机循环矩阵内兼顾信号混合、记忆保持和稳定性，缺乏对可逆混合和不可逆遗忘的独立模态控制以及直接的全局稳定性保证。
method: 引入受经典林德布拉德启发的经典多时间尺度储备池，将循环算子由精确离散化的阻尼旋转模式组装而成，使得旋转和衰减成为独立的设计变量。正交模式混合保持正态性，衰减谱直接决定回声状态稳定性边界，无需事后谱半径重新缩放。
results: 在十个对齐种子的多项基准测试（包括线性记忆、非线性递归、混沌预测、延迟逻辑和真实传感器校准）中，该方法在有界 NARMA-20 上实现了最佳的固定储备池性能，在 Lorenz-63 上获得了最低的平均误差，匹配了最强的线性记忆结果，并在广泛的基准测试中保持了极强的竞争力。消融实验表明，旋转增加了状态多样性，而耗散提供了受控的遗忘并改善了预测条件。
conclusion: 提出了一种受林德布拉德启发的经典多时间尺度储备池架构，通过分离旋转与耗散实现了混合、记忆和稳定性的独立调控与全局稳定性，在多个基准测试中表现优异。

title: Securing Contrastive mmWave-based Human Activity Recognition against Adversarial Label Flipping
authors: Amit Singha, Ziqian Bi, Tao Li, Yimin Chen, Yanchao Zhang
abstract: Wireless Human Activity Recognition (HAR), leveraging their non-intrusive nature, has the potential to revolutionize various sectors, including healthcare, virtual reality, and surveillance. The advent of millimeter wave (mmWave) technology has significantly enhanced the capabilities of wireless HAR systems. This paper presents the first systematic study on the vulnerabilities of mmWave-based HAR to label flipping poisoning attacks in the context of supervised contrastive learning. We identify three label poisoning attacks on the contrastive mmWave-based HAR and propose corresponding countermeasures. The efficacy of the attacks and also our countermeasures are experimentally validated on a prototype system. The attacks and countermeasures can be easily extended to other wireless HAR systems, thereby promoting security considerations in system design and deployment.
comment: 11 pages, 18 figures. Published in Proceedings of the 17th ACM Conference on Security and Privacy in Wireless and Mobile Networks (WiSec '24)
zh_title: 针对对抗性标签翻转保护基于对比毫米波的人体活动识别
translation: 利用无线技术的非侵入性，无线人体活动识别（HAR）有望革新医疗保健、虚拟现实和监控等各个领域。毫米波（mmWave）技术的出现显著增强了无线HAR系统的功能。本文对基于监督对比学习的毫米波HAR对标签翻转投毒攻击的脆弱性进行了首次系统研究。我们识别了针对基于对比的毫米波HAR的三种标签投毒攻击，并提出了相应的对策。攻击和我们对策的有效性在原型系统上得到了实验验证。这些攻击和对策可以轻松扩展到其他无线HAR系统，从而促进系统设计和部署中的安全性考虑。
tldr: 论文研究了毫米波行为识别在对比学习下的标签翻转攻击及防御策略。
ai_comments: 该论文首次系统研究了基于毫米波的人体行为识别在监督对比学习下对标签翻转对抗攻击的脆弱性，具有重要的现实安全指导意义。
motivation: 无线毫米波人体行为识别技术在多个领域应用前景广阔，但其在监督对比学习框架下对标签翻转等对抗性攻击的脆弱性尚缺乏系统性研究，因此有必要研究其安全漏洞及防护措施。
method: 识别了三种针对对比毫米波行为识别的标签中毒攻击，并提出了相应的对抗防御措施，并在原型系统上进行了实验验证。
results: 通过原型系统实验，验证了所提出的标签翻转攻击的有效性以及所提 countermeasures（应对措施）的防御效果。
conclusion: 论文通过实验验证了标签翻转攻击对毫米波行为识别系统的威胁，并证明了所提防御措施的有效性，推动了无线感知系统中的安全性研究。

title: NuclearDiffusion: Text-to-Image Foundation Models for Learning Nuclear Energy Concepts
authors: Mohammed I. Radaideh, Jeremy Moon, Andre Gala-Garza, Emma Son, Yug Shah, Majdi I. Radaideh
abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed text-to-image synthesis, yet its ability to represent specialized engineering domains remains largely unexplored. As an exmaple in nuclear engineering, general-purpose foundation models frequently generate physically incorrect or conceptually inconsistent images because they lack domain-specific knowledge. This work presents one of the first systematic studies of domain adaptation for nuclear text-to-image generation through fine-tuning of open-source diffusion models. We curate a dataset of 1,000 captioned nuclear energy images spanning reactors, fuel cycles, radiation, and related concepts, and use it to fine-tune three state-of-the-art open-source models: Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL), SD-v3.5-Medium, and the flow-matching Flux.1 model. Their performance is evaluated using both quantitative image-similarity metrics and qualitative expert assessment against the corresponding zero-shot models. Fine-tuning substantially improves the fidelity of SDXL, provides only limited gains for SD-v3.5-Medium, and yields no measurable improvement for Flux.1, demonstrating that adaptation effectiveness depends strongly on the underlying generative architecture rather than model scale alone. We further compare the fine-tuned models against three leading commercial systems--GPT-Image-2, Gemini-3.1-Flash-Image, and Midjourney. Although GPT-Image-2 and Gemini generate convincing images for broad nuclear concepts, they frequently fail on specialized engineering prompts, where the fine-tuned open-source models produce more accurate and technically consistent outputs. These results establish domain-specific fine-tuning as a practical pathway for developing trustworthy generative AI tools for domain-specific applications.
zh_title: NuclearDiffusion：用于学习核能概念的文本到图像基础模型
translation: 生成式人工智能（AI）改变了文本到图像的合成，但其表示专业工程领域的能力仍未得到充分探索。以核工程为例，通用基础模型由于缺乏领域特定知识，经常生成物理上不正确或概念不一致的图像。这项工作提出了对核文本到图像生成领域适应性的首次系统研究之一，通过微调开源扩散模型来实现。我们策划了一个包含1,000张带标题的核能图像数据集，涵盖反应堆、燃料循环、辐射及相关概念，并用其微调了三个最先进的开源模型：Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL)、SD-v3.5-Medium和flow-matching Flux.1模型。使用定量图像相似性指标和定性专家评估，将它们的性能与相应的零样本模型进行了评估。微调显著提高了SDXL的保真度，对SD-v3.5-Medium提供的增益有限，对Flux.1没有产生可测量的改进，这表明适应效果很大程度上取决于底层生成架构，而不仅仅是模型规模。我们进一步将微调后的模型与三个领先的商业系统（GPT-Image-2、Gemini-3.1-Flash-Image和Midjourney）进行了比较。尽管GPT-Image-2和Gemini为广泛的核概念生成了令人信服的图像，但它们在专门的工程提示上经常失败，而微调后的开源模型产生了更准确和技术上一致的输出。这些结果确立了领域特定微调作为开发用于特定领域应用的可信生成式AI工具的实用途径。
tldr: 通过微调开源扩散模型研究核能领域的文本到图像生成，发现架构决定微调效果，且微调后的模型在专业核工程提示词上优于通用商业系统。
ai_comments: 该论文针对专业工程领域（核能）进行文本到图像生成模型的领域自适应研究，发现微调效果高度依赖于底层生成架构而非单纯的模型规模，为开发领域可信的生成式AI工具提供了重要参考。
motivation: 通用文本到图像基础模型缺乏专业领域的知识，在核工程等专业领域生成图像时常常出现物理错误或概念不一致。
method: 构建包含1,000张带标题的核能图像数据集，对三个开源扩散模型（SDXL、SD-v3.5-Medium和Flux.1）进行微调，并通过定量图像相似性指标和定性专家评估进行性能评估，同时与三个领先的商业系统进行对比。
results: 微调大幅提升了SDXL的保真度，对SD-v3.5-Medium效果有限，对Flux.1无明显提升；在处理专业工程提示词时，微调后的开源模型比通用商业系统能产生更准确和技术上更一致的输出。
conclusion: 领域特定的微调是开发用于核能等专业工程应用的可信生成式AI工具的实用途径，其效果取决于底层生成架构。

title: EDATracer: An Agentic Framework for Large-Scale EDA Artifact Analysis
authors: Phat Tieu, Sayanti Jana, Matthew DeLorenzo, Jiawen Wu, Narendran Srinivasan, Srinivas Shakkottai, Jiang Hu, Jeyavijayan Rajendran
abstract: Modern chip design relies on electronic design automation (EDA) tools that generate large, heterogeneous artifacts, including source files, scripts, logs, netlists, and reports. Analyzing these artifacts is critical for debugging, optimization, and design-flow understanding, but remains difficult because relevant evidence is often distributed across many artifact types and design stages. Although LLM agents show promise for EDA assistance, existing approaches lack public benchmarks for large-scale cross-artifact analysis and often struggle to ground reasoning in tool-generated evidence. We present EDATracer, an agentic framework for evidence-grounded EDA artifact analysis. EDATracer organizes design artifacts into a knowledge graph paired with a semantic vector index, enabling LLM agents to retrieve evidence across source files, logs, netlists, and reports. We curate an 18.9 GB dataset of 2,787 synthesizable open-source chip designs and introduce a 90-question benchmark spanning factual, statistical, and reasoning tasks. Across evaluated agents, EDATracer achieves the best pass@1 accuracy, outperforming Cursor and Claude Code by 6.4 and 7.2 percentage points on average, while using 2.0-3.2x fewer tokens.
zh_title: EDATracer：用于大规模EDA构件分析的智能体框架
translation: 现代芯片设计依赖于电子设计自动化（EDA）工具，这些工具会生成大量异构构件，包括源文件、脚本、日志、网表和报告。分析这些构件对于调试、优化和理解设计流程至关重要，但由于相关证据通常分布在许多构件类型和设计阶段中，因此仍然很困难。尽管LLM智能体在EDA辅助方面显示出潜力，但现有方法缺乏用于大规模跨构件分析的公开基准，且往往难以将推理建立在工具生成的证据基础之上。我们提出了EDATracer，一个用于基于证据的EDA构件分析的智能体框架。EDATracer将设计构件组织成一个知识图谱，并配有语义向量索引，使LLM智能体能够跨源文件、日志、网表和报告检索证据。我们整理了一个包含2787个可综合开源芯片设计的18.9 GB数据集，并引入了一个涵盖事实性、统计性和推理性任务的90个问题的基准。在评估的智能体中，EDATracer实现了最佳的pass@1准确率，平均比Cursor和Claude Code高出6.4和7.2个百分点，同时使用的Token少2.0-3.2倍。
tldr: EDATracer是一个新型智能体框架，利用知识图谱和向量索引实现高效的大规模EDA跨构件证据溯源与分析，在准确率和Token效率上均显著优于现有方法。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了EDATracer框架，通过知识图谱和语义向量索引解决了大规模EDA跨构件分析中证据难以定位的痛点。创新性地引入了大规模公开数据集与基准测试，在提升准确率的同时显著减少了Token消耗，具有很高的实用价值和研究意义。
motivation: 现代芯片设计的EDA工具会产生大量异构构件，跨构件分析至关重要但极具挑战；现有LLM智能体缺乏针对大规模跨构件分析的公开基准，且难以在工具生成的证据中进行有效的推理。
method: 提出EDATracer智能体框架，将设计构件组织为知识图谱并配合语义向量索引，使大模型能够在源文件、日志、网表和报告等多种构件间检索证据；同时构建了一个18.9 GB的开源芯片设计数据集和一个包含90个问题的基准测试。
results: 在包含90个问题的基准测试中，EDATracer实现了最佳的pass@1准确率，平均超越Cursor和Claude Code 6.4到7.2个百分点，同时Token消耗减少了2.0到3.2倍。
conclusion: EDATracer通过结合知识图谱与向量检索的智能体框架，有效解决了大规模EDA设计构件的跨域分析与证据溯源问题，在基准测试中展现出卓越的准确性与效率。

title: SoK: How Frontier AI Reshapes System-Level Security Risk Dynamics in Critical Infrastructure
authors: Chandra Thapa, Mohan Baruwal Chhetri, Marthie Grobler, Shahroz Tariq, Tooba Aamir
abstract: Frontier artificial intelligence (FAI), encompassing large-scale, general-purpose AI systems, including large language models, multimodal foundation models, and agentic systems, is increasingly integrated into critical infrastructure (CI). This challenges long-standing security assumptions of bounded behavior, segmented networks, component transparency, and human-paced decision-making. Existing AI-security literature typically organizes risks by attack type, lifecycle stage, or asset class, but fails to capture the system-level dynamics, such as how risk emerges, spreads, and is controlled, through which FAI reshapes CI security outcomes. This Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) introduces a five-dimensional risk-dynamics framework that characterizes how FAI reconfigures CI security across the lifecycle: (i) Capability Emergence through new FAI-enabled attack and defense capabilities, (ii) Infiltration Pathways through data, models and AI supply chains, (iii) Cross-System Propagation across interconnected infrastructures and dependencies, (iv) degradation of effective technical and human Control Authority, and (v) strain on institutional Response Capacity under operational pressure. Rather than enumerating threats, the framework identifies recurring mechanisms that jointly determine system-level risk. We further identify a structural mismatch between academic AI-security research and CI operational constraints, and derive a deployment-oriented research agenda grounded in system-level assurance criteria. Collectively, this work shifts attention from model-centric robustness to lifecycle-structured, system-level assurance in interconnected CI environments.
zh_title: SoK：前沿AI如何重塑关键基础设施中的系统级安全风险动态
translation: 前沿人工智能（FAI）涵盖了大规模、通用型AI系统（包括大语言模型、多模态基础模型和智能体系统），正日益融入关键基础设施（CI）中。这挑战了关于行为受限、网络隔离、组件透明度和人类节奏决策的长期安全假设。现有的AI安全文献通常按攻击类型、生命周期阶段或资产类别来组织风险，但未能捕捉系统级动态——即风险如何通过FAI重塑CI安全结果而产生、扩散和控制。本知识系统化（SoK）研究引入了一个五维风险动力学框架，表征了FAI如何在整个生命周期中重新配置CI安全：(i) 通过新型FAI赋能的攻防能力实现能力涌现，(ii) 通过数据、模型和AI供应链形成的渗透途径，(iii) 跨越互联基础设施和依赖关系的跨系统传播，(iv) 有效技术与人类控制权限的退化，以及 (v) 在运营压力下对机构响应能力的挤压。该框架没有枚举威胁，而是确定了共同决定系统级风险的重复机制。我们进一步指出了学术AI安全研究与CI运营约束之间的结构性错位，并推导出了一个以系统级保证标准为基础的面向部署的研究议程。总的来说，这项工作将注意力从以模型为中心的鲁棒性转移到互联CI环境中生命周期结构化的系统级保证上。
tldr: 本文提出了一个五维风险动力学框架，系统分析了前沿人工智能如何重塑关键基础设施的系统级安全风险，并推动研究从模型鲁棒性转向系统级保障。
ai_comments: 本文系统化地探讨了前沿AI对关键基础设施系统级安全风险动态的影响，提出了五维风险动力学框架，超越了传统的模型中心式鲁棒性研究，具有很高的理论价值和实践指导意义。
motivation: 前沿AI越来越多地融入关键基础设施中，挑战了长久以来的安全假设；现有文献通常按攻击类型、生命周期阶段或资产类别组织风险，无法捕捉系统级的风险演变、传播和控制动态，因此需要进行知识系统化（SoK）研究。
method: 提出一个五维风险动力学框架，包括能力涌现、渗透途径、跨系统传播、控制权限降级以及响应能力压力，并分析了学术研究与运营约束之间的结构性错位。
results: 构建了一个刻画前沿AI如何重塑关键基础设施生命周期安全的五维风险动力学框架，识别了决定系统级风险的复现机制，并导出了一个面向部署的研究议程。
conclusion: 本文通过引入五维风险动力学框架，将前沿AI在关键基础设施中的安全研究从模型中心式的鲁棒性转向了生命周期结构化的系统级保障。

title: A Multimodal Automatic Redteaming Evaluation based on Atomic Jailbreak Strategy Decoupling and Combination
authors: Shiji Zhao, Yuxuan Zhou, Chen Xiong, Dongxian Wu, Yang Bai, Xun Chen
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive progress in image-text comprehension and generation, yet they remain susceptible to jailbreak attacks that can trigger harmful outputs and pose serious safety concerns. Existing multimodal jailbreak attacks have shown the feasibility of such attacks, but they still face two fundamental challenges: the lack of a atomic multi-modal strategy space, the absence of a concise and efficient executable framework beyond human-craft experience. To address these challenges, we first decompose the text-image jailbreak strategy space into three levels: structural, semantic, and syntactic, constructing a jailbreak strategy set encompassing both text and image modalities to systematically achieve combined coverage of different attack types. Then we propose a multimodal automated red team jailbreak method named Hierarchical Atomic Combination Attack (HACA). Specifically, based on a six-dimensional strategy space, a cross-modal joint planner is used to select and combine the different atomic jailbreak strategy for subsequent jailbreak command generation. Finally, at the implementation level, we explore to apply a unified generate executor to directly generate jailbreak instructions based on the selected multi-modal strategies. A series of experiments show that our automated red team method can achieve an attack success rate of average 95.48\% against five mainstream MLLMs.
zh_title: 基于原子越狱策略解耦与组合的多模态自动红蓝对抗评估
translation: 多模态大模型（MLLMs）在图文理解与生成方面取得了显著进展，但它们仍然容易受到触发有害输出并引发严重安全担忧的越狱攻击。现有的多模态越狱攻击展示了此类攻击的可行性，但它们仍面临两个根本性挑战：缺乏原子多模态策略空间，以及缺乏超越人工经验的简洁高效可执行框架。为了应对这些挑战，我们首先将图文越狱策略空间分解为三个级别：结构、语义和语法，构建了一个包含文本和图像模态的越狱策略集，以系统地实现对不同攻击类型的组合覆盖。然后，我们提出了一种名为分层原子组合攻击（HACA）的多模态自动化红蓝对抗越狱方法。具体而言，基于六维策略空间，利用跨模态联合规划器选择和组合不同的原子越狱策略，用于后续的越狱指令生成。最后，在实现层面，我们探索应用统一的生成执行器，根据所选的多模态策略直接生成越狱指令。一系列实验表明，我们的自动化红蓝对抗方法对五种主流MLLM实现了平均95.48%的攻击成功率。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于原子策略解耦与组合的多模态大模型自动越狱攻击框架（HACA），在五个主流模型上取得了95.48%的平均攻击成功率。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将多模态越狱策略解耦为结构、语义和语法三个层级，并提出了分层原子组合攻击（HACA）框架，实现了自动化、系统化的红蓝对抗评估，对提升多模态大模型的安全性具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的多模态越狱攻击存在缺乏原子多模态策略空间以及缺乏摆脱人工经验的简洁高效可执行框架这两个基本挑战，因此需要建立一个系统化、自动化的多模态红蓝对抗评估方法。
method: 首先将图文越狱策略空间分解为结构、语义和语法三个层级，构建涵盖双模态的原子策略集；其次提出分层原子组合攻击（HACA）方法，利用跨模态联合规划器选择和组合不同原子策略；最后通过统一的生成执行器直接生成越狱指令。
results: 一系列实验表明，所提出的自动化红蓝对抗方法针对五种主流多模态大模型实现了平均95.48%的攻击成功率。
conclusion: 本文提出的HACA方法能够有效且自动化地对主流多模态大模型进行越狱攻击评估，平均攻击成功率高达95.48%，凸显了当前MLLMs在安全性方面的巨大隐患。

title: CheckOne: Lightweight Fault Detection and Mitigation for Vision Transformers
authors: Mohammad Hasan Ahmadilivani, Sven-Markus Loorits, Jaan Raik
abstract: The wide adoption of Vision Transformers (ViTs) in safety-critical applications raises reliability concerns related to hardware faults. Algorithm-Based Fault Tolerance (ABFT) methods have emerged as lightweight and symmetric protection mechanisms for DNNs. However, they are particularly challenging for ViTs due to their significant computational requirements. This work comprehensively evaluates the reliability of ViTs, emphasizing the need for symmetric protection in their layers. Furthermore, we present CheckOne, a novel, cost-effective method for fault detection and mitigation in ViTs that significantly reduces the computational cost compared to conventional ABFT. Through extensive experiments with multiple ViTs, CheckOne mitigates critical faults by up to $26\times$ and achieves an average 3.8x higher performance than ABFT in ViTs.
comment: Accepted at IEEE DFTS'26, 4 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables
zh_title: CheckOne：面向视觉Transformer的轻量级故障检测与缓解方案
translation: 视觉Transformer（ViTs）在安全关键应用中的广泛采用引发了人们对硬件故障可靠性的担忧。基于算法的容错（ABFT）方法已成为深度神经网络（DNNs）的轻量级且对称的保护机制。然而，由于ViTs显著的计算需求，ABFT对它们而言极具挑战性。本工作全面评估了ViTs的可靠性，强调了在其各层中进行对称保护的必要性。此外，我们提出了CheckOne，这是一种用于ViTs中故障检测与缓解的新颖且具成本效益的方法，与传统的ABFT相比，它显著降低了计算成本。通过对多个ViTs进行的大量实验，CheckOne将关键故障缓解了高达26倍，并在ViTs中实现了比ABFT平均高3.8倍的性能。
tldr: 本文提出了CheckOne，一种针对视觉Transformer（ViTs）的轻量级故障检测与缓解方法，以极低的计算成本显著提升了ViTs在硬件故障下的可靠性和性能。
ai_comments: 该论文针对视觉Transformer（ViTs）在安全关键应用中的硬件故障可靠性问题，提出了一种轻量级且高性价比的故障检测与缓解方法CheckOne，相较于传统ABFT显著降低了计算成本并提高了性能，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 视觉Transformer（ViTs）在安全关键应用中的广泛采用引发了对其硬件故障可靠性的担忧，而传统的基于算法的容错（ABFT）方法由于ViTs巨大的计算需求，在应用于ViTs时面临巨大挑战。
method: 全面评估ViTs的可靠性，提出名为CheckOne的新颖且具有成本效益的故障检测与缓解方法，相比传统ABFT显著降低了计算开销。
results: 通过对多个ViTs进行的大量实验，CheckOne将关键故障缓解了最多26倍，并且在ViTs中实现了平均高出3.8倍的性能。
conclusion: CheckOne为视觉Transformer提供了一种高效、轻量级的故障检测与缓解方案，有效解决了传统ABFT在ViTs中计算开销大的难题，提升了系统在安全关键应用中的可靠性。

title: Hardware-Enabled Fuzzy Inference: Architectures, Platforms, and Emerging Trends
authors: Amir Hossein Jalilvand, Parsa Hassani Shariat Panahi, M. Hassan Najafi
abstract:
Fuzzy logic systems are widely used for intelligent decision-making under uncertainty, offering interpretability and robustness across diverse applications. However, the growing demand for real-time edge intelligence has exposed the limitations of software-based fuzzy inference: unpredictable latency, excessive power consumption, and inefficient resource utilization. This has motivated extensive research into hardware acceleration, spanning platforms from custom analog circuits and digital ASICs to reconfigurable FPGAs and ultra-low-power microcontrollers. This survey presents the first comprehensive, platform-centric review of hardware fuzzy systems, systematically organizing the literature into three principal categories: FPGA-based implementations, ASIC and custom VLSI realizations, and embedded, IoT, and TinyML platforms. For each category, we analyze architectural organization, resource mapping strategies, implementation trade-offs, and key design challenges.
  Our cross-platform comparative analysis reveals that no single platform dominates across all metrics. FPGAs offer flexibility and rapid prototyping, ASICs deliver peak performance and energy efficiency, while embedded and TinyML systems balance low power and cost for edge deployment. Despite significant progress, critical research gaps persist: the absence of standardized benchmarks, limited scalability of rule bases, insufficient design automation, and limited support for online learning and emerging memory technologies. We outline future directions including in-memory fuzzy computing with memristive crossbars, integration with TinyML ecosystems, explainable hardware AI, and open-source design automation. This survey serves as a {reference for} researchers and practitioners working on hardware-enabled fuzzy intelligence.
zh_title: 硬件支持的模糊推理：架构、平台与新兴趋势
translation: 模糊逻辑系统广泛用于处理不确定性下的智能决策，在各种应用中提供可解释性和鲁棒性。然而，日益增长的实时边缘智能需求暴露了基于软件的模糊推理的局限性：延迟不可预测、功耗过高和资源利用率低下。这激发了对硬件加速的广泛研究，跨越了从定制模拟电路、数字ASIC到可重构FPGA和超低功耗微控制器的各种平台。本综述呈现了首个全面的、以平台为中心的硬件模糊系统回顾，将文献系统地组织为三大主要类别：基于FPGA的实现、ASIC与定制VLSI实现，以及嵌入式、物联网和TinyML平台。针对每个类别，我们分析了其架构组织、资源映射策略、实现权衡以及关键设计挑战。我们的跨平台比较分析表明，没有任何单一平台能在所有指标上占据主导地位。FPGA提供灵活性和快速原型设计，ASIC提供峰值性能和能源效率，而嵌入式和TinyML系统则平衡了边缘部署的低功耗和低成本。尽管取得了显著进展，但仍存在关键的研究空白：缺乏标准化基准、规则库可扩展性有限、设计自动化不足，以及对在线学习和新兴存储器技术支持有限。我们勾勒了未来的发展方向，包括基于忆阻交叉条的存内模糊计算、与TinyML生态系统的集成、可解释硬件AI以及开源设计自动化。本综述为从事硬件模糊智能研究的研究人员和从业者提供了重要参考。
tldr: 本文首度对硬件模糊推理系统进行了全面的平台导向型综述，分析了FPGA、ASIC和嵌入式平台的架构、优劣势及未来趋势。
ai_comments: 本文是首篇全面审视硬件模糊系统的综述，按平台分类深入探讨了其架构、权衡与挑战，并指出了标准化缺失和可扩展性等未来研究方向，对于推动边缘智能与硬件AI的发展具有重要参考价值。
motivation: 随着实时边缘智能需求的增长，基于软件的模糊推理暴露出延迟不可预测、功耗过高和资源利用率低下等局限性，这促使了对定制模拟电路、数字ASIC、可重构FPGA和超低功耗微控制器等硬件加速方案的广泛研究。
method: 本文对硬件模糊系统进行了系统性的平台中心化综述，将文献划分为基于FPGA的实现、ASIC及定制VLSI实现、嵌入式、IoT与TinyML平台三类，并进行了跨平台比较分析、权衡评估与架构组织分析。
results: 跨平台比较分析表明，没有单一平台在所有指标上占优：FPGA提供灵活性与快速原型开发，ASIC提供峰值性能与能效，嵌入式和TinyML系统则平衡了边缘部署的低功耗与成本。同时，明确了缺乏标准化基准、规则库可扩展性有限等关键研究空白。
conclusion: 硬件模糊推理通过多种硬件平台突破了软件实现的性能瓶颈，但在标准化、可扩展性及在线学习等方面仍面临挑战，未来有望向存内计算、TinyML集成和开源设计自动化方向发展。

title: A Symbolic Execution Framework for Symbolic Timing Analysis of Digital Integrated Circuits
authors: Dennis Eigner, Arman Ferdowsi, Ulrich Schmid
abstract: Simulation-based dynamic timing analysis of digital integrated circuits (DDTA) offers a faster alternative to traditional analog SPICE simulations. To achieve timing predictions that are reasonably competitive in terms of accuracy, however, DDTA mandates gate delay models that go beyond the standard pure or inertial delay models used in state-of-the-art tools. Recent advances in analytic gate delay models, which now also capture effects like drafting and multi-input switching, unlock new possibilities for timing analysis, which go way beyond simulation-based approaches towards an exhaustive exploration. In this paper, we present the cornerstones of a novel symbolic execution framework, which utilizes such analytic delay models for automatically computing symbolic delay expressions for all paths in a digital circuit, for some given ordering of the input transitions. To reduce combinatorial explosion, we introduce symbolic pruning methods that also enable path-sensitive, goal-driven reasoning about timing properties and analytic optimization of specific circuit paths.
zh_title: 用于数字集成电路符号时序分析的符号执行框架
translation: 数字集成电路的基于仿真动态时序分析（DDTA）为传统的模拟SPICE仿真提供了一种更快的替代方案。然而，为了实现具有竞争力的精度，DDTA需要采用超越最先进工具中所使用的标准纯延迟或惯性延迟模型的门延迟模型。近期解析门延迟模型的进展（现已能捕获如漂移和多输入切换等效应）为时序分析释放了新的可能性，使其超越了基于模拟的方法，转向了穷举探索。在本文中，我们提出了一个新颖的符号执行框架的基石，该框架利用此类解析门延迟模型，针对给定的输入跳变顺序，自动计算数字电路中所有路径的符号延迟表达式。为了减少组合爆炸，我们引入了符号剪枝方法，该方法还能够对时序属性进行路径敏感、目标驱动的推理，以及对特定电路路径进行解析优化。
tldr: 提出了一种结合解析门延迟模型与符号剪枝技术的数字集成电路符号时序分析框架，能够自动计算路径延迟并进行路径敏感的时序优化。
ai_comments: 该论文针对数字集成电路的时序分析，提出了一种新颖的符号执行框架。其创新之处在于结合了先进的解析门延迟模型（如考虑电流漂移和多输入切换），并引入了符号剪枝方法来缓解组合爆炸问题，从而实现对电路路径时序属性的穷举探索和路径敏感的优化。这为超越传统模拟仿真和纯/惯性延迟模型的时序分析开辟了新途径。
motivation: 传统的基于模拟的动态时序分析（DDTA）虽然比SPICE快，但为了达到竞争力的准确性，需要超越标准纯延迟或惯性延迟模型的复杂门延迟模型。近年来解析门延迟模型（可捕获漂移和多输入切换等效应）的进展，促使人们探索超越传统仿真、实现穷举探索的新时序分析方法。
method: 提出一个新型符号执行框架，利用先进的解析门延迟模型自动计算数字电路中所有路径的符号延迟表达式，并引入符号剪枝方法进行路径敏感、目标驱动的时序属性推理和电路路径的解析优化。
results: Not mentioned in abstract
conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract

title: Reconstructing Persistent Worlds from Narratives for Narrative-Grounded Interactive Experiences
authors: Yi-Chun Chen
abstract:
Designing narrative-grounded interactive experiences remains labor-intensive because interactive content must align with the underlying world implied by the narrative. Existing approaches formulate problems such as narrative planning, scene generation, and gameplay generation, each constructing computational representations tailored to specific downstream tasks rather than explicitly reconstructing and maintaining the persistent world that grounds them.
  We investigate reconstructing explicit persistent worlds from narrative descriptions as the central computational objective for narrative-grounded interactive realization. Rather than treating the world as an implicit by-product of downstream generation, our approach reconstructs and maintains persistent entities, locations, semantic relationships, and evolving world states while inferring only the contextual information required to support coherent interactive experiences.
  To investigate this perspective, we develop a reference prototype that reconstructs structured persistent world representations from narrative descriptions and subsequently instantiates playable tile-based environments. Through three representative case studies spanning a procedural scenario, an original fantasy narrative, and an adapted public-domain story, we demonstrate the feasibility of reconstructing persistent worlds and show how a shared world representation supports coherent gameplay while remaining grounded in the source narrative.
  By explicitly reconstructing persistent worlds prior to interactive realization, this work bridges computational narrative understanding and interactive content generation, providing a semantic foundation for AI-assisted game authoring, mixed-initiative design, educational simulations, and narrative-grounded interactive experiences.
zh_title: 从叙事中重建持久世界以构建叙事驱动的交互体验
translation:
设计叙事驱动的交互体验仍然是一项劳动力密集型的工作，因为交互内容必须与叙事暗示的底层世界保持一致。现有方法将叙事规划、场景生成和游戏生成等问题公式化，每种方法都构建针对特定下游任务的计算表征，而不是明确地重建和维护支撑它们的持久世界。
我们研究了从叙事描述中重建显式持久世界，作为叙事驱动交互实现的核心计算目标。我们的方法没有将世界视为下游生成的隐式副产品，而是重建和维护持久的实体、位置、语义关系和不断演变的世界状态，同时仅推断支持连贯交互体验所需的上下文信息。
为了研究这一观点，我们开发了一个参考原型，它可以从叙事描述中重建结构化的持久世界表征，并随后实例化可玩的基于瓦片的环境。通过涵盖程序化场景、原创奇幻叙事和改编公共领域故事的三个代表性案例研究，我们证明了重建持久世界的可行性，并展示了共享世界表征如何在保持扎根于源叙事的同时支持连贯的游戏玩法。
通过在交互实现之前显式重建持久世界，本工作桥接了计算叙事理解和交互内容生成，为AI辅助游戏创作、混合主动设计、教育模拟和叙事驱动的交互体验提供了语义基础。
tldr: 本论文提出从叙事中显式重建持久世界，作为实现叙事驱动交互体验的核心，从而在叙事理解与交互生成之间架起桥梁。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的视角，将“持久世界的显式重建”作为叙事驱动交互体验的核心计算目标，克服了以往方法将世界状态隐式处理的局限性，为AI辅助游戏创作和叙事生成提供了强有力的语义基础。
motivation: 设计叙事驱动的交互体验目前仍需要大量人工，因为现有的方法通常针对特定的下游任务（如叙事规划、场景生成等）构建计算表征，缺乏对支撑这些任务的底层持久世界的显式重建与维护。
method: 开发了一个参考原型，从叙事描述中重建结构化的持久世界表征，并进而实例化为可玩的基于瓦片的（tile-based）环境，通过三个具有代表性的案例研究进行了验证。
results: 通过三个涵盖程序化场景、原创奇幻叙事和改编公共领域故事的案例研究，证明了重建持久世界的可行性，并展示了共享世界表征如何在保持与源叙事紧密结合的同时支持连贯的游戏玩法。
conclusion: 通过显式重建持久世界，本研究成功桥接了计算叙事理解与交互内容生成，证明了共享世界表征在支持一致性游戏玩法和忠于源叙事方面的可行性与有效性。

title: Toward Uncertainty Quantification in Modern Art
authors: Tirtho Roy, Ushashi Bhattacharjee, Showrav Kumar Saha, Sayantan Chakraborty, Koushik Howlader, Tanusree Bhattacharjee
abstract: Asked to animate the same modern artwork under different random seeds, a text to video model returns visibly different films, one reading per seed. Because modern art is ambiguous by intent, this disagreement is signal, not noise. Yet prevailing uncertainty quantification (UQ) collapses a set of generations to a dispersion scalar that says how much the seeds differ but not how: it cannot tell a compact interpretation from a dominant reading plus an outlier, two competing modes, or diffuse instability, nor whether the set still contains a rendering faithful to the original. We present the first study of the structure of generative uncertainty for modern art animation, and a reusable protocol for identifying source blind multiseed uncertainty: a suite of seven source blind and six reference aware estimators; a distributional profile (robust spread, outlier influence, explicit topology, multimodality, anisotropy, leave one seed influence, reference coverage); a distribution model ablation (vMF, Kent, ACG, Student t, kernel, mixture); eight identification questions; and an artwork level statistical protocol. We build the first corpus: 250 modern artwork captions rendered by Wan2.1 14B under four seeds (1000 videos) across 4 encoders, artworks withheld from generation. As a diagnostic the protocol succeeds: it classifies seed set topology at balanced accuracy 0.98 (chance 0.25), isolates the outlier configuration at AUROC 1.00 where a scalar reaches only 0.35, and splits high uncertainty artworks into reference covering (n=97) and reference missing (n=56) diversity, reliably from three seeds and across encoders.
zh_title: 迈向现代艺术中的不确定性量化
translation: 当被要求在不同的随机种子下动画化同一件现代艺术作品时，文本到视频模型会返回明显不同的影片，每个种子对应一种解读。由于现代艺术本质上是模糊的，这种分歧是信号而非噪声。然而，现有的不确定性量化（UQ）将一组生成结果压缩为一个分散标量，该标量只能说明种子之间的差异程度，却无法说明如何差异：它无法区分紧凑的解释与主导解读加异常值、两个竞争模式、或是扩散的不稳定性，也无法判断该集合是否仍然包含忠实于原作的渲染。我们首次研究了现代艺术动画生成不确定性的结构，并提出了一个用于识别源盲多种子不确定性的可复用协议：一套包含7个源盲和6个参考感知估计器的组合；一个分布轮廓（稳健散布、异常值影响、显式拓扑、多峰性、各向异性、留一种子影响、参考覆盖度）；一个分布模型消融（vMF、Kent、ACG、学生t分布、核、混合）；8个识别问题；以及一个艺术品级别的统计协议。我们构建了首个语料库：由Wan2.1 14B在4个种子下渲染的250个现代艺术作品标题（1000个视频），跨越4个编码器，且艺术品在生成过程中被保留。作为诊断手段，该协议取得了成功：它以0.98的平衡准确率（随机为0.25）对种子集拓扑进行分类，以1.00的AUROC隔离异常值配置（而标量仅达到0.35），并能可靠地从三个种子跨编码器将高不确定性艺术品拆分为覆盖参考（n=97）和丢失参考（n=56）的多样性。
tldr: 本文首次研究了现代艺术动画生成中的不确定性结构，提出了一套全面且可复用的多种子不确定性量化协议，并构建了首个现代艺术视频语料库，有效解决了传统标量方法无法捕捉生成多样性结构的问题。
ai_comments: 该论文切入点新颖，将现代艺术的模糊性与文本到视频模型的随机种子差异相结合，颠覆了传统将不确定性视为噪声的观点，并提出了全面的结构化不确定性量化协议及首个现代艺术动画语料库。
motivation: 现代艺术具有意图上的模糊性，文本到视频模型在不同随机种子下产生的差异是信号而非噪声；然而，现有的不确定性量化方法只能给出分散标量，无法捕捉多样的生成结构和解释，因此需要研究现代艺术动画的生成不确定性结构并建立可复用的评估协议。
method: 提出了一套包含7个源盲和6个参考感知估计器的协议、分布配置文件、分布模型消融、8个识别问题以及艺术品级别的统计协议；并构建了包含250个现代艺术品标题和1000个视频的首个语料库进行评估。
results: 诊断协议取得了显著成功：以0.98的平衡准确率分类种子集拓扑，以1.00的AUROC隔离异常配置（相比之下标量仅为0.35），并能可靠地将高不确定性艺术品划分为覆盖参考和丢失参考的多样性。
conclusion: 提出的源盲多种子不确定性协议在分类种子集拓扑、隔离异常配置以及区分覆盖与未覆盖参考的艺术品多样性方面表现优异，有效解决了现代艺术动画生成中的不确定性量化难题。

title: AMD SEV-SNP: A Confidential Computing Primer
authors: Amean Asad, Patrick McClurg, Patrick Woodhead
abstract: This paper is a technical primer on AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization with Secure Nested Paging (SEV-SNP), a hardware confidential computing implementation that provides Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) for virtual machines. SEV-SNP treats the hypervisor as adversarial. It encrypts guest memory and register state with keys the hypervisor never possesses, detects any tampering with guest memory at the point of access, and lets a guest prove to a remote verifier exactly what code it is running. The paper constructs each of these guarantees from the hardware up. It opens with the threat model that drives the design and the hardware that enforces it, the AMD Secure Processor and the encryption engine in the memory controller. It then develops the mechanisms that make a confidential guest practical. The Reverse Map Table provides memory integrity against an adversary who controls the page tables. The privilege and communication machinery (VM Privilege Levels, the encrypted VM Save Area, and the GHCB protocol) lets the guest cooperate with a hypervisor it does not trust. The attestation pipeline binds a hardware-signed measurement of the guest's initial state to AMD's certificate chain, so a remote verifier can confirm independently what is running.
zh_title: AMD SEV-SNP：机密计算入门
translation: 本文是关于AMD SEV-SNP（安全嵌套分页的安全加密虚拟化）的技术入门，这是一种为虚拟机提供可信执行环境（TEE）的硬件机密计算实现。SEV-SNP将虚拟机监控程序视为对抗者，使用虚拟机监控程序永远无法获取的密钥加密访客内存和寄存器状态，在访问时检测对访客内存的任何篡改，并允许访客向远程验证者证明其正在运行的确切代码。本文从硬件底层构建了这些保证。首先介绍了驱动设计的威胁模型以及强制执行该模型的硬件（AMD安全处理器和内存控制器中的加密引擎）。然后开发了使机密访客实用的机制：反向映射表针对控制页表的对手提供内存完整性；特权和通信机制（VM特权级别、加密的VM保存区和GHCB协议）允许访客与不信任的虚拟机监控程序合作；证明流水线将访客初始状态的硬件签名测量值绑定到AMD的证书链，以便远程验证者可以独立确认正在运行的内容。
tldr: 本文详细介绍了AMD SEV-SNP硬件机密计算技术，阐述其如何在不可信的虚拟机监控程序下，通过内存加密、完整性检查、特权隔离和远程证明为虚拟机提供安全的可信执行环境。
ai_comments: 本文是一篇关于AMD SEV-SNP技术的优秀技术入门论文，清晰地阐述了其硬件层面的机密计算实现机制、威胁模型及安全保证。它对于理解现代云环境中的虚拟机安全具有重要意义。
motivation: 为了提供一个关于AMD SEV-SNP（安全嵌套分页的安全加密虚拟化）的技术入门，详细解释其如何在将虚拟机监控程序视为对抗者的前提下，实现虚拟机的机密计算和安全保证。
method: 本文从硬件底层出发，详细分析了威胁模型、AMD安全处理器、内存控制器加密引擎、反向映射表（RMT）、虚拟机特权级（VMPL）、加密VM保存区、GHCB协议以及远程证明流水线。
results: 阐明了SEV-SNP如何通过加密访客内存和寄存器状态、使用反向映射表检测内存篡改、建立特权与通信机制以及实现远程证明，从而为云环境中的虚拟机提供强有力的安全保障。
conclusion: AMD SEV-SNP通过结合硬件加密、内存完整性检查、特权级隔离和远程证明，为虚拟机提供了强大的可信执行环境（TEE），有效防御了不可信的虚拟机监控程序带来的威胁。

title: An Explainable LLM Agent Layer for Open-World Anomaly Detection in Oil Wells
authors: Lucas Gouveia Omena Lopes, Thales Miranda de Almeida Vieira, Eduardo Toledo de Lima Junior, William Wagner Matos Lira
abstract: Open-World Learning (OWL) pipelines for oil well anomaly detection have recently been shown to combine autoencoder-based detection, multiclass classification, and Mahalanobis-based novelty detection on the public 3W dataset. These pipelines answer \textit{what happened}, but they do not explain \textit{why the model believes it} or \textit{what the operator should do next}, and they do not put a human-readable name on the novelty clusters they discover. This paper evaluates a Large Language Model (LLM) agent layer placed downstream of the OWL pipeline, designed as a \textbf{companion} to the published upstream methods rather than a replacement. Using the Qwen3.5-397B-A17B Mixture-of-Experts model served via NVIDIA NIM, the agent receives structured sensor metrics and upstream classification or novelty assertions, and returns natural-language justifications, confidence-ranked critiques, and consolidated names for detected novelties. Across three studies spanning 989 real well-file segments from the 3W dataset, the agent achieved $35.1\%$ top-1 / $63.9\%$ top-3 (95\% CI [56.9, 70.4]) classification on all nine classes, $71.7\%$ top-2 validation [64.8, 77.6] with precision $0.91$ [0.84, 0.95] across 7 probed classes, and $89.7\%$ novelty detection [87.0, 91.9] with stable cluster naming on 5 of 7 hidden classes. The agent is not a standalone classifier. Its role is to: (1) confirm upstream decisions when sensor evidence supports them, (2) justify decisions in sensor-grounded language operators can audit, (3) flag disagreement when upstream labels are implausible, and (4) name novelties so that clustered unlabeled events arrive at the engineer with a consolidated human-readable label. The goal is to close the explainability gap that currently blocks deployment of OWL pipelines in operational settings.
zh_title: 油井开放世界异常检测的可解释LLM代理层
translation: 油井异常检测的开放世界学习（OWL）管道最近被证明结合了基于自编码器的检测、多分类以及公共3W数据集上的基于马氏距离的新奇检测。这些管道回答了“发生了什么”，但它们并没有解释“模型为什么这样认为”或“操作员接下来应该做什么”，也没有为它们发现的新奇簇赋予人类可读的名称。本文评估了一个放置在OWL管道下游的大语言模型（LLM）代理层，旨在作为已发布上游方法的伴随者而不是替代品。该代理利用通过NVIDIA NIM服务的Qwen3.5-397B-A17B混合专家模型，接收结构化传感器指标和上游分类或新奇断言，并返回自然语言的理由、置信度排序的批判以及对检测到的新奇事物的合并名称。在跨越3W数据集989个真实井筒文件片段的三项研究中，该代理在所有9个类别上实现了35.1%的top-1 / 63.9%的top-3（95%置信区间[56.9, 70.4]）分类，在7个探测类别上实现了71.7%的top-2验证[64.8, 77.6]（精度0.91 [0.84, 0.95]），以及89.7%的新奇检测[87.0, 91.9]，并在7个隐藏类别中的5个上实现了稳定的簇命名。该代理不是一个独立的分类器。其作用是：（1）当传感器证据支持时确认上游决策，（2）以操作员可以审计的传感器接地语言证明决策，（3）在上游标签不可信时标记分歧，以及（4）命名新奇事物，以便聚类的未标记事件以合并的人类可读标签到达工程师手中。其目标是缩小目前阻碍OWL管道在运营环境中部署的可解释性鸿沟。
tldr: 本文提出在油井异常检测管道下游引入一个大语言模型代理层，以提供自然语言解释、决策批判和未知事件命名，从而跨越工业落地的可解释性鸿沟。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型（LLM）代理层引入油井开放世界异常检测（OWL）管道的下游，弥补了传统方法缺乏可解释性、无法给出操作建议和命名未知簇的痛点。这种“伴随式”架构（非替代式）对工业实际部署具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的油井开放世界学习（OWL）异常检测管道虽然能检测并分类异常，但无法解释模型做出判断的原因、无法给出后续操作建议，也无法对发现的新奇簇进行人类可读的命名，这导致其难以在实际操作环境中部署。
method: 在已有的OWL管道下游部署了一个大语言模型代理层（采用Qwen3.5-397B-A17B混合专家模型，通过NVIDIA NIM服务），接收结构化传感器指标及上游分类与新奇断言，输出自然语言解释、置信度排序的批判以及新奇事物的合并名称。
results: 在包含989个真实井筒文件片段的三项研究中，该代理层实现了所有9个类别下35.1%的top-1/63.9%的top-3分类准确率，7个探测类别下71.7%的top-2验证准确率（精确度0.91），以及对7个隐藏类别中5个的89.7%新奇检测准确率和稳定的簇命名。
conclusion: LLM代理层能够有效弥补油井开放世界异常检测管道的可解释性鸿沟，通过提供基于传感器的自然语言解释、决策批判和新奇簇命名，促进了OWL方法在工业环境中的安全部署。

title: Kitchen Robotic Manipulation utilizing Foundation Models
authors: Myung-Hwan Jeon, Sankalp Yamsani, Joohyung Kim
abstract: Deploying robots in everyday human environments requires perception systems that are both robust and adaptable to diverse, dynamic conditions. In this work, we present a modular perception pipeline for household manipulation tasks, with a focus on dishware handling in kitchen environments. The pipeline integrates open-vocabulary object detection, multi-view segmentation, instance-aware 3D reconstruction, and a 2D-3D feature fusion strategy for 6D pose estimation and grasp planning. Its modular design enables systematic substitution of multiple visual and geometric foundation models, allowing us to identify the best-performing configuration through extensive evaluation on a custom kitchen dataset. The best-performing configuration (LLMDet + SAMv2 + DINOv2 + GeoTransformer) achieves an ADI of 89.12\% on the 20-scene kitchen benchmark with cluttered and occluded conditions. Furthermore, real-world demonstrations confirm that the best configuration can be deployed on physical robots without environment-specific retraining, successfully executing tasks such as sink-to-dishwasher transfer and cup stacking. It validates the adaptability and scalability of the pipeline and highlights its potential as a practical framework for household robotic systems. Our code and supplementary materials are available at https://raivlab.github.io/FM_kitchen .
zh_title: 利用基础模型的厨房机器人操作
translation: 在日常人类环境中部署机器人需要既稳健又能适应多样化动态条件的感知系统。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种用于家庭操作任务的模块化感知管道，重点关注厨房环境中的餐具处理。该管道集成了开放词汇目标检测、多视点分割、实例感知3D重建以及用于6D位姿估计和抓取规划的2D-3D特征融合策略。其模块化设计能够系统性地替换多个视觉和几何基础模型，使我们能够通过在定制厨房数据集上的广泛评估来识别出表现最好的配置。表现最佳的配置（LLMDet + SAMv2 + DINOv2 + GeoTransformer）在具有杂乱和遮挡条件的20个场景厨房基准测试中取得了89.12%的ADI。此外，真实世界的演示证实，最佳配置可以部署在物理机器人上，而无需针对特定环境进行重新训练，能够成功执行从水槽到洗碗机的转移和杯子堆叠等任务。它验证了该管道的适应性和可扩展性，凸显了其作为家庭机器人系统实用框架的潜力。我们的代码和补充材料可在 https://raivlab.github.io/FM_kitchen 获取。
tldr: 利用基础模型构建了一个模块化的厨房机器人感知与操作管道，实现了高鲁棒性的餐具处理并在真实世界中成功部署。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将多种最先进的视觉和几何基础模型（如LLMDet, SAMv2, DINOv2, GeoTransformer）进行模块化组合，构建了一个用于厨房机器人操作的高效感知管道。其重要性在于无需特定环境重新训练即可部署到真实世界中，对家庭服务机器人的实用化具有重要推进作用。
motivation: 为了解决在日常人类环境中部署机器人时，感知系统需要具备对多样化和动态条件的高度鲁棒性与适应性的挑战，重点关注厨房环境中的餐具处理任务。
method: 提出了一种模块化感知管道，集成了开放词汇目标检测、多视点分割、实例感知3D重建以及2D-3D特征融合策略，用于6D位姿估计和抓取规划，并评估了不同基础模型的组合。
results: 最佳配置（LLMDet + SAMv2 + DINOv2 + GeoTransformer）在包含杂乱和遮挡条件的20场景厨房基准测试中达到了89.12%的ADI，并且在真实世界演示中无需重新训练即可成功执行水槽到洗碗机的转移和杯子堆叠任务。
conclusion: 论文成功展示了基于基础模型的模块化感知管道在处理复杂厨房操纵任务时的卓越性能与泛化能力，为家庭机器人的实际部署提供了强有力的实用框架。

title: Tactus: Open-Vocabulary Object Recognition from Low-Cost Pressure Arrays
authors: Abdul Basit Tonmoy
abstract: Resistive pressure arrays are the cheapest and most widely shipped tactile sensors, yet tactile representation learning has concentrated on optical sensors that image a deforming gel. We present Tactus, an open model that answers text queries from pressure data alone: on the STAG benchmark (27 objects, held-out recordings), it reaches 0.771 +/- 0.062 top-1 over four runs (top-3 0.935), matching, and at best exceeding, the dataset's supervised closed-set CNN at 0.76, with no trained classifier head. The recipe is small-data: 187 training recordings, masked-autoencoder pretraining on 144k unlabeled same-sensor frames, and the sensor's own calibration affine, which recovered more accuracy than every architecture change combined. The released model's errors concentrate in a few contact-ambiguous classes, are uncorrelated with text-target geometry (Spearman rho <= 0.05 over 702 class pairs), and survive paraphrased and even bare-name queries within one point; two diverse frames recover 89% of eight-frame accuracy. Failures are reported with equal precision: cross-sensor pretraining pooling gave no gain, vision co-training degraded touch, and a mis-normalized input pipeline silently discarded 97% of the sensor's dynamic range while producing plausible intermediate results. Weights, code, and the memory layer the model plugs into are released openly.
zh_title: Tactus：基于低成本压力阵列的开放词汇表对象识别
translation: 电阻式压力阵列是最便宜且出货量最大的触觉传感器，然而触觉表示学习主要集中在对变形凝胶进行成像的光学传感器上。我们提出了Tactus，这是一个开放模型，仅从压力数据中就能回答文本查询：在STAG基准测试（27个物体，保留录音）上，四次运行的top-1准确率达到了0.771 +/- 0.062（top-3为0.935），匹配并最好地超越了该数据集的监督闭集CNN（0.76），且没有训练分类头。其秘诀在于小数据：187个训练录音，对144k个未标记的同传感器帧进行掩码自编码器预训练，以及传感器自身的仿射校准，这恢复了比所有架构更改加起来还要多的准确率。发布模型的错误集中在几个接触模糊的类别中，与文本目标的几何形状不相关（702个类别对之间的Spearman相关系数小于等于0.05），并且在复述甚至纯名称查询下能够保持在一个百分点以内；两个不同的帧恢复了八帧准确率的89%。论文同等精确地报告了失败案例：跨传感器预训练池化没有带来收益，视觉协同训练降低了触觉性能，并且一个错误归一化的输入管道在产生合理的中间结果的同时，默默丢弃了传感器97%的动态范围。权重、代码以及模型接入的记忆层均已开源。
tldr: Tactus打破了触觉学习对光学传感器的依赖，仅通过低成本压力阵列和创新的小数据训练方法，实现了媲美监督闭集模型的开放词汇表对象识别。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将开放词汇表对象识别技术引入了低成本、广泛使用的电阻式压力阵列中，打破了以往触觉表示学习过度依赖光学触觉传感器的局限。通过小数据训练、掩码自编码器预训练以及精细的校准，实现了无需分类头即可媲美甚至超越监督闭集CNN的性能。论文不仅展示了出色的识别效果，还坦诚地指出了失败案例与局限性，对低成本触觉感知的发展具有重要意义。
motivation: 目前的触觉表示学习大多集中于依赖成像变形凝胶的光学传感器，而作为最便宜且出货量最大的电阻式压力阵列却未被充分利用于开放词汇表对象识别。为此，作者开发了Tactus模型，旨在仅通过低成本的压力数据实现开放词汇表对象识别。
method: 采用小数据训练策略，结合基于144k个未标记同类传感器帧的掩码自编码器（MAE）预训练，并利用传感器自身的仿射校准方法，直接从压力数据中回答文本查询。
results: 在STAG基准测试中，Tactus取得了0.771的top-1准确率（top-3为0.935），匹配甚至超过了该数据集原本的监督闭集CNN（0.76），且无需训练分类头。
conclusion: Tactus证明了仅凭低成本压力阵列数据也能实现强大的开放词汇表对象识别，为触觉感知提供了一条经济且高效的新途径。

title: Recurrent Residual Quantization: A Progressive Multi-Precision Representation for LLMs
authors: Yu Luo, Bo Dong, Wenhua Cheng, Haihao Shen
abstract: Serving large language models (LLMs) under diverse deployment constraints requires flexible trade-offs between accuracy, memory footprint, and throughput. However, conventional quantization methods typically require a separate checkpoint for each target bit-width. We introduce Recurrent Residual Quantization (RRQ), a post-training quantization (PTQ) framework that represents weights as a low-bit quantized base together with a sequence of quantized residual corrections, enabling multiple effective precisions from a single checkpoint. Starting from a 2-bit model obtained via post-training quantization (PTQ) or round-to-nearest (RTN), RRQ progressively adds lightweight 2-bit residuals generated via RTN to construct 4-, 6-, and 8-bit representations. The method is calibration-free and avoids joint multi-bit optimization. In our Qwen3-8B setup, the full all-RTN 2-/4-/6-/8-bit package is constructed in 1,293 seconds, 3.3 times faster than the measured MatGPTQ construction. Experiments on six recent LLMs show competitive accuracy at 6 and 8 bits, with model-dependent behavior at 4 bits. The code will be made publicly available upon publication.
comment: NeurIPS 2026 submission; 14 tables, 1 algorithm, and no figures
zh_title: 循环残差量化：大语言模型的渐进式多精度表示
translation: 在多样化的部署约束下服务大语言模型（LLMs），需要在准确性、内存占用和吞吐量之间进行灵活的权衡。然而，传统的量化方法通常需要为每个目标位宽提供一个单独的检查点。我们引入了循环残差量化（RRQ），这是一种后训练量化（PTQ）框架，它将权重表示为一个低比特量化的基础加上一系列量化的残差修正，从而使单个检查点能够支持多种有效精度。从通过后训练量化（PTQ）或四舍五入到最近邻（RTN）获得的 2 比特模型开始，RRQ 逐步添加通过 RTN 生成的轻量级 2 比特残差，以构建 4、6 和 8 比特表示。该方法无需校准，并避免了联合多比特优化。在我们的 Qwen3-8B 设置中，完整的全 RTN 2/4/6/8 比特包在 1,293 秒内构建完成，比测得的 MatGPTQ 构建速度快 3.3 倍。在六个最新 LLM 上的实验表明，该方法在 6 和 8 比特时具有竞争力的准确度，在 4 比特时则表现出模型相关的行为。代码将在发表后公开。
tldr: RRQ 是一种全新的大语言模型后训练量化框架，它通过单一检查点支持多精度（2-8比特）表示，无需复杂校准即可实现高效、灵活的模型部署。
ai_comments: RRQ 创新性地结合了循环残差思想与后训练量化，通过单一检查点支持多种比特精度，大幅降低了多精度部署的存储与构造开销，具有很强的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的常规量化方法通常需要为每个目标位宽提供单独的检查点，无法很好地满足在不同部署约束下灵活权衡准确性、内存占用和吞吐量的需求。
method: 提出循环残差量化（RRQ）后训练量化（PTQ）框架，将权重表示为一个低比特量化的基础权重加上一系列量化的残差修正，从2比特模型开始逐步添加轻量级的2比特残差（通过RTN生成）构建4、6和8比特表示。该方法无校准且避免了联合多比特优化。
results: 在 Qwen3-8B 设置中，完整的全 RTN 2/4/6/8-bit 软件包在 1,293 秒内构建完成，比测得的 MatGPTQ 构建速度快 3.3 倍。在六个最新 LLM 上的实验表明，该方法在 6 和 8 比特时具有竞争力的准确度，在 4 比特时表现出模型依赖的行为。
conclusion: RRQ 框架成功实现了从单一模型检查点支持多精度（2/4/6/8-bit）LLM 推理，在保证竞争力的同时大幅提高了量化效率。

title: Beyond the QBER Threshold: A Temporal QBER Based Machine Learning Framework for Multi Attack Detection in BB84 QKD
authors: Isha, Deepak Singh, Devesh Kumar, S.K Pal, Praful Hambarde, Amit Shukla
abstract: Conventional BB84 Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) systems rely on a fixed 11% Quantum Bit Error Rate (QBER) threshold to detect eavesdropping. However, stealthy attacks can remain below this threshold while still compromising channel security. This paper proposes a temporal QBER based machine learning framework for detecting and classifying eavesdropping attacks in BB84 QKD systems. Rather than relying on average session level QBER, the framework extracts 63 physics-informed temporal features capturing burst behavior, temporal instability, basis dependent asymmetry, and QBER loss interactions. Random Forest, XGBoost, and Support Vector Machine with a Radial Basis Function kernel (SVM-RBF) classifiers are evaluated on seven eavesdropping attacks and a normal channel scenario under noisy and lossy conditions. Averaged over ten independent runs, XGBoost achieves the best performance with 88.01% (0.47%) accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.8803, while SVM-RBF performs comparably, confirming the robustness of the proposed features. Evaluated as a binary attack-versus-normal detector for comparison with conventional monitoring, a fixed 11% QBER threshold achieves only 25.82% accuracy with a False Negative Rate (FNR) of 0.8477, whereas the proposed framework reduces the FNR to 0.0198, substantially improving detection of stealthy attacks that evade threshold-based monitoring. SHapley Additive exPlanations based (SHAP) explainability shows that physics-informed temporal and channel derived features are highly discriminative for identifying eavesdropping strategies. These results demonstrate that temporal QBER driven machine learning provides an accurate, explainable, and practical framework for multi attack security monitoring in BB84 QKD systems.
zh_title: 超越QBER阈值：BB84 QKD中基于时间QBER的多攻击检测机器学习框架
translation: 传统的BB84量子密钥分发（QKD）系统依赖于固定的11%量子误码率（QBER）阈值来检测窃听。然而，隐蔽攻击可以在保持在该阈值以下的同时仍然危害信道安全。本文提出了一种基于时间QBER的机器学习框架，用于检测和分类BB84 QKD系统中的窃听攻击。该框架不依赖于平均会话级别的QBER，而是提取了63个基于物理特性的时间特征，这些特征捕获了突发行为、时间不稳定性、基底相关的不对称性以及QBER与损耗的交互作用。在噪声和损耗条件下，对随机森林、XGBoost和带有径向基函数核的支持向量机（SVM-RBF）分类器进行了七种窃听攻击和一个正常信道场景的评估。在十次独立运行的平均结果中，XGBoost取得了最佳性能，准确率为88.01%（0.47%），宏F1分数为0.8803，SVM-RBF表现相当，证实了所提特征的鲁棒性。作为二分类攻击与正常检测器与传统监测进行对比评估时，固定的11% QBER阈值仅达到25.82%的准确率，虚警/漏检率（FNR）为0.8477，而所提出的框架将FNR降低至0.0198，大幅改进了对逃避基于阈值监测的隐蔽攻击的检测。基于SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）的可解释性表明，基于物理特性的时间和信道衍生特征对于识别窃听策略具有高度的辨别力。这些结果证明，由时间QBER驱动的机器学习为BB84 QKD系统中的多攻击安全监测提供了一个准确、可解释且实用的框架。
tldr: 提出一种基于时间QBER特征和机器学习的框架，用于有效检测BB84量子密钥分发系统中的隐蔽窃听攻击，解决了传统固定阈值方法漏报率高的问题。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了基于时间特性的QBER特征和机器学习框架，克服了传统BB84 QKD系统固定11%阈值无法检测隐蔽攻击的局限性，具有重要的实用价值和高安全性提升。
motivation: 传统的BB84 QKD系统依赖于固定的11% QBER阈值来检测窃听，但隐蔽攻击可以在保持在阈值以下的同时破坏信道安全，因此需要一种更先进的框架来检测此类攻击。
method: 提取了63个基于物理特性的时间特征（涵盖突发行为、时间不稳定性、基底相关不对称性以及QBER与损耗的交互作用），并评估了随机森林、XGBoost和支持向量机（SVM-RBF）三种分类器在噪声和损耗条件下的性能。
results: 在十次独立运行的平均结果中，XGBoost取得了最好的性能，准确率为88.01%，宏F1分数为0.8803；同时，该框架将传统固定阈值监测下的漏警率从0.8477大幅降低至0.0198。
conclusion: 基于时间QBER的机器学习框架（特别是XGBoost模型）能够有效检测和分类BB84 QKD系统中的多种隐蔽窃听攻击，大幅降低漏警率，显著优于传统的固定阈值监测方法。

title: FM4WiFi: Flow Matching for Multi-AP Coordination in Dense Deployments of Beyond Wi-Fi 8 Networks
authors: Maksymilian Wojnar, Krzysztof Rusek, Katarzyna Kosek-Szott, Szymon Szott
abstract: Wi-Fi networks are moving beyond random channel access toward tightly coordinated operation across access points (APs), a shift reflected in Wi-Fi 8's multi-AP coordination (MAPC). However, the current MAPC specification restricts cooperation to AP pairs, fundamentally limiting the gains achievable in dense deployments and calling for scalable, network-wide coordination in beyond Wi-Fi 8 systems. We target coordinated spatial reuse (Co-SR), where APs transmit concurrently at reduced power. Effective Co-SR demands joint selection and configuration of AP-station transmissions, yet existing approaches simply do not scale: they rely on heavy signaling, slow convergence, unrealistic assumptions, and often require computation time that explodes with network size. We introduce FM4WiFi, a generative ML pipeline that addresses these limitations by producing high-quality Co-SR configurations in a single inference step. FM4WiFi integrates (i) an autoencoder that learns compact latent representations of network states, (ii) a flow-matching generative model that synthesizes feasible Co-SR configurations (including rate control, absent from prior work), and (iii) a surrogate rate predictor that allows rapid, large-scale Co-SR candidate evaluation without dependence on a live system or digital twin. Across extensive evaluations (including experimental validation), FM4WiFi matches or exceeds state-of-the-art baselines at medium-to-large scales and scales to 30+ APs with sub-second inference. Extensive ablation studies validate each modeling and optimization choice.
zh_title: FM4WiFi：超越Wi-Fi 8网络稠密部署中多AP协同的流匹配方法
translation: Wi-Fi网络正在从随机信道接入转向跨接入点（AP）的紧密协同操作，这一转变在Wi-Fi 8的多AP协同（MAPC）中得到了体现。然而，当前的MAPC规范将合作限制在AP对之间，从根本上限制了密集部署中可实现的收益，这要求在超越Wi-Fi 8的系统中实现可扩展的网络范围协同。我们针对协同空间复用（Co-SR），其中AP以降低的功率并发传输。有效的Co-SR需要联合选择和配置AP与站点之间的传输，然而现有的方法根本无法扩展：它们依赖于繁重的信令、缓慢的收敛、不切实际的假设，并且通常需要随网络规模爆炸式增长的计算时间。我们推出了FM4WiFi，这是一个生成式机器学习管道，它通过在单个推理步骤中产生高质量的Co-SR配置来解决这些局限性。FM4WiFi集成了：（i）学习网络状态紧凑潜在表示的自编码器，（ii）合成可行Co-SR配置（包括以往工作所缺少的速率控制）的流匹配生成模型，以及（iii）代理速率预测器，允许在不依赖实时系统或数字孪生的情况下进行快速、大规模的Co-SR候选评估。通过广泛的评估（包括实验验证），FM4WiFi在中到大规模下的性能匹配或超越了最先进的基线，并能以亚秒级的推理扩展到30个以上的AP。广泛的消融研究验证了每个建模和优化选择。
tldr: 提出基于流匹配的生成式机器学习管道FM4WiFi，实现了超越Wi-Fi 8稠密网络中多AP的高效、可扩展协同配置。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将生成式流匹配（Flow Matching）技术引入Wi-Fi多AP协同中，解决了稠密部署下传统方法计算复杂度随网络规模爆炸的难题，对于下一代无线网络智能化控制具有重要意义。
motivation: 超越Wi-Fi 8规范中的多AP协同（MAPC）局限于AP对的限制，以解决稠密部署中现有方法由于信令重、收敛慢和计算时间随网络规模爆炸而无法扩展的问题。
method: 提出FM4WiFi生成式机器学习管道，包含：(1) 学习网络状态紧凑潜在表示的自编码器；(2) 合成可行Co-SR配置的流匹配生成模型；(3) 无需实时系统或数字孪生即可进行快速候选评估的代理速率预测器。
results: FM4WiFi在中到大规模网络中的性能匹配或超越了最先进的基线方法，能够扩展到30个以上的AP，并实现亚秒级的推理。
conclusion: FM4WiFi通过自编码器、流匹配生成模型和代理速率预测器的有机结合，实现了稠密Wi-Fi网络下高效、可扩展的协同空间复用配置，具有巨大的实际应用潜力。

title: CAMP: A Cycle-Aware Multi-Scale Patch Mixer for Time Series Forecasting
authors: Jung Min Choi, Vijaya Krishna yalavarthi, Lars Schmidt-Thieme
abstract: Real-world time series are often governed by recurring patterns, but their dominant periods may vary across datasets, forecasting settings, and individual input windows. Existing cycle-aware forecasters commonly rely on a single period selected at the dataset level, which can be restrictive when periodic behavior changes over time or when multiple cycles coexist. Moreover, patch-based models typically process all patch positions uni- formly, although patches farther from the forecast boundary may require broader contextual refinement, while recent patches contain information that should be preserved more directly. Af- ter cyclic behavior is removed, the remaining dynamics may also span multiple temporal resolutions and cannot be adequately de- scribed at a single scale. We introduce CAMP, a Cycle-Aware Multi-Scale Patch Mixer designed to address these challenges. The Adaptive Cycle Learning module identifies dominant fre- quencies separately for each input window and generates both historical and future cyclic components without requiring a pre- defined cycle length. The Horizon-Guided Patch Mixer intro- duces position-dependent refinement, allowing earlier patches to incorporate broader temporal context while preserving infor- mation close to the forecast boundary. CAMP further models the de-cycled residual through temporally aligned multi-resolution representations, enabling complementary dynamics at different scales to be captured within one forecasting framework. Across seven long-term forecasting benchmarks, CAMP achieves the best average MSE on six datasets and the best or tied-best MAE on six. It also obtains the highest MSE win count across sixteen settings on four PEMS traffic benchmarks.
zh_title: CAMP：一种用于时间序列预测的循环感知多尺度 Patch 混合器
translation: 现实世界的时间序列通常受重复模式支配，但其主导周期可能在不同的数据集、预测设置和单个输入窗口之间发生变化。现有的循环感知预测器通常依赖于在数据集级别选择的单一周期，当周期性行为随时间变化或多个周期共存时，这种方法会受到限制。此外，基于 patch 的模型通常对所有 patch 位置进行均匀处理，尽管距离预测边界较远的 patch 可能需要更广泛的上下文求精，而最近的 patch 则包含应更直接保留的信息。在去除循环行为之后，剩余的动态也可能跨越多个时间分辨率，无法在单一尺度上得到充分描述。我们介绍了 CAMP，这是一种旨在解决这些挑战的循环感知多尺度 Patch 混合器。自适应循环学习模块为每个输入窗口单独识别主导频率，并生成历史和未来的循环分量，而无需预定义的循环长度。视界引导的 Patch Mixer 引入了位置依赖的精炼，允许较早的 patch 包含更广泛的时间上下文，同时保留靠近预测边界的信息。CAMP 进一步通过时间对齐的多分辨率表示对去周期后的残差进行建模，从而能够在统一的预测框架内捕获不同尺度上的互补动态。在七个长期预测基准测试中，CAMP 在六个数据集上取得了最佳的平均 MSE，在六个数据集上取得了最佳或并列最佳的 MAE。它还在四个 PEMS 交通基准的十六种设置中获得了最高的 MSE 胜出次数。
tldr: 本文提出了 CAMP 模型，通过自适应周期学习、位置导向的 Patch 混合和多尺度残差建模，解决了时间序列预测中周期多变、均匀分块和单尺度分析的问题，并在多个基准测试中取得领先表现。
ai_comments: 本文针对时间序列预测中的周期多变性、分块处理的局限性以及残差多尺度动态特征三大痛点，提出了CAMP模型。其创新点在于自适应循环学习模块、视界引导的 Patch Mixer 以及多尺度残差建模，在多个基准数据集上取得了优异的性能，展现了强大的通用性和有效性。
motivation: 现实世界的实际时间序列往往受循环模式支配，但其主导周期在不同数据集、设置和输入窗口中会有所变化；现有的循环感知预测器通常依赖于数据集级别的单一周期，且基于 patch 的模型通常对所有 patch 位置进行均匀处理，未考虑距离对上下文需求的影响，同时去周期后的残差动态也往往跨越多个时间分辨率无法由单一尺度充分描述。
method: 提出 CAMP 模型，包含三个核心部分：1）自适应循环学习模块，按输入窗口自适应识别主导频率并生成周期分量；2）视界引导的 Patch Mixer，实现位置依赖的细化，对不同距离的 patch 进行差异化上下文处理；3）多尺度残差建模，在时间对齐的多分辨率表示下捕捉去周期后的残差动态。
results: 在七个长期预测基准测试中，CAMP 在六个数据集上实现了最佳平均 MSE，在六个数据集上实现了最佳或并列最佳的 MAE，并在四个 PEMS 交通基准的十六种设置中获得了最高的 MSE 胜出次数。
conclusion: CAMP 通过自适应周期学习、位置依赖的 Patch 混合以及多尺度残差建模，有效克服了传统时间序列预测中周期固定、处理均匀以及单尺度分析的局限性，在多个长期预测基准上取得了最先进的性能。

title: AgentAntibody: An Adaptive Immune System for Defending LLM Agents against Prompt Injection
authors: Shihao Weng, Yang Feng, Xiaofei Xie, Jiongchi Yu
abstract: Prompt injection remains a critical threat to LLM agents, yet existing defenses treat each task as a self-contained problem, independent of previous encounters. In practice, user requests are often underspecified: they describe the desired outcome without fully specifying acceptable behavior. An injection can exploit this ambiguity, causing the agent to complete the task in a way the user would reject. As the user's expectations become clearer through concrete cases, a defense should learn from each encounter and apply what it learns to the next. Inspired by adaptive immunity, we propose AgentAntibody, which equips LLM agents with a self-evolving immune system against prompt injection. AgentAntibody represents its evolving understanding of the user's security boundary as a persistent library of antibodies. At runtime, the library recognizes threats to this boundary and mounts corresponding immune responses. Across encounters, it evolves to strengthen the agent's immunity to future attacks. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks and four backbone LLMs show that, by learning the user's boundary through experience, AgentAntibody outperforms existing defenses in preventing harmful actions while preserving legitimate task completion, even when the harmful and legitimate actions are both compatible with the stated task.
zh_title: AgentAntibody：用于防御LLM Agent免受提示词注入攻击的适应性免疫系统
translation: 提示词注入仍然是对LLM Agent的关键威胁，然而现有的防御将每个任务视为独立的、与先前遭遇无关的问题。在实践中，用户的请求往往是不明确的：它们描述了期望的结果，但没有完全指定可接受的行为。注入可以利用这种模糊性，导致Agent以用户会拒绝的方式完成任务。随着用户的期望通过具体案例变得更加清晰，防御应该从每次遭遇中学习并将所学应用于下一次。受适应性免疫的启发，我们提出了AgentAntibody，它为LLM Agent配备了一个自我演化的免疫系统来对抗提示词注入。AgentAntibody将其对用户安全边界不断演化的理解表示为一个持久的抗体库。在运行时，该库识别对该边界的威胁并发起相应的免疫反应。在多次遭遇中，它不断演化以增强Agent对未来攻击的免疫力。在三个基准测试和四个骨干LLM上的广泛实验表明，通过从经验中学习用户的边界，AgentAntibody在防止有害行为同时保留合法任务完成方面优于现有防御，即使有害行为和合法任务都与所述任务兼容。
tldr: 本文提出了一种模仿生物免疫系统的AgentAntibody框架，通过在交互中学习和演化“抗体库”，有效防范LLM Agent面临的提示词注入攻击。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将生物学中的适应性免疫系统（Adaptive Immune System）引入大语言模型（LLM）Agent的安全防御中，通过将用户的安全边界表示为持续演化的“抗体库”，实现了从历史交互中学习并抵御提示词注入攻击的能力，兼顾了防御效果和合法任务的完成率。
motivation: 现有的LLM Agent防御机制将每个任务视为彼此独立的自立问题，无法应对由于用户请求描述模糊而被提示词注入利用的安全漏洞；为此，需要一种能够从每次交互中学习并应用于后续任务的自适应防御系统。
method: 提出AgentAntibody框架，模仿生物适应性免疫系统，将对用户安全边界不断演化的理解表示为一个持久的抗体库；在运行时识别对该边界的威胁并采取免疫反应，跨会话不断进化以增强对未来攻击的免疫力。
results: 在三个基准测试和四个骨干LLM上的广泛实验表明，通过从经验中学习用户边界，AgentAntibody在防止有害行为和保留合法任务完成方面均优于现有防御方法。
conclusion: AgentAntibody提供了一种基于自适应免疫机制的LLM Agent防御框架，能够通过经验不断学习用户的安全边界，在防止恶意提示词注入攻击的同时保持合法任务的高效完成。

title: Robust and Personalized Federated Learning for Aircraft-Engine Prognostics under Benign and Adversarial Client Heterogeneity
authors: Chinmoy Mitra, Md. Mehedi Hasan Nipu, Mohammad Sakib Mahmood, Md. Rakibul Islam, M. F. Mridha
abstract:
Federated learning (FL) enables aircraft fleet operators to jointly train remaining-useful-life (RUL) models from engine sensor telemetry without sharing raw data. This study examines two complementary challenges: benign heterogeneity, where honest operators observe different operating conditions and fault modes, and adversarial heterogeneity, where compromised operators submit poisoned updates. We conduct a controlled, safety-oriented evaluation using a multi-task one-dimensional convolutional neural network and a structurally non-IID partition of the Commercial Modular Aero-Propulsion System Simulation (C-MAPSS) benchmark. We compare four remedies for benign heterogeneity and evaluate five attacks against four aggregation methods, including a physically motivated sensor-value backdoor designed to mask engine degradation.
  Shared-representation personalization closes approximately 70% of the local-to-centralized root-mean-square-error gap, compared with 21% for proximal regularization and 10% for server-side reweighting. The backdoor achieves a 94.9% attack success rate against standard averaging while leaving clean accuracy statistically unchanged, demonstrating that accuracy alone cannot certify model safety and that attack success must be evaluated explicitly. Krum reduces attack success by an order of magnitude and is the only evaluated aggregator that withstands coordinated attackers, whereas personalization alone provides no protection. Combining personalization with robust aggregation restores robustness (2.8% attack success) with only a small accuracy cost, revealing a trade-off between robust update selection and collaborative representation learning. Results remain consistent across client counts and on a harder six-condition dataset. Code and data partitions are released for reproducibility.
zh_title: 考虑良性与对抗性客户端异构性的航空发动机预测与健康管理鲁棒个性化联邦学习
translation: 联邦学习（FL）使飞机机队运营商能够利用发动机传感器遥测数据共同训练剩余寿命（RUL）模型，而无需共享原始数据。本研究检查了两个互补的挑战：良性异构性（诚实运营商观察到不同的操作条件和故障模式）和对抗性异构性（受compromised运营商提交带毒更新）。我们使用多任务一维卷积神经网络和商业模块化航空推进系统仿真（C-MAPSS）基准的结构化非IID分区进行了受控的、面向安全的评估。我们比较了针对良性异构性的四种补救措施，并评估了针对四种聚合方法的五种攻击，包括旨在掩盖发动机退化的物理动机传感器值后门。共享表示个性化弥补了大约70%的局部到集中式均方根误差差距，而近端正则化为21%，服务器端重新加权为10%。在标准平均下，后门实现了94.9%的攻击成功率，同时保持干净的准确率在统计学上不变，这表明仅靠准确率不能证明模型安全性，必须明确评估攻击成功率。Krum将攻击成功率降低了一个数量级，是唯一能够抵御协调攻击者的评估聚合器，而仅靠个性化不提供保护。将个性化与鲁棒聚合相结合恢复了鲁棒性（2.8%的攻击成功率），且仅需支付很小的准确率代价，揭示了鲁棒更新选择与协同表示学习之间的权衡。结果在不同的客户端数量以及更困难的六条件数据集上保持一致。代码和数据分区已发布以实现可复现性。
tldr: 本文提出了将个性化联邦学习与鲁棒聚合相结合的方法，有效解决了航空发动机剩余寿命预测中因数据异构和恶意攻击带来的安全与精度难题。
ai_comments: 该论文探讨了航空发动机剩余寿命预测中联邦学习面临的良性和对抗性异构性双重挑战，创新性地将个性化联邦学习与鲁棒聚合结合，对保障航空安全具有重要意义。
motivation: 旨在解决航空发动机剩余寿命预测中联邦学习面临的良性异构性（不同运行条件和故障模式）与对抗性异构性（受损客户端提交恶意更新）的双重挑战。
method: 采用多任务一维卷积神经网络和结构化非独立同分布（non-IID）划分的C-MAPSS基准数据集，对比了四种良性异构性解决方法、五种攻击方法以及四种聚合方法。
results: 共享表示个性化弥补了约70%的局部到中心化RMSE差距；Krum将攻击成功率降低了一个数量级；将个性化与鲁棒聚合相结合可将攻击成功率降至2.8%，同时仅付出很小的精度代价。
conclusion: 结合共享表示个性化与鲁棒聚合能够有效平衡抗攻击能力与预测精度，是解决航空发动机故障预测中异构联邦学习的有效途径。

title: When Modalities Fail to Tango: Conformal Backdoor Detection in Multimodal Contrastive Learning
authors: Yiming Chen, Kemou Li, Haiwei Wu, Jiantao Zhou
abstract: Backdoor attacks in multimodal contrastive learning (MCL) have garnered growing attention in recent years, as many downstream tasks critically depend on pre-trained MCL models. Existing detection-based defenses predominantly rely on the CLIPScore metric, under the assumption that poisoned pairs exhibit lower semantic similarity between the image and the caption. However, we identify two critical flaws remaining in existing methods: (1) the substantial overlap between CLIPScore distributions of benign and poisoned pairs undermines the reliability of this metric, and (2) fixed-threshold detection cannot provide statistical guarantees for ambiguous samples within overlapping regions. To overcome these limitations, we propose integrating conformal prediction (CP), a statistical framework that quantifies uncertainty through nonconformity scores (NCSs), to establish provable confidence bounds for detecting poisoned image-caption pairs. Building on CP, we introduce CASCADE, a novel two-stage Coarse-to-Fine Conformal Backdoor Detection framework. The coarse-grained stage uses cross-modality consistency to identify high-confidence benign and poisoned pairs. In the fine-grained stage, a reference set is constructed from high-confidence poisoned pairs, and instance-level NCSs based on text-space similarity are computed for each sample in the unidentified subset. These NCSs measure conformity to the poisoning distribution and enable precise identification of latent poisoned pairs within the unidentified subset. Extensive experiments on the large-scale CC3M dataset demonstrate that CASCADE achieves an average FPR of 5.79% at 100% TPR and an average AUROC of 0.9867 across diverse attacks, while remaining effective against adaptive attacks.
zh_title: 当模态无法共舞：多模态对比学习中的共形后门检测
translation: 多模态对比学习（MCL）中的后门攻击近年来受到了越来越多的关注，因为许多下游任务严重依赖于预训练的MCL模型。现有的基于检测的防御方法主要依赖于CLIPScore指标，其假设受污染对的图像和文本之间的语义相似度较低。然而，我们发现现有方法存在两个关键缺陷：（1）良性和受污染对的CLIPScore分布之间存在大量重叠，削弱了该指标的可靠性；（2）固定阈值检测无法为重叠区域内的模糊样本提供统计保证。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出将共形预测（CP）这一通过非一致性分数（NCSs）量化不确定性的统计框架结合起来，为检测受污染的图文对建立可证明的置信边界。在CP的基础上，我们引入了CASCADE，一个新颖的两阶段由粗到细的共形后门检测框架。粗粒度阶段利用跨模态一致性来识别高置信度的良性和受污染对。在细粒度阶段，由高置信度的受污染对构建参考集，并为未识别子集中的每个样本计算基于文本空间相似度的实例级NCSs。这些NCSs测量了对污染分布的一致性，并能够精确识别未识别子集中的潜在受污染对。在大规模CC3M数据集上的大量实验表明，CASCADE在各种攻击下以100%的TPR实现了5.79%的平均FPR，平均AUROC达到0.9867，同时对自适应攻击保持有效。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CASCADE的新型共形后门检测框架，利用共形预测为多模态对比学习中的后门检测提供统计保证和高精度识别。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将共形预测（Conformal Prediction）引入多模态对比学习的后门检测中，突破了传统基于固定阈值和CLIPScore方法的局限性，提供了具备统计保证的置信度边界，在安全性和鲁棒性方面有重要贡献。
motivation: 现有的多模态对比学习后门检测方法主要依赖CLIPScore指标，存在良性与中毒对分布重叠严重以及固定阈值无法对重叠区域的模糊样本提供统计保证的关键缺陷。
method: 提出了CASCADE，一个两阶段的由粗到细的共形后门检测框架。粗粒度阶段利用跨模态一致性识别高置信度的良性和中毒对；细粒度阶段基于高置信度中毒对构建参考集，通过计算文本空间相似度的非 conformity scores (NCSs) 精确识别潜在中毒对。
results: 在CC3M数据集上的广泛实验表明，CASCADE在各种攻击下实现了平均5.79%的误报率（100%召回率下）和0.9867的平均AUROC，并且对自适应攻击依然有效。
conclusion: 本研究提出的CASCADE框架成功解决了多模态对比学习中后门检测的置信度与重叠分布问题，实验证明其在各种攻击下均具有高效且鲁棒的检测能力。

title: LaPrune: Controllable Differentiable Sparsity at Million Scale
authors: Jakub Antczak, Joanna Wojciechowicz, Łukasz Struski, Jacek Tabor
abstract: Top-$k$ selection determines which components of a sparse model remain active. Hard selection blocks gradients, while continuous relaxations often couple mask hardness to the selected mass. We introduce LaPrune, a mathematically exact-budget differentiable layer that controls the normalized second moment while preserving the selected mass. A LapSum barrier preserves the selection mass, and a normalized second-moment constraint moves the mask from a dense equal-mass allocation toward hard top-$k$ at each budget. We derive a population prediction of the saturated fraction, a near-binary limiting law, and a tight worst-case guarantee on the near-zero fraction. The normalized hardness parameter is invariant to score scale, while a fixed LapSum temperature is not.
zh_title: LaPrune：百万级规模下的可控可微稀疏性
translation: Top-k选择决定了稀疏模型的哪些组件保持活跃。硬选择会阻断梯度，而连续松弛通常将掩码硬度与所选质量耦合。我们引入了LaPrune，这是一个数学上精确预算的可微分层，它在保持所选质量的同时控制归一化二阶矩。LapSum势垒保持了选择质量，而归一化二阶矩约束在每个预算下将掩码从密集的等质量分配推向硬Top-k。我们推导了饱和分数的总体预测、近二进制极限定律以及近零分数的紧密最坏情况保证。归一化硬度参数对分数尺度具有不变性，而固定的LapSum温度则不然。
tldr: LaPrune是一种解决稀疏模型中Top-k选择梯度阻断和硬度耦合问题的新型可微分稀疏层。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种名为LaPrune的可控可微稀疏性方法，通过精确的预算控制和LapSum势垒解决了传统Top-k选择中梯度阻断和松弛操作耦合的问题。该方法在百万级规模上具有较强的理论保证和实用价值。
motivation: Top-k选择决定了稀疏模型中哪些组件保持活跃，但硬选择会阻断梯度，而连续松弛通常将掩码硬度与所选质量耦合，因此需要一种可控且可微的稀疏性方法来解决该问题。
method: 引入数学上精确预算的可微分层，通过LapSum势垒保持选择质量，并利用归一化二阶矩约束将掩码从密集等质量分配推向硬Top-k。
results: 推导了饱和分数的总体预测、近二进制极限定律以及近零分数的紧密最坏情况保证；归一化硬度参数对分数尺度具有不变性。
conclusion: LaPrune提供了一种在百万级规模下实现可控可微分稀疏性的数学精确预算方法，有效克服了传统稀疏化方法中的梯度和硬度耦合问题。

title: SJEPA: Learning Elegant Latent Dynamics with Hybrid Symbolic-Neural Predictors
authors: Yongchao Huang
abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn abstract states by predicting target embeddings from context embeddings, but their transition models are typically opaque neural maps. We introduce SJEPA, a reconstruction-free JEPA framework that learns predictive representations whose induced dynamics admit compact symbolic descriptions. Its hybrid transition combines a symbolic law with a regularised neural correction for dynamics outside the selected grammar. The central principle is to learn the simplest adequate dynamics: representation constraints preserve informative, non-collapsed predictive coordinates, while operator compression favours low-complexity symbolic-neural transitions that remain predictively adequate. We formalise this principle through induced-dynamics complexity, analyse predictive-coordinate non-identifiability, and show that unconstrained operator compression creates a direct shortcut to representation collapse. The framework supports both alternating representation-equation learning and symbolic dynamics fitted to fixed representations. In controlled pendulum experiments, joint learning discovers substantially simpler symbolic dynamics with lower long-horizon rollout error and divergence than post-hoc fitting, while an unconstrained one-step diagnostic realises the predicted collapse shortcut. Under grammar misspecification, correction regularisation preserves the representable symbolic mechanism and directs the neural component towards residual dynamics. The results expose a controllable trade-off among predictive fidelity, representation quality, symbolic parsimony, and symbolic-neural allocation.
zh_title: SJEPA：利用混合符号-神经预测器学习优雅的潜空间动力学
translation: 联合嵌入预测架构通过从上下文嵌入预测目标嵌入来学习抽象状态，但它们的转移模型通常是不透明的神经网络映射。我们引入了SJEPA，这是一个免重构的JEPA框架，它学习其诱导动力学允许紧凑符号描述的预测表征。其混合转换将符号规律与针对所选文法之外的动力学的正则化神经修正相结合。核心原则是学习最简单的充分动力学：表征约束保留了信息丰富、未坍塌的预测坐标，而算子压缩则有利于低复杂度的符号-神经转换，同时保持预测的充分性。我们通过诱导动力学复杂度形式化了这一原则，分析了预测坐标的不可辨识性，并表明不受约束的算子压缩为表征坍塌创造了一条直接捷径。该框架支持交替表征-方程学习和拟合到固定表征的符号动力学。在受控的摆锤实验中，联合学习发现了具有更低长期展开误差和散度的更简单的符号动力学，优于事后拟合，而不受约束的一步诊断实现了预测的坍塌捷径。在文法误设定下，修正正则化保留了可表示的符号机制，并将神经分量引导向残差动力学。结果揭示了预测保真度、表征质量、符号简约性以及符号-神经分配之间可控的权衡。
tldr: SJEPA结合了符号逻辑与神经网络，无需重构即可学习具有紧凑且可解释符号描述的潜空间动力学。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将符号逻辑与神经网络相结合，提出了一种名为SJEPA的混合预测架构，旨在解决传统联合嵌入预测架构中转移模型不透明的问题，并通过诱导动力学复杂度理论防止表征坍塌。
motivation: 传统的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）虽然能学习抽象状态，但其转换模型通常是不透明的神经网络映射，缺乏可解释的紧凑符号描述。
method: 引入SJEPA框架，其混合转换结合了符号规律与用于处理文法外动力学的正则化神经修正，并应用了表示约束和算子压缩。
results: 在受控的摆锤实验中，联合学习发现了更简单的符号动力学，具有更低的长期展开误差和散度；无约束的单步诊断则验证了预测的坍塌捷径。
conclusion: SJEPA通过混合符号-神经预测器成功实现了简洁的潜空间动力学学习，在保持预测准确性的同时提高了可解释性。

title: Modality Agreement- and Conflict-Aware Prototype Hypergraph Learning for Multimodal Intent Understanding
authors: Mohnish Raj, Suraj Kumar, Soumi Chattopadhayay, Chandranath Adak, Ayan Dutta
abstract: Multimodal intent recognition requires understanding not only what textual, acoustic, and visual signals share, but also how they disagree. Such disagreement is frequently class-informative; for example, lexical positivity accompanied by incongruent vocal or facial behavior may indicate sarcasm or taunting, yet most fusion methods either encourage modality alignment or treat inconsistency as uncertainty to be suppressed. We propose MACH (Modality Agreement- and Conflict-aware prototype Hypergraph), a hierarchical prototype-hypergraph framework that represents multimodal agreement and conflict as distinct, recurring relational structures. MACH progressively composes unimodal representations into bimodal and trimodal abstractions. At each applicable level, modality-composition anchors activate sparse agreement prototype hypergraphs that capture reusable consensus patterns, while a separate conflict pathway maps cross-modal discrepancies to dedicated conflict prototype hypergraphs. The two pathways are combined through a feature-wise, sample-adaptive arbitration mechanism, enabling the model to preserve informative disagreement while suppressing incidental modality noise. A progressive optimization strategy stabilizes the interdependent hierarchy before joint agreement-conflict learning. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed formulation, while component and robustness analyses validate the distinct roles of hierarchical composition, prototype-mediated semantic refinement, and agreement-conflict arbitration.
zh_title: 面向多模态意图理解的模态一致与冲突感知原型超图学习
translation: 多模态意图识别不仅需要理解文本、声学和视觉信号的共同点，还需要理解它们的分歧。这种分歧通常包含类别信息；例如，词汇的积极性伴随着不一致的声音或面部行为可能表明讽刺或嘲弄，然而大多数融合方法要么鼓励模态对齐，要么将不一致视为需要抑制的不确定性。我们提出了MACH（模态一致与冲突感知的原型超图），这是一个分层的原型超图框架，将多模态的一致性和冲突表示为不同的、反复出现的关联结构。MACH将单模态表示逐步组合成双模态和三模态抽象。在每个适用级别，模态组合锚点激活稀疏的一致原型超图，捕捉可重用的共识模式，而单独的冲突路径则将跨模态差异映射到专用的冲突原型超图中。这两条路径通过特征级的、样本自适应的仲裁机制结合起来，使模型能够保留信息丰富的不一致性，同时抑制偶然的模态噪声。渐进式优化策略在联合一致性-冲突学习之前稳定了相互依赖的层次结构。在基准数据集上的实验证明了所提出的公式的有效性，而组件和鲁棒性分析验证了分层组合、原型介导的语义精炼以及一致-冲突仲裁的不同作用。
tldr: 提出了一种名为MACH的分层原型超图框架，能够显式捕捉并结合多模态数据中的一致性与冲突性，从而提升多模态意图理解的性能。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地提出同时捕捉模态间一致性与冲突性并用于多模态意图理解，通过原形超图框架有效建模了复杂的模态交互，克服了传统方法仅追求对齐或忽视不一致信息的局限性。
motivation: 多模态意图识别不仅需要理解文本、声学和视觉信号的共同点，还需要理解它们的分歧（如讽刺或嘲弄），然而大多数融合方法倾向于模态对齐或将不一致性视为需要抑制的不确定性，忽略了冲突信息的类别信息价值。
method: 提出了MACH（Modality Agreement- and Conflict-aware prototype Hypergraph）框架，采用分层原型超图结构，通过模态组合锚点激活稀疏的一致性原型超图，利用独立的冲突路径映射跨模态差异，并通过特征级样本自适应仲裁机制结合两条路径，辅以渐进式优化策略。
results: 在基准数据集上的实验证明了所提方法的有效性，组件和鲁棒性分析验证了分层组合、原型介导的语义精炼以及一致性-冲突仲裁的不同作用。
conclusion: MACH框架通过显式建模多模态的一致与冲突结构，并采用自适应仲裁与渐进式优化策略，显著提升了多模态意图理解的准确性与鲁棒性。

title: Advancing Utility Pole and Sign Detection Through Deep Learning
authors: Carl Dickinson, Gaetano Di Caterina
abstract: Utility poles are an essential part of the infrastructure used to support power distribution systems and other critical public services. Their regular inspection is crucial to ensure the stability and safety of the electrical grid. A deep learning framework is presented for the automated detection, segmentation and lean angle estimation of wooden utility poles, and classification of attached electrical warning signs, using ground-level imagery. The system is trained on a custom dataset of 4,570 annotated images extracted from Google Street View, featuring challenging real-world scenes with visually ambiguous wooden poles lacking distinctive features. The proposed model is based on the Detection Transformer (DETR), suitably modified and trained on the custom dataset. The model outperforms standard object detectors (RetinaNet, Faster R-CNN, YOLOv3-Tiny), achieving a mean average precision of 90.43% for pole detection and 88.26% for sign detection. Extending this model with a segmentation head enables per-instance mask generation, which is then used to estimate pole lean angle. The model accurately estimates lean for 1,367 out of 1,433 test-set poles, with a mean absolute error of 1.01 degrees. Moreover, the custom dataset created in this work is also made publicly available to be used as a benchmark.

title: Learning Sexism Detection Using Multi-Agent Perspectivist Preference Optimization
authors: Hadi Mohammadi, Tina Shahedi, Robert A. Bagheri, Mehdi Dastani, Masoume M. Raeissi
abstract: When people label text for sexism, they often disagree, and not because some of them are wrong: they genuinely perceive sexism differently. Most NLP systems discard this disagreement by collapsing it into a majority vote. We propose the Multi-Agent Perspectivist Preference Optimization (MAP-PO) framework to keep these different perspectives. On the EXIST 2024 dataset of labeled English and Spanish tweets, we first cluster annotators by their labeling behavior rather than their demographic attributes. We then fine-tune one Large Language Model agent per cluster to reproduce that cluster's annotation behavior, and coordinate the agents with preference optimization that combines individual and team-level rewards. We evaluate MAP-PO in four settings defined by two languages and two backbone language models, asking whether each agent reproduces the annotations of its own cluster and whether the agents together reproduce the majority label. Two findings hold in all four settings. First, without fine-tuning the agents behave almost identically, so cluster-specific training is necessary. Second, we show that training each agent only on the labels of its own cluster pushes the agents far beyond the clusters they should represent, while adding a shared team-level training signal consistently keeps each agent calibrated to its cluster.
comment: 17 pages, 12 figures, 14 tables. Preprint; under review at EACL 2027 (ACL Rolling Review, August 2026 cycle). Code and data: https://github.com/mohammadi-hadi/MAP-PO
zh_title: 基于多智能体视角主义偏好优化的性别歧视检测学习
translation: 当人们为文本标注性别歧视时，他们经常产生分歧，这并不是因为其中一些人是错的：他们对性别歧视的感知确实存在差异。大多数自然语言处理系统通过将这些分歧折叠为多数投票来丢弃它们。我们提出了多智能体视角主义偏好优化（MAP-PO）框架来保留这些不同的视角。在包含英语和西班牙语标记推文的EXIST 2024数据集上，我们首先根据标注者的标注行为而不是人口统计属性对其进行聚类。然后，我们为每个聚类微调一个大语言模型代理以重现该聚类的标注行为，并通过结合个体和团队级别奖励的偏好优化来协调这些代理。我们在由两种语言和两个骨干语言模型定义的四种设置中评估了MAP-PO，询问每个代理是否重现其自身聚类的标注，以及这些代理是否共同重现了多数标签。在所有四种设置中都有两个发现成立。首先，未经微调的代理表现几乎完全相同，因此聚类特定的训练是必要的。其次，我们发现仅在自身聚类的标签上训练每个代理会将其推向远远超出了他们应该代表的聚类的方向，而添加共享的团队级训练信号始终可以使每个代理与其聚类保持校准。
tldr: 提出了一种名为MAP-PO的多智能体框架，通过行为聚类和偏好优化，在性别歧视检测中保留并模拟了标注者的多样化观点，克服了传统多数投票法丢失细节的缺点。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了多智能体视角主义偏好优化（MAP-PO）框架，有效处理了文本标注中客观存在的视角分歧，避免了传统多数投票法忽略少数观点的弊端，对计算社会学和NLP领域的公平性研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有大多数自然语言处理系统通过多数投票丢弃了人们在标注性别歧视文本时产生的真实视角分歧，为了保留这些不同的视角，作者提出了MAP-PO框架。
method: 首先根据标注行为（而非人口统计属性）将标注者聚类，然后为每个聚类微调一个大语言模型代理以模拟其行为，最后通过结合个体和团队级别奖励的偏好优化来协调这些代理。

conclusion: MAP-PO框架证明了结合个体与团队级别的奖励能够有效保持大语言模型代理的视角多样性，并在还原特定群体标注行为和整体多数标签方面表现出色。

title: The LLM Proposes, the Executive Disposes: A Self-Verifying Agent Instrument that Dissociates Commitment Drift from Binding Drift in Long-Horizon Agents
authors: Mohsen Arjmandi
abstract: How do you verify a long-horizon agent when its own state and self-reports are exactly what you cannot trust? We present an agent instrument built so that verification is structural rather than post-hoc. A deterministic Executive owns all belief; a language model may only file typed proposals, and a claim is admitted only when a prediction pre-registered before acting is matched against observation by code. Two properties make the instrument a verifier of its own science, not just of the agent: every run invalidates itself when per-organ write-error, render-size, or salted-canary-echo floors are breached (four of the first eight architecture runs were invalidated, each localizing a real defect); and a render-invisible shadow reference compiles the plan the full system would have committed in every ablation cell, so drift metrics are defined even where the mechanism under test has been removed. Using this instrument we report a clean, single-variable result on a failure every long-horizon agent suffers: ablating the commitment mechanism flips goal-abandonment from 0.00 to 1.00 while binding error stays flat at 0.00 (three seeds per cell, up to 394 reference beats per run, every run gated valid). The binding channel, by contrast, does not reappear as per-beat drift when its repair is ablated -- because binding is code-owned, the failure class is structurally absorbed, its only residue appearing one layer upstream as a collapse in hypothesis formation. We report these under full disclosure that task efficacy is null (zero level completions across 52 gated runs on ARC-AGI-3), pre-registered as a structural defeater. The contribution is a verification methodology for agent development and the drift decomposition it makes measurable.

title: Tail-Calibrated Soft-Output GRAND for Finite-Memory Noise-Effect Posteriors
authors: Behrooz Razeghi
abstract: In guessing random additive noise decoding (GRAND), memory in the hard-decision noise effect changes the likelihood order of candidate noise effects. In soft-output decoding, the same memory also affects the finite-block quantity determining the missing-list probability: the codebook-restricted posterior mass outside the current list. Existing correlation-aware GRAND methods exploit local dependence without interleaving, but their stopping and soft-output rules are not derived from finite-memory posterior tails. Soft-output GRAND (SOGRAND) derives random-codebook a posteriori probability (APP) estimates for GRAND lists, but does not provide finite-memory algorithms for posterior weights, partition functions, tail masses, or bitwise tail marginals for correlated noise-effect posteriors. We introduce Tail-Calibrated SOGRAND for binary additive channels whose ambient hard-decision noise-effect posterior, conditioned on received soft information, is represented by a finite-memory energy. The decoder enumerates candidate noise effects in nondecreasing posterior energy, queries codebook membership as in GRAND, computes posterior weights and tail masses by finite-state recursions, and estimates the unqueried codebook-restricted denominator as $p_qT_q$, where $T_q$ is the ambient posterior tail mass and $p_q$ is the remaining random-codebook occupancy probability. With exact enumeration and no abandonment, the first listed codeword is ML under the likelihood model defining the posterior energy. We also prove an ambient posterior-tail abandonment bound and, separately, conditional unbiasedness, variance, and concentration bounds for the random-codebook missing-list estimator. The same posterior-tail decomposition gives blockwise APP estimates, missing-list probabilities, and bitwise APP log-likelihood ratios (LLRs) for finite-memory noise-effect posteriors.

title: An Inline Control Architecture for Language Models in Intelligent Transportation Systems
authors: Narendra Kumar Dewangan, Mounira Msahli
abstract: Vehicle-to-everything (V2X) systems increasingly incorporate large language models (LLMs) for semantic tasks such as message summarization, operator assistance, and decision support at roadside units and edge nodes. Although these components are not part of safety-critical control loops, they introduce prompt-level attack surfaces that are not addressed by traditional V2X security mechanisms focused on authentication and message integrity. This paper presents Guarded-V2X, an inline semantic guardrail architecture for securing LLM-enabled V2X services under real-time constraints. The proposed system integrates rule-based ingress filtering, a lightweight safety classifier, policy-constrained structured generation, trusted-only retrieval, and post-decision adjudication to enforce machine-checkable safety boundaries prior to downstream execution. Guarded-V2X is evaluated using a four-stage experimental pipeline encompassing intrusion vulnerability analysis, calibration and latency benchmarking, guardrail validation, and robustness under adversarial stress. Experiments are conducted on a V2X-aligned simulated dataset derived from RSU advisories, operator messages, and annotated V2X message summaries. Results show that unguarded and prompt-only baselines retain residual vulnerability under multi-turn adversarial trials, while Guarded-V2X consistently reduces intrusion acceptance success rates and eliminates observed unsafe completions in two-turn settings, without exceeding latency budgets for V2X semantic advisory paths.
zh_title: 智能交通系统中语言模型的内联控制架构
translation: 车联网（V2X）系统越来越多地将大语言模型（LLM）用于路侧单元和边缘节点的语义任务，如消息摘要、操作员辅助和决策支持。尽管这些组件不属于安全关键控制回路，但它们引入了传统V2X安全机制（侧重于身份验证和消息完整性）未解决的提示词级攻击面。本文提出了Guarded-V2X，一种用于在实时约束下保护LLM赋能的V2X服务的内联语义护栏架构。所提出的系统集成了基于规则的入站过滤、轻量级安全分类器、策略约束的结构化生成、可信检索以及决策后裁决，以便在下游执行前强制实施机器可检查的安全边界。Guarded-V2X使用包含入侵漏洞分析、校准和延迟基准测试、护栏验证以及对抗压力下鲁棒性的四阶段实验管道进行了评估。实验在基于RSU建议、操作员消息和注释的V2X消息摘要导出的V2X对齐模拟数据集上进行。结果表明，未加保护的和仅提示词的基线在多轮对抗试验中保留了残余漏洞，而Guarded-V2X持续降低了入侵接受成功率，消除了两轮设置中观察到的不安全补全，且没有超出V2X语义建议路径的延迟预算。
tldr: 提出了一种名为Guarded-V2X的内联安全护栏架构，用于保护智能交通系统中的大语言模型免受提示词攻击，同时满足实时性能要求。
ai_comments: 该论文针对智能交通系统中大语言模型引入的新型提示词攻击面，提出了一种实时内联安全护栏架构，兼顾了安全性与实时性约束，对V2X系统的安全部署具有重要意义。
motivation: V2X系统引入大语言模型处理语义任务带来了未被传统安全机制覆盖的提示词级攻击面，需要在实时约束下确保安全性。
method: 提出了Guarded-V2X架构，整合了基于规则的入站过滤、轻量级安全分类器、策略约束的结构化生成、可信检索以及决策后裁决。

title: Monte Carlo Tree Search for Table-to-Multimodal Report Generation
authors: Teng Lin, Zhiyang Zhang, Yuyu Luo, Nan Tang
abstract: Automatically generating professional multimodal reports comprising both textual analysis and visual charts from structured tabular data is a critical challenge in data intelligence. Existing methods suffer from fixed linear pipelines and isolated subtask processing, which hinder joint optimization of factual accuracy, visual quality, and narrative coherence. To address these issues, this paper proposes MCTS-Report, a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-driven framework that formulates multimodal table-to-report generation as a progressive construction process over a structured search space. The core idea is to decompose report generation into atomic actions, including chapter planning, visualization task identification, chart generation, insight organization, and narrative refinement, each executed by an LLM based on dynamic reasoning conditioned on the current report state. We use an LLM to generate step-by-step reasoning and actions during MCTS, storing the reasoning trajectory in each node for context-aware, coherent report construction. To guide the search, we design a multi-dimensional reward function that jointly evaluates numerical fact consistency (via SQL), chart quality, chart-text alignment, and structural completeness, while incorporating a diversity penalty to suppress repeated charts and a precondition check to prune invalid actions. We also construct MMRBench, a comprehensive benchmark comprising real-world tables from six domains, paired with expert-refined reference report structures and verifiable key insights. Experiments on MMRBench demonstrate that MCTS-Report significantly outperforms strong baselines across structural completeness, numerical accuracy, chart-text alignment, and insight novelty, achieving a 77.9 overall score.
