zh_title: 阿片类药物使用障碍预测中EHR诊断代码特征选择方法的比较研究
translation: 特征选择是基于电子健康记录（EHR）的预测建模中的关键步骤，其中输入变量通常具有高维、稀疏、噪声大和冗余的特点。大型特征集不仅增加了计算负担和过拟合风险，还使模型解释变得困难，导致其在临床环境中的实用性受限。在本研究中，我们专注于诊断相关特征，并比较了用于阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）预测的五种特征选择范式：复发富集、NTK激发的早期梯度敏感性、LightGBM-SHAP、弹性网和大语言模型（LLM）引导的语义选择。我们使用统一的预处理和评估框架，通过下游预测性能、重采样稳定性和对不常见诊断代码的表征能力来评估每种方法。我们的结果表明，随着特征预算的增加，性能有所提升，但在达到中等规模后收益递减。NTK敏感性方法提供了最佳的准确性和稳定性总体平衡，尽管LLM引导的选择独立性能较低，但它贡献了互补的临床有意义信号。
tldr: 本研究比较了五种EHR诊断代码特征选择方法用于阿片类药物使用障碍预测的效果，发现NTK敏感性方法表现最优，LLM能提供有价值的互补临床信号。
ai_comments: 该研究针对电子健康记录（EHR）中阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）预测的高维、稀疏诊断代码特征，系统比较了五种不同的特征选择方法。创新点在于结合了传统机器学习、深度学习（NTK）和大语言模型（LLM）的语义选择，为临床预测模型的特征工程提供了有价值的参考。
motivation: 电子健康记录（EHR）中的输入变量通常具有高维、稀疏、噪声大和冗余的特点，大规模特征集不仅增加了计算负担和过拟合风险，还阻碍了模型的临床解释性。因此，需要研究和比较针对OUD预测的最佳特征选择方法。
method: 比较了五种特征选择范式：复发富集（recurrence enrichment）、NTK激发的早期梯度敏感性、LightGBM-SHAP、弹性网（Elastic Net）和大语言模型（LLM）引导的语义选择。在统一的预处理和评估框架下，通过下游预测性能、重采样稳定性和对不常见诊断代码的表征能力进行评估。
results: 随着特征预算的增加，预测性能随之提升，但在达到适度规模后收益递减。NTK敏感性方法提供了最佳的整体准确性和稳定性平衡，而LLM引导的选择尽管独立性能较低，但能贡献互补的临床意义信号。
conclusion: NTK敏感性方法在准确性和稳定性之间提供了最佳平衡，而LLM引导的选择则能够提供互补的临床有意义信号，这为未来的临床预测模型开发提供了指导。

title: MergeSE: Post-Hoc Model Merging for Software Engineering Tasks Without Retraining
authors: Palash R. Roy, Banani Roy, Kevin A. Schneider, Chanchal K. Roy
abstract: Fine-tuned code models often behave as domain specialists and can degrade sharply under distribution shift: in our clone-detection setting, a model trained on same-language clones drops 71\% F1 on cross-language clones, while multi-task training falls to 0.151 F1 on unseen AI-generated clones. Our companion study shows that post-hoc model merging can address this fragmentation, achieving 93\% of multi-task performance without training data while generalizing 4$\times$ better to unseen clone types. However, no practical tool exists that lets SE researchers diagnose checkpoint compatibility, merge specialists, validate results on SE benchmarks, and export models for deployment. We present \textbf{MergeSE}, an open-source CLI and web tool for training-free model merging of HuggingFace encoder checkpoints. While motivated by OOD generalization in clone detection, MergeSE supports SE classification workflows more broadly through a built-in registry of nine task types, including vulnerability detection, defect prediction, and code-smell detection. MergeSE provides five operations: \textit{tasks}, \textit{inspect}, \textit{merge}, \textit{evaluate}, and \textit{export}. It supports five merging algorithms, including TIES, DARE-TIES, Wudi, PCB, and averaging; detects cross-task classification-head mismatches; produces seedable deterministic outputs; and includes bundled benchmark samples for smoke-test reproduction. A full merge of two 124M-parameter checkpoints completes in under 5 seconds on CPU. End-to-end validation confirms that MergeSE-produced checkpoints match reference implementations and recover cross-domain performance from domain-specific specialists. The tool is available online at https://mergese.usask.ca, and the development repository is at https://github.com/srlabUsask/MergeSE.
zh_title: MergeSE：无需重新训练的软件工程任务后门模型合并
translation: 微调的代码模型通常表现为领域专家，在分布偏移下性能会急剧下降：在我们的克隆检测设置中，在同语言克隆上训练的模型在跨语言克隆上F1分数下降了71%，而多任务训练在未见过的AI生成克隆上的F1分数下降至0.151。我们的配套研究表明，事后模型合并可以解决这种碎片化问题，在无需训练数据的情况下实现多任务性能的93%，同时对未见过的克隆类型的泛化能力提高了4倍。然而，目前尚不存在一个实用的工具，能够让SE研究人员诊断检查点兼容性、合并专家模型、在SE基准上验证结果并导出用于部署的模型。我们提出了MergeSE，这是一个用于HuggingFace编码器检查点免训练模型合并的开源CLI和Web工具。虽然受克隆检测中OOD泛化的启发，但MergeSE通过内置的九种任务类型注册表（包括漏洞检测、缺陷预测和代码坏味检测）更广泛地支持SE分类工作流。MergeSE提供五种操作：tasks、inspect、merge、evaluate和export。它支持五种合并算法，包括TIES、DARE-TIES、Wudi、PCB和averaging；检测跨任务分类头不匹配；产生可种子的确定性输出；并包含用于冒烟测试复现的捆绑基准样本。两个124M参数检查点的完整合并在CPU上可在5秒内完成。端到端验证证实，MergeSE生成的检查点与参考实现相匹配，并从领域特定专家那里恢复了跨域性能。该工具可在https://mergese.usask.ca在线获取，开发仓库位于https://github.com/srlabUsask/MergeSE。
tldr: MergeSE是一个用于软件工程代码模型无训练合并的开源CLI和Web工具，能够有效解决微调模型的性能退化和分布偏移问题。
ai_comments: MergeSE巧妙地将模型合并技术（Model Merging）引入软件工程领域，解决了微调模型在面对分布偏移时的性能下降问题，且无需重新训练，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 微调的代码模型容易退化且对分布偏移敏感（如跨语言克隆检测性能急剧下降），而目前缺乏一个实用的、无需训练的模型合并工具来整合SE领域的专业模型。

title: Test, then Route: How Language Models Execute In-Context Conditional Rules Across Models and Languages
authors: Luxshan Thavarasa, Sivasuthan Sukumar
abstract: When a language model follows an in-context conditional rule such as "if P(x) then A else B," does it assemble a runtime circuit with one module that tests the predicate and another that routes the answer? We probe this with activation patching under a four-donor design whose two swapped-rule donors make the condition and the answer word disagree, so each layer reveals which of the two it carries. Across three open models from two families and six languages sharing one fixed item bank, a mid-stack residual band carries the predicate's truth value: patching it reroutes the answer with predicate-outcome flip near 1.0 and mapping flip near 0.0, meeting a strict pre-specified isolation criterion in 17 of 18 cells, and the same localization holds across five predicate families. The router shows the opposite profile. A learned subspace flips A and B near-perfectly within the trained pair yet transfers to a new pair at approximately 0 in every model, while in Gemma-3-4B (the only model probed cross-lingually) it transfers at approximately 0.98 to the same pair in other languages. Under every probe we ran, the router direction is token-bound and non-transferable (largely answer-readout in Gemma, pair-specific in Qwen) rather than an abstract routing module. Test is modular; under these probes, route is not.

title: Large Language Models for Low-Resource Languages: A Conceptual Framework for an Electronic Explanatory Dictionary of the Tajik Language
authors: Mullosharaf K. Arabov
abstract: This paper presents a conceptual framework for developing an electronic explanatory dictionary of the Tajik language using large language models (LLMs). The relevance of the work stems from the absence of a comprehensive digital lexicographic resource for Tajik that is comparable in functionality to dictionaries for high-resource languages, and from the limited adaptation of modern natural language processing technologies to low-resource language systems. Based on a systematic survey of existing linguistic, statistical, and corpus resources, we propose a dictionary architecture that integrates modules for morphological analysis, lemmatization, semantic clustering, and dictionary entry generation using LLMs. The choice of subword tokenization is justified by the agglutinative nature of Tajik morphology and its high morphological variability, along with a parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) strategy suitable for limited annotated data. The novelty of the work lies in proposing the first holistic conceptual architecture of an explanatory dictionary for Tajik that unifies classical lexicographic methods, language statistics, and generative capabilities of LLMs into a single system. The practical significance of the study is the formation of a methodological foundation for developing a full-featured electronic dictionary that can serve both as a lexicographic tool and as a core resource for machine translation, automatic summarization, sentiment analysis, and other applied NLP tasks. The paper is intended for specialists in computational linguistics, lexicography, and developers of natural language processing systems working with low-resource languages.
zh_title: 面向低资源语言的大语言模型：塔吉克语电子解释词典的概念框架
translation: 本文提出了一个利用大语言模型（LLM）开发塔吉克语电子解释词典的概念框架。该工作的相关性源于缺乏与高资源语言词典功能相当的全面数字词典资源，以及现代自然语言处理技术对低资源语言系统适应性的不足。基于对现有语言学、统计学和语料库资源的系统调查，我们提出了一个词典架构，集成了形态分析、词形还原、语义聚类以及使用LLM生成词条的模块。鉴于塔吉克语黏着语的形态特征及其高度的形态变异性，子词分词的选择得到了论证，同时采用了适用于有限标注数据的参数高效微调（PEFT）策略。本工作的创新之处在于首次提出了塔吉克语解释词典的整体概念架构，将经典词典编纂方法、语言统计学和LLM的生成能力统一到单一系统中。本研究的实际意义在于为开发全功能电子词典奠定了方法论基础，该词典既可作为词典编纂工具，也可作为机器翻译、自动摘要、情感分析和其他应用NLP任务的核心资源。本文面向计算语言学、词典编纂领域的专家以及从事低资源语言自然语言处理系统开发的工程师。
tldr: 本文提出了利用大语言模型构建塔吉克语电子解释词典的概念框架，填补了低资源语言数字词典资源的空白。
ai_comments: 该论文首次为塔吉克语提出了一种将传统词典编纂方法与大语言模型生成能力相结合的综合概念架构，对低资源语言的自然语言处理具有重要的学术和应用价值。
motivation: 缺乏与高资源语言功能相当的塔吉克语全面数字词典资源，且现代自然语言处理技术对低资源语言系统的适配有限。
method: 提出了一种词典架构，集成了形态分析、词形还原、语义聚类以及使用大语言模型的词典条目生成模块，并针对塔吉克语的黏着特性采用了子词分词技术和参数高效微调（PEFT）策略。

title: Behavioral Skill Reconstruction: Reconstructing Hidden Functionality from LLM Agent Skills
authors: Peichun Hua, Haoxuan Xu, Mengyuan Li
abstract:
Closed source agent skills may encode proprietary instructions, scripts, constants, and data. Providers may offer their capabilities as services while keeping the underlying packages hidden. Prior work focuses on prompt injection attacks that directly disclose these artifacts, and existing defenses accordingly aim to prevent such leakage. However, preventing file disclosure does not prevent users from recovering the functionality those files implement. This raises a fundamental question: can a user reconstruct a skill's functionality through ordinary use while its files remain hidden?
  We study behavioral skill reconstruction (BSR), in which an attacker uses valid task requests and observed responses to build a functional clone of a hidden skill. We introduce SkillClone, a black-box attack that clones a target skill by forming an interface hypothesis from its public advertisement, issuing structured benign probes, synthesizing an executable replica, and iteratively repairing it through differential validation against the victim skill. Across 30 skills spanning rules, tables, procedures, and algorithms, SkillClone achieves exact or partial recovery on held-out inputs for several targets. Iterative requerying closes gaps missed by single-round reconstruction. Because SkillClone uses only legitimate interactions, disclosure-focused defenses provide limited coverage, and less detailed skill descriptions offer limited protection. These results show that file secrecy alone does not ensure functional secrecy. Defenses must also limit cumulative information leakage from ordinary use.
zh_title: 行为技能重建：从大模型智能体技能中重建隐藏功能
translation:
闭源的智能体技能可能编码了专有指令、脚本、常量和数据。提供商可能会将其能力作为服务提供，同时保持底层软件包隐藏。先前的研究侧重于直接披露这些工件的提示注入攻击，现有的防御措施也相应地旨在防止此类泄露。然而，防止文件泄露并不能阻止用户恢复这些文件所实现的功能。这就提出了一个根本性的问题：用户能否在文件保持隐藏的情况下，通过普通使用重建技能的功能？
我们研究了行为技能重建（BSR），其中攻击者使用有效的任务请求和观察到的响应来构建隐藏技能的功能克隆。我们引入了SkillClone，这是一种黑盒攻击，它通过从其公共广告中形成接口假设、发出结构化的良性探针、合成可执行副本，并通过针对受害者技能的差分验证进行迭代修复来克隆目标技能。在跨越规则、表格、程序和算法的30个技能中，SkillClone在几个目标上对保留的输入实现了精确或部分恢复。迭代查询弥补了单轮重建错过的差距。因为SkillClone仅使用合法交互，所以关注披露的防御措施提供的覆盖范围有限，而不太详细的技能描述提供的保护也有限。这些结果表明，单纯的文件保密并不能确保功能保密。防御还必须限制来自普通使用的累积信息泄露。
tldr: 本论文提出了SkillClone攻击，证明了攻击者仅通过与闭源AI智能体技能的正常交互，就能成功逆向并重建其隐藏的底层功能，打破了“文件保密即功能安全”的传统认知。
ai_comments: 该论文揭示了仅靠文件保密无法实现功能保密的重要安全隐患，提出的黑盒攻击方法SkillClone证明了通过合法交互即可重建隐藏技能，对未来大模型Agent系统的隐私保护和防御机制设计提出了新的挑战。
motivation: 闭源智能体技能可能包含专有指令和数据，现有防御侧重于防止文件泄露，但未能防止用户通过普通使用恢复隐藏文件的底层功能。
method: 引入了SkillClone黑盒攻击方法，通过从公共广告中形成接口形态假设、发出结构化良性探针、合成可执行副本，并通过与受害者技能进行差分验证来迭代修复。
results: 在跨越规则、表格、程序和算法的30个技能中，SkillClone在多个目标上实现了对留出输入（held-out inputs）的精确或部分恢复，迭代查询弥补了单轮重建的不足。
conclusion: 文件 secrecy 不等于功能 secrecy，防御机制必须限制来自普通使用的累积信息泄露。

title: Adversarially Robust Abductive Fusion of Pre-trained Transformer-based Perception Models
authors: Mario Leiva, Yue Ma, Qinru Qiu, Gerardo Simari, Paulo Shakarian
abstract: Deploying pre-trained perception models in novel environments degrades their accuracy under distributional shift, and assembling them alone does not recover it: combiners such as majority voting trade recall for precision and are brittle to coordinated failures. Prior metacognitive methods learn logical rules that flag a model's errors, but rely on hand-authored domain-knowledge cues (object-size priors, segmentation masks) that do not transfer to genuinely novel scenes. We show that this metacognitive layer can be learned without any domain knowledge by exploiting vector-space geometry: per-model Label Vector Pools (LVP), built from each model's own training embeddings, yield error-detection rules from the geometry of detections relative to training-determined prototypes, reaching parity with domain-knowledge rules to within $0.002$ every F1 on test set. Because the approach remains neurosymbolic, these geometric rules share a single logical framework and can still be complemented by domain knowledge when available. We frame the fusion of multiple imperfect ViT-based detectors as a consistency-based abduction problem solved at test time by an exact Integer Program (IP) and a polynomial-time heuristic. On an aerial-imagery benchmark of 15 weather-shifted test sets and six ViT detectors, our domain-knowledge-free layer matches the strongest majority-vote variant on clean data (within $0.005$ F1) and, unlike every majority-vote baseline, retains its performance under a coordinated label-flipping attack: at a $90\%$ flip rate it averages $0.42$ F1 versus $0.35$ for MV-Plurality (a $22\%$ relative gain) and attains the highest F1 on \emph{every} test set once the flip rate exceeds $0.4$
zh_title: 基于预训练Transformer感知模型的对抗鲁棒溯因融合
translation: 在新的环境中部署预训练的感知模型会在分布偏移下降低其准确性，而单独组装它们并不能恢复准确性：诸如多数投票等组合器以召集率为代价换取精确度，并且对协同故障很脆弱。先前的元认知方法学习标记模型错误的逻辑规则，但依赖于不适用于真正新场景的手工领域知识线索（对象大小先验、分割掩码）。我们表明，通过利用向量空间几何图形，可以在没有任何领域知识的情况下学习这种元认知层：每个模型的标签向量池（LVP）建立在每个模型自己的训练嵌入之上，从检测相对于训练确定的原型的几何形状中产生错误检测规则，在测试集上达到与领域知识规则相差0.002以内F1的奇偶校验。因为该方法仍然是神经符号学的，所以这些几何规则共享一个逻辑框架，并且在可用时仍然可以辅以领域知识。我们将多个不完美的基于ViT的检测器的融合构建为基于一致性的溯因问题，该问题在测试时通过精确的整数规划（IP）和多项式时间启发式算法解决。在包含15个天气偏移测试集和6个ViT检测器的航空图像基准测试中，我们的无领域知识层在干净数据上与最强的多数投票变体相匹配（在0.005 F1以内），并且与每个多数投票基线不同，它在协调的标签翻转攻击下保持了其性能：在90%的翻转率下，它平均为0.42 F1，而MV-Plurality为0.35（相对增益22%），一旦翻转率超过0.4，就在每个测试集上获得最高的F1。
tldr: 提出了一种无需领域知识、利用向量空间几何和溯因融合来组合预训练感知模型的方法，显著提升了在分布偏移和对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种无需领域知识、利用向量空间几何特征构建元认知层的方法，并通过一致性溯因融合框架（IP与多项式启发式算法）实现了对多个预训练ViT感知模型的对抗鲁棒性融合。这在对抗攻击和分布偏移下展现了极高的鲁棒性与实用价值。
motivation: 在面对分布偏移时，预训练感知模型准确率下降，而传统的组合方法（如多数投票）会牺牲召集率且脆弱；现有的元认知方法依赖于难以迁移的手工领域知识。因此，需要开发一种无需领域知识且具有对抗鲁棒性的模型融合方法。
method: 利用每模型的训练嵌入构建标签向量池（LVP），通过几何特征学习无领域知识的错误检测规则；并将多个ViT检测器的融合建模为基于一致性的溯因问题，在测试时通过精确整数程序（IP）和多项式时间启发式算法求解。
results: 在包含15个天气偏移测试集和6个ViT检测器的航空图像基准测试中，该方法在干净数据上与最强多数投票基线相匹配；在面对高达90%的协调标签翻转攻击时，仍能保持显著的性能优势（平均F1为0.42对比MV-Plurality的0.35），在翻转率超过0.4时在所有测试集上达到最高F1。
conclusion: 通过结合无领域知识的向量空间几何错误检测与基于整数规划的一致性溯因融合，该方法在保持高准确率的同时，显著提升了多模型系统在面对分布偏移和协调标签翻转攻击时的对抗鲁棒性。

title: Structured Differentiable Optimization for Efficient Decision-focused Learning in Power Systems
authors: Wangkun Xu, Fei Teng
abstract: Decision-focused learning (DfL) trains forecasting models to align downstream decision consequences, such as power-system operating costs. However, its application to realistic power networks is limited by the need to repeatedly solve and differentiate large optimization problems during training. This paper presents DiffAPQP, a solver-flexible framework and open-source Python package for scalable DfL with affine-parametric quadratic programs. To accelerate the forward pass, DiffAPQP automatically canonicalizes quadratic power-system models written in CVXPY into a differentiation-ready representation and takes advantage of the repetitive solving structure through solver warm-start and solver-data update during training. For the backward pass acceleration, we establish the equivalence between differentiation through the full KKT system and a reduced system obtained by eliminating inactive inequality constraints. For training losses depending solely on the optimal value, we further derive an envelope-theorem-based gradient that avoids solving an adjoint KKT system, resulting in eligible backward time. To our knowledge, this work presents the first solver-based end-to-end DfL demonstration on the IEEE 118-bus system with a 24-hour coupled economic-dispatch and redispatch horizon. Under matched SCS and Clarabel backends on a Linux machine, DiffAPQP achieves $2.27\times$--$3.58\times$ closed-loop and $3.62\times$--$4.38\times$ counterfactual end-to-end DfL training speedups over CvxpyLayers. The best solver configurations increase these speedups to $3.91\times$ (from 38.65 to 9.55 min/epoch) and $6.39\times$ (from 10.73 to 1.68 min/epoch), respectively. Additionally, DiffAPQP reduces peak memory usage by approximately $50\%$, while keeping similar operating costs as CvxpyLayers.
zh_title: 电力系统中高效决策聚焦学习的结构化可微分优化
translation: 决策聚焦学习（DfL）通过对齐下游决策后果（如电力系统运营成本）来训练预测模型。然而，其在真实电力网络中的应用受限于训练期间需要重复求解和微分的大规模优化问题。本文提出了DiffAPQP，这是一个用于具有仿射参数二次规划的可扩展DfL的求解器灵活框架和开源Python包。为了加速正向传递，DiffAPQP将用CVXPY编写的二次电力系统模型自动规范化为可微分表示，并在训练期间通过求解器热启动和求解器数据更新利用重复求解结构。为了加速反向传递，我们建立了通过完整KKT系统微分与通过消除非活动不等式约束获得的简化系统微分之间的等效性。对于仅依赖于最优值的训练损失，我们进一步推导了基于包络定理的梯度，从而避免了解算伴随KKT系统，实现了极快的反向时间。据我们所知，这项工作展示了首个基于求解器的端到端DfL在IEEE 118节点系统上的应用，并具有24小时耦合经济调度和再调度视界。在Linux机器上匹配SCS和Clarabel后端时，DiffAPQP比CvxpyLayers实现了2.27至3.58倍的闭环和3.62至4.38倍的反端到端DfL训练加速。最佳求解器配置将这些加速比分别提高到了3.91倍（从每轮38.65分钟降至9.55分钟）和6.39倍（从每轮10.73分钟降至1.68分钟）。此外，DiffAPQP将峰值内存使用量减少了约50%，同时保持了与CvxpyLayers相似的运营成本。
tldr: 提出了一种名为DiffAPQP的新型框架，通过优化正反向微分计算过程，显著提升了电力系统决策聚焦学习（DfL）的训练速度并降低了内存消耗。
ai_comments: 该论文在电力系统决策聚焦学习（DfL）领域具有重要创新，通过引入DiffAPQP框架，解决了传统方法在大规模电网应用中计算效率低、内存消耗大的痛点。其通过KKT系统简化、包络定理以及利用求解器热启动等技术，大幅提升了训练速度并降低了内存占用，是该领域的一个重要里程碑。
motivation: 传统的决策聚焦学习（DfL）在应用于真实电力网络时，受限于训练过程中需要重复求解和微分的大规模优化问题，导致计算效率低下且内存消耗巨大。
method: 提出DiffAPQP框架，利用CVXPY自动规范化二次电力系统模型，在正向传递中采用求解器热启动和求解器数据更新，在反向传递中通过消除非活动不等式约束建立简化系统，并利用包络定理计算基于最优值的损失梯度。
results: 在IEEE 118节点系统及24小时耦合经济调度与再调度视界下，DiffAPQP实现了显著的端到端训练加速（闭环加速2.27至4.38倍，最佳配置下达3.91倍和6.39倍），并将峰值内存使用量减少了约50%，同时保持了与CvxpyLayers相似的运行成本。
conclusion: DiffAPQP是一个高效、可扩展且求解器灵活的Python包，能够显著加速电力系统中基于仿射参数二次规划的决策聚焦学习训练，同时保持与现有方法相当的优化质量。

title: Patients-like-me: A Variational LM--GNN Framework for Explainable Clinical Prediction
authors: Xinyu Wang, Yixuan Li, Hanwei Wu, Qincheng Lu, Chi-Kuang Yeh, Xiao-Wen Chang, Ziyang Song
abstract: Language models (LMs) offer strong textual representations for electronic health records (EHRs), but they encode patient sequences in isolation and provide limited explainability. Graph neural networks (GNNs) complement LMs by incorporating inter-patient relationships and enabling reference-patient attribution, yet they rely on high-quality patient representations. We propose Patients-like-me (PLM), a unified LM--GNN framework that integrates local patient semantics with global cohort structure. To train PLM efficiently, we introduce a Variational Expectation-Maximization algorithm that alternates LM and GNN updates under a supervised variational objective. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV show that PLM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with improvements generalizing across encoder-only and decoder-only LM backbones. These gains are achieved with only modest additional computational overhead. PLM also provides reference-patient explanations by retrieving influential similar patients, while edge-masking experiments confirm that the highest-ranked references have the greatest impact on model predictions.
zh_title: 类我患者：用于可解释临床预测的变分LM-GNN框架
translation: 语言模型（LMs）为电子健康记录（EHRs）提供了强有力的文本表征，但它们孤立地编码患者序列，并提供有限的可解释性。图神经网络（GNNs）通过结合患者间关系和实现参考患者归因来补充LMs，然而它们依赖于高质量的患者表征。我们提出了Patients-like-me（PLM），一个将局部患者语义与全局队列结构相结合的统一LM-GNN框架。为了有效地训练PLM，我们引入了一种变分期望最大化算法，该算法在监督变分目标下交替进行LM和GNN的更新。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上的广泛实验表明，PLM consistently 优于最先进的方法，并且改进能够推广到仅编码器和仅解码器的LM骨干网络。这些收益是在仅有适度额外计算开销的情况下实现的。PLM还通过检索具有影响力的相似患者来提供参考患者解释，而边缘掩码实验证实，排名最高的参考对模型预测具有最大的影响。
tldr: 提出了一种结合语言模型与图神经网络的PLM框架，能够高效提升临床预测的准确性并提供相似患者的可解释性。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地结合了语言模型（LM）的文本表征能力与图神经网络（GNN）的群体结构捕捉能力，并通过变分期望最大化算法进行高效联合训练。不仅提升了临床预测的准确性，还通过相似患者检索提供了出色的可解释性，对医疗AI的实际应用具有重要价值。

title: SONAR: Task-Aware Code Summary Evaluation for LLM Consumers Without References
authors: Simantika Bhattacharjee Dristi, Matthew B. Dwyer
abstract: Source code summaries have traditionally been evaluated from a human developer's perspective, with quality determined by how closely they resemble developer-written references and how well they align with human preferences. But this overlooks a growing reality: LLM-based tools and agents increasingly consume code summaries as inputs for software engineering (SE) tasks, and what makes a summary useful for a consuming agent on a task remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose SONAR, a reference-free framework that evaluates source code summaries along four dimensions: Correctness, Abstraction, Conciseness, and Fluency. Rather than optimizing for a pre-written "gold standard", SONAR introduces a novel code regeneration-based approach that uses a summary to regenerate code and leverages that reconstruction as a quality signal of the summary. This provides an empirical grounding that requires neither a reference summary nor the subjective judgment of humans or LLMs. We evaluate SONAR's dimensions on their ability to influence LLM performance across four downstream SE tasks. We find that Correctness, followed by Abstraction, significantly correlates with LLM performance, with correlations up to 14X higher than the best baseline. Conciseness and Fluency, though widely valued by human developers, remain mostly insignificant to an LLM consumer, suggesting that what makes a summary useful is task- and consumer-dependent. Through a large-scale evaluation of 11 popular LLMs using SONAR, we further identify the strengths and weaknesses of different models across each quality dimension, while offering insights to facilitate future research on task-aware summarization.

title: SiMDex: Mining Similar Egocentric Videos for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation
authors: Nie Lin, Takehiko Ohkawa, Sijin Chen, Ruoshi Wen, Zhuohang Li, Liqun Huang, Zhengming Zhu, Yiming Bao, Yunfei Li, Minjie Cai, Xiao Ma, Wei Xu, Yoichi Sato
abstract: Recent years have witnessed an explosive trend of scaling ego-centric human videos for robot manipulation, yet it remains unclear which data actually benefits dexterous manipulation. We present SiMDex, a similarity-based data mining framework that casts human data selection for VLA post-training in dexterous manipulation as a recommendation problem. For each robot demonstration, SiMDex employs a three-layer recall-ranking-re-ranking pipeline to extract task-relevant subsets from a pool of ~32M egocentric human samples, operating in a morphology-agnostic action space that requires no changes to VLA architecture or training. Against a strong baseline trained with an equal amount of randomly sampled human data, SiMDex uses only ~1.49M mined samples (<5% of the pool) yet improves the overall success rate from 47.7% to 61.1%, showing that selective curation outperforms indiscriminate data mixing.
zh_title: SiMDex：挖掘相似的第一视角视频用于跨具身灵巧操作
translation: 近年来，利用大规模第一视角人类视频进行机器人操作呈现爆发式增长趋势，但究竟哪些数据真正有利于灵巧操作仍不明确。我们提出了SiMDex，这是一个基于相似性的数据挖掘框架，它将VLA后训练中的人类数据选择构建为一个推荐问题。对于每个机器人演示，SiMDex采用三层（召回-排序-重排序）管道，从约3200万个第一视角人类样本池中提取与任务相关的子集，该管道在形态无关的动作空间中运行，无需更改VLA架构或训练。与使用同等数量随机采样人类数据的强基线相比，SiMDex仅使用了约149万个挖掘样本（占数据池的不到5%），就将整体成功率从47.7%提升至61.1%，这表明选择性数据精炼优于盲目数据混合。
tldr: SiMDex通过基于相似性的三层数据挖掘框架筛选人类第一视角视频，以不到5%的数据量显著提升了机器人灵巧操作的成功率。
ai_comments: 该论文针对具身智能中的数据规模化难题，创新性地将人类第一视角数据的筛选转化为推荐系统问题，提出了SiMDex框架。通过多层级召回与排序机制，以极少的数据量（小于5%）显著提升了灵敏操作（dexterous manipulation）的成功率，证明了精细化数据筛选优于盲目的大规模数据混合，对未来机器人学习具有重要的指导意义。
motivation: 近年来虽然利用大规模第一视角人类视频进行机器人操作训练的趋势激增，但究竟哪些数据真正对灵巧操作（dexterous manipulation）有益仍不明确，且盲目混合大量数据效率低下。
method: 提出SiMDex框架，将人类数据选择构建为推荐问题；采用包含召回、排序和重排序的三层管道，从海量第一视角人类视频池中提取与机器人演示高度相关的子集，并运行在无需修改VLA架构或训练的形态无关动作空间中。
results: 使用仅约149万个挖掘样本（占数据池的不到5%），将整体成功率从强基线的47.7%提升至61.1%，证明了选择性数据筛选优于随机数据混合。
conclusion: SiMDex通过基于相似性的多层级数据挖掘框架，证明了在VLA后训练中进行选择性数据精炼（Selective curation）能以极小的数据子集大幅提升机器人灵巧操作的成功率，超越了盲目混合大规模人类数据的传统做法。

title: Unscented KalmanNet: a hybrid deep learning filter with calibrated posterior covariance for nonlinear state estimation
authors: Minhyeok Ko, Abdollah Shafieezadeh
abstract: State estimation for nonlinear dynamical systems is commonly performed with the Unscented Kalman filter (UKF), which propagates the state moments through deterministic sigma points and reports a posterior covariance at every step. In practice, however, unknown and time-varying noise statistics and model mismatch degrade both estimation accuracy and covariance calibration. Existing learned filters improve accuracy but are largely built on the extended Kalman filter and either forgo an explicit covariance or learn uncertainty without correcting mismatch-induced gain bias. This paper introduces the Unscented KalmanNet (UKN), a hybrid recursive estimator that augments the UKF with two structurally distinct learned components while preserving its explicit sigma-point covariance recursion. NoiseNet predicts time-varying process and measurement covariances as bounded multiplicative corrections to fixed baselines, guaranteeing positive definiteness, while GainNet applies a bounded residual correction to the analytical gain. A calibration-aware training objective combines state error with covariance- and innovation-consistency terms through adaptive weights, jointly optimizing accuracy and calibration. UKN is benchmarked against UKF, KalmanNet, and Bayesian KalmanNet on three synthetic systems and UZH-FPV real-flight data. It achieves the lowest aggregate state-estimation error in all four examples and reduces RMSE by $26.4$-$49.7\%$ compared to UKF in the synthetic cases. Leave-one-sequence-out cross-validation over 11 flights shows $22.4\%$ and $34.3\%$ reductions in mean position and velocity RMSE, respectively. UKN also yields the lowest fold-to-fold variability, with normalized NEES and empirical coverage closest to nominal values among the other filters.
zh_title: 无迹卡尔曼Net：一种具有校准后验协方差的用于非线性状态估计的混合深度学习滤波器
translation: 非线性动力系统的状态估计通常使用无迹卡尔曼滤波（UKF），它通过确定性 sigma 点传播状态矩，并在每一步报告后验协方差。然而在实践中，未知且时变的噪声统计量以及模型失配会降低估计精度和协方差校准。现有的学习型滤波器提高了精度，但大多基于扩展卡尔曼滤波，要么放弃了显式协方差，要么在学习不确定性的同时不纠正失配引起的增益偏差。本文介绍了无迹卡尔曼Net（UKN），这是一种混合递归估计器，它用两个结构不同的学习组件增强了 UKF，同时保留了其显式的 sigma 点协方差递推。NoiseNet 将时变的过程和测量协方差预测为对固定基线的有界乘法修正，以保证正定性；而 GainNet 对解析增益应用有界残差修正。校准感知的训练目标通过自适应权重将状态误差与协方差和新息一致性项结合起来，共同优化精度和校准。UKN 在三个合成系统和 UZH-FPV 真实飞行数据上与 UKF、KalmanNet 和 Bayesian KalmanNet 进行了基准测试。它在所有四个示例中实现了最低的总状态估计误差，与合成案例中的 UKF 相比，RMSE 降低了 $26.4\%$ 到 $49.7\%$。在 11 次飞行上的留一序列交叉验证显示，平均位置和速度 RMSE 分别降低了 $22.4\%$ 和 $34.3\%$。UKN 还产生最低的折叠到折叠变异性，在其他滤波器中具有最接近标称值的归一化 NEES 和经验覆盖率。
tldr: UKN 是一种结合深度学习与无迹卡尔曼滤波的混合滤波器，通过学习组件校正噪声和增益，显著提升了非线性状态估计的精度和协方差校准能力。
ai_comments: Unscented KalmanNet (UKN) 巧妙地将无迹卡尔曼滤波（UKF）的显式 sigma 点协方差递推与深度学习相结合，通过 NoiseNet 和 GainNet 两个结构不同的学习组件，在提高状态估计精度的同时保证了后验协方差的校准，具有很强的创新性和实用性。
motivation: 现有的非线性状态估计方法（如 UKF）在面对未知/时变噪声统计和模型失配时，估计精度和协方差校准会下降；而现有的学习型滤波器大多基于扩展卡尔曼滤波，且往往缺乏显式的协方差或无法校正增益偏差。
method: 引入了 Unscented KalmanNet (UKN)，包含两个学习组件：NoiseNet（预测时变过程和测量协方差的乘法修正）和 GainNet（对解析增益应用残差修正），并采用包含状态误差、协方差和新息一致性项的校准感知训练目标进行联合优化。
results: 在三个合成系统和一个真实飞行数据集（UZH-FPV）上，UKN 实现了最低的综合状态估计误差，相比 UKF 将合成案例的 RMSE 降低了 26.4% 至 49.7%，并在交叉验证中显著降低了位置和速度 RMSE，同时具备最佳的协方差一致性。
conclusion: UKN 是一种高效的混合深度学习滤波器，在非线性状态估计任务中表现出极高的精度和卓越的协方差校准能力。

title: Efficient Algorithms for the Bottleneck Path Problem in Geometric Graphs
authors: Matthew J. Katz, Rachel Saban, Micha Sharir
abstract:
We present efficient algorithms for the bottleneck path problem in two geometric settings that arise naturally in applications: directional-antenna graphs in the plane with antenna angles bounded from below by a constant, and visibility graphs whose vertices lie on or above a 1.5-dimensional terrain, both with Euclidean distances as edge weights. We provide near-linear algorithms for the corresponding decision problems, namely, determining whether the subgraph obtained by retaining all edges with weight at most some threshold ${\bf bn}$ contains a path from $s$ to $t$. We then use the decision procedures to obtain algorithms for the bottleneck path problem that run in $O^*(n^{8/7})$ randomized expected time, where $n$ is the input size and the $O^*(\cdot)$ notation hides subpolynomial factors.
  Within the same performance bounds, we can also solve the bounded-hop version, in which we only consider $s$-$t$ paths with at most $k$ edges, for a given integer $k < n$.
zh_title: 几何图中瓶颈路径问题的高效算法
translation: 我们在两个自然涌现于应用的几何环境中，提出了针对瓶颈路径问题的高效算法：平面中天线角度下界受常数限制的定向天线图，以及顶点位于1.5维地形上或其上的可见性图，两者的边权重均为欧几里得距离。我们为相应的判定问题（即确定保留所有权重小于等于某个阈值 ${\bf bn}$ 的边所构成的子图是否包含一条从 $s$ 到 $t$ 的路径）提供了近线性算法。随后，我们利用这些判定过程得到了求解瓶颈路径问题的算法，其运行时间为 $O^*(n^{8/7})$ 的随机期望时间，其中 $n$ 是输入规模，$O^*(\cdot)$ 符号隐藏了亚多项式因子。在相同的性能界限内，我们还可以解决带跳数的版本，即对于给定的整数 $k < n$，只考虑最多包含 $k$ 条边的 $s$-$t$ 路径。
tldr: 本文提出了在平面定向天线图和地形可见性图两类几何图中高效求解瓶颈路径问题的算法，其随机期望运行时间为 $O^*(n^{8/7})$。
ai_comments: 该论文针对几何图中的瓶颈路径问题（包括定向天线图和地形可见性图），提出了近线性的判定算法和 $O^*(n^{8/7})$ 随机期望时间的优化算法，并扩展到了有界的跳数版本，具有较高的理论创新性。
motivation: 为了解决实际应用中两类常见几何图（具有下界限制天线角的平面定向天线图，以及顶点位于1.5维地形上或上方的可见性图）中高效求解瓶颈路径问题的需求。
method: 首先针对判定问题开发了近线性时间的算法（判断阈值内是否存在路径），随后利用该判定过程设计了运行时间为 $O^*(n^{8/7})$ 的随机期望时间算法来求解瓶颈路径问题，并将其推广至有界跳数版本。
results: 得到了判定问题的近线性算法，以及求解瓶颈路径问题及其带跳数限制版本的 $O^*(n^{8/7})$ 随机期望时间算法。
conclusion: 通过高效的判定算法与优化策略，成功解决了特定几何图（定向天线图和地形可见性图）中的瓶颈路径问题及其受限跳数版本，实现了 $O^*(n^{8/7})$ 的随机期望运行时间。

title: MatrAIx: Simulating the World with 8.3 Billion Persona Agents
authors: Xiaomin Li, Yuexing Hao, Jianheng Hou, Jintao Huang, Qianfeng Wen, Shirley Huang, Yifan Liu, Xiaoyi Liu, Yilan Fan, Yijun Wang, Koutian Wu, Ruoqi Gao, Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin, Jing Tang, Brihi Joshi, Heming Liu, Zheyuan Deng, Zonglin Di, Sankalp Jajee, Jiuyao Lu, Zhiwei Zhang, Saksham Kapoor, Ishan Gupta, Yunhan Zhao, Chanwoo Park, Yucheng Lu, Bing Hu, Weihang Xiao, Aravind Mohan, Hanwen Xing, Runyu Zhang, Mihir Kulshreshtha, Yuanda Xu, Qianyu Zhu, Dianzhuo Wang, Yuxin Xiao, Bowen Jiang, Yongye Su, Wenhao Chai, Zuxin Liu, Lawrence Yunliang Chen, Xuandong Zhao, Ethan Ye, Shivam Patel, Jason Xie, Alex Martin Richmond, Weixiang Ding, Emre Okcular, Diya Mathew, Ziheng Wang, Rana M. Shahroz Khan, Zhejian Peng, Fang Wu, Fan Nie, Xinyang Han, Yubin Kim, Jiawei Zhang, Zhenting Qi, Huangyuan Su, Xu Pan, Abinitha Gourabathina, Hyewon Jeong, Hemanth Neelgund Ramesh, Kumail Alhamoud, Kimia Hamidieh, Zidi Xiong, Samuel Schmidgall, Pengrui Han, Yepeng Huang, Yongheng Wang, Bowen Yang, Alex Gu, Yuchu Wang, Akshay Paruchuri, Brenna Li, Hejie Cui, Jiayuan Ding, Chaosheng Dong, Jiahao Wang, Yixuan He, Chi Wang, Pamela Bhattacharya, Tianyi Peng, Paul Pu Liang, Mitchell Gordon, Yilun Du, Marinka Zitnik, James Zou, Prasanna Tambe, Philip Torr, Emily Fox, Asu Ozdaglar, Dawn Song
abstract: Human evaluation of AI systems and digital products is costly, slow, and difficult to scale. Offline evaluations are more scalable but often abstract away human diversity and interactive behavior. We therefore introduce MatrAIx, a population-scale simulated-user evaluation infrastructure for testing AI systems and digital products with heterogeneous users. MatrAIx has three core components: First, Persona 8B contains 8.3 billion persona records represented by 1,290 categorical dimensions. Records are either sampled from a dependency graph that preserves correlated attributes or derived from human-authored profiles. We release a quality-filtered coreset of approximately 1 million personas, comprising 599,847 human-grounded and 400,000 synthetic records. Second, the MatrAIx Playground provides four environments in which diverse users evaluate and interact with digital products: Survey, AI Chatbot, Web, and App. Third, MatrAIx provides 1,010 application tasks spanning more than 25 domains, including Commerce, Software, Finance, and Healthcare. We conducted 18,189 evaluation trials across eight representative tasks. Persona agents were powered by three LLMs: Claude Opus 4.8, GPT 5.5, and Claude Haiku 4.5. The resulting feedback captures how decisions and preferences vary across persona backgrounds, including hesitation after a price increase, willingness to continue after an AI assistant fails, and latency tolerance. We conducted two main validation studies: First, a 400-trial controlled study evaluated persona adherence across ten behavioral attributes and all four environments. The declared behavior was expressed or correctly suppressed in 366 trials (91.5%). Second, human and LLM judges evaluated the extraction quality of human-grounded personas. Overall, MatrAIx provides an end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating AI systems and digital products with diverse simulated human users.
zh_title: MatrAIx：用83亿画像代理模拟世界
translation: 对AI系统和数字产品进行人类评估成本高昂、速度缓慢且难以扩展。离线评估更具可扩展性，但通常抽象掉了人类的多样性和交互行为。因此，我们推出了MatrAIx，这是一个面向异质用户的群体规模模拟用户评估基础设施，用于测试AI系统和数字产品。MatrAIx包含三个核心组件：首先，Persona 8B包含8.3亿个由1,290个分类维度表示的画像记录。记录要么是从保留相关属性的依赖图中抽样得出，要么源自人工编写的档案。我们发布了一个包含约100万个画像的质量过滤核心集，其中包含599,847个基于人类真实情况的记录和400,000个合成记录。其次，MatrAIx Playground提供了四个环境，供不同用户在其中评估和与数字产品互动：调查、AI聊天总、网页和应用。第三，MatrAIx提供了跨越商业、软件、金融和医疗等25个以上领域的1,010个应用任务。我们在8个代表性任务中进行了18,189次评估试验。画像理由三个大语言模型驱动：Claude Opus 4.8、GPT 5.5和Claude Haiku 4.5。所得反馈捕捉了决策和偏好如何随画像背景而变化，包括价格上涨后的犹豫、AI助手失败后的继续意愿以及延迟容忍度。我们进行了两项主要的验证研究：首先，一项400次试验的对照研究评估了十个行为属性和所有四个环境中的画像依从性。声明的行为在366次试验（91.5%）中得到了表达或正确抑制。其次，人类和大语言模型评判员评估了基于真实人类的画像的提取质量。总体而言，MatrAIx提供了一个端到端的基础设施，用于通过多样化的模拟人类用户评估AI系统和数字产品。
tldr: MatrAIx是一个包含8.3亿画像代理的模拟用户评估基础设施，用于高效测试AI系统和数字产品。
ai_comments: MatrAIx为AI系统和数字产品的评估提供了一种极具规模化潜力的模拟用户基础设施，通过83亿规模的画像库及多样的交互环境，有效弥补了传统离线评估缺乏人类多样性的缺陷。
motivation: 人类评估成本高、速度慢且难以扩展，而传统离线评估通常忽略了人类的多样性和交互行为，因此需要一种能够模拟多样化异质用户的群体规模评估基础设施。
method: 构建包含8.3亿画像的Persona 8B数据库、提供四种交互环境的MatrAIx Playground以及涵盖25个领域的1,010个应用任务，并利用主流LLM驱动代理进行实验和验证。
results: 在18,189次评估试验中，反馈成功捕捉了不同背景下的决策和偏好差异；在400次对照研究中，画像代理的行为依从性达到了91.5%。
conclusion: MatrAIx通过83亿画像代理与多环境测试，成功验证了其在模拟多样化人类行为和评估AI系统方面的有效性与高保真度。

title: PADFormer: Pose-agnostic Anomaly Detection from Sparse View Images
authors: Ruiqi Wang, Yiming Qian, Fenggen Yu, Yuxuan Lu, Dakuo Wang, Hao Zhang, Jing Huang
abstract: Pose-agnostic Anomaly Detection (PAD) remains challenging as anomalies can appear under arbitrary viewpoints, requiring methods to handle significant pose variations. Existing approaches rely on complex 3D reconstruction, which are computationally expensive and require extensive multi-view data. We propose PADFormer, a novel image-space approach that leverages Vision Transformer (ViT) to directly reconstruct anomaly-free versions of query images while preserving pose information. Our key insight is to adapt cross-view masked reconstruction for anomaly detection through training exclusively on normal data, combined with dynamic patch selection and spatial alignment mechanisms that enable effective learning from sparse reference views under significant pose variations. During inference, we perform multiple forward passes with different masking patterns to generate an ensemble of anomaly-free reconstructions, ensuring comprehensive coverage of the query image. Anomalies are detected by comparing these reconstructions with the query image. PADFormer achieves state-of-the-art results on the PAD benchmark while maintaining comparable performance on classic few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) tasks, demonstrating superior efficiency and generalization without requiring 3D reconstruction.

title: From Non-Convex Self-Concordant Regularization to Scalable Quasi-Newton Training of PINNs
authors: Chenhao Si, Kang An, Shiqian Ma, Ming Yan
abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often require high-accuracy quasi-Newton refinement to obtain reliable partial differential equation solutions, but their residual objectives can exhibit indefinite, nearly singular, and poorly scaled local curvature. Regularized quasi-Newton methods provide established mechanisms for stabilizing secant models, while self-concordant methods provide local-metric rules for curvature-dependent step selection. Building on these two lines of work, we propose SCORE, a self-concordance-inspired quasi-Newton method with decrement-coupled shifted secant geometry for PINN training. Its distinguishing mechanism is that a single quasi-Newton decrement computed from the learned inverse metric jointly determines a strong-Wolfe-tested candidate step and an adaptive shift used to define the next secant geometry. The shifted displacement represents the action of an averaged shifted metric along the accepted step, while requiring neither Hessian construction nor Hessian-vector products. Under a local spectral-equivalence condition, we show that the quasi-Newton decrement and candidate step remain comparable to their counterparts in a positive shifted metric, and recover the normalized self-concordant rule in the matched-metric case. Strong Wolfe acceptance, fallback line search, and standard curvature safeguards provide globalization without modifying the underlying PINN objective. Experiments on the viscous Burgers, Kuramoto--Sivashinsky, Korteweg--de Vries, and complex Ginzburg--Landau equations show that SCORE attains lower final errors than the tested BFGS and self-scaled Broyden baselines. The Burgers ablation further indicates that shifted curvature stabilization and decrement-based step selection make complementary contributions to high-accuracy refinement.
zh_title: 从非凸自协调正则化到PINN的可扩展拟牛顿训练
translation: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）通常需要高精度的拟牛顿精化来获得可靠的偏微分方程解，但其残差目标函数会表现出不定、近奇点和缩放不良的局部曲率。正则化拟牛顿方法为稳定割线模型提供了既定机制，而自协调方法则为依赖曲率的步长选择提供了局部度量规则。基于这两条研究路线，我们提出了SCORE，这是一种受自协调性启发、具有decrement-coupled移位割线几何的拟牛顿方法，用于PINN训练。其独特机制在于：由学习到的逆度量计算出的单个拟牛顿衰减量（decrement）联合决定了强Wolfe测试的候选步长以及用于定义下一个割线几何的自适应移位。移位后的位移表示沿接受步长的平均移位度量的作用，同时既不需要Hessian构造也不需要Hessian-向量乘积。在局部谱等价条件下，我们证明了拟牛顿衰减量和候选步长与正移位度量中的对应项保持可比性，并在匹配度量情况下恢复了归一化自协调规则。强Wolfe接受、回溯线搜索和标准曲率保护在不修改底层PINN目标函数的情况下提供了全局化。对粘性Burgers、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky、Korteweg-de Vries和复Ginzburg-Landau方程的实验表明，SCORE比测试的BFGS和自适应Broyden基线获得了更低的最终误差。Burgers消融实验进一步表明，移位的曲率稳定化和基于衰减量的步长选择对高精度精化做出了互补的贡献。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SCORE的新型拟牛顿训练方法，通过自协调启发的移位割线几何和decrement-coupled步长选择，无需海森矩阵即可显著提升物理信息神经网络（PINNs）求解偏微分方程的精度和稳定性。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的SCORE方法，巧妙结合了非凸自协调正则化与拟牛顿法，无需计算海森矩阵即可高效且稳定地求解物理信息神经网络（PINN），具有显著的理论深度和广阔的应用前景。
motivation: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在求解偏微分方程时需要高精度的拟牛顿精化，但其残差目标函数常表现出不定、近奇点且缩放不良的局部曲率，传统方法难以稳定处理。
method: 提出SCORE方法，采用自协调启发的带有decrement-coupled移位割线几何的拟牛顿法，利用学到的逆度量联合决定强Wolfe测试候选步长与自适应移位，且无需构建海森矩阵或进行海森向量乘积。
results: 在粘性Burgers、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky、Korteweg-de Vries和复Ginzburg-Landau方程的实验中，SCORE取得了比BFGS和自适应Broyden基线更低的最终误差。
conclusion: SCORE方法通过自协调启发的移位割线几何和decrement-coupled步长选择，有效解决了PINN训练中的局部曲率病态问题，实现了比传统BFGS等基线更高精度的偏微分方程求解。

title: Attention-Only White-Box Transformer via LeJEPA-Based Self-Supervised Pretraining
authors: Yang Bai, Linyuan Wang, Haoyang Jiang, Nuolin Sun, Libin Hou, Bin Yan
abstract: Existing studies on self-supervised learning for white-box networks typically decouple the derivation of white-box networks via optimization algorithms from self-supervised learning paradigms. In this work, we instead revisit the two components from a joint perspective. The LeJEPA-based self-supervised framework assumes an isotropic Gaussian distribution as the optimal embedding distribution for downstream tasks, which is conceptually equivalent to the expansion term $R(Z)$ in the sparse rate reduction objective guiding white-box Transformer optimization. Building on this observation, we use the LeJEPA self-supervised paradigm to optimize $R(Z)$, and derive the remaining terms $R^{c}(Z\mid U_{[K]})+λ\lVert Z\rVert_{0}$ via the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) into an attention-only Transformer that dispenses with the ISTA structure or MLP layers of the original design. Experimental results demonstrate that our attention-only white-box Transformer achieves classification accuracies of $88.88\%$ on CIFAR-10 and $63.54\%$ on CIFAR-100 at the Base scale under the LeJEPA self-supervised paradigm, while the original white-box Transformer CRATE achieves classification accuracies of $89.18\%$ on CIFAR-10 and $63.56\%$ on CIFAR-100. Our model achieves competitive performance while reducing the parameter count by roughly $31\%$. Beyond the white-box setting, we further investigate standard ViTs and find that replacing all MLP blocks with ReLU activations under knowledge distillation removes approximately 66\% of the parameters while preserving competitive accuracy, motivating further investigation into the potential redundancy of MLP modules in standard ViT architectures.
zh_title: 基于LeJEPA自监督预训练的纯注意力白盒Transformer
translation: 现有关于白盒网络自监督学习的研究通常将通过优化算法推导白盒网络与自监督学习范式解耦。在这项工作中，我们转而从联合视角重新审视这两个组件。基于LeJEPA的自监督框架假设各向同性高斯分布是下游任务的最优嵌入分布，这在概念上等价于指导白盒Transformer优化的稀疏率约简目标中的扩展项 $R(Z)$。基于这一观察，我们利用LeJEPA自监督范式优化 $R(Z)$，并通过交替方向乘子法（ADMM）将剩余项 $R^{c}(Z\mid U_{[K]})+λ\lVert Z\rVert_{0}$ 推导为一个纯注意力的Transformer，它省去了原设计中的ISTA结构或MLP层。实验结果表明，在LeJEPA自监督范式下，我们的纯注意力白盒Transformer在Base尺度下在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上分别实现了88.88%和63.54%的分类准确率，而原始白盒Transformer CRATE在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的分类准确率分别为89.18%和63.56%。我们的模型在实现具有竞争力的性能的同时，参数量减少了约31%。除了白盒设置外，我们还进一步研究了标准ViT，发现在知识蒸馏下用ReLU激活替代所有MLP块可以在保留竞争力的准确率的同时去除大约66%的参数，这促使人们进一步研究标准ViT架构中MLP模块的潜在冗余性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LeJEPA自监督预训练的纯注意力白盒Transformer，在保持与原始白盒Transformer相近分类准确率的同时，参数量减少了约31%。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将基于LeJEPA的自监督预训练与白盒Transformer（CRATE）的优化目标（稀疏率约简）结合起来，通过数学推导去除了传统设计中的ISTA结构和MLP层，得到了纯注意力机制的白盒Transformer。这不仅减少了约31%的参数量，还引发了对标准ViT中MLP模块冗余性的深入思考，对模型压缩和可解释性研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的白盒网络自监督学习研究通常将基于优化算法的白盒网络推导与自监督学习范式解耦，本文旨在从联合视角重新审视这两者，以简化白盒Transformer结构并提高参数效率。
method: 基于LeJEPA自监督框架优化稀疏率约简目标中的扩展项 $R(Z)$，并通过交替方向乘子法（ADMM）推导其余项，最终去除了ISTA结构和MLP层，构建了一个纯注意力机制的白盒Transformer。
results: 在Base尺度下，该纯注意力白盒Transformer在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上的分类准确率分别为88.88%和63.54%，与原始CRATE模型（89.18%和63.56%）性能相当，但参数量减少了约31%。此外，在知识 distillation 下用ReLU激活函数替代标准ViT的所有MLP块可去除约66%的参数并保持竞争力。
conclusion: 本研究通过结合LeJEPA与稀疏率约简目标，成功推导并实现了一种精简的、纯注意力的白盒Transformer。实验表明该模型在大幅减少参数量的同时保持了极具竞争力的分类性能，并揭示了ViT中MLP模块的潜在冗余性。

title: A Unified Model for Cross-Domain Clone Detection via Model Merging
authors: Palash R. Roy, Banani Roy, Kevin A. Schneider, Chanchal K. Roy
abstract: The growing diversity of code clone types, from syntactic copies to cross-language semantic clones to AI-generated duplicates, has created a fragmentation crisis in clone detection. Current deep learning detectors are domain specialists that degrade significantly outside their training distribution, with F1 drops exceeding 70% across domains. Deploying multiple specialized models is impractical, yet training a single cross-domain detector requires simultaneous access to all training data. To address this, we investigate model merging, a family of post-hoc techniques that operate solely on trained checkpoints. We evaluate parameter merging with five task-vector methods, architecture merging via greedy layer stitching, and cross-tokenizer alignment across four code models, three benchmarks, and twelve configurations. Same-base TIES merging creates effective cross-domain detectors, validated across two model families and three random seeds, reaching 0.865 combined F1 on UniXcoder, 93% of multi-task performance without any training data at the merging step. WUDI achieves the highest in-distribution combined F1 at 0.899, but TIES generalizes better to unseen AI-generated clones, making it our recommended method. Cross-base merging yields only marginal and high-variance gains across all five methods, indicating that task vector compatibility through a shared pre-trained base is the binding factor for effective merging. Merged detectors also outperform zero-shot code LLMs on GPTCloneBench at lower inference cost and generalize up to 4x better than multi-task training to unseen AI-generated clones, suggesting a trade-off between in-domain performance and OOD robustness. This work provides one of the first systematic empirical studies of model merging for software engineering and a practical recipe for building cross-domain clone detectors.
zh_title: 基于模型合并的统一跨域克隆检测模型
translation: 从句法复制到跨语言语义克隆再到AI生成的重复代码，代码克隆类型的日益多样化导致了克隆检测领域的碎片化危机。当前深度学习检测器属于领域专家，在训练分布之外性能显著下降，跨域F1下降超过70%。部署多个专用模型并不切实际，而训练单个跨域检测器则需要同时访问所有训练数据。为了解决这一问题，我们研究了模型合并，这是一类仅在训练好的检查点上运行的事后技术。我们在四个代码模型、三个基准测试和十二种配置下评估了五种任务向量方法的参数合并、通过贪婪层拼接的架构合并以及跨分词器对齐。相同基础的TIES合并创建了有效的跨域检测器，并在两个模型系列和三个随机种子下得到验证，在UniXcoder上达到了0.865的组合F1值，在合并步骤中无需任何训练数据便达到了多任务性能的93%。WUDI实现了0.899的最高分布内组合F1，但TIES对未见过的AI生成克隆泛化能力更好，使其成为我们推荐的方法。跨基础合并在所有五种方法中仅产生边际且高方差的收益，这表明通过共享预训练基础的任务向量兼容性是有效合并的决定性因素。合并后的检测器在GPTCloneBench上的表现也优于零样本代码LLM且推理成本更低，其对未见过的AI生成克隆的泛化能力比多任务训练高出高达4倍，这表明域内性能与域外（OOD）鲁棒性之间存在权衡。这项工作为软件工程提供了模型合并的首次系统性实证研究之一，并为构建跨域克隆检测器提供了实用的方案。
tldr: 通过模型合并技术（如TIES），无需原始训练数据即可将多个领域的代码克隆检测模型融合成一个高效的跨域检测器，泛化能力远超传统多任务训练。
ai_comments: 该论文首次系统性地将模型合并技术应用于软件工程领域的跨域代码克隆检测，通过TIES等方法在不需要原始训练数据的情况下达到了接近多任务训练的性能，并在防过拟合和域外泛化（OOD）方面表现优异，为构建通用代码理解模型提供了新思路。
motivation: 现有的深度学习代码克隆检测器多为领域专家模型，在分布外表现急剧下降（F1下降超70%），而部署多个模型不切实际，同时训练一个跨域检测器又需要同时访问所有训练数据。
method: 评估了五种任务向量参数合并方法、基于贪婪层拼接的架构合并以及跨分词器对齐技术，涵盖四个代码模型、三个基准测试和十二种配置。
results: Same-base TIES合并能够创建有效的跨域检测器，在UniXcoder上达到0.865的组合F1值（达到多任务性能的93%），且无需合并阶段的训练数据；同时它对未见过的AI生成克隆展现出比多任务训练高出最多4倍的泛化能力。
conclusion: 基于相同基础模型的TIES合并是构建高效、鲁棒的跨域代码克隆检测器的最佳选择，它在无需额外训练数据的前提下实现了极高的性能与泛化能力。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Proof-of-Vulnerability Generation with Open-Weight Models
authors: Yu Nong, Haipeng Cai
abstract: Software vulnerabilities are persistent, but validating them remains difficult: a Proof-of-Vulnerability (PoV) requires a concrete input that triggers the vulnerable behavior, yet public triggering inputs are often unavailable for disclosed vulnerabilities. Existing techniques make different tradeoffs in effectiveness, scalability, cost, and controllability, leaving room for complementary designs. To complement them, we present POVGEN, a low-cost neuro-symbolic framework that makes PoV generation cost-effective via semantic focusing and LLM-guided constraint reasoning using open-weight models. POVGEN first localizes vulnerability-relevant regions (utilizing patch information if available), then performs path-sensitive reachability analysis, and finally generates PoVs by extracting and solving constraints with LLM-guided reasoning backed by an SMT solver. POVGEN successfully generates PoVs for 78.98% of vulnerabilities in a recent benchmark, outperforming fuzzing (up to 50.20%) and symbolic execution (2.45%). On 250 real-world CVEs without public PoVs, it generates valid PoVs for 74.80% of cases and reproduces 65.1% when without patch information. The fine-tuned open-weight models match frontier commercial LLMs on key sub-tasks (i.e., the core constraint-reasoning steps) while running locally at no per-sample API cost. Applying the generated PoVs revealed six flawed patches in disclosed CVEs (all subsequently fixed) and five previously unreported vulnerabilities (of which four have been confirmed and fixed by the developers).
zh_title: 使用开源模型进行神经符号学漏洞验证生成
translation: 软件漏洞一直存在，但验证它们仍然很困难：漏洞验证（PoV）需要一个能触发漏洞行为的具体输入，然而对于已披露的漏洞，公开的触发输入通常是不可用的。现有的技术在有效性、可扩展性、成本和可控性方面做出了不同的权衡，这为设计互补方案留下了空间。为了与它们互补，我们提出了POVGEN，这是一个低成本的神经符号学框架，通过使用开源模型的语义聚焦和LLM引导的约束推理，使PoV生成具有成本效益。POVGEN首先定位与漏洞相关的区域（如果有的话，利用补丁信息），然后执行路径敏感的可达性分析，最后通过大语言模型引导的约束提取与推理（由SMT求解器支持）来生成PoV。POVGEN成功为最近基准测试中78.98%的漏洞生成了PoV，优于模糊测试（高达50.20%）和符号执行（2.45%）。在没有公开PoV的250个真实世界CVE中，它为74.80%的情况生成了有效的PoV，在没有补丁信息时复现了65.1%。微调后的开源模型在关键子任务（即核心约束推理步骤）上与前沿商业LLM相匹配，同时在本地运行，没有每个样本的API成本。应用生成的PoV揭示了已披露CVE中6个有缺陷的补丁（随后全部修复）以及5个以前未报告的漏洞（其中4个已被开发人员确认并修复）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为POVGEN的低成本神经符号学框架，利用开源大语言模型和SMT求解器自动生成软件漏洞验证（PoV）输入，在多个基准测试和真实世界CVE中取得了显著成效。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地结合了神经方法（大语言模型）与符号方法（SMT求解器），提出了一个低成本、高效率的漏洞验证生成框架POVGEN。它不仅在基准测试中大幅超越传统模糊测试和符号执行，还能在真实世界CVE中发现有缺陷的补丁和未报告的新漏洞，具有极高的安全工程实用价值。
motivation: 软件漏洞验证困难，许多已披露的漏洞缺乏具体的触发输入（PoV）。现有的模糊测试和符号执行等技术在有效性、可扩展性、成本和可控性方面各有权衡，缺乏一个低成本且高效互补的方案。
method: 提出POVGEN框架，首先通过语义聚焦（可利用补丁信息）定位与漏洞相关的区域，接着进行路径敏感的可达性分析，最后通过大语言模型引导的约束提取与推理，并结合SMT求解器生成PoV。
results: POVGEN在最近的基准测试中成功为78.98%的漏洞生成了PoV，超越了模糊测试（50.20%）和符号执行（2.45%）；在250个无公开PoV的真实世界CVE中，74.80%成功生成有效PoV；并发现了6个有缺陷的补丁及5个以前未报告的漏洞。
conclusion: POVGEN证明了神经符号学方法在漏洞验证生成领域的巨大潜力，通过结合开源大语言模型与符号推理，能够在无API成本的情况下高效生成高质量的PoV。

title: Bicriteria Approximation Algorithms for Demand Matching
authors: Yuchong Pan, Michel X. Goemans
abstract:
The demand matching problem generalizes both the knapsack problem and the $b$-matching problem. In this problem, each edge of a graph has a demand and a weight, each vertex has a capacity, and the goal is to find a maximum weight subset of edges whose total incident demand at every vertex does not exceed its capacity. We study $(α, β)$-bicriteria approximation algorithms, which return a solution of weight at least $1/α$ times the optimum while allowing an additive capacity violation of at most $β$ times the maximum edge demand.
  We give an iterative relaxation algorithm for the demand matching problem that exploits a structural characterization of strictly fractional extreme points of the natural LP relaxation, which reduces the residual rounding problem to odd-cycle instances. Combined with a better-of-two rounding strategy, this yields $(7/6, 1)$- and $(1, 1)$-bicriteria approximation algorithms for general and bipartite graphs, respectively. We further generalize this approach to obtain a parametric family of algorithms, including a $(1, 4/3)$-bicriteria approximation. Separately, for the more general $k$-hypergraph demand matching problem, we give a greedy, combinatorial $(k, 1)$-bicriteria approximation algorithm.
  We complement these algorithmic results with matching lower bounds relative to the natural LP relaxation for $β= 0$ and all $β\geq 1$, completely characterizing the trade-off between weight approximation and additive capacity violation in this range.
zh_title: 需求匹配问题的双标准近似算法
translation:
需求匹配问题泛化了背包问题和 $b$-匹配问题。在该问题中，图的每条边都有需求和权重，每个顶点都有容量，目标是找到一组最大权重的边子集，使得每个顶点关联的总需求不超过其容量。我们研究了 $(\alpha, \beta)$ 双标准近似算法，该算法返回一个权重至少为最优解 $1/\alpha$ 倍的解，同时允许顶点容量产生最多为最大边需求 $\beta$ 倍的附加违反。
我们为需求匹配问题提出了一种迭代松弛算法，该算法利用了自然LP松弛的严格分数极点的结构特征，将残差舍入问题归约到奇圈实例。结合“二选一”舍入策略，这分别针对一般图和二分图产生了 $(7/6, 1)$ 和 $(1, 1)$ 的双标准近似算法。我们进一步将此方法推广以获得参数化算法族，包括 $(1, 4/3)$ 双标准近似。此外，对于更一般的 $k$-超图需求匹配问题，我们给出了一个贪心的组合式 $(k, 1)$ 双标准近似算法。
我们用相对于自然LP松弛的匹配下界（针对 $\beta=0$ 和所有 $\beta\ge 1$）来补充这些算法结果，完全刻画了该范围内权重近似与附加容量违反之间的权衡。
tldr: 本文研究了需求匹配问题的双标准近似算法，在一般图、二分图和超图上取得了突破性的近似比结果，并彻底刻画了近似比与容量违反之间的权衡关系。
ai_comments: 该论文在需求匹配问题（Demand Matching）的近似算法研究上取得了重要突破，通过深入剖析线性规划（LP）松弛的严格分数极点结构，给出了最优的权值与容量违反的双标准近似算法，并建立了紧密的理论下界。这对于推广背包问题和图匹配理论具有重要的理论价值。
motivation: 需求匹配问题作为背包问题和 $b$-匹配问题的泛化，在资源分配等领域有重要应用。以往对该问题的双标准近似算法还有改进空间，且权值近似与容量违反之间的精确权衡关系尚不完全清楚。
method: 提出了一种基于迭代松弛（iterative relaxation）的算法，利用了自然LP松弛的严格分数极点的结构特征，并结合了“二选一”舍入策略（better-of-two rounding strategy），以及针对超图的贪心组合算法。
results: 针对一般图和二分图分别给出了 $(7/6, 1)$ 和 $(1, 1)$ 的双标准近似算法，并得到了包含 $(1, 4/3)$ 近似在内的参数化算法族；对于 $k$-超图需求匹配问题给出了 $(k, 1)$ 贪心组合算法；同时证明了匹配的下界，完全刻画了该范围内的权值与容量违反权衡。
conclusion: 本文研究了需求匹配问题的双标准近似算法，针对一般图和二分图给出了改进的算法，并建立了匹配的理论下界，完全刻画了权值近似与容量违反之间的权衡关系。

title: Topological Semantics for Scoped Computational Paths
authors: Arthur Freitas Ramos, Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz, Anjolina Grisi de Oliveira, Tiago M. L. de Veras
abstract:
Computational paths record equality as explicit finite traces of primitive steps. We give a topological semantics for a scoped rewrite presentation whose steps have continuous geometric realizations and whose named rewrites carry endpoint-fixed homotopies.
  For every presentation we construct a quotient arrow space with a canonical final-domain groupoid structure: multiplication is continuous on the quotient of explicitly composable representatives. We prove an exact four-way criterion for this final composable topology to agree with the ordinary pullback topology, together with a compact-Hausdorff sufficient condition. Thus the unconditional construction exposes, rather than hides, the product-quotient issue in ordinary topological groupoids.
  The realization map to geometric homotopy classes is a continuous groupoid morphism and is faithful exactly under a separate geometric-completeness condition. In the universal presentation, a continuous section identifies the coherent-path quotient homeomorphically with the usual quotient-topologized fundamental groupoid. We then give finite-generator circle and genuine torus examples, with winding-based normal forms and classifications by Z and Z^2. A Lean 4.24.0 development checks the theorem package; the mathematical presentation is independent of the implementation.
comment: 22 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Lean artifact: https://github.com/Arthur742Ramos/ComputationalPathsLean (tag topological-paper-v2); Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21797011
zh_title: 带辖域计算路径的拓扑语义
translation:
计算路径将等式记录为显式的原始步骤有限轨迹。我们为一种辖域重写表示法给出了拓扑语义，其步骤具有连续的几何实现，且其命名的重写携带端点固定的同伦。
对于每种表示法，我们构造了一个具有典范最终域群胚结构的商箭头空间：乘法在显式可组合代表元的商上是连续的。我们证明了一个四分准则，用于判定这种最终可组合拓扑与普通拉回拓扑是否一致，并给出了紧豪斯多夫充分条件。因此，无条件构造暴露了而非隐藏了普通拓扑群胚中的乘积-商问题。
到几何同伦类的实现映射是一个连续群胚态射，且恰好在满足一个单独的几何完备性条件时才是忠实的。在泛表示法中，一个连续截面将相干路径商空间同胚地等同于通常商拓扑化的基本群胚。接着，我们给出了有限生成圆和真正的环面例子，具有基于缠绕数的范式以及由 $\mathbb{Z}$ 和 $\mathbb{Z}^2$ 的分类。Lean 4.24.0 开发版本对定理包进行了检查；数学表示法独立于实现。
tldr: 本文研究了带辖域计算路径的拓扑语义，构建了商箭头空间与拓扑群胚，并完成了Lean 4形式化验证。
ai_comments: 本文通过拓扑语义研究带有辖域的计算路径，结合了同伦论、拓扑群胚以及形式化验证（Lean 4），具有较强的理论创新性和严谨性。
motivation: 为了给记录等式的显式有限原始步骤（计算路径）提供一个具有连续几何实现和端点固定同伦的拓扑语义。
method: 为每个呈现构建商箭头空间及典范最终域群胚结构，证明拓扑一致性的四分准则与紧豪斯多夫充分条件，并建立通向几何同伦类的连续群胚态射。
results: 证明了最终可合组合拓扑与普通拉回拓扑一致的四分准则，在泛呈现中建立了同伦群胚同胚，并通过Lean 4.24.0进行了定理包的形式化验证。
conclusion: 本文为具有辖域的计算路径建立了完整的拓扑语义学框架，并给出了具体例子及形式化验证。

title: OmniVR: Joint Video-Audio Conditional Generation for Restoring Degraded Historical Films
authors: Xin Lu, Zihao Fan, Mingchen Zhong, Jie Huang, Xueyang Fu, Zheng-Jun Zha
abstract: Historical films suffer from co-occurring visual and audio degradations---blur, noise, flicker, hiss, clipping, and dropout---yet existing methods restore each modality independently, leaving quality gaps and cross-modal inconsistency. We present OmniVR, the first joint audio-video generative restoration model. Built upon a 22B-parameter audio-video generation backbone, OmniVR formulates restoration as conditional generation within a unified multimodal DiT: the low-quality video and audio are encoded as latent conditions, combined with a fixed restoration prompt, and jointly denoised to recover visual structure, temporal motion, and acoustic detail under one coordinated objective. Three key designs enable this adaptation: (1) a joint audio-video degradation pipeline that simulates real old-film characteristics from Internet-collected data; (2) an architecture-preserving text-to-audio-video (T2AV) to audio-video-to-audio-video (AV2AV) transition with prompt annealing that maximally retains the generative prior; and (3) first-frame image-to-video (I2V) anchoring with loss reweighting and waveform supervision for long-video extrapolation and audio fidelity. We also propose OmniVRBench, the first benchmark that evaluates audio-video restoration across visual quality, audio quality, temporal consistency, and audio-visual synchrony on 200 real historical clips. OmniVR surpasses all prior methods on all six visual metrics, achieves the best audio quality, and produces natural colorization---the first method to jointly address all three aspects. Code and weights will be publicly released. Project Page: https://xin1u.github.io/OminiVR_PAGE/
zh_title: OmniVR：用于修复退化历史电影的联合音视频条件生成方法
translation: 历史电影遭受视觉和音频的共同退化——模糊、噪声、闪烁、嘶嘶声、削波和丢帧——然而现有方法独立恢复每个模态，留下了质量差距和跨模态不一致性。我们提出了OmniVR，这是第一个联合音视频生成修复模型。OmniVR建立在22B参数的音视频生成骨干网络之上，将修复构建为统一多模态DiT中的条件生成：低质视频和音频被编码为潜在条件，与固定的修复提示相结合，并联合去噪以在统一的协调目标下恢复视觉结构、时间运动和声学细节。三个关键设计促成了这一适应：（1）一个联合音视频退化管道，模拟从互联网收集的数据中提取的真实老电影特征；（2）一个保留架构的文本到音视频（T2AV）向音视频到音视频（AV2AV）的过渡，并结合提示词退火以最大程度保留生成先验；以及（3）用于长视频外推和音频保真度的首帧图生视频（I2V）锚定与损失重新加权及波形监督。我们还提出了OmniVRBench，这是第一个在200个真实历史片段上评估视听修复跨视觉质量、音频质量、时间一致性和视听同步性的基准。OmniVR在所有六个视觉指标上超越了所有先前方法，实现了最佳的音频质量，并产生了自然的着色——这是第一种同时解决这三个方面的方法。代码和权重将公开发布。项目网页：https://xin1u.github.io/OminiVR_PAGE/
tldr: OmniVR是首个联合音视频的生成式修复模型，通过多模态DiT同时恢复历史电影的视觉和音频，显著优于传统的独立修复方法。
ai_comments: 该论文首次实现了视频和音频的联合生成式修复，克服了传统单模态修复方法在跨模态一致性上的不足，基于庞大的多模态DiT骨干网络取得了显著的效果。
motivation: 历史电影同时存在视觉和音频退化，但现有方法各自独立修复，导致质量差距和跨模态不一致，为此需要一个联合音视频的生成式修复模型。
method: 提出OmniVR模型，基于22B参数的音视频生成骨干网络，将修复公式化为统一多模态DiT中的条件生成；设计了联合音视频退化管道、保留生成先验的T2AV到AV2AV转换（带提示词退火）以及首帧I2V锚定与波形监督策略。
results: 在OmniVRBench（包含200个真实历史片段的基准）上，OmniVR在所有6个视觉指标上超越所有先前方法，实现了最佳音频质量并产生自然的着色效果，是首个同时解决这三个方面的方法。
conclusion: OmniVR作为首个联合音视频生成修复模型，通过联合条件生成、退化管道设计以及跨模态锚定等技术，在历史老片修复任务中展现出卓越的视觉、音频及跨模态同步修复性能。

title: Transferable Dual-Stream Representations for Mesoscale-Preserving Sea Surface Temperature Downscaling
authors: Parth Doshi, Priyanka Aravindan, Vaishnav Vaidheeswaran, Md Mahbub Alam, Gabriel Spadon
abstract: Deep learning models for scientific spatio-temporal downscaling often minimize reconstruction error while failing to preserve physically meaningful multi-scale structure. For sea surface temperature prediction, this can yield outputs that are numerically plausible yet overly smooth, missing mesoscale variability critical to regional ocean dynamics. Existing methods often focus on pixel-wise objectives or single-context conditioning, which limits their ability to preserve spectral fidelity and generalize across regions. To address this, we propose EddyFlow, a representation learning framework for kilometer-scale sea surface temperature downscaling that balances predictive accuracy, scale-dependent structure, and regional generalization. EddyFlow is trained on the Gulf of St.~Lawrence and evaluated in zero-shot and few-shot settings on the Bay of Fundy and the Gulf of Mexico. EddyFlow demonstrates that physics-informed representation learning reduces zero-shot RMSE by 21%, achieves up to 85.6% skill relative to persistence on unseen domains, and maintains near-ideal spectral fidelity with a PSD ratio of $\approx 1.00$.
zh_title: 用于保持中尺度特征的海表温度降尺度可迁移双流表示法
translation: 用于科学时空降尺度的深度学习模型通常会最小化重建误差，但往往无法保留具有物理意义的多尺度结构。对于海表温度预测而言，这可能产生数值上合理但过于平滑的输出，从而丢失对区域海洋动力学至关重要的中尺度变率。现有方法通常侧重于像素级目标或单上下文条件约束，这限制了它们保持谱保真度以及跨区域泛化的能力。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 EddyFlow，这是一个用于公里级海表温度降尺度的表示学习框架，它平衡了预测准确性、尺度依赖结构和区域泛化能力。EddyFlow 在圣劳伦斯湾进行训练，并在芬迪湾和墨西哥湾的零样本和少样本设置下进行评估。结果表明，物理信息驱动的表示学习将零样本 RMSE 降低了 21%，在未见领域上相对于持续性基准实现了高达 85.6% 的技巧，并保持了约 1.00 的功率谱密度（PSD）比，维持了近乎理想的谱保真度。
tldr: EddyFlow是一个用于海表温度降尺度的物理信息双流表示学习框架，能有效保持中尺度变率并具备出色的跨区域泛化能力。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了双流表示学习框架（EddyFlow），平衡了预测准确性与多尺度物理结构的保持，在海洋温度降尺度任务中展现了出色的零样本泛化能力和物理保真度。
motivation: 现有的科学时空降尺度深度学习模型往往仅最小化重建误差，未能保留具有物理意义的多尺度结构，导致预测结果过于光滑，丢失了对区域海洋动力学至关重要的中尺度变率，且跨区域泛化能力受限。
method: 提出了EddyFlow——一个用于公里级海表温度降尺度的双流表示学习框架，在圣劳伦斯湾进行训练，并在芬迪湾和墨西哥湾进行了零样本与少样本评估。
results: 物理信息引导的表示学习将零样本均方根误差（RMSE）降低了21%，在未见区域上相对于持续性基准实现了高达85.6%的技巧评分，并保持了约1.00的功率谱密度（PSD）比，接近理想的谱保真度。
conclusion: EddyFlow通过物理信息驱动的表示学习，有效克服了传统深度学习方法在海洋海表温度降尺度中生成过于平滑、丢失中尺度变率的缺点，在跨区域泛化和多尺度结构保持上取得了显著成效。

title: Random features for Grassmannian kernel approximation with bounded rank-one projections
authors: Rémi Delogne, Laurent Jacques
abstract:
We propose a family of random feature maps for scalable kernel machines on low-dimensional subspaces, ie on the Grassmannian manifold. Such representations are useful when data classes or clusters are well described by the span of a few samples. Classical Grassmannian kernels, including the projection and Binet-Cauchy kernels, require full Gram matrices, which leads to prohibitive computational and memory costs for large high-dimensional subspace datasets. We address this limitation using random features based on rank-one projections of subspace projection matrices followed by bounded non-linear transforms, either periodic or binary, to control the resulting distributions.
  We show that inner products in the random feature space approximate well-defined rotation-invariant Grassmannian kernels that depend only on the principal angles between subspaces. When the number of features is sufficiently large relative to the intrinsic subspace dimension, the approximation holds uniformly over all fixed-dimensional subspaces with high probability. For periodic transforms, the approximated kernel has a closed-form expression with tunable behaviour between inverse Binet-Cauchy and Gaussian-type regimes. Binary transforms yield compact one-bit subspace features, although no closed-form kernel is known. Structured rank-one projections based on randomised fast Fourier transforms further reduce computation without sacrificing practical accuracy. Experiments on synthetic data and ETH-80 classification tasks show that these features accurately preserve Grassmannian geometry while reducing computation, memory, and storage. Rank-one embeddings therefore provide a practical and scalable alternative to classical Grassmannian kernels.
zh_title: 基于有界秩一投影的Grassmannian核近似随机特征
translation:
我们提出了一系列用于低维子空间（即Grassmann流形）上可扩展核机器的随机特征映射族。当数据类或聚类可以通过少数样本的跨度来很好地描述时，这类表示非常有用。经典的Grassmann核，包括投影核和Binet-Cauchy核，需要完整的Gram矩阵，这导致大规模高维子空间数据集的计算和内存成本高得令人望而却步。我们通过基于子空间投影矩阵的秩一投影（后跟有界非线性变换，无论是周期性的还是二二进制的，以控制所得分布）的随机特征来解决这一局限性。
我们证明了随机特征空间中的内积可以很好地近似定义明确的、仅取决于子空间之间主角的旋转不变Grassmann核。当特征数量相对于内在子空间维度足够大时，该近似以高概率在所有固定维度的子空间上均匀成立。对于周期性变换，近似核具有闭式表达式，其行为可在逆Binet-Cauchy机制和高斯型机制之间进行调整。二值变换产生紧凑的一位子空间特征，尽管没有已知的闭式核。基于随机快速傅里叶变换的结构化秩一投影在不牺牲实际准确性的情况下进一步减少了计算量。在合成数据和ETH-80分类任务上的实验表明，这些特征准确地保留了Grassmann几何结构，同时减少了计算、内存和存储。因此，秩一嵌入为经典的Grassmann核提供了一种实用且可扩展的替代方案。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于有界秩一投影的随机特征方法，用于高效近似Grassmann流形上的核函数，显著降低了处理大规模子空间数据的计算与内存成本。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种针对Grassmann流形的高效随机特征映射方法，通过有界秩一投影解决了经典核函数在大规模高-dimensional子空间数据上计算成本高的问题，在理论分析和实验验证上都具有较高的价值。
motivation: 经典的Grassmann核（如投影核和Binet-Cauchy核）需要完整的Gram矩阵，导致大规模高维子空间数据集的计算和内存成本极高，因此需要一种可扩展的随机特征图方法来解决这一限制。
method: 利用基于子空间投影矩阵的秩一投影的随机特征，结合有界非线性变换（周期性或二值变换），并结合随机快速傅里叶变换构建结构化秩一投影以进一步减少计算量。
results: 随机特征空间中的内积能够很好地近似依赖于子空间主角的旋转不变Grassmann核，当特征数量相对于内在子空间维度足够大时，该近似以高概率在所有固定维度的子空间上均匀成立；实验表明该方法能准确保持Grassmann几何结构，同时降低计算、内存和存储开销。
conclusion: 本文提出的基于有界秩一投影的随机特征方法，能够有效近似Grassmann流形上的旋转不变核，显著降低了计算与存储开销，为大规模子空间数据处理提供了可扩展的实用方案。

title: Interoceptive Attention as Dynamic Homeostatic Prioritization in a Foraging Agent
authors: St John Grimbly, Nicolas Kuske, Evert A. Boonstra, Bruce A. Bassett, Charel van Hoof, Rowan Hodson, Benjamin Rosman, Ryan Smith, Mark Solms, Jonathan P. Shock
abstract: Biological systems must regulate competing needs under limited perceptual bandwidth, where sharpening one estimate costs the capacity to sharpen the others. Any fixed-budget system therefore has to decide where to allocate its perceptual precision. We study this in a foraging agent that must keep several bodily needs satisfied to survive, modelled with active inference. At each step it reads its own body-state beliefs, identifies the most-needed channel, and reallocates a fixed budget of interoceptive precision toward it, so that the same precision-shaped likelihood feeds both belief update and planning. In AffectWorld, a four-channel foraging gridworld, this selective allocation more than doubles learning-phase survival at matched budget against a uniform-precision agent ($0.414$ vs $0.199$ across 11 layouts, $n{=}32$ seeds each, paired cluster-bootstrap $p \leq 10^{-4}$). Two further results sharpen the mechanism. The benefit runs through planning as well as perception, since denying the shaped likelihood to the planner alone removes about half of it. It is also need-aligned, since aiming precision at the least-needed channel does worse than spreading it evenly. The attended channel additionally learns its own dynamics about twice as fast, and stays ahead even at matched observation count, a behavioural trace of the same precision routing, visible in learning speed, not survival.

zh_title: 寻觅智能体中作为动态内稳态优先级的内感受注意力
translation: 生物系统必须在有限的感知带宽下调节相互竞争的需求，其中磨砺一个估计值会消耗磨砺其他估计值的容量。因此，任何固定预算的系统都必须决定将其感知精度分配到何处。我们在一个必须满足多重身体需求才能生存的寻觅智能体中研究了这一点，该智能体使用主动推断进行建模。在每一步中，它读取自身的身体状态信念，识别最急需的通道，并将固定的内感受精度预算重新分配给该通道，从而使相同的精度塑造后的似然度同时馈入信念更新和规划。在包含四个通道的寻觅网格世界 AffectWorld 中，在相同预算下，这种选择性分配使学习阶段的生存率提高了一倍以上（在11种布局、每种布局32个随机种子上，为 0.414 对比 0.199，配对集群自举 $p \le 10^{-4}$）。另外两个结果使该机制更加清晰。这种益处既通过规划发挥作用，也通过感知发挥作用，因为仅拒绝向规划器提供经塑造的似然度会消除大约一半的益处。它也是需求对齐的，因为将精度对准最不需要的通道比均匀分散它的表现更差。此外，受关注通道自身的动态学习速度快了大约两倍，甚至在匹配观察计数时也能保持领先，这是相同精度路由的行为痕迹，体现在学习速度而非生存率上。
tldr: 提出了一种基于主动推断的内感受注意力机制，通过动态分配内感受精度预算，使具身智能体在多重生理需求下的生存率提升了一倍以上。
ai_comments: 该论文将主动推断框架应用于具身智能体的内感受注意力机制研究，提出了一种动态体感优先级分配策略，对理解生物体如何通过有限的感知带宽来维持内稳态（Homeostasis）具有重要的理论启发意义。
motivation: 生物系统必须在有限的感知带宽下调节相互竞争的生理需求，任何固定预算的系统都必须决定如何分配其感知精度。论文旨在研究这种内感受注意力机制如何作为一种动态的内稳态优先级分配策略。
method: 构建了一个基于主动推断的寻觅智能体模型。智能体在每一步读取自身的身体状态信念，识别最急需的通道，并将固定的内感受精度预算重新分配给该通道，从而利用形状优化的似然度来同时支持信念更新和规划。
results: 在四通道的AffectWorld寻觅网格环境中，相比于统一精度的智能体，这种选择性精度分配策略在相同预算下的学习阶段生存率提升了一倍以上（0.414对比0.199）。同时，规划阶段的收益占了总收益的一半左右，且精度分配具有需求对齐的特性，受关注通道的动态学习速度快了一倍。
conclusion: 动态分配内感受精度可以显著提升具身寻觅智能体在多重需求冲突环境下的生存能力，这种优势同时作用于感知和规划阶段。

title: Scale-CDA: A Scalable Prototype to Democratize AI-Assisted Cooperative Driving Automation (CDA) for Production Cars
authors: Hao Zhou, Shengming Yuan, Yuhang Wang, Haibin Wen
abstract: This study presents Scale-CDA, an open-hardware/open-software tool-chain that democratizes a functional version of Generative-AI-assisted Cooperative Driving Automation (CDA). Built on the community-maintained OpenDBC interface (300+ car models) and Openpilot Level-2 ADAS, Scale-CDA achieves plug-and-play retrofitting with off-the-shelf parts that cost under US \$1,000 (edge PC, webcam, CAN adapter, optional LTE/Wi-Fi radios). A lightweight Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) stack using MQTT over Wi-Fi 6/LTE provides bidirectional connectivity. Field experiments in a 7.5 km test loop demonstrated mean round-trip latency of 5.25 ms and link speeds near 100 Mb/s, validating Wi-Fi 6 as a viable, low-cost medium for non-safety-critical CDA messaging . At the intelligence layer, an edge-deployed multimodal large-language model (MLLM) ingests synchronized vision, CAN, and V2X streams via a Model-Context-Protocol (MCP) bridge, then issues structured JSON advisories and motion primitives. A library of meta-action executors translates these high-level commands into verified Openpilot planner hooks, enabling lane changes, gap management, and emergency stops without altering the safety-certified core. In multi-vehicle road tests the full stack maintained end-to-end decision latencies below 60 ms, while preserving data privacy by keeping inference on-board. Collectively, Scale-CDA closes two critical gaps that have limited CDA R\&D: (i) affordable, interoperable hardware for large-scale field trials, and (ii) a standardized interface that lets GenAI reason and act on everyday cars. By releasing the bills-of-materials, connectivity APIs, and GenAI bridges as open resources, this work offers transportation agencies and researchers a practical blueprint for democratizing cooperative autonomy, accelerating deployments that enhance traffic efficiency and safety.
zh_title: Scale-CDA：一个用于量产车上普及AI辅助协作式自动驾驶（CDA）的可扩展开源原型
translation: 本研究提出了Scale-CDA，这是一个开源硬件/软件工具链，旨在普及生成式AI辅助的协作式自动驾驶（CDA）功能版本。基于社区维护的OpenDBC接口（300多种车型）和Openpilot L2级ADAS，Scale-CDA实现了使用低于1000美元的现成零件（边缘PC、网络摄像头、CAN适配器、可选LTE/Wi-Fi无线电）进行即插即用改装。使用Wi-Fi 6/LTE上的MQTT构建的轻量级车路协同（V2X）协议栈提供了双向连接。在7.5公里测试环路进行的现场实验表明，平均往返延迟为5.25毫秒，链路速度接近100 Mb/s，验证了Wi-Fi 6作为非安全关键CDA消息传输的经济高效媒介的可行性。在智能层，边缘部署的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）通过模型上下文协议（MCP）桥接摄取同步的视觉、CAN和V2X流，然后发布结构化的JSON建议和运动基元。元动作执行器库将这些高级命令转换为经过验证的Openpilot规划器钩子，在不改变安全认证核心的情况下实现车道变换、间距管理和紧急停车。在多车道路测试中，整个协议栈将端到端决策延迟保持在60毫秒以下，同时通过保持车端推理来保护数据隐私。总的来说，Scale-CDA弥合了限制CDA研发的两个关键差距：（i) 用于大规模现场试验的经济、可互操作的硬件，以及（ii) 让GenAI能够在日常车辆上进行推理和行动的标准化接口。通过将物料清单、连接API和GenAI桥接作为开源资源发布，这项工作为交通机构和研究人员提供了一个民主化协作自主性的实用蓝图，加速了提高交通效率和安全性的部署。
tldr: Scale-CDA是一个低成本、开源的AI辅助协作式自动驾驶（CDA）工具链，通过结合边缘大模型与量产车改装，实现了高效的车辆协作与自动驾驶。
ai_comments: Scale-CDA具有极高的创新性和实用价值，它通过低成本的开源硬件和标准接口，将生成式AI与协作式自动驾驶（CDA）结合，填补了平价硬件与量产车AI落地的研究空白。其局限性可能在于非安全关键通信的可靠性受限于实际道路环境。
motivation: 解决协作式自动驾驶（CDA）研发中长期存在的两大痛点：一是缺乏适用于大规模实地试验的经济、互操作硬件；二是缺乏能让生成式AI在日常车辆上进行推理和行动的标准化接口。
method: 基于OpenDBC和Openpilot开源接口，采用成本低于1000美元的现成硬件实现即插即用改装；利用MQTT构建轻量级V2X栈；在边缘端部署多模态大语言模型（MLLM），通过Model-Context-Protocol（MCP）桥接输入输出，并借助元动作执行器转化为Openpilot规划器指令。
results: 在7.5公里测试环路的现场实验中，平均往返延迟为5.25毫秒，链路速度接近100 Mb/s；多车道路测试显示，端到端决策延迟保持在60毫秒以下，同时通过车端推理保护了数据隐私。
conclusion: Scale-CDA通过开源硬件和轻量级V2X协议，成功将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）引入普通量产车中，实现了低成本、高效且保护隐私的AI辅助协作式自动驾驶。

title: Physics-informed reduced-order modelling with equivariant spectral submanifolds
authors: Georg Maierhofer
abstract: Spectral submanifold (SSM) reduction has emerged as a mathematically principled route to reliable nonlinear reduced-order models, capturing dynamics beyond the reach of linear techniques such as Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD). The computation of SSMs, however, remains computationally expensive, particularly for high-dimensional systems. In this work, we introduce equivariant spectral submanifold (eSSM) reduction, a novel extension of the SSM framework that explicitly incorporates symmetries of the full-order model into the reduction process. We establish the mathematical foundations of this approach by showing that SSMs are naturally equivariant submanifolds and that the associated charts and reduced dynamics inherit the appropriate induced group actions. Building on this framework, we develop a novel equivariant SSM reduction algorithm that exploits these symmetries to achieve substantially faster computations while also improving model robustness. We demonstrate the advantages of this approach on several benchmark problems including a test from the Common Task Framework for Science.
zh_title: 具有等变谱子流形的物理信息降阶建模
translation: 谱子流形（SSM）降阶已成为通往可靠非线性降阶模型的数学原则性途径，能够捕捉超越线性技术（如动态模态分解，DMD）能力的动力学。然而，SSM的计算仍然成本高昂，特别是对于高维系统。在这项工作中，我们引入了等变谱子流形（eSSM）降阶，这是SSM框架的一个新颖扩展，它将全阶模型的对称性明确地纳入降阶过程中。我们通过证明SSM是天然的等变子流形，且相关图表和简化动力学继承了适当的诱导群作用，从而建立了该方法的数学基础。在此框架的基础上，我们开发了一种新颖的等变SSM降阶算法，该算法利用这些对称性来实现实质性更快的计算，同时提高模型鲁棒性。我们在几个基准问题（包括科学通用任务框架中的一个测试）上展示了该方法的优势。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合物理对称性的等变谱子流形（eSSM）降阶建模方法，有效降低了高维非线性系统降阶的计算成本并增强了鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 该论文通过将物理对称性（Equivariance）引入谱子流形（SSM）降阶建模中，不仅在数学上证明了SSM的等变性质，还显著提升了高维非线性系统降阶模型的计算效率和鲁棒性，具有重要的理论意义和应用价值。
motivation: 尽管谱子流形（SSM）降阶能够可靠地捕捉非线性动力学，但对于高维系统而言，其计算成本仍然非常昂贵。因此，有必要引入全阶模型的物理对称性来改进这一过程。
method: 建立谱子流形作为等变子流形的数学基础，证明相关图表和简化动力学继承了诱导群作用，并开发了一种利用这些对称性的新型等变SSM降阶算法。
results: 在多个基准问题（包括科学通用任务框架中的测试）上的实验表明，eSSM方法能够实现显著更快的计算速度，并提高了模型的鲁棒性。
conclusion: 等变谱子流形（eSSM）降阶框架成功地将系统对称性融入非线性降阶建模中，实现了计算效率和模型鲁棒性的双重提升。

title: Feasibility of Embedded Photoplethysmography Sensing in Short-Duration Tactile Interactions With Pocket-Sized Robots Using IMU- and Confidence-Based Filtering
authors: Turjja Datta, Morten Roed Frederiksen
abstract: Ubiquitous companion robots offer a promising avenue for immediate anxiety relief in children, yet their effectiveness relies on the ability to monitor physiological states continuously and unobtrusively. Current solutions often depend on external wearables, which impose usability barriers and limit the robot's autonomy. This paper investigates the integration of an embedded photoplethysmography (PPG) sensor directly into a pocket-sized companion robot, AffectaPocket, to enable self-contained heart rate monitoring during tactile interaction. We address the significant challenge of motion artifacts inherent in handheld usage by implementing a two-stage filtering pipeline that utilizes an onboard Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) to reject high-variance segments and a confidence-based smoothing algorithm for recovery periods. We evaluated the system against a commonly used wrist worn sensor in a Within-Subjects Study with 26 participants. Our results demonstrate that the filtering strategy significantly reduced the Mean Absolute Percentage Error and achieved statistical equivalence to the ground truth measurements (p<0.05). Analysis of short-duration interactions shows that the sensor requires stability over longer periods to converge.
