title: Error estimates for vector field interpolation based on generalized matrix-valued kernels
authors: Zhengjie Sun, Lishuo Dong, Leevan Ling
abstract: Matrix-valued kernels provide a flexible framework for approximating vector fields from scattered data, especially when structural constraints such as divergence-free or curl-free conditions must be preserved. Classical potential-based constructions enforce these constraints naturally, but they typically require the generating scalar function to possess relatively high smoothness. We develop an operator-based framework for constructing div-free and curl-free matrix-valued kernels using integral and differential operators, which substantially relaxes the regularity requirements of the potential approach. Using dimension-walking techniques, we show that the resulting native spaces are norm-equivalent to appropriate vector-valued Sobolev spaces. Another main contribution of the paper is a sharp error analysis for the corresponding kernel matrix-valued interpolation problem. We derive direct Sobolev error estimates that allow fractional regularity of the target field, and we establish Bernstein-type inequalities for the associated kernel trial spaces. These results lead to a complete inverse theorem. We also investigate stability by proving lower bounds for the smallest eigenvalues of the interpolation matrices. Numerical experiments are included to verify the theoretical results.
zh_title: 基于广义矩阵值核的向量场插值的误差估计
translation: 矩阵值核为从分散数据近似向量场提供了一个灵活的框架，尤其是当必须保持如无散或无旋等结构约束时。传统的基于势函数的构造可以自然地施加这些约束，但它们通常要求生成的标量函数具备相对较高的平滑度。我们开发了一个基于算子的框架，利用积分和微分算子构造无散和无旋的矩阵值核，这大幅放宽了势函数方法的正则性要求。利用维度行走技术，我们证明了所得的原生空间在范数上等价于适当的向量值Sobolev空间。本文的另一个主要贡献是对相应的核矩阵值插值问题进行了紧致的误差分析。我们推导了允许目标场具有分数阶正则性的直接Sobolev误差估计，并为相关的核试探空间建立了Bernstein型不等式。这些结果导出了一条完整的逆定理。我们还通过证明插值矩阵最小特征值的下界研究了稳定性。文中包含数值实验以验证理论结果。
tldr: 本文针对无散和无旋向量场插值提出了基于算子的矩阵值核构造框架，降低了正则性要求，并建立了完备的Sobolev误差估计、逆定理与稳定性理论。
ai_comments:
1. 创新性：引入基于积分与微分算子的新框架构造无散和无旋矩阵值核，克服了传统基于势函数方法要求高平滑度的局限，并结合维度行走技术建立了原生空间与向量值Sobolev空间的范数等价性。
2. 重要性：为保持物理结构约束（如流体力学中的无散场、电磁学中的无旋场）的散乱数据向量场插值提供了全面且紧致的理论支撑，包括直接误差估计、逆定理和稳定性分析。
3. 局限性：论文主要侧重于数学理论分析与一维/高维推导，对于高维复杂区域下算子的计算效率和矩阵条件数恶化问题在摘要中未作深探讨。
motivation: 传统的基于势函数构造无散或无旋矩阵值核的方法通常要求标量生成函数具备较高的平滑度（正则性）。为了降低这种正则性限制，并为矩阵值核插值建立严格且紧致的误差估计与稳定性理论，本文提出了新的算子化框架。
method:
1. 利用积分和微分算子开发基于算子的无散（div-free）和无旋（curl-free）矩阵值核构造框架；
2. 应用维度行走（dimension-walking）技术证明原生空间与向量值Sobolev空间的范数等价性；
3. 建立允许分数阶正则性的直接Sobolev误差估计，并推导核试探空间的Bernstein型不等式以导出完备的逆定理；
4. 证明插值矩阵最小特征值的下界，用于评估算法的数值稳定性。
results:
1. 证明了新构造的原生空间与适当的向量值Sobolev空间范数等价；
2. 得到了允许目标场具备分数阶正则性的精确Sobolev误差估计；
3. 建立了Bernstein型不等式并由此导出了完整的逆定理；
4. 给出了插值矩阵最小特征值的下界估计，验证了稳定性；
5. 数值实验验证了上述理论分析的正确性。
conclusion: 提出的基于算子的矩阵值核构造框架有效降低了对生成标量函数平滑度的要求，为带物理约束的向量场插值提供了完整的Sobolev误差分析、逆定理及稳定性保证，并通过数值实验进行了验证。

title: Pun Intended: Multi-Agent Translation of Wordplay with Contrastive Learning and Phonetic-Semantic Embeddings
authors: Russell Taylor, Benjamin Herbert, Michael Sana
abstract: Translating wordplay across languages has long challenged both professional translators and machine translation systems. We investigate three approaches to translating puns from English to French by combining large language models with linguistic constraints for wordplay generation. Our baseline uses a large language model with feedback from a discriminator prompted with positive and negative French examples. Our guided reasoning pipeline uses combined phonetic-semantic embeddings to retrieve lexical candidates for wordplay generation. Finally, our multi-agent framework iteratively evaluates and regenerates candidate translations using specialized feedback. Moving beyond literal translation, our objective is to preserve the linguistic creativity, ambiguity, and humor of the source-text wordplay rather than simply reproduce its vocabulary. The multi-agent and guided chain-of-thought systems ranked first and second, respectively, in the CLEF JOKER 2025 Task 2 competition under expert human evaluation, despite only modest improvements in BLEU and BERTScore. These findings suggest that both explicit phonetic-semantic guidance and iterative multi-agent evaluation can improve LLM-based wordplay translation relative to direct discriminator-guided generation, particularly when balancing semantic fidelity, phonetic similarity, and natural target-language expression
zh_title: 双关之意：基于对比学习与语音-语义嵌入的多智能体双关语翻译
translation: 跨语言翻译双关语长期以来对专业翻译人员和机器翻译系统都构成了巨大挑战。我们探讨了将大语言模型与语言约束相结合来生成双关语的三种英法双关语翻译方法。我们的基线系统使用大语言模型，并结合由法语正负示例提示的判别器的反馈。我们的引导推理管道利用结合的语音-语义嵌入来检索用于生成双关语的词汇候选。最后，我们的多智能体框架使用专门的反馈对候选翻译进行迭代评估和重新生成。超越字面翻译，我们的目标是保留源文本双关语的语言创造力、歧义性和幽默感，而不是简单地重现其词汇。在CLEF JOKER 2025 Task 2竞赛中，尽管BLEU和BERTScore仅有微幅提升，但在专家人工评估下，多智能体系统和引导式思维链系统分别排名第一和第二。这些发现表明，显式的语音-语义引导和迭代多智能体评估相比于直接的判别器引导生成，均能改进基于大语言模型的双关语翻译，特别是在平衡语义忠实度、语音相似度和自然的目标语言表达时。
tldr: 本文提出了结合语音-语义嵌入与多智能体迭代反馈的翻译框架，显著提升了跨语言双关语翻译中的幽默感、创造力与自然度表达。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将语音-语义联合嵌入与多智能体迭代反馈机制应用于跨语言双关语翻译这一高难度领域。其重要价值在于打破了传统的字面机械翻译，成功保留了修辞中的幽默与创造力，同时也再次印证了传统自动评价指标（如BLEU、BERTScore）在评估非字面、创造性翻译时的局限性。局限性在于摘要中未详细展开对比学习的具体实现细节，且评估主要集中在英法单一语种对上。
motivation: 跨语言翻译双关语（Wordplay/Puns）长期以来是专业翻译人员和机器翻译系统的难题。研究旨在突破字面翻译的局限，在翻译过程中保留源文本双关语的语言创造力、歧义性和幽默感。
method: 本文探讨了三种结合大语言模型与语言约束的英法双关语翻译方法：1）基线模型：基于正负法语示例提示的判别器反馈的LLM；2）引导推理管道：利用结合的语音-语义嵌入检索词汇候选，用于生成双关语；3）多智能体框架：利用专门的智能体反馈，对候选翻译进行迭代评估与重新生成。
results: 在CLEF JOKER 2025 Task 2竞赛的专家人工评估中，多智能体系统和引导式思维链系统分别荣获第一名和第二名。尽管在BLEU和BERTScore等自动评估指标上仅有微幅提升，但人工评估展现出了显著优越性。
conclusion: 明确的语音-语义引导以及迭代多智能体评估均能有效改进基于大语言模型的双关语翻译，特别是在平衡语义忠实度、语音相似度以及目标语言表达的自然度方面表现突出。

title: Adversarial Attacks for Good: A Survey of Proactive Protection across the Visual Content Lifecycle
authors: Jiaming Zhang, Boyang Chen, Zherui Li, Fuyao Zhang, Xinyu Yan, Hong Xi Tae, Wenwen He, Xuan Wang, Siqi Guo, Junhao Dong, Kun Wang, Hanxun Huang, Yige Li, Xingjun Ma, Yang Cao, Lingjuan Lyu, Wei Yang Bryan Lim
abstract: Once visual content enters an AI pipeline, its owner often retains little technical control over how it is used. Legal and regulatory remedies can address misuse, but many technical interventions must be applied earlier, when content is released or accessed. This survey examines the protective paradigm that has grown around this intervention point, which we call \emph{adversarial attacks for good}. Perturbations and structured signals long studied as attacks on learned models are instead applied by data owners, creators, platforms, or auditors to disrupt unauthorized automation or support later accountability. Five research communities have arrived at this inversion largely independently, each addressing a different stage of a visual asset's lifecycle: privacy filters against unwanted recognition at sharing time, unlearnable examples against unauthorized training, generative safeguards against malicious editing or imitation, adversarial CAPTCHAs for access control against automated agents, and provenance mechanisms for post-circulation attribution. Although developed in separate venues with incompatible success criteria, many of these methods exploit persistent gaps between human perception, semantic interpretation, and machine inference, suggesting that the paradigm remains relevant as visual pipelines evolve toward multimodal models and autonomous agents. To make their claims comparable, we evaluate all five families along shared axes of transferability, adaptability, and deployment readiness. Across the lifecycle, we find that most protections are still validated mainly against static or weakly adaptive adversaries, while evidence beyond controlled benchmarks remains scarce. We close by consolidating cross-stage countermeasures and open problems for robust, composable, and deployable owner-side protection.
zh_title: 以善之名的对抗性攻击：视觉内容全生命周期主动保护综述
translation: 视觉内容一旦进入AI流水线，其所有者往往很难从技术层面控制其后续使用。法律和监管补救措施可以应对滥用问题，但许多技术干预必须在更早的阶段（即内容发布或被访问时）实施。本综述探讨了围绕这一干预节点发展起来的保护性范式，我们称之为“以善之名的对抗性攻击”。长期以来作为机器学习模型攻击手段被研究的扰动和结构化信号，现在被数据所有者、创作者、平台或审计员反向应用，以干扰未授权的自动化操作或支持事后追责。五个研究社区很大程度上独立地实现了这一理念翻转，各自针对视觉资产生命周期的不同阶段：分享时的隐私过滤器（防止未授权识别）、未授权训练时的不可学习样本、针对恶意编辑或模仿的生成安全防护、用于访问控制对抗自动化智能体的对抗验证码，以及用于传播后归因的溯源机制。尽管这些方法在不同的会议发表且具有不兼容的成功标准，但许多方法都利用了人类感知、语义理解与机器推理之间持续存在的差距，这表明随着视觉流水线向多模态模型和自主智能体演进，该范式仍将保持其重要性。为了使其主张具备可比性，我们沿着可转移性、适应性和部署准备度这三个共享轴线对所有五个家族进行了评估。贯穿整个生命周期，我们发现大多数保护措施仍然主要针对静态或弱适应性对手进行验证，而在受控基准之外的证据依然匮乏。最后，我们整理了跨阶段对策以及构建鲁棒、可组合且可部署的所有者端保护的开放性问题。
tldr: 本综述总结了利用“对抗攻击”技术进行视觉内容主动保护的五大领域（隐私过滤、不可学习样本、生成防御、对抗验证码、溯源机制），统一评估了其技术成熟度与局限性，指出了当前缺乏真实环境下强对抗测试的问题。
ai_comments: 该综述角度非常独特且切中时弊，将以往被视为“攻击”手段的对抗扰动技术翻转为数据所有者主动使用的“防御工具”，系统性地梳理了覆盖视觉内容全生命周期的五大保护场景。文章建立了统一的评估维度（可转移性、适应性、部署准备度），并指出了当前研究普遍局限于受控基准与弱对抗环境的痛点，对AI安全、版权保护及数据隐私领域的后续研究提供了极具价值的统揽视角。
motivation: 视觉内容进入AI流水线后，所有者难以对其后续使用进行技术控制。需要在内容发布或访问阶段尽早引入技术干预，利用对抗性扰动来阻断未授权的自动化使用或支持事后追责。
method: 梳理了贯穿视觉资产全生命周期的五大保护技术族（隐私过滤器、不可学习样本、生成防御、对抗验证码、出处溯源机制），并在可转移性、适应性和部署准备度等统一维度上对它们进行了评估与比较。
results: 研究发现目前绝大多数保护技术主要仅在静态或弱适应性攻击者假设下进行了验证，在受控基准测试之外的真实应用证据仍然极其匮乏。
conclusion: 本文对跨阶段的对抗防护对策进行了整合，并提出了构建鲁棒、可组合且具备可部署性的所有者端主动保护机制所面临的开放性问题。

title: ArborEnum: Decision Tree Rashomon Sets over Continuous Features
authors: Zakk Heile, Hayden McTavish, Margo Seltzer, Cynthia Rudin
abstract: The Rashomon effect describes the phenomenon that many models can achieve nearly equivalent performance on the same learning task, with significant ramifications for robustness, feature importance, and customizability. These use cases motivate the computation of Rashomon sets: the set of all models whose regularized loss is near-optimal. Decision trees are one of the few model classes for which Rashomon sets can be fully enumerated, but this computation has always been conditional on a binarization of the original data, either restricting which splits each tree is allowed to make or substantially increasing the complexity of an already difficult combinatorial problem. We introduce the first algorithm that exactly enumerates decision-tree Rashomon sets while exploiting the ordered structure of continuous features. We further develop a relaxation for approximate enumeration and an anytime algorithm that progressively refines the set of candidate thresholds, producing increasingly detailed approximations that converge to the continuous-feature Rashomon set. Experiments show that coarse binarization can miss many trees, important features, and predictive multiplicity; our algorithms achieve orders-of-magnitude speedups over existing enumeration methods, with approximations providing further speedups while maintaining near-perfect recall.
zh_title: ArborEnum：连续特征上的决策树Rashomon集
translation: Rashomon效应描述了许多模型可以在同一个学习任务上取得几乎相当的性能的现象，这对鲁棒性、特征重要性和可定制性有着重要影响。这些应用场景促使了Rashomon集的计算：即所有正则化损失接近最优的模型集合。决策树是少数可以完全枚救援Rashomon集的模型类之一，但这种计算过去一直依赖于原始数据的二值化，这要么限制了每棵树允许进行的划分，要么大幅增加了本就困难的组合问题的复杂度。我们推出了首个在利用连续特征有序结构的同时精确枚救援决策树Rashomon集的算法。我们进一步开发了一种用于近似枚救援的松弛方法，以及一种能够逐步细化候选阈值集合的任何时间（anytime）算法，从而产生逐渐精细且收敛于连续特征Rashomon集的近似结果。实验表明，粗糙的二值化可能会遗漏许多树、重要特征和预测多样性；我们的算法比现有的枚救援方法实现了数量级的加速，且近似方法在保持近乎完美召回率的同时提供了额外的加速。
tldr: 本文提出了首个无需预先二值化数据、可直接在连续特征上精确且高效枚救援决策树Rashomon集的算法。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了首个直接在连续特征上精确枚救援决策树Rashomon集的算法，打破了以往研究必须预先对特征进行二值化的局限，创新性突出。作者不仅提出了精确求解算法，还设计了松弛近似与Anytime算法，兼顾了理论完备性与工程实用性，对模型鲁棒性、可解释性及预测多样性（predictive multiplicity）的研究具有重要贡献。
motivation: 此前决策树Rashomon集的枚举计算均依赖于对原始数据进行预先二值化，这要么限制了树可进行的划分，要么显著增加了本就复杂的组合计算难度，容易导致重要特征和预测多样性的遗漏。
method: 提出了首个利用连续特征有序结构精确枚救援决策树Rashomon集的算法；同时开发了用于近似枚救援的松弛方法，以及能够逐步细化候选划分阈值的Anytime算法，生成收敛于连续特征Rashomon集的近似结果。
results: 实验表明预先二值化会遗漏许多树结构、重要特征及预测多样性；所提算法相比现有枚救援方法实现了数个数量级的加速，近似算法在保持近乎完美召回率的同时带来了进一步的性能提升。
conclusion: 该研究突破了决策树Rashomon集计算对数据预先二值化的依赖，提出了能够在连续特征上高效进行精确和近似枚救援的新算法，极大提升了计算效率与分析完整性。

title: Responsibility in Multi-Agent Sequential Decision-Making: Comparing Human Judgments to Formal Models of Causal Attribution
authors: Nripsuta Ani Saxena, Stelios Triantafyllou, Goran Radanović
abstract: With the growing adoption of artificial intelligence in high-stakes decision-making, identifying the causes of outcomes--particularly failures--and determining who is responsible has become a critical concern. In this work, we examine how well formal definitions of \textit{responsibility attribution}, grounded in the framework of \textit{actual causality}, align with human judgments of responsibility. To this end, we conduct a large-scale survey to elicit human judgments of responsibility in multi-agent sequential decision-making scenarios, using a modified version of the card game Goofspiel. We evaluate multiple responsibility attribution methods, assess their alignment with human judgments about responsibility, and identify factors that significantly shape responsibility judgments. While no single responsibility attribution method consistently aligns with human responses, our findings highlight key factors that influence human responsibility judgments, including agent-specific biases and amount of information available to agents during decision-making.
zh_title: 多智能体顺序决策中的责任归因：人类判断与因果归因形式化模型的对比
translation: 随着人工智能在高风险决策中的日益普及，识别结果（特别是失败）的原因并确定谁应该承担责任已成为一个关键问题。在这项工作中，我们探讨了基于“实际因果关系”框架的形式化责任归因定义在多大程度上与人类的责任判断相一致。为此，我们利用修改版的Goofspiel扑克牌游戏，开展了一项大规模调查，以获取人类在多智能体顺序决策场景下的责任判断。我们评估了多种责任归因方法，衡量了它们与人类责任判断的一致性，并识别出了显著塑造责任判断的因素。虽然没有任何一种责任归因方法能够持续一致地与人类的反应对齐，但我们的研究结果突出了影响人类责任判断的关键因素，包括特定智能体的偏见以及决策期间智能体可获取的信息量。
tldr: 本研究通过大规模实验评估了多智能体决策中形式化责任归因模型与人类判断的契合度，发现没有单一模型能完全拟合人类直觉，且智能体偏见和信息掌握量是影响人类责任判断的关键因素。
ai_comments: 本文将因果归因的形式化理论与人类认知心理相结合，通过大规模行为实验检验了计算责任归因模型与人类直觉的契合度，对可解释AI和人工智能伦理归责机制的设计具有重要参考价值。其局限性在于实验场景主要基于特定的扑克牌游戏（Goofspiel），其结论在更复杂真实的高风险决策场景中的通用性仍有待验证。
motivation: 随着人工智能在重要决策领域的应用增加，确定结果（特别是失败）的原因及责任归属变得至关重要。研究旨在评估基于实际因果关系的责任归因形式化模型与人类实际责任判断之间的一致程度。
method: 使用修改版的Goofspiel纸牌游戏构建多智能体顺序决策场景，开展大规模调查以收集人类的责任判断数据，并评估多种基于实际因果关系的形式化责任归因模型与人类判断的一致性。
results: 没有任何单一的形式化责任归因方法能够持续一致地与人类判断相吻合；研究确定了显著影响人类责任判断的关键因素，包括智能体特有的偏见以及决策过程中智能体可获取的信息量。
conclusion: 现有的形式化责任归因模型难以完美拟合人类直觉，未来构建与人类期望对齐的AI责任归因体系时，必须将决策者的偏见和信息掌握程度等心理与情境因素纳入考量。

title: Trident : How to Break Deep Reinforcement Learning Cyber Defenses (Agentic)
authors: Ryozo Masukawa, Ian Bryant, Armita Kazeminajafabadi, Sanggeon Yun, Hyunwoo Oh, SungHeon Jeong, Nathaniel D. Bastian, Mahdi Imani, Mohsen Imani
abstract: Autonomous cyber defense systems based on Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) have attracted significant research attention, yet remain evaluated almost exclusively against static, heuristic red agents, leaving their robustness against adaptive threats critically understudied. Meanwhile, recent advances in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) have improved LLM reasoning, but their integration into cybersecurity remains elusive due to the absence of suitable benchmark environments and interaction datasets. To bridge this gap, we introduce Trident, an agentic LLM red teaming framework comprising three components: a dynamic benchmark with isolated sandbox servers spanning CybORG CAGE 4 and CyberWheel, a dataset comprises over 13,000 high-fidelity red-blue interaction trajectories for RLVR, and a ``Code-as-Policy'' RLVR agentic architecture Trident Agentic). The latter reformulates red agent training as a contextual bandit via a tripartite Log Summarizer--Planner--Coder design, where a trainable Planner generates complete attack strategies from compressed execution logs, which a frozen Coder translates into executable Python policies deployed against live DRL defenders. Empirical evaluations reveal a fundamental brittleness in existing defenses: with a single trainable 7B planner, Trident reduces blue agent defensive performance by an average of 522% compared to static red agent baselines while autonomously discovering emergent behaviors such as decoy avoidance and adaptive state prioritization that static heuristics entirely fail to uncover.
zh_title: Trident：如何攻破基于深度强化学习的网络防御系统（智能体视角）
translation: 基于深度强化学习（DRL）的自主网络防御系统引起了广泛的研究关注，但目前几乎完全是对静态、启发式的红队智能体进行评估，导致对其应对自适应威胁的鲁棒性研究严重不足。同时，可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的最新进展提升了LLM的推理能力，但由于缺乏合适的基准环境和交互数据集，其在网络安全领域的融合仍难以实现。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了Trident，这是一个智能体LLM红队框架，包含三个组件：跨越CybORG CAGE 4和CyberWheel的具有隔离沙盒服务器的动态基准测试；一个包含13,000多个用于RLVR的高保真红蓝交互轨迹的数据集；以及一种“Code-as-Policy”的RLVR智能体架构（Trident Agentic）。后者通过三元日志总结器-规划器-编码器（Log Summarizer--Planner--Coder）设计，将红队智能体训练重构为上下文多臂老虎机（contextual bandit），其中可训练的规划器（Planner）从压缩的执行日志中生成完整的攻击策略，冻结的编码器（Coder）将其翻译成可执行的Python策略部署到在线DRL防御者上。实证评估揭示了现有防御的根本脆弱性：仅凭一个可训练的7B规划器， Trident使蓝队智能体的防御性能相比静态红队基线平均降低了522%，同时自主发现了静态启发式算法完全无法揭示的涌现行为，如诱饵规避和自适应状态优先级划分。
tldr: Trident是一个基于LLM和RLVR的自适应红队智能体框架，能显著降低现有DRL网络防御系统的性能（平均下降522%）并发现复杂的攻击行为。
ai_comments: 本论文的创新点在于将可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）与大语言模型（LLM）代理重构结合，提出了“Code-as-Policy”的三元攻击架构（总结器-规划器-编码器），打破了以往网络安全评估仅依赖静态、启发式红队攻击的局限。论文提供的13,000+高保真轨迹数据集及沙盒环境对推动LLM在网络红蓝对抗领域的应用具有重要价值。局限性在于主要评估了针对DRL防御者的攻防表现，对其他非DRL防范机制的泛化效果有待进一步验证。
motivation: 基于深度强化学习（DRL）的自主网络防御系统通常仅在静态、启发式的红队智能体面前进行评估，缺乏对自适应威胁鲁棒性的深入研究；同时，大模型结合可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）在网络安全领域的应用受限于缺乏合适的基准环境和交互数据集。
method: 提出了Trident智能体红队框架，包含三个核心组件：跨CybORG CAGE 4和CyberWheel的沙盒动态基准测试；包含13,000多条高保真红蓝交互轨迹的数据集；以及“Code-as-Policy”的RLVR智能体架构（Trident Agentic）。该架构采用日志总结器-规划器-编码器（Log Summarizer-Planner-Coder）三元设计，将攻击训练重构为上下文多臂老虎机，由可训练的Planner根据日志生成策略，冻结的Coder将其转化为Python代码策略对DRL防御者施加攻击。
results: 仅使用一个可训练的7B参数Planner，Trident使得蓝队防御者的防御性能相比静态红队基线平均下降了522%，并自主发现了如诱饵规避和自适应状态优先级划分等静态启发式方法无法揭示的涌现攻击行为。
conclusion: 现有的深度强化学习（DRL）网络防御系统在面对自适应LLM红队攻击时表现出极大的脆弱性，Trident框架能够自主发现复杂的自适应攻击策略并有效评估/突破现有防御。

title: DataRx: Missingness-Aware Sampling for Safer Large Language Model Task-Specific Fine-Tuning
authors: Junbo Zhang, Qianli Zhou, Xinyang Deng, Wen Jiang
abstract: Task-specific fine-tuning can improve the performance of large language models (LLMs) on downstream tasks. However, our study reveals that task-specific fine-tuning can also weaken the safety guardrails of aligned LLMs. A widely adopted strategy for preserving safety during fine-tuning is to incorporate safety data. Although previous studies have shown that randomly mixing safety data can alleviate safety degradation, the underlying principle determining why some safety examples are more effective than others still remains unclear. In this paper, we propose DataRx, a missingness-aware sampling method for selecting safety-critical examples. DataRx is based on the hypothesis that a safety sample is more effective when the selected examples provide safety signals that fill the missing parts of LLMs' safety capabilities. DataRx's key insight is leveraging high-dimensional hidden representations rather than discrete tokens to quantify the safety signal gap between the target model's native response and the safety reference response. The results show that, with only 1% additional safety samples from BeaverTails, DataRx reduces the average attack success rate of Llama3-8B-Instruct across seven downstream tasks from 59.23% under random sampling to 13.70%. In addition, DataRx can be combined with the existing safety data synthesis method to further enhance safety defenses during fine-tuning. We hope that DataRx will inspire more data-centric defense research.
zh_title: DataRx：面向更安全大型语言模型任务特定微调的缺失感知采样
translation: 任务特定微调可以提高大型语言模型（LLM）在下游任务上的性能。然而，我们的研究表明，任务特定微调也会削弱已对齐LLM的安全防护。在微调过程中保持安全的一个广泛采用的策略是纳入安全数据。尽管之前的研究表明随机混合安全数据可以缓解安全退化，但决定为什么某些安全示例比其他示例更有效的底层原理仍然不清楚。在本文中，我们提出了DataRx，一种缺失感知采样方法，用于选择安全关键示例。DataRx基于一个假设：当所选示例提供的安全信号能够填补LLM安全能力中的缺失部分时，安全样本会更有效。DataRx的关键洞察在于利用高维隐藏表示而不是离散token来量化目标模型原生响应与安全参考响应之间的安全信号差距。结果表明，仅使用BeaverTails中1%的额外安全样本，DataRx将Llama3-8B-Instruct在七个下游任务上的平均攻击成功率从随机采样下的59.23%降低到13.70%。此外，DataRx可以与现有安全数据合成方法结合，进一步增强微调过程中的安全防御。我们希望DataRx能激发更多以数据为中心的防御研究。
tldr: DataRx提出了一种缺失感知采样方法，通过识别并弥补LLM安全能力中的缺失部分，显著降低了任务特定微调后的攻击成功率。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了“缺失感知采样”的概念，并利用高维隐藏表示来量化LLM的安全信号差距，而非传统的离散token。这种方法为理解和提升LLM安全性提供了一个新的数据中心视角，对于在保持性能的同时增强模型安全性具有重要意义。其高效性（仅需1%额外数据）也令人印象深刻。
motivation: 任务特定微调会削弱大型语言模型（LLM）的安全防护，而现有随机混合安全数据的方法虽能缓解安全退化，但其背后原理仍不明确。本研究旨在找到更有效的安全样本选择方法。
method: 本文提出了DataRx，一种缺失感知采样方法，用于选择安全关键示例。它基于一个假设：当安全样本提供的安全信号能填补LLM安全能力中的缺失部分时，该样本更有效。DataRx通过利用高维隐藏表示而非离散token来量化目标模型原生响应与安全参考响应之间的安全信号差距。
results: DataRx仅使用BeaverTails中1%的额外安全样本，将Llama3-8B-Instruct在七个下游任务上的平均攻击成功率从随机采样的59.23%降低到13.70%。此外，DataRx可与现有安全数据合成方法结合，进一步增强微调过程中的安全防御。
conclusion: DataRx通过缺失感知采样有效提升了大型语言模型任务特定微调的安全性，并有望激发更多以数据为中心的防御研究。

title: HRRC on the Farm: Quantile Forecasting for Highly-Reliable Remote Control via LEO Networks
authors: André Gomes, Jie Wang
abstract: LEO satellite networks are an attractive solution to support farm automation in Agriculture 4.0 because of their ubiquitous coverage. However, LEO networks often suffer from high latency volatility, which can limit their utility in mission-critical farm operations such as remote control. This paper studies highly-reliable remote control over LEO networks by (i) casting highly-reliable remote control as a quantile forecasting problem and (ii) proposing a high-quantile estimator that can predict latency spikes at a given reliability level. Our results, drawn from a real-world OneWeb dataset collected in a major agricultural hub in the US, show that the proposed estimator can support highly-reliable remote control on the farm by meeting reliability requirements while allowing the remote-controlled vehicle to operate at speeds up to 138.6% higher than what would be possible otherwise.
comment: Accepted for presentation at IEEE Globecom 2026
zh_title: 农场上的HRRC：基于低轨卫星网络的高可靠遥控分位数预测
translation: 低轨（LEO）卫星网络因其无处不在的覆盖能力，成为支持农业4.0中农场自动化的极具吸引力的解决方案。然而，LEO网络通常存在高时延波动性，这限制了其在远程控制等任务关键型农场作业中的实用性。本文通过以下方式研究基于LEO网络的高可靠远程控制：(i) 将高可靠远程控制抽象为分位数预测问题；(ii) 提出一种高分位数估计器，可以在给定的可靠性水平下预测时延尖峰。我们在美国主要农业枢纽采集的真实OneWeb数据集上的结果表明，所提出的估计器不仅能满足可靠性要求以支持农场的高可靠远程控制，同时还能允许遥控车辆以比其他可能情况高出多达138.6%的速度运行。
keywords: 时延突发预测 (Latency Spike Prediction)
tldr: 提出一种高分位数预测方法，可精准预判低轨卫星通信的时延尖峰，在保证农场远程控制极高可靠性的同时提升138.6%的车辆运行速度。
ai_comments: 本研究将智慧农业场景下的低轨卫星通信时延波动问题巧妙地转化为高分位数预测问题，兼顾了理论创新与实用价值。利用真实OneWeb数据进行验证，不仅证明了高可靠性保证，还显著提升了作业效率（速度提高多达138.6%），对推动卫星互联网在关键任务农业自动化中的应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 低轨（LEO）卫星网络覆盖广泛，是支持农业4.0中农场自动化的有力工具；但其通信时延存在极大的波动性，严重限制了其在远程控制等任务关键型农场作业中的可靠应用。
method: 将高可靠远程控制建立为分位数预测问题，并提出一种高分位数估计器（High-quantile Estimator），用于在指定的可靠性水平下预测时延尖峰。
results: 基于美国主要农业枢纽采集的真实OneWeb卫星数据集验证表明，该估计器不仅能满足严格的可靠性要求，还能使远程控制车辆的运行速度提高多达138.6%。
conclusion: 基于高分位数预测的方法能够有效应对低轨卫星通信的高时延波动，在保障农场远程控制极高可靠性的同时，大幅提升农具/车辆的作业效率。

title: Real-time probabilistic tsunami forecasting via generative AI
authors: Yusuke Oishi, Takashi Furumura, Fumihiko Imamura
abstract: Explicit onshore tsunami inundation forecasting can improve public risk awareness, but deterministically predicted inundation boundaries under highly uncertain conditions, such as near-field tsunamis generated by megathrust earthquakes, may falsely imply safety outside the boundaries. Consequently, current warnings primarily target coastal tsunami height, not onshore inundation. Although machine learning enables instant inundation predictions, they remain deterministic, lacking uncertainty quantification. Here, we develop a probabilistic ensemble model based on a conditional diffusion model (a type of generative AI) that reconciles accuracy with calibration. Validated with the 2011 Tohoku-oki earthquake data, our model faithfully tracks the postearthquake uncertainty decreasing over time while accurately predicting inundation depth and extent. Our framework shows that generative AI can shift tsunami forecasting from determinism to probabilism, providing a foundation for next-generation early warning.
zh_title: 基于生成式人工智能的实时概率性海啸预报
translation: 明确的陆上海啸淹没预报可以提高公众的风险意识，但在高度不确定的条件下（例如由巨型逆冲地震引起的近场海啸），确定性预测的淹没边界可能会错误地暗示边界之外是安全的。因此，当前的预警主要针对沿海海啸高度，而不是陆上淹没。尽管机器学习能够实现即时淹没预测，但它们仍然是确定性的，缺乏不确定性量化。在此，我们开发了一款基于条件扩散模型（一种生成式人工智能）的概率集合模型，兼顾了准确性与标定性。通过2011年日本东北地震数据的验证，我们的模型在准确预测淹没深度和范围的同时，忠实地跟踪了震后不确定性随时间降低的过程。我们的框架表明，生成式人工智能可以将海啸预报从确定性转变为概率性，为下一代早期预警奠定了基础。
tldr: 提出了一种基于条件扩散模型的生成式AI框架，实现了海啸陆上淹没的高精度实时概率预测与不确定性量化。
ai_comments:
创新点：首次将条件扩散模型（生成式AI）应用于海啸陆上淹没的实时概率预报，填补了现有机器学习方法在海啸不确定性量化方面的空白。
重要性：实现了精度与标定性的统一，能够动态反映震后不确定性衰减，为下一代海啸早期预警系统提供了新的范式。
局限性：仅在2011年日本东北地震数据上进行了验证，在不同地质结构与海啸情境下的泛化能力仍需进一步评估。
motivation: 传统的确定性海啸淹没边界预测在高度不确定的近场巨震条件下可能会误导边界外的安全感，且现有的机器学习预测缺乏不确定性量化，因此需要兼具高精度与不确定性标定的实时概率预报方法。
method: 构建了一种基于条件扩散模型（一种生成式人工智能）的概率集合模型，用于兼顾预测精度与不确定性标定。
results: 通过2011年日本东北地震数据验证，该模型在精准预测海啸淹没深度和范围的同时，能够忠实跟踪震后不确定性随时间降低的动态过程。
conclusion: 基于条件扩散模型的生成式AI能够将海啸预报从传统的确定性范式成功转向概率性范式，为下一代早期预警系统奠定了重要基础。

title: Efficient Online Lexicographic Generalized Low-Rank Matrix Bandits
authors: Bo Xue, Ji Cheng, Haodong Jing, Hongzong Li, Shuang Qiu
abstract: This paper studies generalized low-rank matrix bandits with multiple prioritized objectives. At each round, the learner selects a matrix-valued arm and observes a vector-valued reward, whose components correspond to multiple objectives with different priority levels. Each objective is governed by an objective-specific generalized low-rank matrix model, and the learner evaluates arms according to a lexicographic preference order, prioritizing higher-level objectives before lower-level ones. We propose \textsc{Lexi-LowGLM}, an efficient online algorithm that first estimates objective-specific low-rank subspaces and then performs lexicographic learning in the reduced feature spaces. Unlike existing single-objective algorithms that repeatedly solve a batch generalized linear estimator using all historical observations, \textsc{Lexi-LowGLM} updates each objective-specific estimator via an online Newton step, reducing the estimator-update complexity over $T$ rounds from $O(T^2)$ to $O(T)$. We establish a regret bound of $\widetilde O\left(W_i^{\rm lex}\sqrt{m}\,(d_1+d_2)r\sqrt{T}\right)$ for each objective $i\in[m]$, where $r$ is an upper bound on the ranks of the objective-specific parameter matrices and $W_i^{\rm lex}$ characterizes the lexicographic trade-off effect. This bound depends on the effective low-rank dimension $(d_1+d_2)r$ rather than the ambient dimension $d_1d_2$. Numerical experiments further validate the effectiveness and computational efficiency of the proposed method.
zh_title: 高效在线词典序广义低秩矩阵多臂老虎机
translation: 本文研究了具有多个优先级目标的广义低秩矩阵多臂老虎机问题。在每一轮中，学习者选择一个矩阵值的臂并观察一个向量值的收益，收益的各分量对应具有不同优先级水平的多目标。每个目标均由特定的广义低秩矩阵模型支配，学习者根据词典序偏好对臂进行评估，优先满足高层级目标而非低层级目标。我们提出了 Lexi-LowGLM 算法，这是一种高效在线算法，首先估计特定目标的低秩子空间，然后在降维后的特征空间中进行词典序学习。与现有的重复求解批处理广义线性估计器的单目标算法不同，Lexi-LowGLM 通过在线牛顿步更新每个目标的估计器，将 $T$ 轮内的估计器更新复杂度从 $O(T^2)$ 降低至 $O(T)$。我们为每个目标 $i\in[m]$ 建立了 $\widetilde O\left(W_i^{\rm lex}\sqrt{m}\,(d_1+d_2)r\sqrt{T}\right)$ 的遗憾界，其中 $r$ 是目标特定参数矩阵秩的上界，$W_i^{\rm lex}$ 表征词典序权衡效应。该遗憾界取决于有效低秩维度 $(d_1+d_2)r$ 而非环境维度 $d_1d_2$。数值实验进一步验证了所提方法的有效性和计算效率。
tldr: 本文提出了 Lexi-LowGLM 算法，通过在线牛顿步与低秩子空间估计，高效解决了多优先级目标的词典序广义低秩矩阵老虎机问题，将复杂度降至 $O(T)$。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于首次将多偏好的词典序优化引入广义低秩矩阵老虎机问题中，并巧妙利用在线牛顿步替代传统批处理估计，在保证算法具有依赖低秩有效维度的最优遗憾界的同时，将更新复杂度从二次降至线性，显著提升了算法在实际高维环境中的计算可行性。
motivation: 现有单目标算法通常需要重复利用所有历史观测求解批处理估计器，导致计算复杂度高达 $O(T^2)$，且无法直接应对具有不同优先级顺序的多目标词典序优化问题。
method: 提出Lexi-LowGLM算法：首先估计各目标特定的低秩子空间，并在降维后的特征空间中进行词典序偏好学习；同时采用在线牛顿步（Online Newton Step）更新每个目标的估算器，将计算复杂度从 $O(T^2)$ 降至 $O(T)$。
results: 理论上为每个目标 $i\in[m]$ 建立了 $\widetilde O\left(W_i^{\rm lex}\sqrt{m}\,(d_1+d_2)r\sqrt{T}\right)$ 的遗憾界，该界仅依赖于有效低秩维度 $(d_1+d_2)r$ 而非高维空间维度 $d_1d_2$；数值实验进一步证实了算法的计算效率与性能优势。
conclusion: Lexi-LowGLM算法能够高效解决具有多优先级目标的广义低秩矩阵老虎机问题，不仅计算复杂度低（$O(T)$），而且具备良好的理论遗憾界保障。

title: IntentLint: Supporting Intent Scaffolding and Prompt-time Linting in Human-AI Collaborative Data Analysis
authors: Felicia Li Feng, Jian Zhao, Anamaria Crisan
abstract: In human-AI collaborative data analysis, as analyses rapidly evolve, the artifacts meant to capture shared understanding often become incomplete or difficult to interpret, leading to undocumented assumptions, cross-user misaligned intent, context-poor prompts, and unwanted agent behaviors. To address these challenges, we introduce a rule-based coordination layer with two interaction mechanisms, intent scaffolding and prompt-time linting, that make analytic intent explicit and actionable during human-AI collaborative data analysis. We implement them in IntentLint, a proof-of-concept system that infers analytic intent from shared notebooks, represents it as structured, editable rules, and checks users' prompts against shared rules. IntentLint helps analysts externalize and refine their intent and proactively checks prompts for potential conflicts. A study with 16 data analysts shows that IntentLint improves awareness of collaborators' intent and encourages reflection on analytic strategies, and provides design implications for supporting more aligned and transparent human-AI collaborative data analysis.
zh_title: IntentLint：在人机协同数据分析中支持意图脚手架与提示词实时检查
translation: 在人机协同数据分析中，随着分析过程的快速演进，用于记录共享理解的产物往往变得不完整或难以解释，从而导致未记录的假设、跨用户意图不一致、缺乏上下文的提示词以及不期望的智能体行为。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了一个基于规则的协调层，包含两种交互机制：意图脚手架和提示词实时检查，使分析意图在人机协同数据分析过程中变得显性化和可操作。我们在概念验证系统 IntentLint 中实现了这些机制，该系统能够从共享 Notebook 中推断分析意图，将其表示为结构化、可编辑的规则，并根据共享规则检查用户的提示词。IntentLint 能够帮助分析师外化并完善其意图，并主动检查提示词中的潜在冲突。对 16 名数据分析师的研究表明，IntentLint 提高了对协作者意图的感知，促使人们反思分析策略，并为支持更对齐和透明的人机协同数据分析提供了设计启示。
tldr: IntentLint 通过构建结构化意图规则和实时检查提示词，解决了人机协同数据分析中的意图错位与上下文缺失问题。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将软件工程中的“Linting”（静态检查）概念引入到大模型提示词交互与人机协同数据分析中，提出了“意图脚手架”和“提示词实时检查”两种机制。这一设计巧妙地解决了多用户协作场景下AI上下文丢失和意图冲突的痛点，对于提升AI协同工具的透明度与一致性具有重要的实践价值。
motivation: 在人机协同数据分析中，分析演进迅速，共享理解的产物易变得不完整或难解释，导致未记录的假设、跨用户意图不一致、上下文缺失的提示词以及不期望的智能体行为。
method: 提出了一个基于规则的协调层，包含意图脚手架（从共享Notebook推断分析意图并转化为结构化可编辑规则）和提示词实时检查（对照共享规则实时检测用户提示词）两种交互机制，并在概念验证系统 IntentLint 中实现。
results: 针对16名数据分析师的研究表明，IntentLint 显著提高了对协作者意图的感知度，促使分析师反思分析策略，并减少了潜在的意图冲突。
conclusion: IntentLint能有效帮助分析师外化和完善意图，主动检查提示词潜在冲突，为构建更一致、更透明的人机协同数据分析系统提供了重要设计启发。

title: An Analysis and Implementation of Seam Carving for Content-Aware Image Resizing
authors: Francesco Tosoni
abstract: Seam carving is a classical content-aware image resizing operator that modifies the width or height of an image by repeatedly removing (or inserting) seams, i.e., 8-connected monotonic paths of pixels of locally minimal importance. Because seams bend around salient content rather than uniformly scaling or cropping it, the operator preserves vital image structures while discarding (or duplicating) low-energy regions. This article describes a C++ implementation of the operator that follows the original formulation of Avidan and Shamir (2007), including the optional forward-energy criterion subsequently introduced by Rubinstein, Shamir and Avidan (2008). The implementation supports image reduction, image enlargement via ordered seam insertion, multi-pass enlargement for large scale factors, a user-supplied weight mask for object protection and removal, along with dumping of energy maps and visualisation of seams. We detail the algorithm, its parameters and its computational complexity, discuss design choices with respect to the original descriptions, and illustrate the behaviour of the operator on natural images.
zh_title: 内容感知图像大小调整的接缝裁剪分析与实现
translation: 接缝裁剪是一种经典的、内容感知的图像大小调整操作符，它通过重复移除（或插入）接缝来修改图像的宽度或高度，接缝是指局部重要性最低的8连通单调像素路径。由于接缝会围绕显著内容弯曲，而不是均匀地缩放或裁剪它，因此该操作符在丢弃（或复制）低能量区域的同时保留了重要的图像结构。本文描述了一个遵循Avidan和Shamir（2007）原始公式的C++实现，包括Rubinstein、Shamir和Avidan（2008）随后引入的可选前向能量准则。该实现支持图像缩小、通过有序接缝插入进行图像放大、用于大比例因子的多通道放大、用户提供的用于对象保护和移除的权重蒙版，以及能量图的导出和接缝的可视化。我们详细阐述了算法、其参数和计算复杂性，讨论了与原始描述相关的设计选择，并说明了该操作符在自然图像上的行为。
tldr: 本文分析并实现了一种C++的接缝裁剪算法，用于内容感知图像大小调整，通过移除/插入重要性最低的像素路径来保留图像关键结构。
ai_comments: 这篇论文提供了一个内容感知图像大小调整算法——接缝裁剪的详细分析和C++实现。其创新性在于对经典算法的工程实践，包含了前向能量准则，并提供了多功能支持（如放大、权重蒙版），对于需要高效图像处理的开发者和研究者具有实用价值。
motivation: 解决传统图像缩放或裁剪方法无法有效保留图像关键结构的问题，提供一种内容感知的方式来调整图像大小。
method: 采用接缝裁剪（Seam Carving）算法，该算法通过重复移除或插入8连通的局部最小重要性像素路径（接缝）来调整图像尺寸。文章描述了一个遵循Avidan和Shamir (2007)原始公式的C++实现，并包含了Rubinstein等人(2008)引入的前向能量准则。
results: 该C++实现支持图像缩小、通过有序接缝插入进行图像放大、用于大比例因子的多通道放大、用户提供的权重蒙版以保护和移除对象，以及能量图的导出和接缝的可视化。文章还详细介绍了算法、其参数、计算复杂性，并讨论了与原始描述相关的设计选择，并演示了操作符在自然图像上的行为。
conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract

title: Right Reset: Chunking by Prefix Removal
authors: Mike Vegeto
abstract: Removing the left context from a causal language model reveals a useful kind of boundary: an edge where the model processes the same right-hand tokens with little change. We turn this observation into prefix-removal probing and introduce Right Reset (RR), which measures preservation of the right-hand hidden-state trajectory. A dynamic program converts RR edge scores into variable-length chunks. On flattened text formed by concatenating topically similar records after deleting their separators and layout, RR recovers 47.7% of the original records as clean units, versus 25.9% for a BGE embedding boundary, the strongest tested conventional baseline without task-specific model training. The gain persists after rendering and OCR. Passive scores from the same Qwen3-4B layer and direct prompting of a same-scale instruction model perform substantially worse on flattened records. Across six language models, RR-selected cuts also undergo consistently less local output disruption than unselected candidate edges. An observed-token likelihood-ratio readout is competitive in some architectures, indicating that the central contribution is the intervention: context dependence itself can provide a boundary signal when surface structure is weak.
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code, data, and reproduction materials: https://github.com/ZECTBynmo/right-reset-paper
zh_title: 右复位：通过前缀移除进行文本分块
translation: 从因果语言模型中移除左侧上下文可以揭示一种有用的边界：在这种边缘上，模型在处理相同的右侧标记时变化很小。我们将这一观察转化为前缀移除探查，并引入了“右复位”（Right Reset, RR），用于测量右侧隐状态轨迹的保留程度。动态规划将RR边缘得分转换为可变长度的文本块。在删除分隔符和布局后将主题相似的记录拼接而成的扁平化文本上，RR将47.7%的原始记录恢复为干净单元，而无需特定任务模型训练的最强测试传统基线（BGE嵌入边界）仅为25.9%。这种收益在渲染和OCR后依然保持。来自同一Qwen3-4B层的被动得分以及相同规模指令模型的直接提示在扁平化记录上的表现要差得多。在六个语言模型中，RR选择的切割点比未选择的候选边缘承受的局部输出干扰始终更少。观察到的标记对数似然比读出在某些架构中具有竞争力，这表明核心贡献在于干预：当表面结构较弱时，上下文依赖性本身就可以提供边界信号。
tldr: 本文提出“右复位（RR）”方法，通过移除因果语言模型的左侧前缀干预上下文，利用隐状态稳定性识别文本边界，实现强力的无监督变长分块。
ai_comments:
创新性：该研究巧妙地将因果语言模型的“前缀移除”干预手段转化为边界探测信号，打破了依赖显式文本结构或被动表征的传统思路。
重要性：在缺乏明显分隔符或经过OCR恢复的无结构文本中，该方法显著提升了变长分块（Chunking）的质量，对RAG（检索增强生成）和文档解析具有重要应用价值。
局限性：由于需要多次干预计算隐状态，其计算成本可能高于单次前向传播的被动提取方法。
motivation: 传统文本分块方法高度依赖显式分隔符或版面布局，当表面结构较弱或缺失时表现较差。研究者希望无需特定任务训练，仅利用语言模型自身的上下文依赖特性来精准识别文本边界。
method: 提出“前缀移除探查”和“右复位”（Right Reset, RR）指标，通过移除左侧上下文来测量右侧标记隐状态轨迹的保存程度；再结合动态规划算法将RR边缘得分转换为变长的文本块。
results: 在删除分隔符和布局形成的扁平化文本上，RR成功将47.7%的原始记录恢复为干净单元，远超最强传统基线BGE嵌入边界（25.9%），且优势在渲染和OCR后依然保持；在6个语言模型中，RR选择的切割点受到的局部输出干扰显著更少。
conclusion: 干预手段（即通过前缀移除观察上下文依赖性）是该方法的核心贡献。当文本的表面结构极弱时，语言模型内部对上下文依赖的变化本身就能提供强有力的边界信号。

title: ATLAS: Adaptive Topological Learning with Abstract Successors for Continual Learning
authors: R. Blake Lawlor, Daniel S. Brown
abstract: Contemporary model-free reinforcement learning algorithms can achieve very high performance, but have low sample efficiency and are not robust to changes in the environment. Model-based algorithms have much higher sample efficiency, but still fail when the environment shifts. This paper introduces Adaptive Topological Learning with Abstract Successors (ATLAS) to combat these challenges. ATLAS uses a Grow When Required network with Successor Features in order to achieve high sample efficiency while also robustly tackling catastrophic forgetting. We evaluate ATLAS in spatial navigation tasks, benchmarking its performance against common on-policy and off-policy algorithms. Our empirical results demonstrate that by structurally decoupling transition dynamics from the reward signal, ATLAS achieves near-instantaneous adaptation to new goals and can exhibit positive backward transfer, significantly outperforming baseline methods in non-stationary environments.
zh_title: ATLAS：用于持续学习的抽象后继自适应拓扑学习
translation: 现代无模型强化学习算法能够实现非常高的性能，但样本效率较低且对环境变化缺乏鲁棒性。有模型算法虽然具有更高的样本效率，但在环境发生偏移时依然会失效。本文提出了基于抽象后继的自适应拓扑学习（ATLAS）来应对这些挑战。ATLAS结合按需增长（Grow When Required）网络与后继特征（Successor Features），以获得极高的样本效率，同时鲁棒地解决灾难性遗忘问题。我们在空间导航任务中评估了ATLAS，并将其性能与常见的同策略及异策略算法进行了基准测试。我们的实证结果表明，通过在结构上将转移动态与奖励信号解耦，ATLAS实现了对新目标的几乎即时适应，并能展示出正向向后迁移，在非平稳环境中显著优于基线方法。
tldr: ATLAS结合按需增长网络与后继特征，通过解耦环境转移动态与奖励信号，有效克服灾难性遗忘并在非平稳环境中实现对新目标的即时适应。
ai_comments: 创新性与重要性：本文创新性地将拓扑自组织网络（GWR）与后继特征（Successor Features）相结合，通过在结构上解耦转移动态与奖励信号，兼具了高样本效率与鲁棒抗遗忘能力，且能实现难能可贵的正向向后迁移（positive backward transfer）。局限性：目前仅在空间导航任务中进行了评估，其在复杂高维状态空间（如视觉强化学习或高维连续控制）上的扩展性仍需进一步检验。
motivation: 无模型强化学习算法样本效率低且对环境变化缺乏鲁棒性，而有模型算法在环境分布偏移时也会失效，并且两者在持续学习中都易面临灾难性遗忘问题。
method: 提出了ATLAS（基于抽象后继的自适应拓扑学习），结合按需增长（Grow When Required, GWR）网络与后继特征（Successor Features），从结构上将转移动态（transition dynamics）与奖励信号（reward signal）解耦。
results: 在空间导航任务的评估中，ATLAS在非平稳环境下显著优于常见的同策略和异策略基线算法，实现了对新目标的几乎即时适应，并展现出正向向后迁移能力。
conclusion: 通过在结构上将转移动态与奖励信号解耦，ATLAS不仅实现了高样本效率，还成功克服了灾难性遗忘，能够在非平稳环境中实现即时适应与持续学习。

title: Cost-Aware Multi-Objective Bandits: Theory and Application to Budgeted LLM Configuration Evaluation
authors: Bo Xue, Zhi Hong, Jiayi Li, Yuanyu Wan, Ji Cheng, Shuang Qiu
abstract: Large language model (LLM) configuration evaluation is challenging due to limited evaluation budgets, varying costs, and multiple competing objectives. In this paper, we formulate LLM configuration evaluation as a cost-aware multi-objective bandit problem, where each configuration evaluation incurs a configuration-dependent cost and yields a noisy vector-valued outcome. Under this framework, we study two fundamental problems: online configuration selection and Pareto configuration identification. For online configuration selection, we propose a hypervolume-based UCB algorithm that optimizes an optimistic hypervolume-per-cost index. We establish a budgeted regret bound of order $O\bigl(\sum_{i\ne i^\star}\frac{\log B}{Δ_i}\bigr)$, where $B$ is the evaluation budget, $i^\star$ is the optimal configuration in terms of hypervolume efficiency, and $Δ_i$ is the corresponding efficiency gap of configuration $i$. This bound retains the logarithmic budget dependence of classical single-objective budgeted bandits. For fixed-budget Pareto identification, we develop a cost-aware empirical gap elimination algorithm and prove that its error probability is of order $O\bigl(\exp(-\frac{B}{H_{μ,c}})\bigr)$, where $H_{μ,c}$ is a cost-aware Pareto identification complexity depending on configuration costs and Pareto classification gaps. This error probability decays exponentially with the evaluation budget and recovers the standard Pareto set identification guarantee when all configuration costs are identical. Experiments on LLM configuration evaluation tasks demonstrate that the proposed framework enables efficient online decision-making and accurate cost-aware Pareto identification under limited budgets.
zh_title: 成本感知多目标老虎机：理论及其在预算受限LLM配置评估中的应用
translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）配置评估由于评估预算有限、成本多变以及多个相互竞争的目标而具有挑战性。在本文中，我们将LLM配置评估公式化为一个成本感知多目标老虎机问题，其中每次配置评估都会产生与配置相关的成本并产生一个带噪声的向量值结果。在该框架下，我们研究了两个基本问题：在线配置选择和帕累托配置识别。对于在线配置选择，我们提出了一种基于超体积的UCB算法，该算法优化了乐观的单位成本超体积指数。我们建立了一个$O\bigl(\sum_{i\ne i^\star}\frac{\log B}{Δ_i}\bigr)$的预算遗憾界，其中$B$是评估预算，$i^\star$是超体积效率最优配置，$Δ_i$是配置$i$的相应效率差距。此界限保留了经典单目标预算老虎机的对数预算依赖性。对于固定预算的帕累托识别，我们开发了一种成本感知经验差距消除算法，并证明其错误概率为$O\bigl(\exp(-\frac{B}{H_{μ,c}})\bigr)$，其中$H_{μ,c}$是取决于配置成本和帕累托分类差距的成本感知帕累托识别复杂度。该错误概率随评估预算呈指数衰减，并在所有配置成本相同时恢复标准帕累托集识别保证。LLM配置评估任务的实验表明，所提出的框架能够在有限预算下实现高效的在线决策和准确的成本感知帕累托识别。
tldr: 本文将大型语言模型（LLM）配置评估中的挑战（预算有限、成本多变、目标竞争）建模为成本感知多目标老虎机问题。提出了两种算法：一种基于超体积的UCB算法用于在线配置选择，具有对数预算依赖的遗憾界；另一种成本感知经验差距消除算法用于固定预算下的帕累托识别，具有指数衰减的错误概率。实验证明该框架在有限预算下能实现高效在线决策和准确的帕累托识别。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于首次将LLM配置评估中的复杂性（成本感知、多目标、预算限制）整合到多目标老虎机框架中。理论分析严谨，给出了具体的遗憾界和错误概率，并证明了其与现有理论的兼容性。这为在资源受限环境下优化LLM配置提供了一个强大的理论和实践工具，具有重要的应用价值。
motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）配置评估面临预算有限、成本多变和多个相互竞争的目标等挑战，使得评估过程复杂且效率低下。
method: 本文将LLM配置评估建模为成本感知多目标老虎机问题，其中每次配置评估都会产生与配置相关的成本并产生带噪声的向量值结果。在该框架下，研究了两个基本问题：在线配置选择和帕累托配置识别。对于在线配置选择，提出了一种基于超体积的UCB算法，该算法优化了乐观的单位成本超体积指数。对于固定预算的帕累托识别，开发了一种成本感知经验差距消除算法。
results: 对于在线配置选择，提出的UCB算法建立了$O\bigl(\sum_{i\ne i^\star}\frac{\log B}{Δ_i}\bigr)$的预算遗憾界，其中$B$是评估预算，$i^\star$是超体积效率最优配置，$Δ_i$是配置$i$的相应效率差距。此界限保留了经典单目标预算老虎机的对数预算依赖性。对于固定预算的帕累托识别，证明了成本感知经验差距消除算法的错误概率为$O\bigl(\exp(-\frac{B}{H_{μ,c}})\bigr)$，其中$H_{μ,c}$是取决于配置成本和帕累托分类差距的成本感知帕累托识别复杂度。该错误概率随评估预算呈指数衰减，并在所有配置成本相同时恢复标准帕累托集识别保证。实验证明该框架在有限预算下能实现高效的在线决策和准确的成本感知帕累托识别。
conclusion: 该框架在有限预算下，能够实现高效的在线决策和准确的成本感知帕累托识别，有效解决了LLM配置评估中的挑战。

title: COMPAS: Difficulty-Aware Joint Search for Optimizing Code Generation
authors: Jingzhi Gong, Jie M. Zhang, Gunel Jahangirova, Dong Huang, Mohammad Reza Mousavi, Mark Harman
abstract: Code generation systems make each LLM call with a model, a prompt, and decoding settings. However, existing optimization methods usually tune only part of these choices or use one fixed configuration for all tasks: global optimizers search one configuration for all tasks, routers choose only a model, and prompt optimizers keep the model and decoding settings fixed. This leaves their joint, group-specific interactions unclear. We therefore examine how these choices interact and observe that prompts and decoding settings interact, tuning effects vary by model, and the best configuration varies by task difficulty. Guided by these observations, we introduce COMPAS (Code-generation Optimization over Models, Prompts, And Decoding Settings), a difficulty-aware method that learns group-specific quality-cost fronts through low-cost model selection and joint prompt-decoding search, then routes each test task to its matching front online without further search. Under a matched search budget on LiveCodeBench, COMPAS improves pass@1 from 45.9% for the best baseline to 52.8% while reducing cost from $36.57 to $4.92. This also transfers to repository-level code generation on SWE-bench, resolving 76.0% of tasks versus 70.0% for the best baseline. Code and the reproducibility artifact are available at https://github.com/gjz78910/COMPAS.
zh_title: COMPAS：面向代码生成优化的难度感知联合搜索
translation: 代码生成系统对大语言模型（LLM）的每次调用都包含模型、提示词和解码设置。然而，现有的优化方法通常仅调整这些选择的一部分，或者对所有任务使用单一的固定配置：全局优化器为所有任务搜索单一配置，路由器仅选择模型，而提示词优化器保持模型和解码设置不变。这使得它们联合且特定于分组的交互作用尚不明确。因此，我们研究了这些选择是如何相互作用的，并发现提示词与解码设置会发生交互，调优效果因模型而异，且最佳配置随任务难度而变化。在这些观察的指导下，我们提出了COMPAS（面向模型、提示词和解码设置的代码生成优化方法），这是一种难度感知的方法，通过低成本的模型选择和联合提示词-解码搜索来学习特定分组的质量-成本前沿，随后在线将每个测试任务路由到其匹配的前沿而无需进一步搜索。在LiveCodeBench相同的搜索预算下，COMPAS将pass@1从最佳基线的45.9%提升至52.8%，同时将成本从36.57美元降低至4.92美元。这种方法还能迁移到SWE-bench上的仓库级代码生成，解决了76.0%的任务，而最佳基线为70.0%。代码和可复现性构建产物已在 https://github.com/gjz78910/COMPAS 开源。
tldr: COMPAS通过联合搜索模型、提示词和解码设置，并结合难度感知路由，在降低约87%成本的同时显著提升了代码生成的准确率。
ai_comments: 创新性：COMPAS打破了以往单一维度（仅模型路由或仅提示词优化）优化的局限，首次提出将模型选择、提示词和解码设置进行联合优化，并引入任务难度感知。重要性：该工作同时大幅提升了代码生成质量（pass@1提升约7%）并降低了使用成本（降低近8倍），对大模型落地应用具有巨大的实践价值。局限性：难度评估和分组路由策略可能会增加离线搜索开销，且路由效果依赖于任务难度预测的准确性。
motivation: 现有的LLM代码生成优化方法通常仅调整模型、提示词或解码设置中的一部分，或者对所有任务使用单一固定的配置，忽略了三者之间的联合交互作用以及任务难度对最佳配置的影响。
method: 提出了COMPAS方法，通过低成本的模型选择和联合提示词-解码搜索来学习特定分组的质量-成本前沿（quality-cost fronts），并在在线测试时根据任务难度将每个任务路由到相匹配的前沿配置，无需在线额外搜索。
results: 在LiveCodeBench上，COMPAS将pass@1从最佳基线的45.9%提升至52.8%，成本从$36.57降低至$4.92；在SWE-bench仓库级代码生成任务上，解决率从最佳基线的70.0%提升至76.0%。
conclusion: 联合搜索模型、提示词和解码设置并结合任务难度感知路由，能够大幅提升代码生成的质量并极大地降低推理成本，且该方法具备良好的泛化与迁移能力。

title: From Compensation Design to Budget-Feasible Mechanisms: A Constant Approximation for Subadditive Valuations
authors: Ioannis Anagnostides, Kshipra Bhawalkar, Christopher Liaw, Aranyak Mehta, Grigoris Velegkas, Weiqiang Zheng
abstract:
Budget-feasible mechanism design is a classic framework introduced by Singer, but there is still a wide gap between existing upper and lower bounds. In this paper, we significantly advance the state of the art. First, without computational constraints, we show that there exists a budget-feasible universally truthful mechanism with the following approximation ratios:
  - $3$ for monotone submodular valuations and $e+1$ for nonmonotone submodular valuations, improving over $3.798$ and $9.742$, respectively.
  - $e+1$ for XOS valuations, improving over $28$. In large markets, our approximation can be improved deterministically to $e$.
  - $2e+1$ for subadditive valuations, improving over $33$. In large markets, our approximation can be improved deterministically to $2e$.
  Moreover, for subadditive valuations, we obtain a constant-approximation mechanism that runs in polynomial time using demand queries. This improves over the previous best approximation of $O(\log \log n)$, resolving a long-standing open problem going back to Dobzinski, Papadimitriou, and Singer, who conjectured that a constant approximation requires exponentially many demand queries. We obtain these results through a simple and unifying framework based on non-truthful indirect mechanisms, recently coined compensation design. In particular, through a potential argument, we establish constant price-of-stability bounds for compensation design based on marginal-contribution payment rules, which we then translate into truthful direct mechanisms. For subadditive valuations, the core of the argument is a new smoothing lemma showing that every subadditive function can be approximated within a factor of $2$ by a self-bounding function. This is also of independent interest, readily addressing an open question in multiwinner elections by showing the existence of a $2e$-approximate core even under subadditive valuations.
zh_title: 从补偿设计到预算可行机制：关于次加性估值的常数近似
translation:
预算可行机制设计是一个由Singer引入的经典框架，但现有上下界之间仍然存在很大差距。在本文中，我们显著地推进了该领域的最新进展。首先，在没有计算约束的情况下，我们证明了存在一个预算可行的、普遍真实的机制，其近似比为：
- 对于单调次模估值，为3，优于3.798。
- 对于非单调次模估值，为e+1，优于9.742。
- 对于XOS估值，为e+1，优于28。在大市场中，我们的近似比可以确定性地提高到e。
- 对于次加性估值，为2e+1，优于33。在大市场中，我们的近似比可以确定性地提高到2e。
此外，对于次加性估值，我们获得了一个常数近似机制，该机制使用需求查询可在多项式时间内运行。这优于先前最佳的O(log log n)近似比，解决了自Dobzinski、Papadimitriou和Singer以来长期存在的开放性问题，他们推测常数近似需要指数级数量的需求查询。我们通过一个简单而统一的框架获得这些结果，该框架基于非真实间接机制，最近被称为补偿设计。特别是，通过势能论证，我们为基于边际贡献支付规则的补偿设计建立了常数价格稳定性界限，然后将其转化为真实的直接机制。对于次加性估值，论证的核心是一个新的平滑引理，表明每个次加性函数都可以通过一个自界函数在2的因子内得到近似。这也有独立的意义，通过在次加性估值下证明存在2e近似核心，可以轻松解决多赢选举中的一个开放性问题。
tldr: 该研究提出了在预算可行机制设计中的新近似算法，尤其是在次加性估值方面取得了重大进展，将近似因子从对数级别降低到常数级别。
ai_comments: 该研究在预算可行机制设计领域取得了重要进展，提出的补偿设计框架具有创新性和统一性。在次加性估值方面取得的突破尤为显著，将近似比从对数级别降低到常数级别，并解决了长期存在的开放性问题，这对于理论和实践都具有重要意义。然而，研究中提到的“大市场”条件以及具体算法的实现细节可能需要进一步的阐述和分析。
motivation: 现有预算可行机制设计的上下界之间存在较大差距，需要改进近似比。
method: 提出了一种基于非真实间接机制（补偿设计）的简单统一框架，并结合了边际贡献支付规则和势能论证，将其转化为直接机制。对于次加性估值，引入了一个新的平滑引理。
results: 在无计算约束的情况下，为单调次模估值提供了3的近似比，为非单调次模估值提供了e+1的近似比，为XOS估值提供了e+1的近似比，为次加性估值提供了2e+1的近似比。在有计算约束的情况下，对于次加性估值，提出了一种能在多项式时间内运行的常数近似机制，将近似比从O(log log n)提高到常数级别。
conclusion: 该研究通过补偿设计框架显著改进了预算可行机制设计的近似比，特别是在次加性估值方面取得了突破性进展，解决了长期存在的开放性问题，并为多赢选举问题提供了新的解决方案。

title: Continuous Improvement and Parallel Autonomous Exploration: An LLM-Agent Framework for Searching Large Solution Spaces
authors: Dulmini Hettiarachchi, Andre Rusli, Julio Christian Young, Sho Akiyama
abstract: We present a framework that gives LLM agents two mechanisms for searching large solution spaces autonomously. First, a leaderboard scored on held-out data acts as a reward signal that drives each agent to refine its solutions over repeated submissions, a loop that operates even with a single agent. Second, the framework enables running many agents in parallel, fully autonomously, with no human in the loop: agents independently analyze, survey methods, implement, self-evaluate, submit, and revise, while a moderator agent handles only logistics. Running agents in parallel under the shared reward broadens the explored region of the solution space rather than refining the single seeded paradigm. We instantiate the framework on product-to-catalog matching (a core e-commerce retrieval task with a large, category-structured solution space), posed as selective prediction with a precision-coverage operating point. A single agent refines within its seeded paradigm, whereas parallel autonomous agents surface qualitatively different solutions. On this testbed, best qualified coverage (>=95% P@1 per category) reaches 47.8-57.4% with a single agent and 62.8-69.4% with five, against a 33.3% baseline. Our contribution is the framework itself: a continuous-improvement reward loop and a substrate for fully autonomous parallel exploration, backed by case-study evidence.

title: Equitable System-Prompt Selection via Constrained Mixed-Strategy GroupDRO
authors: Mengyu Xu, Qiaoxin Yang, Zhihan Liu, Ruiyao Xu, Zachary Liu, Kezhen Chen, Chongyang Gao
abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for information seeking, yet semantically equivalent questions phrased in different ways can receive answers of considerably different quality. System prompts are widely employed to steer response behavior, but they are typically optimized for average-case quality, so some question phrasings may still receive incomplete or low-quality answers. To address this, we formulate a constrained mixed-strategy GroupDRO framework for system-prompt selection. Instead of optimizing the system-prompt text, the framework assigns weights to system prompts in an existing pool to minimize the worst-case information-quality loss across evaluation metrics and groups, while constraining the mean loss to stay close to that of average-based selection. Because pool generation and selection are decoupled, the method applies to any system-prompt pool and can leverage an ensemble of complementary system prompts rather than a single one. Across five LLMs on two bilingual medical and consumer-finance benchmarks, the constrained method reduces the Overall Mean, Worst 25% Mean, and Worst by 13.1%, 13.2%, and 13.7% on average relative to no mitigation while keeping overall quality close to Average selection. Its multi-prompt weights reveal complementarity across metric-group pairs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Rainxu09/equitable-system-prompt-selection.
zh_title: 公平的系统提示选择通过约束混合策略GroupDRO
translation: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用于信息检索，但措辞不同但语义相同的问题可能会得到质量差异很大的答案。系统提示被广泛用于引导响应行为，但它们通常针对平均情况下的质量进行优化，因此某些问题措辞的回答仍然可能不完整或质量低下。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种用于系统提示选择的约束混合策略GroupDRO框架。该框架不优化系统提示文本，而是为现有池中的系统提示分配权重，以最小化评估指标和分组上的最坏情况信息质量损失，同时约束平均损失接近基于平均值选择的情况。由于池的生成和选择是分离的，该方法可以应用于任何系统提示池，并利用互补的系统提示集合，而不是单个提示。在五个大型语言模型和两个双语医疗和消费金融基准测试中，与不进行任何干预相比，该约束方法平均将整体平均值、最差25%平均值和最差情况下的损失分别降低了13.1%、13.2%和13.7%，同时保持整体质量接近平均选择。其多提示权重揭示了不同指标-分组对之间的互补性。代码和数据可在https://github.com/Rainxu09/equitable-system-prompt-selection获取。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为GroupDRO的约束混合策略框架，用于选择系统提示，以解决大型语言模型在回答语义相同但措辞不同问题时质量不均的问题。该框架通过优化系统提示池中的权重，最小化最坏情况下的信息质量损失，同时保持平均损失接近基于平均值的方法。实验证明，该方法在多个大型语言模型和数据集上显著降低了最差情况下的回答质量损失，并揭示了不同提示之间的互补性。
ai_comments: 该研究提出的GroupDRO框架在解决大型语言模型回答质量不均问题上具有重要意义，其通过优化系统提示选择来提高公平性，并取得了显著的改进。框架的灵活性使其能够应用于不同的模型和场景，并且代码和数据的公开有助于进一步的研究和应用。然而，对于“最坏情况”的定义以及如何平衡最坏情况和平均情况下的性能，可能还需要更深入的探讨。
motivation: 大型语言模型在信息检索中的应用日益广泛，但对于语义相同但措辞不同的问题，其回答质量可能存在显著差异。现有系统提示的优化通常侧重于平均情况下的质量，导致某些问题措辞的回答仍然不完整或质量低下。
method: 提出了一种约束混合策略的GroupDRO框架，用于系统提示的选择。该框架不直接优化系统提示文本，而是为现有系统提示池中的提示分配权重，以最小化评估指标和分组上的最坏情况信息质量损失，同时约束平均损失接近基于平均值选择的情况。该方法将提示池的生成与选择分离开，可以应用于任何系统提示池，并利用互补的系统提示集合。
results: 在五个大型语言模型和两个双语（医疗和消费金融）基准测试中，与不进行任何干预相比，该约束方法平均将整体平均值、最差25%平均值和最差情况下的损失分别降低了13.1%、13.2%和13.7%，同时保持整体质量接近基于平均值的方法。其多提示权重揭示了不同指标-分组对之间的互补性。
conclusion: 提出的约束混合策略GroupDRO框架能够有效解决大型语言模型在回答语义相同但措辞不同问题时质量不均的问题，通过优化系统提示的选择，显著降低了最差情况下的信息质量损失，并实现了不同提示之间的互补利用。

title: From Cake-Cutting and Necklace-Splitting to Fair Division of Indivisible Items
authors: Max Dupré la Tour, Ayumi Igarashi
abstract:
We give an existential transfer framework for converting continuous fair division theorems into guarantees for indivisible items arranged on a path. This allows continuous envy-freeness and consensus results to translate directly into EF$k$-type guarantees for indivisible allocations.
  Combining this method with connected cake-cutting theorems, we obtain connected allocations satisfying envy-freeness up to one good and one chore for identical valuations and for arbitrary valuations when the number of agents is a prime power.
  Combining this method with the equicardinal necklace-splitting theorem of Jojić et al., we show that, for any prime-power number $r$ of bundles and $n$ arbitrary valuation functions, there exists an allocation in which every bundle is the union of at most $n$ intervals, and the bundles satisfy consensus up to $n$ goods and $n$ chores. This result is the first EF$k$-type guarantee for consensus fair division with non-additive valuations beyond the halving case.
  Envy-freeness constraints can be imposed simultaneously at the cost of one additional interval and one additional item in each guarantee. As a consequence, when the number of agents is a prime power, every instance with monotone valuations admits an EF$2$ allocation whose bundle sizes differ by at most two.

title: Design and Flight of an Ion-propelled Micro Hovercraft Leveraging Ground Proximity Effects
authors: C. Luke Nelson, Grant Nations, Mrinmoy Modak, Daniel S. Drew
abstract: Electroaerodynamic propulsion is compelling for use in micro air vehicles due to its silent and solid-state nature, but its limited efficiency has thus far precluded a path towards power-autonomous flight. Recent work has shown that thrust density and efficiency for small-scale atmospheric ion thrusters can be vastly increased when operating close to a ground plane. Here, we explore the design space of centimeter-scale hovercraft, which can leverage this ground effect for low-altitude flight. We first perform an empirical investigation, characterizing the performance benefits and trade-offs for different geometries and configurations of passive hovercraft skirts, then use the results to fabricate a viable point design. We demonstrate a palm-sized hovercraft that, while tethered to an external power source, can fly for extended periods, withstand dozens of takeoff and landing cycles, passively stabilize to reject significant mechanical disturbances, and generate practically zero audible noise signature. The measured thrust efficiency of 16 mN/W and additional payload capacity of almost 1.5 grams above the vehicle's self mass of about 1.6 grams exceeds any similarly sized electroaerodynamically propelled robot by an order of magnitude. This is the first time an ion-propelled micro hovercraft has been shown in the open literature, and our work points the way towards an entirely new class of robot.

title: iStructTab: Structured Feature Sequencing for Multimodal Learning of Image and Tabular Data
authors: Al Zadid Sultan Bin Habib, Md Younus Ahamed, Prashnna Gyawali, Gianfranco Doretto, Donald A. Adjeroh
abstract: Multimodal learning of images and tabular data is often impaired by ineffective representations, resulting in redundancy, dispersion, and generalization problems. To tackle this challenge, we introduce Graph-Enhanced Descriptor Sequencing (GEDS), a structured feature sequencing algorithm grounded in principles from the Column Permutation Problem (CPP). GEDS refines statistical descriptors of the features through similarity graph-based computations, systematically determining an effective feature sequencing. We incorporate GEDS within an order-aware efficient transformer framework, utilizing order-aware memory tokens that explicitly adhere to the derived feature sequencing via a dedicated loss function. Experimental results across multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that iStructTab effectively minimizes feature dispersion, improving predictive performance and robustness, and highlighting the significance of structured feature sequencing in multimodal learning.

title: Looking in the Mirror: Introspecting Side-Effect Misalignments Induced by Fine-Tuning
authors: Kotaro Yoshida, Laura Gomezjurado Gonzalez, Yukinori Yamamoto, Yuji Naraki, Ryotaro Shimizu, Wenya Wang
abstract: Fine-tuning enables a source model to acquire desired capabilities and behaviors in a target domain while retaining much of its general-purpose competence. However, this adaptation process can also degrade alignment properties that were present in the source model. Recent work has shown that large language models can be trained using LoRA-based modules known as introspection adapters (IAs) to describe behavioral changes induced by fine-tuning. However, existing studies primarily consider settings in which the model is fine-tuned on datasets explicitly designed to implant a specific behavior and is then asked to explain the implanted behavior. This differs from practical deployment scenarios, where the central concern is often side-effect misalignment: unintended degradation of alignment caused by fine-tuning on tasks that are not obviously related to safety or alignment. To bridge this gap, we formulate a novel problem setting called \emph{side-effect introspection}, in which the target of introspection is not a behavior explicitly implanted through fine-tuning, but rather alignment shifts that emerge as unintended side effects, and we construct a dataset for this setting. Furthermore, to enhance sensitivity to internal model changes, we propose the Delta-Aware Introspection Adapter (DAIA), a novel mechanism designed to explicitly process both base-model activations and activation differences induced by fine-tuning. Our empirical evaluation shows that introspection learning generalizes to unseen fine-tuned models and safety categories, and that DAIA consistently outperforms existing introspection adapters.

title: HyPASE: Hyperbolic Geometry for Parameter-Efficient Speech Emotion Fine-Tuning Framework for Large Audio-Language Models
authors: Tian Jin, Ruikang Zhang, Zefeng Zhao, Ding Luo, Jin Zeng
abstract: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) excel at general speech understanding; however, adapting them to fine-grained tasks like Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) remains a significant bottleneck. Current Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods typically operate in flat Euclidean space, and this geometry fails to capture the multi-granularity nature of emotion cues, which range from low-level prosody to high-level semantics. To address this, we propose HyPASE, a hyperbolic PEFT framework for LALM-based SER. HyPASE leverages the Poincare ball model, using the hyperbolic radius as an explicit proxy for representational granularity. The framework consists of two core components: a Hyperbolic Geometric Adapter (HGA) for layer-adaptive weight modulation, and an Emotion-aware Multi-capacity Cross-modal Aggregator (EMCA) that compresses multi-scale features into compact audio prefixes. Empirical results on standard benchmarks show that HyPASE outperforms Euclidean PEFT baselines across all metrics on MELD and achieves a notable Unweighted Accuracy gain on IEMOCAP, particularly in class-imbalanced emotion recognition, with the accompanying slight Weighted Accuracy trade-off reflecting hyperbolic space's geometric prioritization of minority-class representations; furthermore, HyPASE achieves robust zero-shot cross-dataset generalization within a constrained parameter budget. By grounding the adaptation process in hyperbolic geometry, HyPASE offers a highly efficient path for LALM fine-tuning.

title: Poly-OPD: Heterogeneous Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability-Selectable Flow Models
authors: Siming Fu, Haojun Xu, Ruizhe He, Zheming Fu, Hualiang Wang, Jie Huang, Xiaoxiao Ma, Mingchen Zhong, Weihu Huang, Xiaoxuan He, Linjiang Huang, Si Liu
abstract: Leading open text-to-image models often carry complementary strengths: one may lead on preference-aligned aesthetics while another follows compositional instructions more faithfully. However, differences in their autoencoders and noise schedules make it difficult to transfer these strengths across models. In this paper, we present Poly-OPD, a framework that can consolidate complementary strengths of heterogeneous teachers into a single compact flow-matching student. To bridge the incompatible latent spaces of different teachers, Poly-OPD performs on-policy distillation through a pixel bridge. Each student-generated image is re-encoded by a selected teacher's encoder and refined from a noise level matched by magnitude under the teacher's noise schedule. The resulting target is further matched to the student in frozen DINOv2 space, enabling supervision across incompatible latent spaces. To retain complementary capabilities without cross-teacher interference, Poly-OPD uses a gradient compatibility diagnostic to organize its adapters: attention LoRA modules are shared across teachers, whereas feed-forward adapters remain teacher-specific. During distillation, a gap-aware curriculum devotes more training to compositional categories where the student still falls short of the teacher. As each gap narrows, training shifts toward categories with larger remaining gaps. By distilling FLUX.1-dev and Z-Image into a 2.5B SD3.5-Medium student, Poly-OPD improves GenEval from 67.3 to 73.3, surpassing both larger teachers, and raises DrawBench HPSv3 from 9.34 to 11.35, consolidating both strengths within a switchable model.

title: Large-Scale Analysis of Discussions by CS Educators Across the Stack Exchange Network
authors: Farhad Hossain, Natasha Grech, Omar Alam
abstract: Stack Exchange is a widely used question-and-answer network that facilitates knowledge exchange across diverse domains. Within this network, the Computer Science (CS) Educators Stack Exchange provides a dedicated platform where CS educators exchange ideas, seek advice, and discuss teaching practices. In this study, we analyzed 79,854,463 Stack Exchange posts, comprising 32,187,805 questions and 47,666,658 answers, with a particular focus on English-language posts contributed by CS Educators participants. Using topic modeling, we identified, manually labeled, and hierarchically organized the underlying discussion topics, then examined their distribution and complexity. Our findings reveal evolving discussion patterns spanning both technical (IT) and non-technical (Non-IT) domains. Within the IT category, programming and software development were the most prominent topics, whereas mathematics, education, and the humanities received substantial attention within the Non-IT category. These results highlight the broad range of interests and expertise shared by CS educators and provide insights into their evolving priorities. We hope this work contributes to a better understanding of CS educators' knowledge-sharing practices and informs future efforts to better support their professional and educational needs.

title: The Calibration Floor: Format Repair Can Masquerade as Self-Correction at Small-to-Mid Scale
authors: Mingguang Chen, Bo Qu, Licheng Wang
abstract: Accuracy changes after language-model self-revision are usually interpreted as changes in reasoning. We show this can fail at the answer-extraction boundary, and test the failure causally rather than only observationally. Across Qwen3.5 (0.8B-9B), Gemma-4-12B, and two frontier models via API (Tencent Hy3, Nvidia Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B) in 29 primary cells plus a frontier arm, we decompose the always-revise accuracy shift into a content margin (both answers parseable) and format-recovery/loss margins (parseability changes). On 12 cells with meaningful unparseable-answer rates, format effects exceed content effects (Wilcoxon p=1.7e-3). To test this causally, we force already-generated reasoning through grammar-constrained decoding so every answer is parseable by construction: across 14 cells this closes a median 71% of the gap between the naive total effect and the content-margin estimate, with two cells converging exactly and a residual on the two largest-effect cells reported rather than dismissed. A clustered model confirms floor-scale (0.8B/2B) models have far higher odds of content-level change and harm than capable-scale models (p<1e-7). Replicating a cited confidence-gating protocol verbatim on Qwen3.5 does not reproduce its reported gain and shows the same near-zero content margin. A frontier check on much larger models shows format-dominance intensifying with scale: content margin is exactly zero in all 5 cells despite total effects up to +0.275, though this arm is lower-powered. The calibration-floor criterion on the content margin reveals a squeeze: floor-scale cells have headroom but insufficient signal, capable-scale cells have signal but little headroom; only one cell is marginally viable, with negligible sealed-holdout gain. Content is a minority share of what the field has measured as self-correction. We release the instrument, code, and derived results.

title: NeuMoSync: End-to-End Neuromodulatory Control for Plasticity and Adaptability in Continual Learning
authors: Seyed Roozbeh Razavi Rohani, Khashayar Khajavi, Wesley Chung, Mandana Samiei, Mo Chen
abstract: Continual learning (CL) requires models to learn tasks sequentially, yet deep neural networks often suffer from plasticity loss and poor knowledge transfer, which can impede their long-term adaptability. Drawing high-level inspiration from global neuromodulatory mechanisms in the brain, we introduce Neuromodulation and Synchronization (NeuMoSync), a novel architecture that integrates dynamic, neuron-specific modulation into deep neural networks to enhance their adaptability and plasticity. NeuMoSync extends standard neural network architectures with learnable feature vectors for each neuron that track network-wide historical context and with a module operating at a higher level of abstraction. This module synthesizes neuron-specific signals, conditioned on both current inputs and the network's evolving state, to adaptively regulate activation dynamics and synaptic plasticity. Evaluated on diverse CL benchmarks, including memorization (Random Label CIFAR-10 and Random Label MNIST), concept drift (Shuffle CIFAR-10 and Shuffle Mini-ImageNet), class-incremental learning (Class Split ImageNet and Class Split CIFAR-100), and domain-incremental learning (Permuted MNIST), NeuMoSync demonstrates strong performance in retaining plasticity and achieves improvements in both forward and backward adaptation compared with existing methods. Ablation studies validate the necessity of each component, while analysis of the learned modulatory signals reveals interpretable coordination patterns across tasks. Our work underscores the potential of integrating global coordination mechanisms into deep learning systems to advance robust, adaptive continual learning. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/RoozbehRazavi/NeuMoSync.

title: Combating Knowledge Corruption in Agent Systems: A Byzantine-Tolerant Secure Collaborative RAG Framework
authors: Zhaoqi Wang, Daqing He, Zijian Zhang, Ye Liu, Jiamou Liu, Zhirui Zeng, Zhan Qin, Zhen Li, Xin Li, Hongwei Yao, Jincheng An, Yong Liu, Yi Li, Qi Sun, Xiulei Liu, Liehuang Zhu
abstract: While retrieval-augmented generation systems partially address the hallucination issues in large language models, it also introduces new vulnerabilities to knowledge corruption attacks. Adversaries exploit these vulnerabilities by poisoning documents provided by RAG system to manipulate LLM outputs. To counter this threat, we propose SecureCollaRAG, a Byzantine-tolerant collaborative RAG framework leveraging Multi-source Knowledge Validation Mechanism. Our approach enables agent system to securely verify document provenance through dynamic GNN-based credibility scoring, effectively preventing stealthy knowledge corruption attacks while preserving essential domain knowledge integrity. Through extensive evaluations and formal analysis, we demonstrate that SecureCollaRAG maintains robustness against attackers under non-IID data distributions.

title: The Refined Joint Bidiagonalization Method and an Implicitly Restarted Algorithm for Large GSVD Computations
authors: Kaixiao Fang, Zhongxiao Jia
abstract: We make a convergence analysis on the joint bidiagonalization (JBD) method that computes several extreme generalized singular value decomposition (GSVD) components of a regular matrix pair $\{A,L\}$, and show that the right and left Ritz vectors obtained by it may converge erratically and even may fail to converge, while Ritz values converge. These convergence results hold for a class of general Rayleigh--Ritz projection methods for the GSVD problem under the hypothesis that the deviation of a desired right generalized singular vector from the right subspace tends to zero. We prove the interlacing property of Ritz values and generalized singular values, and extend it to the generalized singular values of $\{A,L\}$ and the matrix pairs consisting of subsets of its columns. To overcome the irregular convergence or possible non-convergence of the JBD method, we nontrivially extend the refined Rayleigh--Ritz projection for the eigenvalue problem to the GSVD problem, and propose a refined JBD (RJBD) method that replaces the right Ritz vectors by new approximations, called the right refined Ritz vectors, satisfying certain residual optimality; we define new approximate left generalized singular vectors, called the left refined Ritz vectors. We prove that the left and right refined Ritz vectors unconditionally converge under the same hypothesis. We extend the implicit restarting scheme to the RJBD method, and develop an implicitly restarted RJBD algorithm with the refined shifts proposed. Numerical experiments illustrate that the new algorithm is at least competitive and often considerably more efficient than the implicitly restarted JBD algorithm.

title: Manipulation-Proof Oblivious Audits against Deceptive Model Providers
authors: Augustin Godinot, Sofiane Azogagh, Julien Ferry, Sébastien Gambs
abstract:
Audits have emerged as a critical instrument for algorithmic governance, providing a mechanism for external scrutiny and governance of machine learning models. However, ensuring the integrity of such assessments remains a challenging issue. For instance in regulatory contexts, audits are typically declared or easily detected, thus enabling model providers to manipulate the process, whether intentionally or inadvertently. This vulnerability is particularly acute in the context of fairness evaluations, in which providers can often infer sensitive attributes and strategically equalize allocation rates between groups to satisfy fairness metrics.
  In this paper, we introduce a novel audit protocol designed to significantly increase the post-audit detectability of such manipulations by enabling the auditor to query the model in an oblivious manner. Our approach leverages a Private Information Retrieval mechanism to require the provider to label a large set of instances, while preventing it from knowing which subset will ultimately be used for the audit. The protocol is efficient, imposes minimal overhead on the auditor, and requires no modification to the audited model, its training procedure, or its inference pipeline. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that, under this protocol, a provider attempting to hide unfairness must falsify a significantly larger number of responses, thereby increasing both the difficulty and the likelihood of detection of manipulation. Experimental results across representative audit scenarios confirm the effectiveness and practicality of our approach.

title: Contingency Detection Integrated Model Predictive Control for Resilient Load Frequency Control
authors: Erfan Mehdipour Abadi, Hamid Varmazyari, Sharaf K. Magableh, Caisheng Wang, Le Yi Wang, Feng Lin
abstract: Contingencies can alter power-system dynamics and introduce prediction mismatch in model predictive control (MPC)-based load frequency control (LFC). Although such events may be detected or cleared by protection systems, the corresponding post-contingency dynamic model may not be available to the MPC controller on the LFC time scale. This paper proposes a contingency detection-integrated MPC (CDI-MPC) framework that combines disturbance-aware contingency detection with predictive frequency regulation. Contingencies are modeled as stochastic discrete events of a stochastic hybrid system (SHS), and a disturbance-aware residual formulation is developed to jointly identify the active mode and estimate unknown disturbances. The detected mode is then used to update the MPC prediction model, reducing contingency-induced prediction mismatch under changing operating conditions. Simulation results demonstrate accurate contingency detection and substantial improvements in closed-loop LFC performance under multiple contingency scenarios and unknown disturbances.

title: EvtGraph: Event-Adaptive Compression for Sparse Temporal Graph Learning in Multimodal Time Series
authors: Ziqian Wang, Tingxiong Xiao, Yuxiao Cheng, Jinli Suo
abstract:
Multimodal temporal data are inherently irregular and uneven in information density, yet most models rely on uniform discretization, leading to inefficient representations.
  We propose \textbf{EvtGraph}, a unified framework that aligns computation with temporal salience under explicit budget constraints. EvtGraph reparameterizes sequences into event-level tokens via event-adaptive compression (EAMC), selects a compact subset with a node budget (NBC), and performs temporally constrained sparse graph reasoning (T2SG). This transforms dense sequences into structured computation over salient events, reducing complexity while preserving critical transitions.
  We show that this design provides a practical mechanism for allocating representational capacity under a fixed budget, yielding a consistent performance--efficiency trade-off, where a small budget is often sufficient in practice. Experiments on multimodal clinical (MIMIC-IV + CXR) and cross-domain benchmarks demonstrate that EvtGraph outperforms both Transformer-based and recurrent baselines while significantly improving efficiency.
  These results suggest that budget-constrained event-centric representation provides a general paradigm for learning from high-redundancy temporal data.

title: Large Language Models and Social Media Information Integrity: Opportunities, Challenges, and Research Directions
authors: Junjie Xiong, Zhengyuan Jiang, Xiaoran Xu, Chi Zhang, Changjia Zhu, Ning Wang, Mingkui Wei, Zhuo Lu, Yao Liu, Lingyao Li
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools that impact information integrity on social media platforms. This comprehensive review examines the dual role of LLMs in both facilitating and mitigating various information integrity challenges, including misinformation, disinformation, fake news, social bots, and privacy concerns. \textcolor{black}{We conduct a comprehensive review of the literature from 2019 to 2024, screening 1048 studies and performing an in-depth analysis of 215 representative papers. This systematic approach allows us to identify key patterns in how LLMs influence the information security in social media ecosystems.} Through a systematic analysis of papers from multiple databases, our findings reveal that while LLMs can enhance detection capabilities for malicious content and enable sophisticated defense mechanisms, they simultaneously pose risks by enabling the generation of highly convincing, deceptive content. We categorize and analyze the potential and challenges across different dimensions of information integrity, examining technical capabilities, ethical implications, and privacy concerns. The study demonstrates critical gaps in current approaches, particularly in cross-lingual detection, real-time monitoring, and privacy-preserving implementations. We conclude by proposing future research directions and recommendations for stakeholders to leverage LLMs while mitigating risks in social media information integrity.

title: FinReportBench: Measuring and Improving Institution-Grade Financial Report Generation
authors: Yinghao Tang, Tan Zhenwei, Yiyao Wang, Wanli Gu, Xiaolu Zhang, Jun Zhou, Wei Chen
abstract: Large language models can produce fluent financial analysis, but fluency alone does not establish whether a report is suitable for institutional delivery. We introduce FinReportBench, an expert-grounded benchmark for measuring and improving institution-grade financial report generation. Expert review reveals recurring gaps in report identity, institutional components, source discipline, and visual delivery. We derive a 35-item rubric through expert partial orders, multimodal evidence, and audits of decision boundaries, covering deliverability, report identity, and institutional completeness. Starting from 10,000 balanced Chinese and English financial-research source records, we curate 244 bilingual tasks across three research objects and two input tiers. Each task separates the public query, reconstructed research trajectory, and hidden source packet. Three independent judge families reproduce the expert partial order at near-ceiling rates, showing that bounded, observable criteria support reliable evaluation. Across nine model families, basic deliverability is nearly saturated, while report identity and institutional completeness remain the primary bottlenecks. The largest cross-model gaps concern generation-trace control, information density, and data discipline rather than basic report framing. We then use benchmark-guided skill distillation to turn recurrent failures into reusable generation and self-review constraints. Across five model families, the evolved skill improves mean G1 by 33.85 points and mean G2 by 13.83 points over paired no-skill runs while preserving G0 for every pair. Code and benchmark artifacts are available at https://github.com/MisterBrookT/finreportbench.

title: Towards Trustworthy Hypergraph Neural Networks under Label Noise
authors: Mengyao Zhou, Zhiheng Zhou, Xiao Han, Guiying Yan
abstract: Hypergraph neural networks (HGNNs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in processing complex higher-order relationships. However, their performance is highly dependent on labeled data, making them vulnerable to label noise. Despite advances in learning with label noise (LLN) and graph learning with label noise (GLN), noisy-label learning on hypergraphs remains underexplored. In this paper, we present a systematic study of hypergraph node classification under label noise. First, we adapt representative LLN and GLN methods to hypergraphs and evaluate them under a unified benchmark, revealing the limitations of existing robust learning strategies for hypergraphs. Building on this, we propose a new hypergraph robust framework, HyperTrust, which first estimates hyperedge trustworthiness through a pretraining-based, entropy-aware strategy, and then incorporates the HyperedgeBoost module to enhance reliable supervision by connecting unlabeled nodes to trustworthy hyperedges, as well as the HyperedgePrune module to suppress noisy propagation by removing untrustworthy node-hyperedge incidences. Finally, two modules work collaboratively to adjust the hypergraph structure and generate final predictions. Extensive experiments and theoretical analysis demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of HyperTrust on multiple hypergraph datasets under various noisy settings. Our work provides a unified benchmark and an effective solution for hypergraph learning with label noise and lays a foundation for future research in this direction.
