title: LowRank-SSM: Hardware-Software Co-Design for Rank-Reduced Mamba Acceleration on FPGA
authors: Haocheng Xu, Bhardwaj Bhat, Yu-an Chou, Zhiheng Chen, Leyao Han, Yifan Zhang, Ye Qiao, Saptarshi Mitra, Sitao Huang
abstract:
State Space Models(SSMs) such as Mamba and Mamba-2 achieve linear-time autoregressive inference, making them attractive for latency-sensitive and resource-constrained deployment. Yet their large input and output projection layers impose quadratic weight memory and off-chip bandwidth costs that bottleneck practical FPGA deployment, accounting for over 60% per-token runtime at sequence lengths of 1,024 and beyond. Existing accelerators reduce this overhead through quantization or activation sparsity, but none treat projection rank as an explicit hardware design variable, leaving a systematic accuracy-throughput trade-off unexplored.
  We present LowRank-SSM, a hardware-software co-design framework that closes this gap. On the software side, we decompose the input and output projection weights via post-training truncated SVD and introduce a greedy bandwise rank-allocation algorithm that searches for the per-band rank vector that minimizes weight storage while respecting a user-specified accuracy constraint. On the hardware side, we map the resulting factored projections onto a fully-pipelined accelerator on an FPGA, featuring a dual-path projection(low-rank path and full-rank path), a fused selective-scan unit, and five independent AXI master bundles that saturate DDR4 bandwidth without bus contention. A per-band runtime rank mask enables mixed-rank execution across all 64 layers with zero architectural overhead. On Xilinx Versal VC1902 at 400 MHz, the deployed mixed-rank INT8 design achieves 7.89~tokens/s, representing a ${2.19\times}$ throughput improvement and ${2.03\times}$ energy-efficiency improvement over SOTA at comparable power and accuracy.
zh_title: LowRank-SSM：基于FPGA的低秩降维Mamba加速软硬件协同设计
translation:
像 Mamba 和 Mamba-2 这样的状态空间模型（SSM）实现了线性时间的自回归推理，这使得它们非常适合延迟敏感和资源受限的部署场景。然而，它们庞大的输入和输出投影层带来了二次方的权重内存和片外带宽成本，这成为了实际 FPGA 部署的瓶颈，在序列长度达到 1,024 及以上时占单 Token 运行时间的 60% 以上。现有的加速器通过量化或激活稀疏性来减少这种开销，但都没有将投影秩视作显式的硬件设计变量，从而留下了未探索的系统性准确率-吞吐量权衡。
我们提出了 LowRank-SSM，一个填补这一空白的软硬件协同设计框架。在软件方面，我们通过训练后截断 SVD 分解输入和输出投影权重，并引入了一种贪婪带状秩分配算法，该算法在满足用户指定的准确率约束的同时，搜索最小化权重存储的每带秩向量。在硬件方面，我们将所得的因子化投影映射到 FPGA 上的全流水线加速器，该加速器具有双路径投影（低秩路径和全秩路径）、融合选择性扫描单元以及五个独立的 AXI 主总线束，可在无总线争用的情况下饱和 DDR4 带宽。按带运行时的秩掩码可在所有 64 层中实现零架构开销的混合秩执行。在 400 MHz 的 Xilinx Versal VC1902 上，部署的混合秩 INT8 设计达到了 7.89 tokens/s，在相近的功耗和准确率下，相比现有最先进技术实现了 2.19 倍的吞吐量提升和 2.03 倍的能效提升。
tldr: LowRank-SSM通过低秩分解与FPGA协同设计，克服了Mamba模型的投影层带宽瓶颈，实现了2.19倍的吞吐量与2.03倍的能效提升。
ai_comments: 该论文通过软硬件协同设计（SVD低秩分解与FPGA流水线加速器），首次将投影秩（Projection Rank）作为硬件可调变量引入SSM加速，有效解决了Mamba等状态空间模型在FPGA上因投影层权重过大导致的内存带宽瓶颈，表现出极高的实用价值和显著的能效提升。
motivation: Mamba等状态空间模型（SSM）的大型输入输出投影层带来二次方级别的权重内存和片外带宽开销，占长序列推理运行时间的60%以上，成为FPGA部署的核心瓶颈，而现有加速器未将投影秩作为硬件设计变量。
method: 软件层面采用训练后截断SVD分解输入输出投影权重，并提出贪婪带状秩分配算法，在准确率约束下优化权重存储；硬件层面构建全流水线FPGA加速器，包含双路径投影、融合选择性扫描单元及5个独立AXI主总线，并利用运行时秩掩码实现64层的零开销混合秩执行。
results: 在400 MHz主频的Xilinx Versal VC1902 FPGA上，部署的混合秩INT8设计实现了7.89 tokens/s的吞吐量，在相当的功耗和准确率下，较现有最先进（SOTA）方法实现了2.19倍的吞吐量提升和2.03倍的能效提升。
conclusion: LowRank-SSM成功通过软硬件协同设计消除了Mamba模型中投影层的带宽与内存瓶颈，为受限硬件上的高效SSM推理提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Inverted Detection and Control in Steering Vectors
authors: Max Torop, Aria Masoomi, Jennifer Dy
abstract: Steering vectors (SVs) are widely used to influence the expression of concepts (e.g., truthfulness) in large language model outputs. A key assumption underpinning SVs is that they are linearly discriminative with respect to the concept: representations of texts that exhibit the concept are more aligned with the SV than those that do not, motivating shifts along the positive or negative SV direction to respectively promote or suppress the concept. In this work, we identify an inverted detection-control phenomenon in which some highly discriminative SVs that are aligned with positive representations can consistently promote the opposite behavior. We refer to such vectors as inverted-steering vectors (ISVs). We provide a geometric characterization of ISVs' effects, finding that steering along these directions systematically pushes representations in discriminative downstream heads as if the concept were absent, even prior to decoding. Motivated by this analysis, we propose an approach for distinguishing ISVs without requiring generation or associated response scoring. This enables targeted sign flips, which we use to improve a foundational detection-based steering pipeline via Inference Time Intervention (ITI). Our approach improves results in 27/30 experiments, ranging from +0.9% to +138%. We evaluate our findings on Gemma 3 12B, Qwen 2.5 14B, and Olmo 3 7B across 5 concepts.
zh_title: 转向向量中的倒置检测与控制
translation: 转向向量（SVs）被广泛用于影响大型语言模型输出中概念的表达（例如，真实性）。SVs的一个关键假设是它们对概念具有线性判别性：表现出概念的文本表示与SVs的对齐程度高于不表现概念的文本，这促使沿SVs正向或负向移动以分别促进或抑制概念。在这项工作中，我们发现了一种倒置检测-控制现象，其中一些高度判别性且与正向表示对齐的SVs可以始终促进相反的行为。我们将此类向量称为倒置转向向量（ISVs）。我们提供了ISVs效应的几何表征，发现沿着这些方向转向会系统性地将表示推向判别性下游头部，使其表现得像概念不存在一样，甚至在解码之前。受此分析的启发，我们提出了一种无需生成或相关响应评分即可区分ISVs的方法。这使得有针对性的符号翻转成为可能，我们利用它通过推理时间干预（ITI）改进了一个基础的基于检测的转向管道。我们的方法在30个实验中的27个中改进了结果，范围从+0.9%到+138%。我们评估了Gemma 3 12B、Qwen 2.5 14B和Olmo 3 7B模型上针对5个概念的发现。
tldr: 大型语言模型中的转向向量（SVs）被发现存在“倒置转向向量”（ISVs），它们能促进与预期相反的行为。本文提供了ISVs的几何表征，并提出了一种无需生成即可识别ISVs的方法，通过有针对性的符号翻转显著改进了基于检测的转向管道，在多项实验中取得了显著提升。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于识别并系统地解释了转向向量中反直觉的“倒置”行为，这挑战了SVs的线性判别性假设。通过提供几何表征并提出无需生成即可识别ISVs的方法，该研究为更有效、更可靠地控制大型语言模型行为提供了重要见解和实用工具。其对现有转向管道的显著改进证明了该发现的实际价值和潜在影响。
motivation: 转向向量（SVs）被广泛用于影响大型语言模型输出中概念的表达，但其核心假设是SVs与概念线性判别。本研究旨在解决一些SVs表现出“倒置检测-控制现象”，即它们反而会促进相反行为的问题。
method: 作者识别并定义了倒置转向向量（ISVs），并提供了ISVs效应的几何表征，发现沿着这些方向转向会系统性地将表示推向仿佛概念不存在的状态。受此启发，他们提出了一种无需生成或相关响应评分即可区分ISVs的方法，并通过有针对性的符号翻转来改进基于检测的转向管道（通过推理时间干预ITI）。
results: 研究发现，一些高度判别性且与正向表示对齐的转向向量（SVs）会始终促进相反的行为，被称为倒置转向向量（ISVs）。沿着ISVs方向转向会系统性地将表示推向判别性下游头部，使其表现得像概念不存在。提出的方法在30个实验中的27个中改进了结果，提升范围从+0.9%到+138%。该发现在Gemma 3 12B、Qwen 2.5 14B和Olmo 3 7B模型上针对5个概念进行了评估。
conclusion: 大型语言模型中存在倒置转向向量（ISVs），它们表现出反直觉的检测-控制现象。通过几何表征和无需生成的方法可以有效识别并纠正这些ISVs，从而显著提高基于检测的转向管道的性能和可靠性。

title: ValueFormer: A Causal Transformer Value Function with Stage-Aware Labels for Semi-Autonomous Vision-Language-Action Policies
authors: Inkyu Sa, Konstantin Stulov, Rajat Bhageria
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies trained by behavior cloning fail silently: from the action stream alone, a collapsing rollout looks much like one making clean progress, because imitation supplies no notion of progress. Reinforcement learning would supply one, but it is impractical here, where real-robot experience is costly and deformable food resists simulation. The cheap alternative, a terminal success / failure bit, is learnable in principle yet far too sparse to say when a rollout went wrong. We argue that the per-frame label, not the architecture, is the hard part: to be useful it must be dense, continuous, and correctly shaped. We present ValueFormer, a compact policy-agnostic causal transformer over a frozen DINOv3 backbone that emits two per-frame signals in one forward pass: a smooth Monte Carlo value, V_mc, for advantage estimation and a sharp binary value for online mistake detection, targets that pull in opposite directions by design. Failed episodes are labeled with a stage-aware, success-then-decay return that preserves the success curve before the failure stage, and detection is supervised from mistake intervals rather than a single failure time, so mistakes the policy recovers from also carry signal. On a real-robot bimanual sandwich-assembly task 1,427 episodes), a critic-derived per-frame training weight lifts task completion from 70% to 85% (within noise at n=20), and a batched bf16 encoder cuts the live serving cost 3~5 times so the critic runs at 2 Hz alongside the policy on a single GPU.
zh_title: ValueFormer：一种具有阶段感知标签的因果Transformer价值函数，用于半自主视觉-语言-动作策略
translation: 通过行为克隆训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略会默默失败：仅从动作流来看，一个崩溃的执行过程与一个顺利进行的执行过程非常相似，因为模仿不提供进展概念。强化学习会提供一个，但在这里不切实际，因为真实机器人的经验成本高昂，且可变形食物难以模拟。廉价的替代方案是终端成功/失败的比特，原则上可以学习，但过于稀疏，无法说明执行何时出错。我们认为，每帧标签而非架构是难点：要有用，它必须是密集的、连续的且形状正确的。我们提出了ValueFormer，一个紧凑的、与策略无关的因果Transformer，基于冻结的DINOv3骨干网络，在一次前向传播中发出两个每帧信号：用于优势估计的平滑蒙特卡洛值V_mc，以及用于在线错误检测的尖锐二值，这些目标在设计上是方向相反的。失败的剧集用阶段感知的、成功后衰减的回报进行标记，该回报保留了失败阶段之前的成功曲线，并且错误检测从错误区间而不是单一失败时间进行监督，因此策略恢复的错误也带有信号。在一个真实机器人的双手三明治组装任务（1,427个剧集）中，评论家派生的每帧训练权重将任务完成率从70%提高到85%（在n=20的噪声范围内），并且批处理的bf16编码器将实时服务成本降低3~5倍，使评论家可以在单个GPU上以2 Hz的速度与策略并行运行。
tldr: ValueFormer是一个因果Transformer价值函数，通过生成密集的、阶段感知的每帧标签来解决行为克隆在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中缺乏进展概念的问题，从而提高任务完成率和推理效率。
ai_comments: ValueFormer的创新点在于其独特的双信号输出设计（V_mc和二值错误检测）以及阶段感知标签和错误区间监督方法，有效地解决了稀疏奖励和无进展信号的问题，为半自主VLA策略提供了关键的反馈。其在实际机器人任务中的性能提升和计算效率优化证明了其实用性和重要性。该工作为机器人学习，特别是在复杂、高成本环境下的策略训练，提供了新的视角和解决方案。
motivation: 行为克隆训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略会默默失败，因为它们没有进展概念。强化学习虽能提供进展概念，但在实际机器人经验昂贵且可变形食物难以模拟的情况下不切实际。终端成功/失败的稀疏标签不足以指示何时出错。本文认为，每帧标签的密度、连续性和正确形状是关键挑战。
method: 本文提出了ValueFormer，一个紧凑的、与策略无关的因果Transformer，基于冻结的DINOv3骨干网络，在一次前向传播中发出两个每帧信号：用于优势估计的平滑蒙特卡洛值（V_mc）和用于在线错误检测的尖锐二值。失败的剧集用阶段感知的、成功后衰减的回报进行标记，该回报保留了失败阶段之前的成功曲线。错误检测从错误区间而不是单一失败时间进行监督。
results: 在一个真实机器人的双手三明治组装任务（1,427个剧集）中，评论家派生的每帧训练权重将任务完成率从70%提高到85%。批处理的bf16编码器将实时服务成本降低3~5倍，使评论家可以在单个GPU上以2 Hz的速度与策略并行运行。
conclusion: ValueFormer通过提供密集的、连续的、正确形状的每帧标签，有效地解决了VLA策略中缺乏进展信号的问题，显著提升了任务完成率和推理效率。

title: SABRE: A Multi-Agent Approach for Selecting Out-of-Distribution Detectors Under a Budget
authors: Mary Wisell, Salimeh Sekeh
abstract: Post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detection for vision-language models assumes that a detector chosen on a benchmark stays reliable once deployed. We show this fails across domains: on a single frozen encoder, a detector that leads in one domain can invert in another, scoring in-distribution inputs as more anomalous than genuine outliers, and the best detector changes from domain to domain, so no fixed choice is reliable throughout. We introduce SABRE (Selective Agentic Budgeted Reliability Ensemble,) which replaces this fixed choice with per-regime selection at inference. Three language-model agents reason over a library of post-hoc detectors under a bounded query budget: a Selector chooses which detector to consult next, a Reporter consolidates the evidence for each input, and an Analyst calibrates detector reliability on a small labeled sample held out from the deployment domain and disjoint from the test data, weighting selection and aggregation without ever observing a scored input's label. The library includes four multimodal density detectors we propose. Inferring the operating regime from data, SABRE tracks the strongest detector in each domain without prior knowledge of it, recovering reliable detection where a conventional detector inverts and converging to that detector where it is sound. A component analysis shows the agents are complementary: the Reporter's feedback yields consistent gains, and the Analyst's calibration is decisive against inversion, ruling out unreliable detectors so that aggregation no longer cancels the sound ones. Since no fixed rule can be trusted across domains, reliability must be established at deployment rather than assumed from a benchmark, and SABRE shows this can be done automatically.
zh_title: SABRE：一种在预算限制下选择分布外检测器的多智能体方法
translation: 事后分布外（OOD）检测对于视觉-语言模型而言，通常假设在基准测试中选择的检测器在部署后仍然可靠。我们发现这在不同领域中会失效：在单个冻结编码器上，在一个领域中领先的检测器在另一个领域中可能会反转，将分布内输入评分比真正的异常值更异常，并且最佳检测器因领域而异，因此没有固定的选择能在所有情况下都可靠。我们引入了SABRE（选择性智能体预算可靠性集成），它用推理时按制度选择取代了这种固定选择。三个语言模型智能体在有限的查询预算下，对事后检测器库进行推理：Selector选择接下来要咨询哪个检测器，Reporter整合每个输入的证据，Analyst在从部署领域中分离出来且与测试数据不相交的小型带标签样本上校准检测器可靠性，在不观察到任何评分输入的标签的情况下，对选择和聚合进行加权。该库包括我们提出的四种多模态密度检测器。SABRE通过从数据中推断操作制度，在没有先验知识的情况下跟踪每个领域中最强的检测器，在传统检测器反转的情况下恢复可靠检测，并在其有效时收敛到该检测器。组件分析表明智能体是互补的：Reporter的反馈带来了持续的增益，Analyst的校准对于防止反转是决定性的，排除了不可靠的检测器，从而使聚合不再抵消有效的检测器。由于不能信任任何固定规则跨领域都有效，可靠性必须在部署时建立，而不是从基准测试中假定，SABRE表明这可以自动完成。
tldr: SABRE是一个多智能体系统，用于在不同领域动态选择最佳的OOD检测器，以解决传统检测器在跨领域部署时可靠性下降的问题。
ai_comments: SABRE的创新之处在于其多智能体框架，通过动态选择和校准OOD检测器来适应不同领域，而非依赖单一固定检测器。这种方法解决了传统OOD检测器在跨领域泛化能力不足的关键挑战，尤其是在“检测器反转”问题上的应对，具有重要的实践意义。其自动建立可靠性的能力是未来OOD检测研究的一个重要方向。
motivation: 现有的视觉-语言模型事后OOD检测方法假设在基准测试中选择的检测器在部署后仍然可靠，但研究发现这种假设在不同领域中会失效，一个在某个领域表现优秀的检测器在另一个领域可能反转，导致无法通过单一固定选择实现可靠的OOD检测。
method: 本文提出了SABRE (Selective Agentic Budgeted Reliability Ensemble)，它在推理时用每个特定情况下的选择取代固定选择。SABRE包含三个语言模型智能体：Selector选择要咨询哪个检测器，Reporter整合每个输入的证据，Analyst在部署领域的小型带标签样本上校准检测器可靠性。该方法在有限的查询预算下运行，并包含四个新提出的多模态密度检测器。
results: SABRE无需先验知识即可在每个领域跟踪最强的检测器，在传统检测器反转的情况下恢复可靠检测，并在检测器有效时收敛。组件分析表明智能体是互补的：Reporter的反馈带来持续增益，Analyst的校准对于防止反转至关重要。
conclusion: 跨领域无法信任任何固定规则，因此可靠性必须在部署时建立而不是从基准测试中假定，SABRE展示了这可以自动完成。

title: Scaling an Autoregressive Transformer for Single-Cell Generation
authors: Aleksandr Sharipov, Yusif Mukhtarov, Igor Molybog
abstract: We study a self-supervised generation task for single-cell gene expression vectors: given a set of vectors from a cell type, we aim to generate additional gene expression vectors of that cell type. For this task we characterize both the biological fidelity of the generated gene expression vectors and the scaling behavior of the pretraining loss. The model is a causal transformer paired with a learned quantized VAE tokenizer, trained with a cross-entropy loss. To evaluate the model, we condition it on held-out gene expression vectors of a cell type and generate vectors of gene expression, comparing the resulting distribution over gene expression vectors to the ground truth distribution of that cell type. We study the scaling properties of the proposed architecture by varying the number of trained parameters and the amount of training data. To our knowledge, we find the first jointly-fit two-exponent scaling law and compute-optimal frontier for a single-cell foundation model. Finally, we discuss how this pretrained model could be finetuned for perturbation response prediction.
zh_title: 用于单细胞生成的自回归 Transformer 的扩展
translation: 我们研究了一种用于单细胞基因表达向量的自监督生成任务：给定一组来自某种细胞类型的向量，我们旨在生成该细胞类型的额外基因表达向量。对于这项任务，我们描述了生成基因表达向量的生物学保真度以及预训练损失的缩放行为。该模型是一个因果 Transformer，与学习到的量化 VAE 分词器配对，并使用交叉熵损失进行训练。为了评估该模型，我们以某种细胞类型的保留基因表达向量为条件，生成基因表达向量，并将生成的基因表达向量的分布与该细胞类型的真实分布进行比较。我们通过改变训练参数的数量和训练数据的量来研究所提出架构的缩放特性。据我们所知，我们首次发现了一种单细胞基础模型的联合拟合双指数缩放定律和计算最优前沿。最后，我们讨论了如何对这个预训练模型进行微调，以进行扰动响应预测。
tldr: 本文研究了单细胞基因表达向量的自监督生成任务，采用因果 Transformer 结合量化 VAE 分词器，并首次发现了单细胞基础模型的双指数缩放定律和计算最优前沿，可用于扰动响应预测。
ai_comments: 这项工作在单细胞生成领域引入了自回归 Transformer，并通过量化 VAE 分词器增强了其能力。其创新之处在于首次为单细胞基础模型识别了联合拟合的双指数缩放定律和计算最优前沿，这对于理解和优化大型单细胞模型的训练效率和性能具有重要意义。未来，该模型在扰动响应预测等下游任务中的应用潜力也值得关注。
motivation: 研究一个用于单细胞基因表达向量的自监督生成任务：给定一组来自某种细胞类型的向量，目标是生成该细胞类型的额外基因表达向量，并表征生成向量的生物学保真度及预训练损失的缩放行为。
method: 模型是一个因果 Transformer，与学习到的量化 VAE 分词器配对，使用交叉熵损失进行训练。通过在保留的细胞类型基因表达向量上进行条件化生成，并将结果分布与该细胞类型的真实分布进行比较来评估模型。通过改变训练参数数量和训练数据量来研究架构的缩放特性。
results: 首次发现了一种单细胞基础模型的联合拟合双指数缩放定律和计算最优前沿。
conclusion: 该预训练模型可以进行微调，用于扰动响应预测。

title: Material-Segmented Per-Pixel Emissivity Correction for Thermographic Anomaly Detection in Cultural Heritage Digital Twins
authors: Jonathan Klingspon, Scott McAvoy, Maurizio Seracini, Falko Kuester
abstract: Quantitative longwave thermography of heritage surfaces is limited by the global-constant emissivity assumption in inverse-Planck temperature retrieval; on heterogeneous surfaces emissivity varies within one field of view, producing apparent-temperature artifacts that mimic and mask subsurface anomalies. We present a training-free pipeline that derives per-pixel emissivity by applying SAM 3.1 open-vocabulary segmentation to a colocated, co-calibrated RGB channel, mapping segments to a material-keyed LWIR emissivity table compiled from primary measurement literature, and propagating the field into a per-pixel inverse-Planck solve on raw radiometric data. Lacking any public dataset with raw radiometry, a temperature reference, and a colocated RGB camera, we evaluate on a physics-based synthetic benchmark and four real datasets. On the benchmark, under a palette spanning the low-emissivity exceptions, the correction cuts mean absolute error from 1.97 K to 0.91 K at 20 K contrast and, with an accurate table, beats the best fitted global constant on every layout; on a heritage-realistic emissivity distribution it does not. We contribute a quantified operating-regime map, and a measurement-backed finding that tempers the heritage claim: weathered outdoor heritage emissivities cluster near the conventional default, so the correction is small on typical surfaces and concentrated on genuine low-emissivity exceptions. We characterize the dominant failure mode, in which open-vocabulary segmentation matches appearance rather than material, and the contraindicated regime in which emissivity-defined anomalies are suppressed.
zh_title: 用于文化遗产数字孪生热成像异常检测的材质分段逐像素发射率校正
translation: 文物表面的定量长波热成像受到反演普朗克温度时全局常数发射率假设的限制；在异质表面上，发射率在单个视场内会发生变化，产生模仿并掩盖地下异常的表观温度伪影。我们提出了一种无需训练的管道，通过将SAM 3.1开放词汇分割应用于同位、同校准的RGB通道，将片段映射到从初级测量文献中汇编的材质键控LWIR发射率表，并将该场传播到原始辐射数据的逐像素逆普朗克求解中。由于缺乏包含原始辐射测温、温度参考和同位RGB相机的公共数据集，我们在基于物理的合成基准和四个真实数据集上进行评估。在基准测试中，在涵盖低发射率异常的调色板下，该校正在20 K对比度下将平均绝对误差从1.97 K降低到0.91 K，并且在具有准确表格的情况下，在每个布局上都击败了最佳拟合全局常数；但在具有真实文物特性的发射率分布上则不然。我们贡献了一个量化的操作区间图，以及一个经测量支持的发现，该发现缓和了文物方面的声明：风化户外文物的发射率聚集在常规默认值附近，因此校正对典型表面很小，而集中在真正的低发射率例外上。我们描述了主要的故障模式，其中开放词汇分割匹配外观而不是材质，以及发射率定义的异常被抑制的禁忌机制。
tldr: 提出了一种结合开放词汇分割与材质数据库的无需训练方法，用于修正热红外成像中的发射率误差，提升文化遗产缺陷检测精度。
ai_comments: 该论文针对文化遗产数字孪生中的热红外成像缺陷检测，提出了一种无需训练的基于材质分割的逐像素发射率校正方法。其创新之处在于结合了开放词汇分割模型（SAM 3.1）与辐射测温学，显著降低了异质表面的温度反演误差，并对风化文物的实际发射率分布进行了定量评估。
motivation: 文化遗产表面具有高度异质性，传统的全局常数发射率假设会导致温度反演出现伪影，从而掩盖或伪装皮下缺陷。因此，需要一种逐像素的发射率校正方法来提高定量长波热成像的准确性。
method: 提出了一种无需训练的管道：利用SAM 3.1对同位同校准的RGB图像进行开放词汇分割，将分割区域映射至文献编译的材质发射率表，并将该发射率场代入原始辐射数据的逐像素逆普朗克求解中。
results: 在物理基准测试中，该校正方法将平均绝对误差从1.97 K降至0.91 K（20 K对比度下）；同时发现风化户外文物的发射率多接近常规默认值，校正主要集中在少数低发射率区域。
conclusion: 该研究提出的材质分割逐像素发射率校正管道有效减少了异质文化遗产表面的温度伪影，指出了其在低发射率异常检测中的适用范围与局限性。

title: A Physics-Informed Hybrid Neural Operator for Transient Magnetization Prediction in Power Magnetics
authors: Yachao Zhu, Qiujie Huang, Sinan Li, Yang Li, Gang Lei, Jianguo Zhu
abstract: Magnetic components in high-frequency, high-power-density converters are increasingly driven by non-sinusoidal flux-density waveforms with fast transitions, minor-loop operation, dc bias, and temperature variation. Under these conditions, steady-state core-loss formulas and single-valued material curves cannot fully capture transient magnetization responses. This work proposes the Physics-Informed Hybrid Neural Operator (PI-HNO), a compact material-specific neural model with B-H energy-consistency regularization for core-loss-oriented transient magnetization prediction. Given the measured B(t)-H(t) history, the input B(t) series over the prediction interval and operating-condition information, PI-HNO predicts the H(t) series and the corresponding reconstructed B-H trajectory. The model integrates a local recurrent branch for boundary-state representation and rate-dependent response evolution with a Preisach-inspired global branch that extracts waveform-level hysteresis context. Evaluation on the MagNetX transient database using material-specific models for 14 ferrite materials demonstrates that PI-HNO achieves a compact trade-off between sequence accuracy and B(t)-H(t) energy consistency, with the mean and 95th percentile B(t)-H(t) energy consistency errors of 1.92% and 7.60%, respectively, using only 4777 trainable parameters per model. Ablation studies further demonstrate that the local, global, and energy-aware regularized components provide distinct contributions to transient magnetization prediction.
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Preprint prepared for possible submission to IEEE Transactions on Power Electronics
zh_title: 电力磁学中瞬态磁化预测的物理信息混合神经算子
translation: 高频、高功率密度转换器中的磁性元件越来越多地由具有快速瞬变、小回线操作、直流偏置和温度变化的非正弦磁通密度波形驱动。在这些条件下，稳态磁芯损耗公式和单值材料曲线无法完全捕捉瞬态磁化响应。本工作提出了物理信息混合神经算子（PI-HNO），这是一种紧凑的、材料特定的神经模型，具有B-H能量一致性正则化功能，用于面向磁芯损耗的瞬态磁化预测。给定测量的B(t)-H(t)历史、预测区间内的输入B(t)序列和运行条件信息，PI-HNO预测H(t)序列和相应的重建B-H轨迹。该模型集成了一个用于边界状态表示和速率依赖响应演化的局部循环分支，以及一个受Preisach启发的全局分支，用于提取波形级滞后上下文。在MagNetX瞬态数据库上，使用14种铁氧体材料的特定材料模型进行评估，结果表明PI-HNO在序列精度和B(t)-H(t)能量一致性之间取得了紧凑的权衡，平均和95百分位的B(t)-H(t)能量一致性误差分别为1.92%和7.60%，每个模型仅使用4777个可训练参数。消融研究进一步表明，局部、全局和能量感知正则化组件对瞬态磁化预测提供了独特的贡献。
tldr: PI-HNO是一种物理信息混合神经算子，用于在高频、高功率密度转换器中预测磁性元件的瞬态磁化响应，克服了传统方法在非正弦波形下的局限性，实现了序列精度和B-H能量一致性的紧凑权衡，且参数量少。
ai_comments: 这项工作创新性地结合了神经算子、物理信息正则化和混合架构（局部循环与全局Preisach启发），有效解决了电力磁学中瞬态磁化预测的挑战。其模型紧凑性和在复杂条件下的准确性具有重要的实际应用价值。
motivation: 在高频、高功率密度转换器中，磁性元件受到非正弦磁通密度波形驱动，具有快速瞬变、小回线操作、直流偏置和温度变化等特点。在这些条件下，稳态磁芯损耗公式和单值材料曲线无法完全捕捉瞬态磁化响应。
method: 本文提出了一种物理信息混合神经算子（PI-HNO），这是一种紧凑的、材料特定的神经模型，具有B-H能量一致性正则化功能，用于面向磁芯损耗的瞬态磁化预测。该模型将一个用于边界状态表示和速率依赖响应演化的局部循环分支，与一个受Preisach启发的全局分支（用于提取波形级滞后上下文）相结合。输入为测量的B(t)-H(t)历史、预测区间内的B(t)序列以及运行条件信息，输出为H(t)序列和重建的B-H轨迹。
results: 在MagNetX瞬态数据库上，使用14种铁氧体材料的特定材料模型进行评估，PI-HNO在序列精度和B(t)-H(t)能量一致性之间取得了紧凑的权衡。平均和95百分位的B(t)-H(t)能量一致性误差分别为1.92%和7.60%，每个模型仅使用4777个可训练参数。消融研究进一步表明，局部、全局和能量感知正则化组件对瞬态磁化预测提供了独特的贡献。
conclusion: PI-HNO模型通过结合局部循环和全局滞后上下文提取分支，并引入物理信息（B-H能量一致性）正则化，能够有效且准确地预测电力磁学中复杂非正弦激励下的瞬态磁化响应，且模型紧凑，参数量少。

title: HyperFL: Query-Adaptive Representation Learning for Software Fault Localization
authors: Shuai Shao, Yiming Zeng, Yu Zhao, Tingting Yu
abstract: Software fault localization identifies the code locations responsible for reported issues and is a fundamental step toward automated debugging and program repair. Recent retrieval-based approaches formulate fault localization as a dense retrieval task by learning a shared embedding space between issue reports and source code. However, these methods encode all issue reports using a fixed query representation, despite the substantial diversity of real-world issue reports in length, structure, and debugging information. To address this limitation, we propose HyperFL, a query-adaptive representation learning framework for software fault localization. HyperFL employs a lightweight hypernetwork to generate query-specific LoRA parameters for the query encoder, enabling dynamic query adaptation while keeping the code encoder fixed and reusable. Experiments on a real-world issue localization benchmark demonstrate that HyperFL consistently improves retrieval performance across multiple embedding backbones, achieving up to 13.3% relative improvement in function-level MRR@10 and 16.7% relative improvement in Hit@1 over the state-of-the-art method SweRank. Further analysis shows that HyperFL learns distinct adaptation patterns for different issue characteristics, highlighting the effectiveness of query-adaptive representations for software issue localization.
zh_title: HyperFL: 查询自适应表示学习用于软件故障定位
translation: 软件故障定位旨在识别导致报告问题d的代码位置，是自动化调试和程序修复的关键一步。最近的基于检索的方法通过学习问题报告和源代码之间的共享嵌入空间，将故障定位表述为密集检索任务。然而，这些方法使用固定的查询表示来编码所有问题报告，尽管实际问题报告在长度、结构和调试信息上存在显著多样性。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了HyperFL，一个用于软件故障定位的查询自适应表示学习框架。HyperFL采用一个轻量级超网络为查询编码器生成查询特定的LoRA参数，从而实现动态查询适应，同时保持代码编码器固定且可重用。在真实世界问题定位基准测试上的实验表明，HyperFL在多个嵌入骨干上持续提高了检索性能，在函数级MRR@10上实现了高达13.3%的相对改进，在Hit@1上实现了高达16.7%的相对改进，优于最先进的方法SweRank。进一步分析表明，HyperFL为不同的问题特征学习了独特的适应模式，突出了查询自适应表示在软件问题定位中的有效性。
tldr: HyperFL通过为查询编码器生成查询特定的LoRA参数，实现了查询自适应的表示学习，显著提高了软件故障定位的性能。
ai_comments: HyperFL的创新之处在于引入了超网络来动态生成查询编码器的LoRA参数，从而实现了查询自适应的表示学习，有效解决了软件故障定位中问题报告多样性的挑战。这种方法提高了检索性能，并保持了代码编码器的可重用性，对自动化调试和程序修复领域具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的检索式故障定位方法使用固定的查询表示来编码所有问题报告，但实际问题报告在长度、结构和调试信息上存在显著多样性，这限制了其性能。
method: 提出HyperFL，一个查询自适应表示学习框架。它使用一个轻量级超网络为查询编码器生成查询特定的LoRA参数，实现动态查询适应，同时保持代码编码器固定和可重用。
results: 在真实世界问题定位基准测试中，HyperFL在多个嵌入骨干上持续提高检索性能，函数级MRR@10相对改进高达13.3%，Hit@1相对改进高达16.7%，超过了现有SOTA方法SweRank。分析表明HyperFL为不同问题特征学习了独特的适应模式。
conclusion: HyperFL通过查询自适应表示学习，有效解决了软件故障定位中问题报告多样性带来的挑战，显著提升了定位性能。

title: Every Wrong Answer Counts: Option-Level Psychometrics for LLM Multiple-Choice Benchmarks
authors: Xiao Fei, Yang Zhang, Sarah Almeida Carneiro, Michalis Vazirgiannis
abstract: Most multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmarks evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) only by whether they select the correct answers. This binary scoring treats all incorrect responses alike, even though an LLM's preferences among incorrect options may contain systematic and useful information about its behavior and ability. We introduce the LLM Nominal Response Model (LLM-NRM), an option-aware psychometric framework that models the full distribution over answer choices to jointly estimate LLM ability and option-level item characteristics, while separating model-specific response calibration sharpness, positional preference, and difficulty-dependent fallback behavior. Across 189 LLMs and 31,554 items from 14 benchmarks, LLM-NRM predicts held-out LLM-item interactions more accurately than binary Item Response models and conventional nominal-response baselines, and its ability estimates achieve the strongest Spearman correlation of 0.920 with the external human-preference Arena.ai Elo leaderboard. Distractor identity contributes +101% additional Fisher Information per item beyond correctness, and incorrect responses alone recover full-information ability estimates with Spearman 0.943. The learned item parameters also enable efficient benchmarking, where 41 selected items preserve the full-bank ranking with Kendall's correlation 0.85, corresponding to a 770 times reduction. In conclusion, we show that incorrect answers carry distinct and useful measurement information rather than representing equivalent mistakes.
zh_title: 每个错误答案都重要：LLM多项选择基准中的选项级心理测量学
translation: 大多数多项选择题（MCQ）基准仅通过LLM是否选择正确答案来评估大型语言模型（LLM）。这种二元评分方式将所有不正确的响应一视同仁，即使LLM在不正确选项之间的偏好可能包含关于其行为和能力的系统性和有用信息。我们引入了LLM名义响应模型（LLM-NRM），这是一个选项感知的心理测量框架，它建模答案选择的完整分布，以联合估计LLM能力和选项级项目特征，同时分离模型特定的响应校准锐度、位置偏好和难度依赖的后备行为。在189个LLM和14个基准的31,554个项目中，LLM-NRM比二元项目响应模型和传统的名义响应基线更准确地预测了LLM-项目交互，其能力估计与外部人工偏好Arena.ai Elo排行榜的斯皮尔曼相关系数达到最高的0.920。干扰项的身份贡献了超出正确性101%的额外费舍尔信息，仅通过不正确的响应就能恢复斯皮尔曼相关系数为0.943的完整信息能力估计。学习到的项目参数还实现了高效基准测试，其中41个选定项目以0.85的肯德尔相关系数保持了完整题库的排名，相当于减少了770倍。总之，我们表明不正确的答案携带着独特而有用的测量信息，而不是代表等价的错误。
tldr: 本文提出LLM-NRM框架，通过分析LLM在多项选择题中对所有选项（包括错误选项）的选择分布，更准确地评估LLM能力和题目特征，并显著提高基准测试效率，证明错误答案包含有用的测量信息。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于它挑战了传统多项选择题基准测试中对LLM的二元评分范式，并提出了一个更精细的选项级心理测量框架。通过深入挖掘错误答案中的信息，该方法不仅提高了LLM能力评估的准确性，还显著提升了基准测试的效率，这对于未来LLM的快速迭代和评估具有重要意义。它揭示了即使是错误的答案也能提供关于模型行为和能力的宝贵洞察。
motivation: 大多数多项选择题（MCQ）基准仅通过LLM是否选择正确答案来评估其能力，这种二元评分方式将所有错误答案一视同仁，忽略了LLM在错误选项之间的偏好可能包含关于其行为和能力的系统性和有用信息。
method: 本文引入了LLM名义响应模型（LLM-NRM），这是一个选项感知的心理测量框架，它建模答案选择的完整分布，以联合估计LLM能力和选项级项目特征，同时分离模型特定的响应校准锐度、位置偏好和难度依赖的后备行为。
results: LLM-NRM在189个LLM和14个基准的31,554个项目中，比二元项目响应模型和传统的名义响应基线更准确地预测了LLM-项目交互。其能力估计与外部人工偏好Arena.ai Elo排行榜的斯皮尔曼相关系数达到最高的0.920。干扰项的身份贡献了超出正确性101%的额外费舍尔信息。仅通过错误响应就能恢复斯皮尔曼相关系数为0.943的完整信息能力估计。学习到的项目参数还实现了高效基准测试，其中41个选定项目以0.85的肯德尔相关系数保持了完整题库的排名，相当于减少了770倍。
conclusion: 本文得出结论，错误答案携带着独特而有用的测量信息，而不是代表等价的错误。

title: ConFL: Explainable Concurrent Fault Localization via Hierarchy-Guided LLM Reasoning
authors: Shuai Shao, Dingbang Wang, Yiming Zeng, Tingting Yu
abstract: Localizing concurrent bugs from bug reports alone is challenging due to incomplete information, misleading program-entity mentions, and complex cross-thread interactions, causing existing LLM-based approaches to suffer from unstable reasoning and limited explainability. We propose ConFL, an explainable concurrent fault localization framework that augments LLM reasoning with structured concurrency knowledge. ConFL constructs a Concurrent Knowledge Base (CKB) from source code and performs LLM-guided hierarchical retrieval to progressively narrow the search space from components to interaction-level concurrency contexts. An interaction-level DSL explicitly encodes cross-thread interactions over shared resources, enabling focused reasoning without traversing deep call chains. Experiments on real-world concurrent bugs from eight large-scale Java projects show that ConFL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art IR-based and LLM-based baselines, achieving an MRR of 0.503 and a MAP of 0.486, while remaining robust to noisy bug reports, unseen bugs, and different LLM backbones.
zh_title: ConFL：通过层次引导的LLM推理实现可解释的并发故障定位
translation: 从错误报告中定位并发错误是具有挑战性的，原因在于信息不完整、误导性的程序实体提及以及复杂的跨线程交互，这导致现有的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法在推理上不稳定且可解释性有限。我们提出了ConFL，一个可解释的并发故障定位框架，它通过结构化并发知识增强LLM的推理能力。ConFL从源代码构建了一个并发知识库（CKB），并执行LLM引导的层次检索，以逐步将搜索空间从组件缩小到交互级并发上下文。一个交互级领域特定语言（DSL）明确编码了共享资源上的跨线程交互，从而实现聚焦推理，而无需遍历深层调用链。在来自八个大型Java项目的真实并发错误上的实验表明，ConFL显著优于最先进的基于信息检索（IR）和基于LLM的基线，实现了0.503的平均倒数排名（MRR）和0.486的平均精度（MAP），同时对嘈杂的错误报告、未见过的错误和不同的LLM骨干保持鲁棒性。
tldr: ConFL通过结构化并发知识增强LLM推理，实现可解释的并发故障定位，显著优于现有方法。
ai_comments: ConFL的创新之处在于将LLM的推理能力与结构化的并发知识（通过CKB和交互级DSL）相结合，有效解决了并发故障定位中信息不完整和复杂交互的挑战。其层次引导的检索和交互级DSL设计提高了定位的准确性和可解释性，对软件调试领域具有重要意义。
motivation: 从错误报告中定位并发错误具有挑战性，原因包括信息不完整、误导性程序实体提及以及复杂的跨线程交互，导致现有基于LLM的方法推理不稳定且可解释性有限。
method: ConFL构建了一个并发知识库（CKB），并执行LLM引导的层次检索，逐步缩小搜索空间，从组件到交互级并发上下文。交互级DSL明确编码了共享资源上的跨线程交互，从而实现聚焦推理，而无需遍历深层调用链。
results: 在八个大型Java项目的真实并发错误上的实验表明，ConFL显著优于最先进的基于IR和基于LLM的基线，实现了0.503的MRR和0.486的MAP，同时对嘈杂的错误报告、未见过的错误和不同的LLM骨干保持鲁棒性。
conclusion: ConFL通过结构化并发知识增强LLM推理，有效解决了并发故障定位的挑战，并在实际应用中表现出优越的性能和鲁棒性。

title: Mapping the City Through the Lens of Language Models
authors: Wanqi Liu, Rong Zhao, Zhizhou Sha, Qinyu Cui, Yecheng Zhang
abstract: Language models often complete an underspecified reference to a city with unstated assumptions about urban size, form, infrastructure, environment, and function. We measure those assumptions without naming places. Ten open-weight checkpoints rate anonymized profiles derived from real morphological urban centres across 40 audited indicators and seven domains. The design combines constrained probability-based ratings, prespecified reliability screens, lineage-aware aggregation, multiple population weightings, an independent replication sample, and whole-profile validation. The clearest shared tendency favours urban profiles with larger developed area, faster recent growth, greater mapped infrastructure and non-residential capacity, and less sparse form. Most eligible directions recur in the replication data, and direct ratings of complete profiles show moderate agreement with the indicator-wise construction. Geographic differences shrink after accounting for city scale and development, while reliably measured paired tasks indicate that typicality and desirability are often closely aligned. The framework makes an otherwise vague notion of what models regard as an ordinary city empirically traceable. The resulting evidence delineates a shared yet model-dependent portrait of the city through the lens of language models.
zh_title: 通过语言模型视角下的城市映射
translation: 语言模型在完成对城市的不明确引用时，常常包含对城市规模、形态、基础设施、环境和功能等方面的未明确假设。我们测量了这些假设，而没有命名具体地点。十个开放权重检查点对来自真实形态城市中心的匿名化档案进行了评分，涉及40个审计指标和七个领域。设计结合了约束概率评分、预设可靠性筛选、血统感知聚合、多重人口加权、独立复制样本和全档案验证。最明显的共同趋势是语言模型偏好具有更大开发面积、更快近期增长、更多映射基础设施和非住宅容量以及更不稀疏形态的城市档案。大多数符合条件的方向在复制数据中重现，并且完整档案的直接评分与指标构建显示出中度一致性。在考虑城市规模和发展后，地理差异缩小，而可靠测量的配对任务表明典型性和 desirability 常常紧密相关。该框架使得模型将普通城市视为一个模糊概念变得可经验追溯。研究结果描绘了通过语言模型视角下对城市的共享但依赖于模型的画像。
tldr: 本研究测量了语言模型在提及城市时隐含的假设，发现它们偏好规模更大、增长更快、基础设施更完善、非住宅容量更大且形态不稀疏的城市，并提供了一个经验可追溯的框架来理解语言模型对城市的认知。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过创新的方法，量化了语言模型对城市特征的隐含认知，揭示了模型在处理城市概念时的内在偏好。其重要性在于为理解和改进语言模型在地理和城市规划领域的应用提供了新的视角和经验证据。方法的严谨性体现在其结合了多种验证手段，增强了结果的可靠性。
motivation: 语言模型在完成对城市的不明确引用时，常常包含对城市规模、形态、基础设施、环境和功能等方面的未明确假设，本研究旨在测量这些假设。
method: 研究使用了十个开放权重检查点，对来自真实形态城市中心的匿名化档案进行评分，涉及40个审计指标和七个领域。设计结合了约束概率评分、预设可靠性筛选、血统感知聚合、多重人口加权、独立复制样本和全档案验证。
results: 语言模型最明显的共同趋势是偏好具有更大开发面积、更快近期增长、更多映射基础设施和非住宅容量以及更不稀疏形态的城市档案。大多数符合条件的方向在复制数据中重现，完整档案的直接评分与指标构建显示出中度一致性。在考虑城市规模和发展后，地理差异缩小，且典型性和 desirability 常常紧密相关。
conclusion: 该框架使得模型将普通城市视为一个模糊概念变得可经验追溯。研究结果描绘了通过语言模型视角下对城市的共享但依赖于模型的画像。

title: Coverage Matters: MarginMerge for Compressing Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrievers
authors: Ailar Mahdizadeh, Aria Salari, Sohail Rajabi, Shahriar Mirabbasi, Panos Nasiopoulos, Alireza Morsali
abstract: Multi-vector visual document retrievers such as ColPali and ColQwen achieve strong retrieval by storing fine-grained patch embeddings, but this produces large indexes and costly late-interaction scoring. We argue that effective compression should preserve query-relevant coverage, meaning the diverse document regions that may become the strongest MaxSim match across queries, rather than selecting patches independently by salience. This view also explains why dense rendered pages are easier to compress than natural images. We introduce MarginMerge, a compression method for frozen multi-vector retrievers. It selects coverage-aware anchors, clusters document patches, and uses a lightweight shared network to synthesize one representative per cluster. Compression is performed once during indexing, while retrieval keeps the standard MaxSim interface. Across six datasets on both ColQwen2.5 and ColPali, MarginMerge achieves the highest matched query-agnostic average at 5% and 10% vector retention. Compared with the uncompressed index using the same backbone, it preserves between 97% and 99% of average nDCG@5 while reducing stored document vectors by between 90% and 95%. At 5% retention, it also reduces ranking flips relative to geometric merging on all six ColQwen2.5 datasets by approximately 41% on average. The same model transfers to unseen datasets and retention ratios without retraining.
zh_title: 覆盖率至关重要：MarginMerge用于压缩多向量视觉文档检索器
translation: 多向量视觉文档检索器，如ColPali和ColQwen，通过存储细粒度补丁嵌入实现强大的检索，但这会产生巨大的索引和昂贵的后期交互评分。我们认为，有效的压缩应保留查询相关的覆盖范围，这意味着可能在查询中成为最强MaxSim匹配的各种文档区域，而不是独立地通过显著性选择补丁。这一观点也解释了为什么密集渲染页面比自然图像更容易压缩。我们引入了MarginMerge，这是一种用于冻结多向量检索器的压缩方法。它选择覆盖率感知的锚点，对文档补丁进行聚类，并使用轻量级共享网络为每个聚类合成一个代表。压缩在索引期间执行一次，而检索保持标准MaxSim接口。在ColQwen2.5和ColPali的六个数据集上，MarginMerge在5%和10%的向量保留率下实现了最高的匹配查询无关平均值。与使用相同骨干网络的未压缩索引相比，它在将存储的文档向量减少90%到95%的同时，保留了97%到99%的平均nDCG@5。在5%的保留率下，它还在所有六个ColQwen2.5数据集上将相对于几何合并的排名翻转平均减少了约41%。相同的模型可以在不重新训练的情况下迁移到未见数据集和保留率。
tldr: 多向量视觉文档检索器虽然强大但索引庞大。MarginMerge通过保留查询相关的覆盖范围来压缩它们，以显著更少的向量实现高检索性能并减少排名翻转。
ai_comments: MarginMerge的创新之处在于其“覆盖率至关重要”的理念，即在压缩时关注保留查询相关的多样化文档区域，而非独立选择显著补丁。这不仅解释了某些现象，还提供了一种有效的压缩策略，显著降低了多向量检索器的存储和计算成本，同时保持了高检索性能和良好的泛化能力，对于实际应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 多向量视觉文档检索器（如ColPali和ColQwen）通过存储细粒度补丁嵌入实现强大检索，但这导致索引庞大且后期交互评分成本高昂，因此需要有效的压缩方法。
method: MarginMerge是一种针对冻结多向量检索器的压缩方法。它选择覆盖率感知的锚点，对文档补丁进行聚类，并使用轻量级共享网络为每个聚类合成一个代表。压缩在索引期间执行一次，检索保持标准MaxSim接口。
results: 在ColQwen2.5和ColPali的六个数据集上，MarginMerge在5%和10%向量保留率下取得了最高的查询无关平均值。与未压缩索引相比，它在减少90%-95%存储文档向量的同时，保留了97%-99%的平均nDCG@5。在5%保留率下，它还使ColQwen2.5所有六个数据集上相对于几何合并的排名翻转平均减少约41%。该模型无需重新训练即可迁移到未见数据集和保留率。
conclusion: MarginMerge通过关注查询相关的覆盖范围，有效压缩了多向量视觉文档检索器，显著降低了索引大小和计算成本，同时保持了高检索性能和良好的泛化能力。

title: TQLite: Multi-LLM Jury Guided Distillation for Real-time MQM Translation Quality Evaluation
authors: Bhavin Jawade, Cameron R. Wolfe
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in MQM-based translation quality (TQ) evaluation, and recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) promise even greater improvements. However, both LLMs and LRMs are computationally expensive to deploy at scale, while small language models (SLMs)---though much more efficient---struggle with the complex reasoning required for evaluation tasks. In this work, we present an extensive empirical study benchmarking SLMs, LLMs, and LRMs across a wide range of TQ evaluation setups, providing a comprehensive view of the current landscape and establishing best practices. To address the scalability challenge, we introduce TQLite, a novel distillation framework that enables SLMs to approach the MQM evaluation performance of the best LRM-based evaluators. Our approach leverages a multi-LRM jury to generate high-quality synthetic training data via practical data curation techniques and aggregation of evaluation responses across a diverse panel of models. Our results demonstrate that SLMs trained via TQLite achieve strong MQM evaluation performance that far exceeds off-the-shelf evaluation capabilities of standard SLMs, offering a scalable and cost-effective alternative to LLM- and LRM-based evaluators.
zh_title: TQLite：多大模型陪审团指导的实时MQM翻译质量评估蒸馏方法
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在基于MQM的翻译质量（TQ）评估中表现出令人印象深刻的性能，大型推理模型（LRMs）的最新进展更承诺带来更大的改进。然而，LLM和LRM在大规模部署时的计算成本都很高，而小型语言模型（SLMs）虽然效率高得多，却难以应对评估任务所需的复杂推理。在这项工作中，我们进行了广泛的实证研究，对SLMs、LLMs和LRMs在各种TQ评估设置中进行了基准测试，提供了当前格局的全面视图并确立了最佳实践。为了应对可扩展性挑战，我们引入了TQLite，这是一个新颖的蒸馏框架，使SLMs能够接近基于LRM的最佳评估器的MQM评估性能。我们的方法利用多LRM陪审团，通过实际的数据策展技术和跨多样化模型面板的评估响应聚合，生成高质量的合成训练数据。我们的结果表明，通过TQLite训练的SLMs实现了强大的MQM评估性能，远远超过了标准SLMs的现成评估能力，为基于LLM和LRM的评估器提供了一个可扩展且具成本效益的替代方案。
tldr: 提出TQLite蒸馏框架，利用多大模型陪审团指导小模型训练，实现低成本且高效的实时MQM翻译质量评估。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种多大语言模型陪审团指导的小模型蒸馏框架（TQLite），有效解决了机器翻译质量评估中大模型计算成本高、小模型推理能力不足的矛盾，为实现实时、低成本的高质量翻译评估提供了切实可行的方案。
motivation: 大型语言模型和推理模型虽然在基于MQM的翻译质量评估中表现出色，但部署成本高昂；而小语言模型虽然高效，却缺乏完成复杂评估所需的推理能力，难以直接应用。
method: 提出TQLite蒸馏框架，利用多大推理模型（LRM）陪审团通过数据筛选技术和多模型响应聚合生成高质量合成训练数据，从而训练小语言模型（SLM）。
results: 经TQLite训练的小语言模型在MQM评估性能上显著超越了现有的标准小模型，达到了接近顶级大推理模型的效果，提供了一种可扩展且具有成本效益的替代方案。
conclusion: TQLite框架成功将大推理模型的复杂MQM评估能力蒸馏到小语言模型中，在大幅降低计算成本的同时保持了出色的评估性能。

title: Sequential Operational Decision-Making for Power System Resilience Under Evolving Wildfires
authors: Arastoo H Salimi, Majid Dehghani, Hamidreza Nazaripouya
abstract: This paper proposes a novel automated decision-support framework aimed at enhancing the resilience of power systems and operational resilience against wildfires by formulating the decision-making process as a stochastic multi-stage programming during a progressive wildfire. The paper develops a framework that takes into account both preventive and corrective actions, enabling automated and adaptive decisions based on potential scenarios over the course of a wildfire's progression. This approach considers the evolving nature of the wildfire threat and seeks to optimize the response strategies accordingly throughout its duration. The objective is to minimize wildfire risk and operational costs while reducing load curtailment. The framework accounts for potential contingencies caused by progressive wildfires. A novel algorithm is proposed to construct a decision tree based on wildfire progression and system geographical information. Additionally, a novel stochastic dual dynamic programming approach is deployed to solve the proposed optimization problem, achieving a global optimum for the framework. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated on the IEEE 30-bus system under various wildfire impact scenarios and is then applied to the IEEE 300-bus system to illustrate the scalability of the proposed approach. The results highlight the advantages of the proposed automated framework over a single-stage operational optimization strategy in enhancing power grid resilience under wildfire conditions.

title: Enhancing Operational Grid Resilience Against Wildfires Under Decision-Dependent Uncertainties
authors: Arastoo H Salimi, Hamidreza Nazaripouya
abstract: This paper proposes a new automated decision-making framework to enhance the resilience of electrical systems against wildfires by applying operational strategies that account for decision-dependent uncertainty (DDU). The proposed framework incorporates both preventive and corrective measures, enabling adaptive and automated decision-making throughout the course of evolving wildfire scenarios. First, a baseline multistage optimization model is presented as a foundation to support wildfire-driven operational decision-making. The model then incorporates DDU, wherein Public Safety Power Shutoff (PSPS) decisions made in earlier stages influence the probabilities and parameters of future wildfire scenarios. To efficiently solve the resulting complex optimization problem, a mathematical decomposition algorithm is employed. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated through case studies on the IEEE 30-bus system. Simulation results confirm that incorporating the impact of DDU into the optimization process provides more realistic, and operationally resilient solutions in the face of evolving wildfire threats.

title: Temporal Leakage in LLM Backtesting: Measurement, Validation, and Adjusted Scores
authors: Zeyu Zhang, Bradly C. Stadie
abstract: The standard check for contamination in LLM backtests is simple: compare scores before and after the training cutoff. We show this check is uninformative. Four flagship models fail it on questions they cannot have memorized: every scored question resolved after their cutoffs. The reason is structural. Models legitimately know more about times near their cutoff, so recency mimics leakage, and we prove no passive backtest can separate the two from genuine skill. Measurement, not just detection, requires information from outside the backtest. We supply it in two forms. A known cutoff identifies leakage at the boundary; a matched clean control identifies it globally and yields a leakage-adjusted score. We also derive where leakage hides: it concentrates on outcomes that surprised the crowd and were well covered in training, and partial memorization is disproportionately rewarded. We validate the estimators against ground truth by planting leakage in twin models, where they recover the injected dose and return null on clean questions. Deployed on frontier models, they detect one cutoff-localized signature and, at the audit's power floor, clear five models whose apparent advantages were recency alone. Backtests need not be discarded; they need one defensible reference.

title: Internalising the Identity Primitive: Cryptographic Individuality for an Autonomous Agent on a Public Blockchain
authors: Keisuke Suzuki
abstract: A software agent on a public blockchain accumulates authority and economic stakes, raising the engineering question of what makes it count as an individual. The paper's central contribution is a shift of trust root for the key-to-weights binding of agent identity: from hardware, operator, or wrapper trust to cryptographic assumptions enforced by a pinned implementation (liveness, key custody, oracle trust, and the underlying software stack remain external). We design and deploy on Solana devnet an agent whose neural-network weights are a deterministic function of its private key. The binding is committed in zero knowledge at genesis, re-checked against that commitment at every state transition, and signed by the agent into an on-chain history unforkable once finalized; in a PoC-tier extension, a protocol-imposed metabolic cost is debited each cycle from a key-derived economic account, adding a consumption-side economic-viability constraint to the key-history-economy triple. Empirically, the agent completes a 2.36-day on-chain run with two host-side resumptions but no rejected transition, at bounded per-transition verification cost; a substituted substrate is rejected on chain, and independently keyed agents diverge as predicted while a same-key control stays at zero. To our knowledge, this is the first published on-chain agent whose identity primitive is itself a cryptographic invariant re-checked at every state transition. The resulting transition-time invariant instantiates the cryptographic individuality proposed by Suzuki 2026's Artificial Externality framework.

title: CAMTA: A Reconfigurable Multi-Region Activation Unit for Nonlinear Function Approximation
authors: Carlos Soto-Porras, Jose Fonseca-Cruz, Pablo Ramirez-Morera, Erick Obregon-Fonseca, Luis G. Leon-Vega, Jorge Castro-Godinez
abstract: Nonlinear activation functions are widely used in machine learning workloads, but their direct hardware implementation is often costly, function-specific, or difficult to reuse across different models. This work introduces CAMTA, a 16-bit reconfigurable multi-region activation unit for nonlinear function approximation in FPGA and ASIC accelerators. CAMTA combines independent region thresholds, per-region polynomial degrees, coefficient sets, and execution modes over a shared Horner-based datapath. Unlike conventional polynomial or piecewise approximation units that mainly reconfigure coefficients or segment selection, CAMTA also reconfigures the computational behavior of each region through HORNER, CONST, ZERO, and IDENTITY modes, enabling the same hardware to support functions with different symmetry and tail behavior without resynthesis. FPGA validation on an AMD Alveo platform shows RMSE as low as \(3.60\times10^{-6}\) for CAMTA-assisted Softmax, outperforming the CORDIC-based Softmax baseline considered in this work by nearly one order of magnitude. FPGA HLS synthesis reports 3 DSPs, 802 FFs, 1756 LUTs, and an 11-cycle datapath latency. ASIC synthesis in TSMC 65~nm at 250~MHz reports \(6632.40~μ\mathrm{m}^2\) total cell area and \(1.3634~\mathrm{mW}\) total power. Compared with a same-node, function-specific PLAC implementation, CAMTA incurs \(2.20\times\) area and \(1.75\times\) power overhead, in exchange for runtime configurability and reuse across multiple nonlinear functions.

title: AcceptMoE: Commitment-Weighted Self-Sizing Verifier Expert Sets for Efficient MoE Speculative Decoding
authors: Shuang Liang, Chen, Zhiwen Mo, Qianzhou Wang, Guoyu Li, Lingxiao Ma, Wayne Luk
abstract: Speculative decoding verifies a tree of draft tokens in one target-model forward pass. For a mixture-of-experts (MoE) target, however, parallel verification can activate the union of the experts selected by all tree nodes, even though only a small subset of those nodes reaches the accepted output. Token count, activated-expert union size, and expert-weight traffic are therefore distinct cost measures: reducing the token workload need not shrink the expert union proportionally, and under offloading, transfer traffic also depends on cache residency. We introduce AcceptMoE, a verifier-side expert selector that combines target-router scores with offline-estimated commitment probabilities and automatically adjusts the number of eligible experts for each verification block, eliminating the need for a user-specified expert budget. Under offloading, AcceptMoE conditions expert eligibility on cache residency instead of predicting natural routes and prefetching the corresponding expert weights. Although constraining target-expert eligibility changes the model distribution, across 12 model-task pairs spanning three MoE targets and four benchmarks, AcceptMoE's mean accuracy is 0.27 percentage points lower than that of EAGLE-3 speculative decoding with natural routing. Served with SGLang at batch size one, it reaches 1.290 times the throughput of this baseline with all expert weights in GPU memory, and 2.06 times under physical expert offloading, while reducing host-to-device traffic by 73.6 percent to 77.1 percent.

title: Qwen-3D: A Generalist 3D Vision-Language Model for Spatial Understanding
authors: Lucy Lin, Ayush Jain, Yifan Liu, Katerina Fragkiadaki
abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have achieved remarkable success on images and short videos, yet scaling them to long videos remains challenging due to frame-centric tokenization and limited context windows. 3D geometry provides a natural compression mechanism for visual streams: depth and camera pose enable observations from multiple views and time steps to be fused into a persistent, world-aligned representation. While recent 3D LMMs leverage geometry-aware representations to improve spatial reasoning, they continue to lag behind specialist 3D perception systems on grounding and segmentation tasks. We argue that a key limitation is geometry-aware decoding: existing methods communicate 3D predictions through language tokens, proposal selection, or lightweight grounding queries, creating a bottleneck between language reasoning and dense geometric prediction. Building on these insights, we introduce Qwen-3D, a geometry-aware LMM that compresses visual information within the Qwen backbone using multi-view geometric cues, enabling efficient long-horizon visual reasoning over static scenes. Qwen-3D augments visual tokens with 3D Rotary Positional Embeddings, allowing attention to operate directly in 3D scene space rather than across independent image frames and thereby facilitating scalable cross-view and temporal reasoning. To bridge language and geometry, Qwen-3D incorporates a query-based segmentation decoder that grounds language directly in the underlying 3D scene representation, unifying referential grounding, instance segmentation, and visual question answering across both images and videos. Across a diverse set of benchmarks, Qwen-3D surpasses existing 3D LMMs and outperforms several large proprietary 2D models. Notably, Qwen-3D achieves these improvements while maintaining strong performance on standard 2D vision-language benchmarks by jointly training on 2D and 3D data.

title: EmbodiedVAE: Disentangled Video VAE for Efficient and Controllable Embodied Manipulation
authors: Jiayi Luo, Hanxin Zhu, Chen Gao, Jiankun Wang, Cong Wang, Tianyu He, Jianxin Li, Zhibo Chen
abstract: Latent diffusion models (LDMs) have recently significantly advanced embodied learning in constructing powerful embodied manipulation world models. However, despite the remarkable performance, existing LDMs predominantly rely on Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) optimized for natural scenes while failing to account for the unique characteristics of embodied manipulation scenarios, yielding latent representations that are neither compact nor controllable, thereby hindering efficient training of LDMs and precise robotic control. To solve this problem, we present EmbodiedVAE, a novel video VAE that provides compact yet controllable latent representations tailored for the robotic manipulation world models. Specifically, EmbodiedVAE adopts a dual-encoder, single-decoder architecture with an asymmetric spatio-temporal compression module, which automatically disentangles the robot arm's motion from background environment, resulting in overall compactness while providing explicit embodied latent to support fine-grained action control. To further preserve the temporal consistency of learned robotic motion latent, we introduce an optimal-transport-based consistency module that explicitly enforces motion fidelity and inter-frame coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed EmbodiedVAE achieves superior reconstruction quality with high compression rate, while enabling more precise action control in robotic manipulation scenarios with an average of 2dB PSNR improvement over state-of-the-art video VAEs.

title: Joint Affine Spectral Shaping: Coupling Weight and Bias Updates Beyond Weight-Only Muon
authors: Gongyue Zhang, Honghai Liu
abstract: Matrix spectral optimizers reshape weight-update spectra but usually delegate vector-valued biases to a separate optimizer. We study whether this separation is neutral. We formulate each affine layer as a joint momentum matrix $A=[M_W,αm_b]$ and apply a capped regularized-inverse spectral map to the complete matrix, producing both the weight and physical bias updates. A strict five-seed ablation on a four-layer BERT-mini trained from scratch on IMDb compares exact-SVD Muon, weight-only inverse shaping, affine-probe inverse shaping, and the proposed joint regularized inverse (JRI). Weight-only inverse shaping raises validation-loss-selected test accuracy from $84.903\pm0.242\%$ to $85.562\pm0.308\%$ and lowers selected test loss from $0.3479$ to $0.3345$. Allowing bias to alter the joint SVD while retaining an independent Adam bias update does not improve over weight-only inverse shaping. Using the transformed bias jointly raises selected test accuracy to $85.738\pm0.180\%$ and lowers test loss to $0.3291$, with all five seeds improving relative to the probe baseline. During the peak-performance window, JRI preserves the eligible weight-update norm while reducing the bias-update norm from $0.02095$ to $0.00301$, lowers boundary-function share from $86.58\%$ to $78.97\%$, and changes the cosine between weight-induced boundary motion and explicit bias from $+0.030$ to $-0.137$. An independent 22-seed replication yields $85.743\pm0.203\%$ selected test accuracy. These results identify joint affine spectral allocation as a small but consistent extension to weight-only spectral optimization.

title: Neurosymbolic Reasoning with Incremental Knowledge for Sample Efficient Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
authors: Subrat Prasad Panda, Blaise Genest, Arvind Easwaran
abstract: (Flat) Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents face significant challenges in environments with sparse rewards that require long-horizon reasoning. A compelling approach to improve sample efficiency is to incorporate knowledge into learning and decision-making. In standard Hierarchical RL (HRL), knowledge is encoded in a fixed, non-updatable form, such as architectural choices, and remains unchanged throughout learning. With fixed HRL, reasoning with incremental knowledge learned during exploration is impractical before sufficient environmental knowledge is acquired, leading to poor sample efficiency. In this work, we propose neurosymbolic HRL with {\em Incremental Knowledge (InK)}: symbolic high-level components perform {\em symbolic planning} (e.g. using $D^*$) on an updatable representation of current InK, while low-level goal-conditioned neural modules learn motion primitives through experience using reward shaping. Experiments on navigation tasks demonstrate that incorporating InK substantially improves sample efficiency. Additionally, to perform {\em optimal} symbolic planning given {\em prior} knowledge about the world, we develop Belief World Tree Search. The code is available at https://github.com/CPS-research-group/ink_bwts.
zh_title: 基于增量知识的高效样本分层强化学习神经符号推理
translation: （平面）强化学习（RL）智能体在需要长航程推理的稀疏奖励环境中面临巨大挑战。提高样本效率的一种有效方法是将知识融合到学习和决策中。在标准分层强化学习（HRL）中，知识是以固定的、不可更新的形式（例如架构选择）进行编码的，并在整个学习过程中保持不变。采用固定 HRL 时，在获取足够的环境知识之前，利用探索期间学到的增量知识进行推理是不切实际的，从而导致样本效率低下。在这项工作中，我们提出了具有增量知识（InK）的神经符号 HRL：高层符号组件在当前 InK 的可更新表示上执行符号规划（例如使用 $D^*$），而低层目标条件神经网络模块通过经验和奖励重塑学习运动原语。导航任务的实验表明，引入 InK 显著提高了样本效率。此外，为了在给定世界先验知识的情况下执行最优符号规划，我们开发了 Belief World Tree Search（信念世界树搜索）。代码见 https://github.com/CPS-research-group/ink_bwts。
tldr: 提出了带有增量知识（InK）的神经符号分层强化学习框架，利用可更新的符号规划与低层神经控制提升长航程任务的样本效率。
ai_comments: 本文巧妙地结合了符号规划的知识增量更新能力与神经网络的低层控制能力，有效解决了分层强化学习在长航程、稀疏奖励环境下知识固定导致样本效率差的痛点。创新性在于引入动态可更新的增量知识（InK）与 Belief World Tree Search。局限性在于目前实验仅在导航任务上进行了验证，在更大规模或高维连续动作空间中的泛化能力尚需进一步评估。
motivation: 传统分层强化学习（HRL）通常将知识硬编码为固定的、不可更新的形式，无法在探索过程中利用新获取的增量知识进行推理，导致在稀疏奖励和需要长航程推理的环境中样本效率极其低下。
method: 提出了带有增量知识（InK）的神经符号分层强化学习框架：高层符号组件基于动态可更新的 InK 表示进行符号规划（如使用 $D^*$ 算法）；低层目标条件神经网络模块通过经验和奖励重塑（reward shaping）学习运动原语。此外，还开发了 Belief World Tree Search 算法，用于在已知世界先验知识的情况下执行最优符号规划。

title: On the missing benchmarks layer and a potential solution
authors: Francis F Daniel, Mauro Ibañez, Francis Perelman, Marian Basti
abstract: Latin America is missing a foundational layer for native AI development: the benchmark layer. The benchmark layer does two things no other layer can - it audits AI systems against regional social requirements and it directs AI optimization in economically relevant environments. Without it, public institutions cannot independently evaluate foreign AI systems, and companies cannot optimize AI systems to solve local problems with SOTA performance. The cost of the missing layer is dual: a loss of auditability and a loss of optimization direction over a technology that is increasingly critical infrastructure. We propose an EvalsHub, with LatamBoard as its first regional instance - an open, task-first benchmark infrastructure where universities, public institutions, professional communities, and companies can publish, execute, compare, and maintain evaluations across models, workflows, and agents. Built once, measured forever - re-run by institutions as new AI systems ship and by industry teams after every system change. Open by design and incentive-driven by construction.
zh_title: 论缺失的基准测试层及一种潜在解决方案
translation: 拉丁美洲缺乏本土人工智能发展的奠基性图层：基准测试层。基准测试层能完成其他任何层级都无法实现的两件事——根据区域社会需求审计AI系统，以及在具有经济相关性的环境中指导AI优化。没有它，公共机构就无法独立评估外国AI系统，公司也无法优化AI系统以通过SOTA性能解决本地问题。缺失该层级的代价是双重的：对于日益成为关键基础设施的技术，既失去了可审计性，也失去了优化方向。为此，我们提出了 EvalsHub 及其首个区域实例 LatamBoard——这是一个开放的、任务优先的基准测试基础设施，大学、公共机构、专业社区和公司可以在其中跨模型、工作流和智能体发布、执行、比较和维护评估。一次构建，永久测量——在新的AI系统发布时由机构重新运行，在每次系统变更后由行业团队重新运行。设计上保持开放，构造上由激励驱动。
tldr: 本文针对拉丁美洲缺乏本土AI基准测试层的问题，提出了开放式基准基础设施EvalsHub及其区域实例LatamBoard。
ai_comments: 本文切中了AI生态中常被忽略的“基准评估本土化”问题，强调了对特定区域社会需求和经济环境进行AI审计与优化的重要性。提出的EvalsHub和LatamBoard构想具有很高的实用与区域治理价值。局限在于摘要中未提供具体的实证评估数据或运行成效，其激励机制与跨机构协作的落地细节仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 拉丁美洲缺乏本土AI发展的基准测试层，导致公共机构无法独立评估外国AI系统，企业也无法针对本地需求优化AI系统，面临失去审计能力与优化方向的双重风险。
method: 提出了 EvalsHub 及其首个区域实例 LatamBoard——一个开放、任务优先的基准测试基础设施，支持大学、公共机构、专业社区和企业跨模型、工作流和智能体发布、执行、比较与维护评估。

conclusion: 构建如LatamBoard这样的本土化开放评估基础设施，是解决区域AI审计缺失与优化方向迷失的可行且必要的解决方案。

title: SparSEEty: Extracting Tokens from Sparsity-Exploiting LLM Serving Systems via Deterministic Side Channels
authors: Yongwan Jo, Jinyoung Park, Euihyun Lee, Dokyung Song
abstract:
Modern large language models (LLMs) exhibit activation sparsity, wherein only a subset of their neurons is activated for given input tokens. Researchers have leveraged this property to optimize LLM serving systems by omitting weight accesses and computations pertaining to inactive neurons. Unfortunately, however, such optimizations create input-dependent weight accesses, which can be leaked over side channels.
  We present SparSEEty, a new token extraction attack that exploits input-dependent neuron weight accesses introduced by sparsity-exploiting LLM serving systems. SparSEEty first constructs a neuron-activation oracle using neuron weight access side channels during LLM inference, and then inverts the activation traces to reconstruct the input tokens, forming an end-to-end token extraction attack. We instantiate SparSEEty against an LLM serving system protected inside an Intel TDX confidential virtual machine (CVM), addressing three key challenges: (i) constructing a neuron-activation oracle using a combination of side channels exposed by CVMs, (ii) reducing inference-time overheads of neuron activation monitoring for covertness, and (iii) accurately inverting partial binary activation traces back to tokens. Our evaluation shows that SparSEEty can reconstruct both prompt and response tokens with consistently high BLEU scores (>0.95) across various models and datasets, while incurring monitoring overheads of 3.7% to 7.2%.
zh_title: SparSEEty：通过确定性侧信道从利用稀疏性的LLM服务系统中提取Token
translation:
现代大语言模型（LLM）表现出激活稀疏性，即对于给定的输入Token，只有一部分神经元会被激活。研究人员利用这一特性，通过省略与未激活神经元相关的权重访问和计算来优化LLM服务系统。然而不幸的是，这种优化创造了依赖输入的权重访问模式，可能会通过侧信道泄露。
我们提出了 SparSEEty，一种新的 Token 提取攻击，它利用了由稀疏性优化 LLM 服务系统引入的依赖于输入的神经元权重访问。SparSEEty 首先在 LLM 推理过程中利用神经元权重访问侧信道构建神经元激活预言机，然后逆向分析激活轨迹以重构输入 Token，形成端到端的 Token 提取攻击。我们在保护于 Intel TDX 机密虚拟机（CVM）内部的 LLM 服务系统上实例化了 SparSEEty，解决了三个关键挑战：（i）利用 CVM 暴露的侧信道组合构建神经元激活预言机；（ii）降低神经元激活监测的推理时间开销以保持隐蔽性；（iii）将部分二进制激活轨迹准确地逆向还原为 Token。我们的评估表明，SparSEEty 在各种模型和数据集上重构提示词（prompt）和响应（response）Token 时均能保持极高的 BLEU 得分（>0.95），同时产生的监测开销仅为 3.7% 至 7.2%。
tldr: SparSEEty利用稀疏性优化LLM服务系统中的神经元权重访问侧信道，在Intel TDX机密虚拟机中实现了高准确率（BLEU>0.95）的端到端Token提取攻击。
ai_comments:
创新性：首次将针对大语言模型稀疏性推理优化的输入依赖性权重访问转化为端到端的Token提取攻击，填补了该领域的安全研究空白。
重要性：揭示了即使在Intel TDX等硬件机密虚拟机（CVM）强防护环境下，系统级优化（稀疏性加速）仍可能通过侧信道引入严重的隐私泄露风险，对LLM隐私保护与机密计算系统设计具有重要警示价值。
局限性：攻击依赖于服务系统开启激活稀疏性优化以及存在可利用的确定性侧信道，在未采用稀疏性优化的传统系统或部署了侧信道防御措施的环境中可能难以实施。
motivation: 现代LLM服务系统常利用激活稀疏性（仅部分神经元被激活）来跳过未激活神经元的权重访问和计算，以提升推理效率。然而，这种优化造成了依赖于输入的权重访问模式，容易通过侧信道泄露用户隐私信息。
method: SparSEEty攻击方法包含两个核心步骤：首先，在LLM推理过程中利用Intel TDX机密虚拟机（CVM）暴露的侧信道组合构建神经元激活预言机（Oracle），实现低开销（3.7%–7.2%）的神经元权重访问监测；其次，将收集到的部分二进制神经元激活轨迹准确地逆向映射还原为原始的输入与输出Token。
results: 实验评估表明，SparSEEty在多种LLM模型和数据集上均能实现端到端的Token提取，重构提示词（Prompt）和响应（Response）Token的BLEU得分均持续保持在0.95以上的高水平，同时仅引入3.7%至7.2%的低推理运行开销。
conclusion: 利用激活稀疏性优化的大语言模型服务系统会因依赖输入的神经元权重访问而引入严重的侧信道漏洞，使得攻击者能够在机密计算环境下以极高准确率提取出用户的敏感文本Token。

title: On the Non-Specificity of Statistical Measures Used in Script Decipherment
authors: Nikhil Raghavendra
abstract: Statistical regularities are routinely offered as evidence that undeciphered sign systems encode language; the Indus script debate is the canonical example. Any such inference rests on specificity: the reported outcome must be unusual among plausible structured non-languages. We test that premise constructively with SIGIL, a purpose-built generative emblem system whose 3,000-text core corpus carries explicit compositional meanings although no sign has a phonological value. A literature registry compiled in advance of evaluation records 54 methods and admits a method to exact scoring when both the published Indus outcome and a source-defined decision rule can be reproduced. SIGIL receives the same category as the Indus corpus on every criterion scored this way, across repetition, directional-asymmetry, and lexical-distribution tests. Declared reconstructions of entropy, frequency, positional, predictive, classifier, and network measures reproduce the familiar Indus-like signatures as well. A sequential decipherment stress test then reaches high dictionary coverage for English, Sanskrit, and Tamil on the same corpus, while grouped held-out declines and unstable keys reveal how little that coverage identifies. The construction does not decide what the Indus signs encode: it shows that the evaluated measures detect organization without being specific to language, and therefore cannot, on their own, establish encoded speech.
zh_title: 论文字破译中所用统计度量的非特异性
translation: 统计规律常被用作未破译符号系统记录了语言的证据，印度河文字争议就是典型例子。任何此类推论都建立在特异性之上：报告的结果在合理的结构化非语言系统中必须是罕见的。我们通过 SIGIL 建设性地检验了这一前提，SIGIL 是一个专门构建的生成式徽章系统，其 3000 个文本的核心语料库具有明确的组合含义，尽管没有任何符号具有语音价值。评估前编译的文献注册表记录了 54 种方法，当已发表的印度河文字结果和源定义的决策规则均可复现时，允许对方法进行精确打分。在通过这种方式打分的每一项标准上（跨越重复、方向不对称性和词汇分布测试），SIGIL 都获得了与印度河文字语料库相同的分类。熵、频率、位置、预测、分类器和网络度量的明确重构也重现了熟悉的类似印度河文字的特征。随后进行的顺序破译压力测试在同一语料库上对英语、梵语和泰米尔语达到了很高的字典覆盖率，而分组保留率下降和不稳定的密钥揭示了这种覆盖率所能识别的东西多么微乎其微。该构建并没有确定印度河符号编码了什么：它表明评估的度量方法可以检测组织结构，但对语言并不具有特异性，因此仅凭它们自身无法确立编码的语音。
tldr: 本文通过构建无语音的符号系统 SIGIL 证明，破译古文字常用的统计度量指标仅能检测符号系统的组织性而缺乏语言特异性，不能单独作为符号编码了人类语言的证据。
ai_comments: 本文创新性极强，通过构建生成式非语言符号系统 SIGIL 进行“反向对照实验”，有力地挑战了古文字破译领域长期依赖统计指标证明“符号即语言”的范式。研究逻辑严密，对 54 种统计方法及破译测试进行了全面评估，对古文字学、计算语言学及信息论在符号系统中的应用具有重要的批判性指导意义。
motivation: 统计规律常被用作未破译符号系统编码了人类语言的证据（如印度河文字争议）。这种推论依赖于“特异性”前提——即该统计特征在非语言结构系统中是罕见的。本文旨在通过构造性方法检验这一前提是否成立。
method: 构建了一个专用的生成式徽章系统 SIGIL（包含 3,000 个文本的核心语料库，具有结构化语义但无语音价值），并汇集文献中 54 种用于分析印度河文字的统计方法，在 SIGIL 语料库上复现并测试这些度量指标（包括重复性、方向不对称性、词汇分布、熵、预测、网络度量等），同时进行了顺序破译压力测试。
results: SIGIL 在所有精准评分的评估标准上均获得了与印度河文字语料库完全相同的分类，并重现了类似的熵、频率、位置、预测及网络特征；在破译压力测试中甚至对英语、梵语和泰米尔语达到了高字典覆盖率，但保留测试性能下降和不稳定密钥揭示了这种覆盖率的虚假性。
conclusion: 研究表明，评估的统计度量只能检测符号系统的组织结构，而不具备语言特异性，因此不能仅凭统计指标本身来确立符号系统编码了人类语言。

title: ProPRL: Property-Aware Prerequisite Relation Learning in Educational Knowledge Graphs
authors: Xinghe Cheng, Jiapu Wang, Chaobo He, Ruihai Dong, Quanlong Guan
abstract: Prerequisite relation learning is central to adaptive instruction, yet existing methods often formulate it as conventional link prediction, limiting their ability to adaptively integrate complementary educational evidence for individual candidate pairs and to discourage contradictory reverse predictions. We propose ProPRL, a Property-aware Prerequisite Relation Learning framework. ProPRL first learns complementary concept representations from a concept-resource hypergraph and a directed learning-behavior graph, where direction-preserving personalized propagation aggregates multi-hop behavioral evidence. It then employs a Pair-conditioned Gate to adaptively weight and fuse the two views for each candidate ordered concept pair. Finally, an \textit{Irreversibility Constraint} introduces an anti-symmetry regularizer that penalizes simultaneously high confidence in both directions of the same concept pair. Experiments on multiple real-world educational datasets show that ProPRL achieves state-of-the-art performance on prerequisite relation learning.
zh_title: ProPRL：教育知识图谱中感知属性的先修关系学习
translation: 先修关系学习对于自适应教学至关重要，然而现有方法通常将其归结为传统的链接预测，这限制了它们为特定候选概念对自适应整合互补教育证据的能力，也无法抑制矛盾的反向预测。为此，我们提出了ProPRL——一种感知属性的先修关系学习框架。ProPRL首先从概念-资源超图和有向学习行为图中学习互补的概念表示，其中保持方向的个性化传播聚合了多跳行为证据。随后，它采用成对条件门控为每个候选有序概念对自适应地加权并融合这两个视图。最后，不可逆约束引入了一个反对称正则化器，惩罚同一概念对在两个方向上同时具有高置信度的情况。在多个真实教育数据集上的实验表明，ProPRL在先修关系学习上达到了最先进的性能。
tldr: ProPRL通过整合超图与行为图的多视图表示、自适应门控融合及反对称不可逆约束，实现了教育知识图谱中精准的先修关系预测。
ai_comments: ProPRL创新性地解决了先修关系学习中的两大痛点：多视角教育证据的自适应融合以及先修关系不可逆（非对称）属性的约束。通过引入对偶视图学习、成对条件门控和不可逆性正则化，显著提升了关系的推断准确性。局限性在于摘要未透露其在异构图和超图构建上的计算复杂度及对稀疏数据的鲁棒性。
motivation: 先修关系学习对于自适应教学至关重要，但现有方法常将其简化为传统的链接预测，限制了其为特定候选概念对自适应整合互补教育证据的能力，且无法有效抑制矛盾的反向预测。
method: 提出ProPRL框架：1）从概念-资源超图和有向学习行为图中学习互补的概念表示，利用保持方向的个性化传播聚合多跳行为证据；2）采用成对条件门控（Pair-conditioned Gate）为每个候选有序概念对自适应地加权融合双视图表示；3）引入不可逆约束（Irreversibility Constraint）作为反对称正则化器，惩罚同概念对双向同时具备高置信度的情况。
results: 在多个真实世界教育数据集上的实验表明，ProPRL在先修关系学习任务上取得了SOTA（最先进）的性能。
conclusion: ProPRL框架通过感知先修关系的结构与行为属性，有效克服了传统链接预测方法的局限，为教育知识图谱中的先修关系建模提供了更精准高效的解决方案。

title: A Wearable Stiffness-Rendering Haptic Device with a Honeycomb Jamming Mechanism for Bilateral Teleoperation
authors: Thomas M. Kwok, Bohan Zhang, Wai Tuck Chow
abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of providing kinesthetic feedback in bilateral teleoperation by designing a wearable, lightweight (20 g), and compact haptic device, the HJ-Haptic, utilizing a honeycomb jamming mechanism for object stiffness rendering. The HJ-Haptic device can vary its stiffness, from 1.15 N/mm to 2.64 N/mm, using a 30 kPa vacuum pressure. We demonstrate its implementation in a teleoperation framework, enabling operators to adjust grip force based on a reliable haptic feedback on object stiffness. A three-point flexural test on the honeycomb jamming mechanism and teleoperated object-grasping tasks were conducted to evaluate the device's functionality. Our experiments demonstrated a small RMSE and strong correlations in teleoperated motion, stiffness rendering, and interaction force feedback. The HJ-Haptic effectively adjusts its stiffness in response to real-time gripper feedback, mimicking the sensation of direct object grasping with hands. The device's use of vacuum pressure ensures operator safety by preventing dangerous outcomes in case of gas leakage or material failure. Incorporating the HJ-Haptic into the teleoperation framework provided the reliable perception of object stiffness and stable teleoperation. This study highlights the potential of the honeycomb jamming mechanism for enhancing haptic feedback in various applications, including teleoperation scenarios, as well as interactions with extended-reality environments.
zh_title: 基于蜂窝阻塞机制用于双向遥操作的可穿戴刚度渲染力触觉设备
translation: 本文针对双向遥操作中提供动觉反馈的挑战，设计了一款利用蜂窝阻塞机制进行物体刚度渲染的轻量化（20 g）、紧凑型可穿戴力触觉设备——HJ-Haptic。HJ-Haptic设备在30 kPa真空压力下，刚度可在1.15 N/mm至2.64 N/mm之间变化。我们在遥操作框架中演示了其应用，使操作员能够基于可靠的物体刚度触觉反馈来调整抓握力。通过对蜂窝阻塞机制进行三点弯曲测试以及遥操作物体抓取任务，对设备的功能进行了评估。实验结果表明，在遥操作运动、刚度渲染和交互力反馈方面均表现出较小的均方根误差（RMSE）和强相关性。HJ-Haptic能根据机械爪的实时反馈有效调节自身刚度，模拟人用手直接抓取物体时的感觉。设备对真空压力的使用确保了操作员的安全，防止了气体泄漏或材料失效时的危险后果。将HJ-Haptic引入遥操作框架中，提供了可靠的物体刚度感知和稳定的遥操作能力。本研究突出了蜂窝阻塞机制在提升包括遥操作场景及扩展现实环境交互在内的多种应用中触觉反馈的潜力。
tldr: 设计了一种仅重20克的蜂窝阻塞式可穿戴触觉设备，可在遥操作中通过负压实时改变刚度，提供安全可靠的物体刚度触觉反馈。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将蜂窝结构与阻塞机制（jamming mechanism）相结合，开发出仅重20克的轻量化穿戴式力触觉设备（HJ-Haptic），解决了遥操作中动觉反馈设备通常过于笨重或安全性不足的问题。使用负压控制保证了操作员的人身安全。局限性在于其刚度变化范围（1.15 N/mm至2.64 N/mm）相对有限，可能难以模拟极高刚度物体的触感。
motivation: 解决双向遥操作中难以向操作员提供轻量、便携、安全且可靠的动觉与物体刚度触觉反馈的问题。
method: 提出了采用蜂窝阻塞机制的触觉设备（HJ-Haptic），重约20克，利用30 kPa的真空负压可将刚度从1.15 N/mm调节至2.64 N/mm；通过三点弯曲测试评估其力学特性，并在物体抓取遥操作实验中对其运动、刚度渲染与交互力反馈能力进行了评估。
results: 遥操作运动、刚度渲染和交互力反馈的实测数据表现出较小的均方根误差（RMSE）和强相关性；设备能根据抓握反馈实时调整刚度，模拟直接手握物体的感觉，且负压工作机制确保了气体泄漏时的操作安全性。
conclusion: 将HJ-Haptic集成到双向遥操作框架中能够提供可靠的物体刚度感知和稳定的遥操作体验，证明了蜂窝阻塞机制在遥操作及扩展现实（XR）交互中的广泛应用潜力。

title: The Ground Is Shifting: A Reflection on the Foundations of Software Measurement
authors: Thomas Bock, Audris Mockus, Bogdan Vasilescu
abstract: For most of the past six decades, software measurement relied on labor-intensive manual collection of proprietary data, which hampered progress. The shift to repurposing traces from version control and related tools dramatically expanded data availability$\unicode{x2014}$especially with the rise of open-source software$\unicode{x2014}$but hinged on an often unstated assumption: that these tools are used by professional developers to build genuine software systems. However, as trace-generating tools, data types and scale, and empirical methods have all evolved, it has become clear that changes in data generation and analytical approaches affect many prior findings about software development, maintenance, and evolution. With AI agents now actively using these same tools, the resulting traces frequently violate the original assumption of human origin. To preserve the relevance of software measurement research, immediate action is needed: We must detect when foundational assumptions are violated in contemporary data and develop new methodologies that remain valid under changed circumstances. To this end, we propose a systematic AI-assisted replication program that revisits key findings using modern techniques, aiming for methods that yield consistent results on current data to keep software measurement meaningful.
comment: Accepted to the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE '26) $\unicode{0x000A}$ DOI: https://doi.org/10.1145/3832783.3834553
zh_title: 基础正在动摇：对软件度量基础的反思
translation: 在过去近六十年的大部分时间里，软件度量依赖于高耗能的专有数据人工收集，这阻碍了学科进展。向重用版本控制及相关工具轨迹数据的转变极大地扩展了数据的可用性——尤其是随着开源软件的兴起——但这一转变依赖于一个通常未经声明的假设：即这些工具是由专业开发者用于构建真实的软件系统的。然而，随着轨迹生成工具、数据类型与规模以及实证方法的演进，显而易见的是，数据生成和分析方法的变化影响了许多以往关于软件开发、维护和演进的发现。随着AI Agent现在积极使用这些相同的工具，由此产生的轨迹频繁打破了最初关于“人类来源”的假设。为了保持软件度量研究的相关性，需要立即采取行动：我们必须检测当代数据中基础假设何时被破坏，并开发在改变的情况下依然有效的新方法论。为此，我们提出了一个系统化的AI辅助复现计划，利用现代技术重新审视关键发现，旨在获得能在当前数据上产生一致结果的方法，以保持软件度量的现实意义。
tldr: 本文反思了软件度量的基础假设，指出AI Agent参与导致的假设失效影响了传统结论，并提出了系统化的AI辅助复现计划以重建有效的软件度量体系。
ai_comments: 本文洞察敏锐，紧扣当前大语言模型与AI Agent在软件工程领域广泛应用的时代背景。它深刻指出了AI生成代码与轨迹数据对传统软件工程实证研究基础假设的冲击，具有极高的理论警示意义与实践导向价值。提出的“AI辅助复现计划”为重新验证和更新软件度量学体系指明了可行路径。
motivation: 随着开源软件演进以及AI Agent广泛参与软件开发，数据生成和分析方式发生了剧烈变化，导致“轨迹数据源于专业人类开发者”这一传统软件度量的基础假设频繁失效，以往的许多研究结论可能不再成立。
method: 提出一个系统化的AI辅助复现计划（systematic AI-assisted replication program），利用现代技术重新审视历史上的关键发现，并开发在改变的环境下依然有效的新方法论。
results: 阐明了数据生成工具和AI参与对现有软件度量有效性的冲击，并确立了通过系统化复现以确保度量结果在现代数据下保持一致性和有意义性的路线。
conclusion: 为了维持软件度量研究的相关性与意义，必须立即检测当代数据中基础假设失效的情况，并通过系统化的复现计划与现代技术开发出在当前环境下依然有效的新度量方法。

title: A Graph Signal Processing Perspective on Numerical Sequence Representations in LLM In-Context Learning
authors: Jiajun Bao, Zihao Qi, Toni J.B. Liu, Gurbir Arora, Raphaël Sarfati, Nicolas Boullé, Christopher J. Earls
abstract: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated in-context learning (ICL) capabilities for numerical inference over sequences serialized as text. Prior work has identified and characterized this form of numerical inference primarily through output-level evaluations such as prediction error. However, how numerical information is organized within LLM representations remains much less understood. To study this internal organization, we adopt a graph signal processing perspective in which attention induces a weighted graph over tokens, while token hidden states define signals on its nodes. Quantitative graph-spectral diagnostics and qualitative token-graph visualizations reveal that representations become more clearly differentiated by input dynamical complexity as context length increases. Simpler inputs produce attention-induced token graphs with stronger global connectivity and smoother, spectrally concentrated hidden-state signals, whereas more complex inputs produce more localized graphs and hidden-state signals with broader spectral support and greater high-frequency energy. Together, these findings point to systematic, context-dependent internal signatures associated with numerical ICL that are conserved across model families.
zh_title: 图信号处理视角下的大语言模型上下文学习数值序列表示研究
translation: 预训练大语言模型（LLM）已展现出对序列化为文本的数值进行上下文学习（ICL）推理的能力。先前的工作主要通过预测误差等输出层面的评估来识别和表征这种数值推理形式。然而，数值信息在LLM内部表征中是如何组织的，目前了解甚少。为了研究这一内部组织结构，我们引入了图信号处理的视角：其中注意力机制诱导出一个作用于词元上的加权图，而词元的隐藏状态则定义了图节点上的信号。定量图谱诊断与定性词元图可视化表明，随着上下文长度的增加，内部表征会根据输入动力学复杂度产生更清晰的分化。较简单的输入会产生具有更强全局连通性以及更平滑、频谱更集中的隐藏状态信号的注意力图；而较复杂的输入则产生更局部化的图以及具有更宽频谱支持和更高高频能量的隐藏状态信号。总之，这些发现揭示了与数值ICL相关的、跨模型家族保守的系统性且依赖于上下文的内部特征。
tldr: 本文利用图信号处理视角，揭示了LLM在数值上下文学习中，注意力图结构和隐藏状态信号如何随输入复杂度发生系统性变化。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将图信号处理（GSP）理论引入大语言模型（LLM）的可解释性研究中，从内部表征和注意力机制构成的图结构出发，揭示了模型处理不同复杂度的数值序列时的内部信号特征。这种跨领域的分析方法为理解LLM的上下文学习机制提供了全新的视角，且结论在不同模型家族间具有一致性。局限性在于目前分析主要集中于数值序列推理，未来可进一步拓展至更复杂的非数值文本推理任务。
motivation: 此前关于大模型在文本序列上进行数值推理的研究主要集中于输出层面的评估（如预测误差），而对于数值信息在LLM内部表征中是如何组织的，目前仍缺乏深刻理解。
method: 引入图信号处理（GSP）视角，将注意力矩阵视为词元（token）构成的加权图，将词元的隐藏状态视为图节点上的信号；结合定量图谱诊断与定性词元图可视化进行内部表征分析。
results: 随着上下文长度增加，内部表征会根据输入的动力学复杂度产生更清晰的分化：较简单的输入会产生全局连通性更强、更平滑且频谱更集中的图与信号；而较复杂的输入则产生局部化更强、频谱支持更宽且高频能量更高的图与信号。
conclusion: 数值上下文学习（ICL）存在系统性且依赖于上下文的内部表征特征，并且这些特征在不同的模型家族中具有保守性（通用性）。

title: Tiny Enough to Break In: Agentic Remote Access Trojans Powered by Small Language Models
authors: Yuhan You, Suhas Adavelly, Victoria Lovelace, Cameron Berryman, Joel Sadler, Daniel Graham
abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence raises a new security concern: cyber threats that reason, act, and adapt locally without continuous human direction. We examine this threat through an Agentic Remote Access Trojan (agentic RAT): a Remote Access Trojan augmented with a locally deployed Small Language Model (SLM). The SLM interprets host and network observations, selects actions, recovers from failed steps, and reduces reliance on an external operator. We implement the concept in a controlled, network-isolated lab built from Kali Linux, a Metasploitable2 target, LM Studio, and a local 8-billion-parameter Dolphin-family model. We then test whether a model this small can support autonomous cyber decision-making. This is architecturally feasible today. On commodity hardware, with no cloud service and no operator in the loop, the SLM closed the full observe-decide-act cycle: it interpreted ranked reconnaissance evidence supplied by the controller, selected actions, and obtained verified root-shell access on real vulnerable services. However, it is not yet operationally reliable. The same model hallucinated commands, misread output, and recovered from failure inconsistently, completing 10.9% of a deliberately strict checklist. That gap reflects the limits of today's small models, not a ceiling on the concept. As SLMs improve, agentic endpoint systems may become more practical, more autonomous, and harder to detect, straining existing monitoring, containment, and policy-enforcement mechanisms. Real-world incidents in 2025-2026 already show AI-driven intrusions moving from concept toward practice. That makes the local, self-contained variant we study a plausible near-term direction, not a hypothetical one.

zh_title: 足够微小以致入侵：由小语言模型驱动的代理远程访问木马
translation: 代理式人工智能引发了新的安全担忧：无需持续的人类指令，就能在本地进行推理、行动和适应的网络威胁。我们通过代理远程访问木马（agentic RAT）来审视这一威胁——这是一种通过本地部署的小型语言模型（SLM）增强的远程访问木马。该 SLM 可以解释主机和网络观察结果、选择行动、从失败步骤中恢复，并减少对外部操作员的依赖。我们在由 Kali Linux、Metasploitable2 目标、LM Studio 和本地 80 亿参数 Dolphin 系列模型构建的受控、网络隔离实验室中实现了这一概念。随后我们测试了如此小规模的模型是否能够支持自主的网络决策。结果表明，这在当今架构上是可行的。在没有云服务且无操作员干预的通用硬件上，SLM 完成了完整的“观察-决策-行动”循环：它解释了由控制器提供的分级侦察证据，选择行动，并在真实存在漏洞的服务上获得了经过验证的 root-shell 访问权限。然而，它在操作上尚不可靠。同一个模型会幻觉出命令、误读输出且故障恢复表现不稳定，仅完成了故意设置的严格检查清单中的 10.9%。这一差距反映了当今小模型的局限性，而非该概念的天花板。随着 SLM 的不断改进，代理式终端系统可能会变得更加实用、更加自主且更难被检测，从而使现有的监控、遏制和策略执行机制承受巨大压力。2025-2026 年的真实世界事件已经表明 AI 驱动的入侵正从概念走向实践，这使得我们研究的这种本地、自包含变体成为近期切实可行的演进方向，而非仅仅是假设。
tldr: 本文探索了基于本地部署的8B小语言模型（SLM）构建代理远程访问木马（Agentic RAT）的可行性，证明了完全自主的网络入侵在架构上可行，但目前受限于小模型可靠性。
ai_comments:
创新性：提出了结合本地小语言模型（8B参数）与远程访问木马（RAT）的自治攻击体系，探索了脱离云端和人类干预的去中心化AI威胁模式。
重要性：揭示了AI驱动的网络攻击正从云端依赖向本地轻量化、自主化演进的趋势，警示现有的网络检测与遏制机制面临严峻挑战。
局限性：当前8B小模型的可靠性不足，容易出现命令幻觉和输出误读，在严格测试中的成功率仅为10.9%，在复杂场景下的作战效能尚受限制。
motivation: 代理式人工智能带来了无需持续人类指令即可在本地进行推理、行动和适应的新型网络安全威胁。本文旨在探索利用本地部署的小语言模型（SLM）构建自主代理远程访问木马（Agentic RAT）的可行性与潜在危害。
method: 在网络隔离的受控实验室环境（由 Kali Linux、Metasploitable2 靶机、LM Studio 及本地 8B 参数 Dolphin 系列模型构成）中构建概念验证系统；在无云端服务且无人工干预的通用硬件上，评估该 SLM 独立执行“观察-决策-行动”循环并获取系统最高权限的能力。
results: 在架构上，8B 参数的 SLM 成功完成了“观察-决策-行动”全循环，解释了侦察证据并获得了真实漏洞服务的 root-shell 访问权限；但系统操作可靠性尚低，模型存在命令幻觉、误读输出及失败恢复不稳定等问题，仅完成了严格检查清单中 10.9% 的任务。
conclusion: 本地自包含的 Agentic RAT 是近期切实可行的攻击演进方向而非纯理论假设。随着 SLM 能力的不断提升，代理式终端攻击系统将更具实用性、自主性且更难被检测，将严重冲击现有的网络安全监控、隔离和策略执行机制。

title: V-FIND: Revealing the Intrinsic Forgery Knowledge Encoded in Video Forgery Detectors
authors: Shichao Kan, Chengpeng Hong, Jingtong Dou, Chuancheng Shi, Yuhan Liu, Linrui Xu, Yixiong Liang, Yigang Cen, Yanpeng Sun, Fei Shen, Tat-Seng Chua
abstract: As generated videos become increasingly realistic, reliable video forgery detection is increasingly important. Existing studies typically optimize and use video forgery detectors as black boxes, while the latent forgery-discriminative knowledge inside them remains largely unexplored. Instead of continuing to rely on resource-intensive full-model retraining to steadily improve detection performance, we ask whether video forgery detection can also be achieved by uncovering and activating sparse forensic knowledge within the detector. We find that forgery-discriminative knowledge is not uniformly distributed across the full representation space, but is concentrated in a sparse set of functionally specialized neurons. Based on this insight, we propose a video forgery-intrinsic neuron discovery (V-FIND) framework. V-FIND first localizes critical layers that exhibit pronounced discrepancies between real and forged videos, and then identifies latent anchor neurons that consistently carry forgery-discriminative signals, organizing them into a compact forensic subspace. With the original backbone frozen and only a lightweight linear classifier trained, this subspace still delivers strong detection performance across multiple external benchmarks for generated videos. Further neuron intervention experiments provide direct evidence for the functional specificity of the discovered neurons. Overall, these results suggest that video forgery detectors contain sparse, extractable, and reusable forgery-discriminative knowledge, offering a new perspective on understanding and exploiting their intrinsic forensic capability.
zh_title: V-FIND：揭示视频伪造检测器中编码的内在伪造知识
translation: 随着生成的视频变得越来越逼真，可靠的视频伪造检测变得日益重要。现有研究通常将视频伪造检测器作为黑盒进行优化和使用，而其内部潜在的伪造鉴别知识在很大程度上仍未被探索。本文没有继续依赖资源密集型的全模型重训练来稳步提高检测性能，而是提出一个问题：是否可以通过揭示和激活检测器内稀疏的取证知识来实现视频伪造检测？我们发现，伪造鉴别知识并非均匀分布在整个表示空间中，而是集中在少数具有功能专一性的稀疏神经元中。基于这一见解，我们提出了视频伪造固有神经元发现（V-FIND）框架。V-FIND 首先定位在真实和伪造视频之间表现出明显差异的关键层，然后识别持续携带伪造鉴别信号的潜在锚点神经元，将其组织成一个紧凑的取证子空间。在冻结原始主干网络且仅训练轻量级线性分类器的情况下，该子空间在多个生成的视频外部基准测试中仍能提供强劲的检测性能。进一步的神经元干预实验为所发现神经元的功能特异性提供了直接证据。总体而言，这些结果表明视频伪造检测器包含稀疏、可提取和可复用的伪造鉴别知识，为理解和利用其内在取证能力提供了新的视角。
tldr: 本文提出了 V-FIND 框架，通过提取视频伪造检测器中稀疏的“固有伪造神经元”构建取证子空间，在冻结主干网络的情况下实现了高效且强泛化性的视频伪造检测。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于打破了传统将伪造检测模型作为“黑盒”的范式，从神经元级别的可解释性视角深入挖掘模型内部知识。通过提取稀疏的固有取证神经元构建子空间，该方法不仅极大地降低了后续适应新任务时的计算资源消耗，还赋予了模型更强的泛化能力与可解释性，为深度伪造检测及模型内部机制探索提供了新颖而有价值的思路。
motivation: 现有视频伪造检测研究大多将检测器视为黑盒，且依赖高资源消耗的全模型重训练来提升性能，缺乏对检测器内部潜在伪造鉴别知识的挖掘。本文旨在探究能否通过揭示和激活检测器内部稀疏的固有取证知识来实现高效检测。
method: 提出了 V-FIND（视频伪造固有神经元发现）框架：1. 定位真实与伪造视频之间存在显著表征差异的关键层；2. 识别持续携带伪造鉴别信号的潜在锚点神经元，并将其组织为紧凑的取证子空间；3. 在冻结原始主干网络的前提下，仅在该子空间上训练轻量级线性分类器。
results: 在冻结主干网络且仅训练轻量线性分类器的条件下，V-FIND 提取的取证子空间在多个外部生成视频基准上均取得了强劲的检测性能；神经元干预实验也直接验证了所定位神经元的功能特异性。
conclusion: 视频伪造检测器内部编码了稀疏、可提取且可复用的伪造鉴别知识，这为理解与利用模型的内在取证能力提供了全新的视角。

title: Forbidden Region Dynamic Active Constraints in Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery
authors: Zejian Cui, Ferdinando Rodriguez y Baena
abstract: In robot-assisted surgery, Forbidden Region Active Constraints (FRAC) represent a control strategy that helps maintain task safety by generating anisotropic haptic guidance to surgeons. However, several challenges need to be overcome before FRAC can benefit teleoperative surgery in a clinical setting. These challenges include the ability to allow for dynamic tissue deformation, maintain energetic passivity, and speed of implementation, among others. In this study, we propose the pipeline design for an energy dissipative FRAC strategy, which accommodates the dynamic tissue deformation caused by respiratory movements, by utilizing a depth sensing camera. The proposed FRAC strategy adopts a fine mesh representation, with a total number of 122,806 polygons in the case study presented, while running at 43.48Hz.
