title: LAEF: A Lead-Agnostic ECG Foundation Model Towards Point-of-Care Diagnostics
authors: Edoardo Coppola, Stefano Fiorini, Pietro Liò, Mattia Savardi, Alberto Signoroni
abstract: Point-of-care cardiac devices such as smartwatches and handheld ECG recorders typically capture 1--2 leads, yet existing ECG foundation models are architecturally constrained to fixed 12-lead inputs, degrading or failing under these reduced configurations. We introduce LAEF (Lead-Agnostic ECG Foundation), a 7M-parameter ECG foundation model that can natively process any lead subset without zero-padding or architectural modification. LAEF represents ECGs as variable-size spatiotemporal graphs with physiologically motivated intra- and inter-lead connectivity, processed by a Graph Attention Network that scales naturally with active lead count.Pre-trained on 9.2M 12-lead ECGs via masked node modelling with stochastic lead sampling, LAEF learns representations robust to lead configuration. Across 18 downstream datasets, LAEF is on par with specialized 12-lead baselines over 12$\times$ larger at full lead availability. Under direct point-of-care-oriented diagnostics (1--2 leads), it outperforms all zero-padded alternatives on 17 out of 18 datasets with with a single randomly sampled lead and on 14 out of 18 with 2 leads, with an average AUROC gain of +3.2 points. Representation analysis links this advantage to architectural lead-agnosticism, and a lead-importance study across 164 cardiovascular conditions shows population-level performance is stable across single standard input leads while still recovering established clinically lead-condition associations.

title: Pattern over Pixels: Measuring Pattern Completion Bias in Multimodal Code Generation
authors: Khai-Nguyen Nguyen, Oscar Chaparro, Antonio Mastropaolo
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to translate webpage screenshots into front-end code, but repeated UI patterns may sway them toward visually incorrect yet pattern-consistent outputs. In this work, we test how repeated webpage patterns hurt MLLM accuracy on an objective screenshot-to-code fill-in-the-blank task. We introduce the first benchmark for visual pattern-completion bias, where one localized element in a repeated UI pattern is perturbed and the model must recover the masked width or font-size value from the screenshot and HTML context. Starting from 30 webpages curated from the Design2Code dataset, we build 1,440 evaluated screenshots spanning structural card and text-style patterns under standard and noise-overlaid conditions. We evaluate five frontier MLLMs and find that all are strongly biased toward the repeated baseline. Mean bias rate reaches 69.78% on card-width perturbations and 80.22% on text font-size perturbations, while mean accuracy is only 21.17% and 7.89%, respectively. Codex-5.3 performs best but still drops from 68.61% accuracy on cards to 13.89% on text, while Flash-3.0 reaches 96.11% bias on text. Noise, subtler perturbations, and boundary positions further increase bias rate. Reasoning analysis further shows that greater reasoning effort correlates with lower bias, yet qualitative evidence reveals that models can identify the anomalous element and still override it with the pattern-consistent answer. Our results identify a concrete failure mode in multimodal code generation and show that its severity is strongly associated with visual saliency

title: SITA: Semantic Interest Tokens for Target-Aware Compression in Long-Sequence Recommendation
authors: Rui Zhou, Bo Chen, Qinglin Jia, Jiezhou Ji, Chaoyi Ma, Ruiming Tang, Hao Wang, Enhong Chen
abstract: As user behavior histories continue to grow on modern Internet platforms, effectively modeling long behavior sequences has become crucial for predicting user interests in candidate items. Existing methods have evolved along two directions. One line dynamically retrieves target-relevant behaviors from long histories, enabling target-aware modeling but requiring target-dependent computation during inference. The other line compresses entire behavior sequences into compact user representations, achieving high efficiency and scalability but sacrificing target-specific adaptation due to target-independent encoding. The key challenge is therefore to enable target-aware modeling while preserving the efficiency and scalability of compressed user representations. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{SITA}, a target-aware compression framework for long-sequence recommendation. SITA enables target-aware compression by organizing compressed interests into semantic structures through semantic identifiers learned via parallel semantic quantization. Conditioned on the semantic identifier of the target item, SITA adaptively aggregates the corresponding structured interests to construct the target-specific user representation. Extensive experiments on public datasets and a large-scale industrial dataset demonstrate that SITA consistently outperforms representative baselines while maintaining strong scalability, highlighting its strong potential for real-world recommender systems.

title: Statistical Verification of Quantitative Hyperproperties: Beyond Boolean Quantification
authors: Amir M. Ahmadian, Hazem Torfah
abstract: Formalisms for hyperproperties provide a solid foundation for studying the verification problem across classes of relational properties, such as those in information flow control (IFC). However, existing formalisms remain limited in expressiveness when it comes to capturing practical aspects of real-world systems. In particular, they do not adequately account for the quantitative nature of such systems. In this paper, we address this gap by revisiting the specification and verification of hyperproperties from a quantitative, measure-based, perspective. We introduce Quantitative Hyper-Logic (QHL), which replaces qualitative trace quantifiers with measure-based ones and extends temporal predicates with richer quantitative expressions. We further study the verification problem from a statistical verification point of view, and develop algorithms for the statistical verification of QHL specifications. For the introduced measure-based quantifiers, we particularly provide an analysis in terms of sample complexity and achievable statistical guarantees. In particular, we show how statistical methods such as Hoeffding's inequality and extreme value theory can be combined to develop statistical verification algorithms for nested measure-based quantifiers. Our approach provides quantitative alternatives for where traditional verification methods become infeasible. We demonstrate both expressiveness and efficacy on benchmarks from quantitative IFC, comparing against qualitative methods.

title: Accelerating Dynamic Graph Clustering on GPU Architectures with cuGraph
authors: Nelson Aloysio Reis de Almeida Passos, Emanuele Carlini, Salvatore Trani
abstract: This work addresses community detection in temporal networks through GPU-accelerated extensions of spectral clustering and modularity-based algorithms originally designed for static graphs. Built on the NVIDIA RAPIDS ecosystem, the framework enables the characterization and tracking of communities in snapshot-based dynamic graphs, either by Leiden greedy optimization with multi-GPU support via Dask-based workload distribution, or eigendecomposition of a symmetric Bethe-Hessian operator. Our multislice modularity backend achieves up to roughly three orders of magnitude speedup over the CPU reference under an equal-work budget, depending on graph density and snapshot count, while preserving compatibility with existing graph analytics pipelines. We demonstrate its applicability on real-world and synthetic datasets, facilitating exploratory analysis of structural network properties over time. Such capabilities are relevant across several application domains, such as epidemic spreading, financial systems, cybersecurity, and trajectory and mobility analysis. We release our implementation as free and open-source software, including Python bindings through the NetworkX-Temporal library for ease of use and zero-code acceleration with existing codebases.

title: TARL: Transaction-Aware Reliable Ledgers for Executable Memory Management in Long-Term Agents
authors: Han Xiao, Hongjun Xu, Xin Zhang, Yidong Chen, Xiaodong Shi
abstract: Persistent memory helps long-term agents retain knowledge, yet a single update error can repeatedly distort future retrieval and reasoning. Most existing systems reduce memory updating to a binary Write/Hold decision, which cannot distinguish whether new information should be added, ignored, used to revise an outdated belief, rejected as unreliable, or deferred for verification. These choices may share the same binary label while producing fundamentally different memory states. We introduce TARL, a memory state update framework that maps each statement to one of five executable actions. TARL identifies the affected memory, resolves its temporal scope, compares source reliability, and updates accepted, pending, and rejected ledgers. It is further trained by comparing the memory states produced by alternative update operations, encouraging the model to select the operation that leads to the correct result. We also introduce TARL-Mem, a benchmark with fine-grained action labels and next-state targets. Across in-domain, cross-source, temporal, counterfactual, and sequential evaluations, TARL improves action prediction and state recovery, reduces memory pollution, preserves conflicting evidence, and limits cumulative corruption. The complete model implementation is provided in the supplementary material.

title: When Agents Learn to Be You: Benchmarking Privacy Leakage, Impersonation Risk, and Defenses in Persona Skills
authors: Yongli Xiang, Zhifang Zhang, Bojun Yang, Ziming Hong, Lei Feng, Miao Xu, Tongliang Liu
abstract: Persona skills distill personal interaction histories into portable and executable artifacts for downstream agents. While enabling flexible personalization, this process concentrates fragmented personal signals, amplifies their impact through reuse, and challenges defenses designed for individual records or retrieval-based memory. To systematically investigate the safety of the persona-skill pipeline, we introduce AntiSkillBench, an end-to-end benchmark for evaluating risks and defenses across the persona-skill pipeline. It comprises: (i) a dataset of 7,500 persona-grounded dialogue traces, constructed from 50 behaviorally rich profiles spanning diverse task scenarios; (ii) an evaluation suite that measures skill-level privacy leakage and agent-level attribute disclosure and behavioral impersonation across three skill-distillation strategies; and (iii) a defense evaluation covering four configurations across online and post-hoc interventions, including active risk suppression and passive provenance protection. Experiments across three frontier agents show that persona-skill risks persist across agent backbones and distillation protocols, extending from explicit attributes to communication styles and personality traits. Existing defenses exhibit limited and distillation-dependent effectiveness, failing to generalize across risk and distillation strategies. These results highlight AntiSkillBench as a challenging benchmark for developing privacy-preserving and authenticity-aware persona skills.

title: LiLa-WAM: Lightweight Latent Reasoning World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
authors: Fan Yang, Yuting Su, Xiaobo Wang, Yuncheng You, Fugui Fan, Yuting Wu, Minghui Wu, Chenxu Zhao, JiaHong Ning, Peiguang Jing
abstract: World-action modeling has emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic control, as it empowers models to go beyond reacting to observations and anticipate how a scene will evolve. However, existing WAMs often incur substantial computational overhead. Pixel-space methods often allocate substantial capacity to visual details that may not be directly relevant to control, while some latent-space methods require multi-stage training to construct the reasoning space. The resulting training cost can make such methods difficult to train under modest computational budgets. In this work, we propose LiLa-WAM, a lightweight world-action model that reasons about the future in a compact latent space and can be trained end-to-end on a single 24GB GPU. Its core design is a compact latent reasoning space jointly shaped by future-state prediction and action generation, which keeps the model lightweight while remaining well aligned with control. For task specification, we further propose the Visual Transition Token(VTT), a language-free task representation that encodes each task as a direction in visual feature space. Experiments on RoboTwin~2.0, LIBERO, and real-robot tasks demonstrate LiLa-WAM's effectiveness, achieving 90.48\% success across 50 RoboTwin tasks with single-GPU training.

title: Learning and Clustering on Temporal Graphs: Principles, Primitives, and Pooling
authors: Nelson Aloysio Reis de Almeida Passos, Emanuele Carlini, Salvatore Trani
abstract: This work focuses on the problem of learning on temporal graphs, with particular emphasis on the task of clustering: obtaining coarse-grained representations by aggregating information from nodes, edges, and temporal dynamics - a task related to pooling in machine learning on graphs, or community detection in network science. Although graph neural networks reach state-of-the-art performance across many downstream graph tasks, their advantage over established descriptive and inferential clustering algorithms is far less settled, especially under demands of efficiency and recovery accuracy. We frame this tension through three linked perspectives: principles, connecting graph learning and community detection through shared spectral foundations and detectability thresholds in stochastic block model regimes; primitives, making spectral clustering and multislice modularity optimization tractable through GPU-accelerated temporal backends; and pooling, viewing principled community detection as a theory-grounded coarse-graining operator for temporal graphs. Our results indicate that algorithmic methods remain the appropriate tool where attributes are absent or weak - scalability rather than accuracy being the binding obstacle - while neural models are most compelling when structural, temporal, and attribute signals align. By making temporal clustering scalable, GPU-accelerated primitives suggest a route toward theory-grounded pooling, while raising a central question: when does community-based coarse-graining preserve the dynamics needed for downstream learning tasks?

title: Less Traffic, Better Outcomes: Competition-Aware Request Dispatch in Real-Time Ad Exchanges
authors: Jonaid Shianifar, Blaz Mramor, Fangda Zou, Matthieu C. Martin, Xingsheng Guo, Zhihua Zhu, Rong Zhou, Bichen Shi
abstract: Real-time bidding (RTB) ad exchanges typically forward nearly all incoming requests to demand-side platforms (DSPs), even though only a small fraction receive bids. This over-distribution weakens auction outcomes: DSPs throttle participation under compute and budget constraints, reducing the effective use of limited bidding capacity. We present a competition-aware request dispatch framework that uses distributional bid prediction and probabilistic forwarding to decide whether each request should be sent to each DSP. The system adapts per-DSP thresholds over time through lightweight policy optimization to track non-stationary market conditions. We evaluate the framework through four sequential online experiments on a production platform serving over 20 billion daily requests. A full multi-DSP deployment reduces DSP request volume under the policy by 34.2% while increasing net revenue by 4.6% (p<0.001) in a recent 14-day window after an initial DSP adaptation period. Further analysis highlights strong heterogeneity across traffic segments and reveals that aggregate metrics can be misleading. Segment-level and per-DSP analyses suggest that the policy surfaces comparative advantages among DSPs, improving monetized outcomes without increasing overall request volume.

title: Predicting Deep Neural Network Training Outcomes from Early Training Telemetry
authors: Ranjita Naik, Anh D. Nguyen, Pankaj Kumar Singh
abstract: Large hyperparameter sweeps for deep neural networks spend substantial compute on configurations that are effectively doomed from the first few epochs. We study whether a single training run's own early telemetry - per-epoch loss, training accuracy, gradient signal-to-noise ratio, weight-norm growth, and an activation-saturation snapshot - together with its sampled hyperparameters, can predict that run's eventual outcome without reference to other runs. We evaluate three prediction tasks: final test accuracy, relative performance within a domain, and training-dynamics failure, including numerical divergence. Across 23,788 training runs spanning six architecture/dataset combinations, gradient-boosted trees using only the first five epochs of telemetry achieve R^2 = 0.92-0.99 for final-accuracy regression and ROC-AUC = 0.983-0.998 for relative classification on a permanently held-out set of hyperparameter configurations. Useful prediction is already available after a single epoch. A paired ablation shows that gradient- and weight-level telemetry provides a statistically consistent improvement over loss and accuracy curves alone, although the practical gain varies by domain. Transfer is strong between similar architectures, while cross-dataset transfer is limited mainly by differences in accuracy scale rather than loss of the underlying relationship. These results suggest that early-training telemetry can provide a practical decision-support signal for compute allocation while motivating human oversight for any automated intervention.

title: MultiCompose: Multi-Concept Personalized Composition with Per-Subject Attribute Binding
authors: Ruirui Zhang, Zhengkai Zhao, Pan Gao
abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models enable personalization of specific visual concepts from a small number of reference images. However, generating a single image that contains multiple personalized subjects, each bound to user-specified attributes such as clothing, accessories, and held objects, remains largely unaddressed. Without explicit spatial constraints, concurrently activated concept checkpoints produce overlapping cross-attention responses, causing per-subject identity degradation and attribute misalignment. Moreover, no established benchmark jointly evaluates these two failure modes in the personalized multi-subject setting. We present MultiCompose, a composition framework that decouples per-concept personalization from multi-subject inference. A semantic preservation regularization maintains attribute binding capacity during fine-tuning, while a two-phase inference procedure automatically establishes subject layout and composes per-concept predictions through spatially exclusive masks. We further introduce MSP-Bench, a benchmark that jointly evaluates identity fidelity (ID), attribute binding accuracy (BIND), and attribute misalignment (MIS) through a dual-pathway protocol. Experiments show that MultiCompose outperforms existing methods on both conventional metrics and MSP-Bench, confirming the benchmark's ability to reveal failure modes that conventional metrics overlook. Code is available at https://github.com/I2-Multimedia-Lab/MultiCompose

title: Attention is Case-Sensitive
authors: Maximilian Dillitzer, Tin Stribor Sohn, Jason J. Corso, Michael Auerbach
abstract: In human visual perception, uppercase lettering serves as a natural salience cue that captures attention within lowercase text. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical characterization study revealing that Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit an analogous property: letter casing modulates internal attention allocation. Through analysis across 13 models, nine LLMs and four Vision-Language Models (VLMs), with diverse tokenization schemes, we show that formatting target information in alternating or uppercase against a lowercase context concentrates attention on those textual spans. In text this effect is universal, holding across every evaluated non-reasoning model. We frame it as a previously under-explored latent property of pretrained transformers rather than a prescriptive method. Our investigation reveals a central attention-performance divergence: while this "casing effect" robustly shifts attention, its impact on downstream accuracy is non-trivial, increased concentration does not inherently improve task accuracy and, in high-entropy contexts like alternating case, can degrade it. We further identify a boundary condition: the deliberative "thinking" phase in reasoning models acts as a semantic buffer that mitigates typographic sensitivity in text. Extending the study to VLMs, we find the effect transfers partially: the same prompt-side casing reorganizes cross-modal attention along two coupled axes, predominantly a macroscopic disengagement from the image toward the text prompt, and secondarily a concentration of the residual visual attention on the target region. By isolating casing as a zero-shot mechanism for attention steering that requires no model access or fine-tuning, we provide a new foundational understanding of how pretraining internalizes typographic emphasis.

title: A Conductance Based Amygdala Model of Threat Processing in Anxiety and Depression
authors: Malik Faizan, P.J.White, Indrakshi Dey
abstract: Anxiety and depressive disorders are increasingly viewed as dysregulations along continuous stress-regulatory dimensions. However, existing computational approaches seldom connect interpretable circuit level mechanisms to autonomic physiology. Methods: This study develops a mechanistic framework that links amygdala dysregulation to cardiovascular stress responses for digital phenotyping and clinical interpretation. We formulated a compact, nine equation, conductance based model of the amygdala hypothalamus cardiovascular pathway. The framework extends Hodgkin Huxley formalism with three clinically grounded modulators: coping capacity, perceived stress load, and prefrontal regulatory strength. A slow, history-dependent internal state, adaptive thresholding, graded threat acknowledgement, and baroreflex coupled hypothalamic integration were used to generate heart rate and blood pressure trajectories. Results: Distinct strong, moderate, and weak regulatory regimes emerged as stable operating states of a single closed-loop system. Robust analyses showed that stochastic variability and parameter perturbation preserved regime separation, while ablation studies identified the adaptive threshold as the principal mechanism driving quantitative regime separation. Simulated cardiovascular responses remained within reported stress physiology ranges. Furthermore, external evaluation across three independent datasets supported robust agreement with real world, stress related autonomic patterns. Conclusion: A compact, mechanistic model can jointly link psychometric modulators, amygdala excitability, and downstream cardiovascular output within a single, interpretable framework. Significance: This work provides a computationally tractable basis for mechanism informed digital phenotyping, patient specific stress monitoring, and future digital twin approaches for mental health decision support.

title: Amortized Interventional Forecasting for Multivariate CIR Processes
authors: Andreas Sauter, Sumit Sourabh, Drona Kandhai, Erman Acar
abstract: Mean-reverting dynamics are pervasive in finance, and the Cox--Ingersoll--Ross (CIR) process is a standard model for the time series they produce, from short rates to credit default swap (CDS) spreads. Yet CIR models capture only \emph{correlated} co-movement, not \emph{causal} influence between series, so they cannot answer the system's response when one series is externally shocked, which observational conditionals confound with historical co-movement. We make two contributions. First, an amortized model for distributional causal effect estimation that frames trajectories as time-stamped observations and predicts the calibrated multi-horizon shock response without retraining per scenario. Second, a causal multivariate CIR data-generating process that supplies the paired observational and interventional ground truth that real markets cannot. We instantiate and calibrate the framework on CDS spreads as a testbed. CIR-ACTIVA's validity is established on synthetic ground truth, independent of how well the simulator matches reality, while practical grounding is assessed by backtesting the generated traces against real CDS data. Against observational and amortized causal-inference baselines, CIR-ACTIVA leads on both causal selectivity in the joint distribution and horizon-resolved calibration, retaining its selectivity once the interventional law varies over the horizon, with gains concentrating at short horizons. This opens up a class of what-if queries on coupled spread systems, CDS stress testing among them, that observational forecasters cannot answer.

title: On the Geometry of Music Bandwidth Extension in Latent Spaces of Audio Codecs
authors: Hendrik Vincent Koops, Hao Hao Tan, Elio Quinton
abstract: Recent audio restoration increasingly relies on large-scale conditional latent generative modeling, including diffusion, Schrodinger Bridges, and Flow Matching variants, to invert degradations such as bandwidth limitation or noise. We present an analysis of the performance of various state-of-the-art methods compared to simple arithmetic transformations in the latent spaces of multiple neural codecs for musical bandwidth extension. We show that estimating a single transport vector between the clean and degraded latent centroids on a reference set, and adding it to degraded latents, can yield restoration performance competitive with large diffusion models. This suggests, first, that some neural codec latent spaces exhibit structure aligned with audio bandwidth; and second, that in such cases complex conditional models may offer only limited gains over a simple vector addition. We argue that these findings reveal an interesting avenue for future research whereby models could take advantage of the latent space structure in order to offer greater training and parameter efficiency, and overall better performance. Additionally, we propose to consider this simple arithmetic transformation as a baseline for music bandwidth extension research, as it allows an assessment of the contribution of learnable parameters towards restoration performance.

zh_title: 论音频编解码器潜在空间中音乐带宽扩展的几何结构
translation: 近期的音频恢复越来越多地依赖于大规模条件潜生成建模（包括扩散模型、薛定谔桥和流匹配变体），以逆化诸如带宽限制或噪声等退化过程。我们分析了多种最新方法与在多个神经网络编解码器潜空间中进行的简单算术变换在音乐带宽扩展任务上的性能对比。我们表明，在参考集上估算清晰与退化潜质心之间的单一传输向量，并将其加到退化潜变量上，可以取得与大型扩散模型相媲美的恢复性能。这首先表明，某些神经网络编解码器的潜空间展现出与音频带宽相契合的结构；其次，在这种情况下，复杂的条件模型相对于简单的向量加法可能只能带来有限的提升。我们认为，这些发现为未来的研究揭示了一条有趣的途径，即模型可以利用潜空间结构以提供更高的训练和参数效率，以及整体更好的性能。此外，我们建议将这种简单的算术变换作为音乐带宽扩展研究的基线，因为它能够评估可学习参数对恢复性能的实际贡献。
tldr: 在音频编解码器的潜空间中，仅需计算并叠加一个简单的传输向量即可实现与大型扩散模型相当的音乐带宽扩展效果。
ai_comments: 本研究创新性地揭示了音频编解码器潜空间中天然存在的与带宽对齐的几何结构，提出了仅需简单向量加法即可实现高质量带宽扩展的观点，挑战了对大型复杂生成模型的过度依赖。其重要性在于提供了一种极具参数与计算效率的新思路，并为该领域设立了一个强有力的简单基线；局限性在于摘要中尚未揭示该几何性质在面对更复杂的非线性退化或跨域场景时的泛化边界。
motivation: 近年音频修复普遍依赖大型复杂的条件潜生成模型（如扩散模型、流匹配等），但缺乏对编解码器潜空间自身几何结构的深入分析，不清楚简单的潜空间算术变换能否达到或接近复杂模型的修复效果。
method: 在参考数据集上计算清晰音频与退化音频在编解码器潜空间质心之间的单一传输向量（transport vector），然后将该向量直接叠加到退化音频的潜表示上。
results: 简单的潜向量加法在音乐带宽扩展任务中取得了与大型扩散模型相当（competitive）的恢复性能。
conclusion: 神经网络编解码器的潜空间具有与音频带宽契合的几何结构；在这些潜空间中，复杂生成模型相对于简单算术变换的收益有限。利用潜空间几何学可显著提升模型训练与参数效率，且该简单算术变换应作为音乐带宽扩展研究的标准基线。

title: Detecting Hallucinations and Recovering Verified Answers in Arabic Islamic Question Answering
authors: Khaled Ziani
abstract: Large language models can generate fluent responses to Islamic questions while introducing factual errors that are difficult to identify. This paper presents our system for \textsc{HalluScoring 2026} Task 2.1, \textit{Islamic Hallucination Detection and Find the Truth}. The task requires a unified two-step prediction: determining whether an Arabic answer generated by an LLM is hallucinated and selecting the verified answer from six closely related candidate options. We use the Islamic knowledge dataset provided by the shared task, which contains 600 question--answer instances, including 341 hallucinated and 259 non-hallucinated answers. Our system is based on the fine-tuned \texttt{google/gemma-4-12B-it} model and uses deterministic decoding during inference. The generated outputs are normalized to extract the hallucination label and the selected option. The system achieves a Macro-F1 score of 0.928 and a label accuracy of 0.935 for hallucination detection, together with an option accuracy of 0.895 for answer selection. These results yield a combined score of 0.912, demonstrating strong performance across both stages of the task. The lower option-selection accuracy indicates that distinguishing the verified answer from plausible alternatives remains more challenging than detecting hallucinated responses.
zh_title: 阿拉伯语伊斯兰问答中的幻觉检测与验证答案恢复
translation: 大语言模型可以生成流畅的伊斯兰问题回答，但同时也可能引入难以识别的事实性错误。本文介绍了我们针对 HalluScoring 2026 任务 2.1“伊斯兰幻觉检测与寻找真相”所构建的系统。该任务要求进行统一的两步预测：判断大语言模型生成的阿拉伯语回答是否存在幻觉，并从六个紧密相关的候选选项中选择经过验证的答案。我们使用了 shared task 提供的伊斯兰知识数据集，其中包含 600 个问答实例（包括 341 个有幻觉的回答和 259 个无幻觉的回答）。我们的系统基于微调后的 google/gemma-4-12B-it 模型，并在推理过程中使用确定性解码。生成的输出经过标准化处理，以提取幻觉标签和所选选项。该系统在幻觉检测上取得了 0.928 的 Macro-F1 分数和 0.935 的标签准确率，同时在答案选择上的选项准确率为 0.895。这些结果得出了 0.912 的综合得分，展示了在任务两个阶段的强劲性能。较低的选项选择准确率表明，将经过验证的答案与似是而非的备选答案区分开来，比检测幻觉回答更具挑战性。
tldr: 基于微调的Gemma-4-12B-it模型，本文提出了一个用于阿拉伯语伊斯兰问答的幻觉检测与真实答案恢复统一系统，实现了0.912的综合评测高分。
ai_comments: 该研究针对特定的伊斯兰宗教知识及阿拉伯语领域，提出了结合幻觉检测与真实答案恢复的统一解决方法。通过微调先进的Gemma-4-12B-it模型，在HalluScoring 2026评测中取得了0.912的优异综合成绩。研究同时揭示了“从似是而非的备选项中挑选正确答案”比“仅检测是否有幻觉”难度更高的特点，对后续特定领域大模型去幻觉研究提供了有价值的参考。
motivation: 大语言模型在生成阿拉伯语伊斯兰问题回答时，容易产生流畅但包含难以识别的事实性错误（幻觉）。为了解决这一问题，需要开发能够同时检测回答中是否存在幻觉并从相关候选选项中恢复出经验证答案的有效系统。
method: 基于微调的 google/gemma-4-12B-it 模型，在推理阶段采用确定性解码（deterministic decoding），并对模型生成的输出进行标准化处理，从而统一提取幻觉预测标签及选定的正确答案选项。
results: 在 HalluScoring 2026 Task 2.1 上，该系统在幻觉检测任务中实现了 0.928 的 Macro-F1 和 0.935 的标签准确率；在答案选择任务中达到了 0.895 的选项准确率；两阶段综合评分为 0.912。
conclusion: 该系统在幻觉检测和答案恢复两个阶段均展示了强劲性能。结果同时表明，将经过验证的真答案与似是而非的替代选项进行区分，比单纯检测是否存在幻觉更具挑战性。

title: Towards Reliable and Reproducible Fetal Brain Biometry: A Deep Learning Approach Using MRI
authors: Francesca Maccarone, Marina Di Stefano, Giorgio Longari, Giulia Frigerio, Gloria Rizzato, Rocco Prudentino, Nivedita Agarwal, Tommaso Ciceri, Denis Peruzzo, Simone Melzi
abstract: Fetal brain biometry is essential for quantitative assessment of brain development, supporting gestational age estimation, developmental monitoring, and detection of abnormalities. In clinical practice, measurements are manually performed, making them time-consuming and prone to variability. While automated approaches have been proposed, reproducible methods remain limited, particularly those providing anatomically interpretable landmark localization. We present a fully automated deep learning-based framework for reliable and reproducible brain biometry from 3D super-resolution-reconstructed fetal brain MRI. The proposed four-step pipeline derives biometric parameters by jointly estimating linear measurements and their corresponding anatomical landmarks. A 3D convolutional neural network is trained to regress landmark coordinates from brain segmentation label maps, followed by measurement-specific geometric optimization to refine landmark positions and compute measurements. The pipeline is evaluated on two publicly available fetal MRI datasets comprising 150 volumes (gestational age range: 20-37 weeks) acquired across different scanners and protocols, assessing five key biometric measurements across varying acquisition settings and providing a comprehensive evaluation of both measurement accuracy and landmark localization using quantitative metrics and visual assessment. Compared with the only available automated pipeline, the proposed method achieves comparable or improved accuracy for most measurements. In conclusion, we introduce a straightforward pipeline for reliable biometry estimations, with efficiency, interpretability and scalability that support integration into clinical workflows.
zh_title: 迈向可靠且可重复的胎儿大脑生物特征测量：一种基于MRI的深度学习方法
translation: 胎儿大脑生物特征测量对于定量评估大脑发育至关重要，支持孕周估计、发育监测和异常检测。在临床实践中，测量通常由手动完成，耗时且容易产生变异。尽管已有自动化方法被提出，但可重复的方法仍很有限，尤其是那些能够提供可解释的解剖地标定位的方法。我们提出了一种完全自动化的基于深度学习的框架，用于从3D超分辨率重建的胎儿大脑MRI中获取可靠且可重复的大脑生物特征测量。所提出的四步管线通过联合估计线性测量值及其对应的解剖地标来导出生物特征参数。训练一个3D卷积神经网络，从大脑分割标签图中回归地标坐标，随后进行针对特定测量的几何优化，以精细化地标位置并计算测量值。该管线在两个包含150个胎儿MRI体积（孕周范围：20-37周）的公开数据集上进行了评估，这些数据采集自不同的扫描仪和协议，评估了不同采集设置下的五个关键生物特征测量，并使用定量指标和视觉评估对测量准确性和地标定位进行了全面评估。与唯一可用的自动化管线相比，所提出的方法在大多数测量中达到了相当或提高的准确度。总之，我们引入了一种用于可靠生物特征估计的简单管线，具有高效性、可解释性和可扩展性，支持集成到临床工作流程中。
keywords: 胎儿大脑生物特征测量
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合3D CNN与几何优化的自动化深度学习框架，能够从胎儿大脑MRI中可靠且可重复地提取生物特征测量参数与解剖地标。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将深度学习（3D CNN）与几何优化相结合，不仅提高了胎儿大脑生物特征测量的自动化程度，还能精准定位具有解剖可解释性的解剖地标，显著增强了诊断结果的直观性和可靠性。其潜在局限性在于该框架依赖于预先生成的3D超分辨率重建和脑部分割标签图，预处理质量可能会直接对地标预测与测量精度产生影响。
motivation: 临床上胎儿大脑生物特征测量多依赖手动操作，耗时且存在较大的个体间变异；现有自动化方法缺乏高可重复性以及具有解剖可解释性的地标定位能力。
method: 提出一种完全自动化的四步处理管道：首先利用训练好的3D卷积神经网络（3D CNN）从脑部分割标签图中回归地标坐标；随后通过针对特定测量的几何优化方法精细化调整地标位置；最终实现线性测量参数及其对应解剖地标的联合估计。
results: 在包含150个胎儿MRI体积（孕周20-37周、多设备/多协议采集）的两个公开数据集上对5个关键指标进行评估，结果显示，与目前唯一现有的自动化管线相比，该方法在大多数测量指标上达到了相当或更优的准确率。
conclusion: 该研究引入了一种简单且高效的自动化管线，能够可靠地估计胎儿大脑生物特征，具备出色的可解释性和可扩展性，有力支持其集成到临床诊疗工作流程中。

title: When Outputs Disperse, Does Epistemic Revision Follow? A Black-Box Coupling Diagnostic for Machine Collectives
authors: Molood Arman
abstract: Collective intelligence research treats disagreement as evidence of epistemic diversity: if agents express different views, the group should retain capacity to revise. In LLM collectives this proxy can break: agents can produce diverse-looking arguments while preserving the same conclusion. We operationalize dispersion-revision coupling: the degree to which an intervention that verifiably increases the dispersion of a collective's outputs in embedding space is accompanied by genuine revision of its epistemic stance rather than premise-preserving reformulation. The diagnostic is black-box: it operates on generated text alone and makes no claims about the internal representations of the generating models. Two channels are measured independently: an output channel, the Coherence Index (CI), verifies that the intervention changed output dispersion; an epistemic channel, per-turn stance annotation, measures whether the collective revised. We propose CI with the Meta-Predictive Clarity System (MPCS), which inserts a Re-Differentiation Protocol (RDP) when outputs over-converge, as a reusable method for estimating this coupling regime. We evaluate five-agent collectives from two configurations (gpt-4o-mini and gemini-2.5-flash; 310 paired episodes per condition). On gpt-4o-mini, conditional dissent improves false-premise recovery by +17.7 points (p<1e-6) while static persona diversity harms recovery (-8.1, p=.007). On gemini-2.5-flash, the same intervention at a comparable budget yields no gain (26.1% vs 27.1%, p=.84) despite a verified dispersion drop; the two treatment effects differ from each other (z=3.79, p<.001). Mechanism tagging shows Gemini preserves the false premise via intra-framework dissent: 94% of tagged post-RDP responses reformulate rather than concede (vs 24% on GPT). We recommend reporting per-intervention stance shift and premise-preservation rate alongside accuracy.

zh_title: 当输出分散时，认知修正是否随之发生？一种用于机器集合的黑盒耦合诊断方法
translation: 群体智能研究通常将分歧视为认知多样性的证据：如果Agent表达了不同观点，群体就应保留修正的能力。然而在LLM集合中，这种代理指标可能会失效：Agent可以在保持相同结论的同时生成看似多样化的论点。我们对“分散度-修正耦合”进行了操作化定义：即在嵌入空间中可证实地增加集合输出分散度的干预，在多大程度上伴随着其认知立场的真正修正，而不是保持前提的重述。该诊断方法是黑盒的：它仅基于生成的文本进行操作，不对生成模型的内部表示做任何假设。独立测量两个通道：输出通道（一致性索引 CI）用于验证干预是否改变了输出分散度；认知通道（逐轮立场标注）用于测量集合是否进行了修正。我们提出了带有元预测清晰系统（MPCS）的CI，当输出过度收敛时插入重分化协议（RDP），作为估计这种耦合机制的可复用方法。我们在两种配置（gpt-4o-mini 和 gemini-2.5-flash；每种条件310组配对回合）的五Agent集合上进行了评估。在 gpt-4o-mini 上，条件性异议使错误前提恢复率提高了 +17.7 分 (p<1e-6)，而静态角色多样性损害了恢复率 (-8.1, p=.007)。在 gemini-2.5-flash 上，相同的干预在相当的预算下未产生收益（26.1% 对 27.1%, p=.84），尽管验证到了分散度的下降；这两种处理效果互相存在显著差异 (z=3.79, p<.001)。机制标记表明，Gemini通过框架内异议保留了错误前提：RDP后被标记的回应中有 94% 选择重述而非让步（GPT仅为 24%）。我们建议在报告准确率的同时，也报告单次干预的立场转移和前提保留率。
tldr: 揭示了LLM多Agent集合中“表达多样”不等于“真正纠错”的现象，并提出一种衡量输出分散度与认知修正耦合程度的黑盒诊断方法。
ai_comments: 本论文提出了大模型群体智能领域中一个至关重要且容易被忽视的问题：表面上的输出多样性（文本分散度）并不等同于实质上的认知修正（改变错误前提）。论文提出的黑盒耦合诊断方法及评估指标（如前提保留率、立场转移）具有极高的实用价值和诊断启发性，提示在多Agent协作与讨论机制的设计中，需警惕“形式异议实则坚持错误前提”的假性多样性现象。
motivation: 群体智能研究通常将异议视为认知多样性的体现，但在大语言模型（LLM）集合中，这一假设可能失效：模型Agent可能在保持相同错误前提/结论的同时，生成看似多样化的论点。因此需要探究输出表达的分散是否真正伴随着认知立场的修正。
method: 提出了“分散度-修正耦合”（dispersion-revision coupling）诊断框架，这是一种仅基于生成文本的黑盒诊断方法。方法包含两个独立通道：1）输出通道，利用一致性索引（CI）验证干预是否改变了嵌入空间中的输出分散度；2）认知通道，通过逐轮立场标注衡量集合是否做出实质修正。此外，提出了带有元预测清晰系统（MPCS）的CI，在输出过度收敛时插入重分化协议（RDP）。评估了gpt-4o-mini和gemini-2.5-flash两种模型构成的5-Agent群体（每种条件310组配对回合）。
results:
1. 在gpt-4o-mini上，条件性异议使错误前提恢复率显著提升了+17.7分（p<1e-6），而静态角色多样性则损害了恢复率（-8.1分，p=.007）。
2. 在gemini-2.5-flash上，相同的干预在相当的资源预算下未带来明显收益（26.1%对27.1%，p=.84），两种模型的干预效果存在显著差异（z=3.79, p<.001）。
3. 机制标记显示，Gemini通过“框架内异议”保留了错误前提：在RDP干预后，Gemini有94%的被标记回应选择重述前提而非让步认错（GPT该比例仅为24%）。
conclusion: 输出的分散性并不必然引发LLM集合的实质性认知修正。作者建议在评估多Agent系统性能时，除了准确率之外，还应同时报告单次干预的立场转移（stance shift）和前提保留率（premise-preservation rate）。

title: Track4Action: Distilling World-Centric 3D Tracker into Vision-Language-Action Policies
authors: Chenyi Wang, Xinkai Wang, Bokai Lin, Jialin Tian, Fucheng Zhang, Cewu Lu, Lixin Yang
abstract: Action labels tell a vision-language-action (VLA) policy which robot commands to imitate, but not how those commands change the 3D world. The aligned demonstration clip contains this missing supervision because its $K$ frame transitions record the geometry, motion, visibility, and camera change produced during the corresponding $K$ actions. We introduce Track4Action, a framework that distills this realized transition from a frozen world-centric 3D tracker into a current-observation VLA policy. During training, Track4World encodes the clip $V_{t:t+K}$ into a pooled tracker feature. Learnable track queries infer this feature from current VLA hidden states, match it in a shared space, and condition a flow-matching action head through a feature-wise gate. The tracker feature only defines the alignment target, so neither the clip nor the tracker is used at deployment. Track4Action reaches 82.3% on zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, improving the alignment-free variant by 7.6 points and LaMP by 3.0 points. It obtains 80.44% and 81.48% on the clean and randomized RoboTwin 2.0 splits, and 67.5% average success across four physical bimanual tasks, 25.0 points above the alignment-free variant. The gains across simulation and physical tasks support action-aligned 3D tracker features as privileged supervision for tracker-free VLA deployment. Our project page is available at https://wing0night.github.io/track4action-project-page.
zh_title: Track4Action：将以世界为中心的3D追踪器蒸馏至视觉-语言-动作策略中
translation: 动作标签告知视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略要模仿哪些机器人指令，但未说明这些指令如何改变三维世界。对齐的演示视频片段包含这种缺失的监督信息，因为其 $K$ 帧过渡记录了对应 $K$ 个动作期间产生的几何、运动、可见性和相机变化。我们提出了 Track4Action，这是一个将已实现的过渡从冻结的、以世界为中心的 3D 追踪器蒸馏到当前观察 VLA 策略中的框架。在训练期间，Track4World 将视频片段 $V_{t:t+K}$ 编码为池化追踪器特征。可学习的追踪查询从当前 VLA 隐藏状态推断该特征，在共享空间中对其进行匹配，并通过按特征门控调节流匹配动作头。追踪器特征仅定义对齐目标，因此在部署时既不需要视频片段也不需要追踪器。Track4Action 在零样本 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 82.3% 的成功率，比无对齐变体提高了 7.6 个百分点，比 LaMP 提高了 3.0 个百分点。它在 RoboTwin 2.0 的干净和随机划分上分别获得了 80.44% 和 81.48% 的成功率，并在四个真实双臂任务中实现了 67.5% 的平均成功率，比无对齐变体高出 25.0 个百分点。仿真和物理任务中的提升支持将动作对齐的 3D 追踪器特征作为无需追踪器的 VLA 部署的特权监督。我们的项目主页位于 https://wing0night.github.io/track4action-project-page。
tldr: Track4Action通过在训练时将以世界为中心的3D追踪特征作为特权监督蒸馏至VLA策略中，提高了机器人动作预测的精确度，且部署时无需追踪器。
ai_comments:
创新性：巧妙引入特权学习（Privileged Learning）范式，将未来演示视频中的3D几何与运动追踪特征作为训练期的显式监督，在推理阶段无需追踪器即可保持对3D世界动态变化的感知能力。
重要性：有效填补了传统VLA策略仅模仿离散动作指令而缺乏对三维物理世界变化理解的空白，并在仿真及真实的双手机器人操作任务中取得了非常显著的性能提升（真机任务上提升了25个百分点）。
局限性：对训练数据的3D追踪器特征提取质量有一定依赖，若演示视频中存在严重遮挡或复杂相机移动导致追踪失真，可能影响蒸馏性能。
motivation: 传统的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略仅学习模仿动作指令，但缺乏对这些动作如何改变三维物理世界（如几何、运动、可见性和相机变化）的显式理解。演示视频中蕴含了这些关键的变化过程，需要有效的方法将此类3D世界动态监督融入到策略学习中。
method: 提出了Track4Action框架。训练时，利用冻结的以世界为中心的3D追踪器（Track4World）将演示视频片段 $V_{t:t+K}$ 编码为池化追踪器特征；通过可学习的追踪查询（track queries）从当前VLA隐藏状态中推断该特征并在共享空间中进行对齐匹配，进而通过特征门控调节流匹配（flow-matching）动作头。在推理部署时，完全不需要视频片段或追踪器。
results:
1. 在零样本 LIBERO-Plus 基准上达到 82.3% 的成功率，比无对齐变体高 7.6 个百分点，比 LaMP 高 3.0 个百分点；
2. 在 RoboTwin 2.0 的干净和随机分割上分别达到 80.44% 和 81.48% 的成功率；
3. 在 4 个真实物理双臂机器人任务中实现 67.5% 的平均成功率，比无对齐变体提升了 25.0 个百分点。
conclusion: 将动作对齐的3D追踪器特征作为特权监督，能够显著增强VLA策略在无需追踪器环境下的部署表现与泛化能力。

title: SAT-Edge-Agent: Hardware-in-the-Loop Edge-Agent Orchestration for Onboard Satellite Intelligence
authors: Longji He, Jeto Xu
abstract: Onboard satellite intelligence requires a task layer that translates mission intent into local tool calls, exposes execution state, and returns machine-consumable artifacts under communication and power constraints. We present SAT-Edge-Agent, a hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) edge-agent system deployed on a commercial off-the-shelf ARM-based heterogeneous edge system-on-chip. A browser workspace and FastAPI agent coordinate a local OpenAI-compatible language service with a project-internal YOLO-style oriented-object-detection endpoint that returns FAIR1M metadata-backed structured results. Two fixed FAIR1M workloads, one single-image and one serial two-image request, were repeated 20 times each and completed 20/20 attempts. Mean Full-Agent latency was 29.353 s and 60.937 s, with empirical P95 values of 31.166 s and 66.882 s. Mean detector time was 861.386 ms and 1510.920 ms, only 2.93% and 2.48% of the corresponding Full-Agent means. Profiling indicates that most visible latency occurs outside detector execution. Mean CPU utilization was 20.761% and 20.482%. A 200-ms NPU-load field averaged 100% for both workloads, but it represents a shared-accelerator software field rather than detector-only occupancy or calibrated utilization. The public evidence package provides sanitized request-level records, redacted JSON, normalized SSE examples, and scripts reproducing the reported statistics. These results establish a reproducible HIL boundary for observable satellite edge-agent orchestration, but do not establish detector accuracy, a new geolocation method, calibrated energy efficiency, or flight readiness.
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, and 10 tables. Code and sanitized research artifacts are available at https://github.com/keithhegit/SAT-Edge-Agent
zh_title: SAT-Edge-Agent：用于卫星星载智能的硬件在环边缘代理编排
translation: 星载卫星智能需要一个任务层，在通信和功耗约束下将任务意图转化为本地工具调用、暴露执行状态并返回机器可消费的构件。我们展示了 SAT-Edge-Agent，这是一种硬件在环（HIL）边缘代理系统，部署在商业现成的基于 ARM 的异构边缘片上系统（SoC）上。浏览器工作区和 FastAPI 代理协调了本地兼容 OpenAI 的语言服务与项目内部的类 YOLO 定向目标检测端点，该端点返回由 FAIR1M 元数据支持的结构化结果。两个固定的 FAIR1M 工作负载（一个单图像请求和一个串行双图像请求）分别重复了 20 次，均 20/20 成功完成。全代理（Full-Agent）平均延迟分别为 29.353 秒和 60.937 秒，经验 P95 值分别为 31.166 秒和 66.882 秒。检测器平均时间为 861.386 毫秒和 1510.920 毫秒，仅占相应全代理平均时间的 2.93% 和 2.48%。分析表明，大部分可见延迟发生在检测器执行之外。平均 CPU 利用率分别为 20.761% 和 20.482%。200 毫秒的 NPU 负载字段在两种工作负载下平均均为 100%，但这代表共享加速器软件字段，而非仅检测器占用率或标定利用率。公开的数据包提供了脱敏的请求级记录、受删减的 JSON、归一化的 SSE 示例以及复现所报告统计数据的脚本。这些结果为可观测的卫星边缘代理编排建立了一个可复现的 HIL 边界，但尚未确立检测器准确率、新的地理定位方法、标定的能源效率或飞行就绪状态。
tldr: SAT-Edge-Agent 是部署于异构边缘 SoC 的硬件在环卫星代理系统，实现了大语言服务与目标检测工具的高可靠自主编排。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将大语言模型代理（LLM Agent）编排引入卫星星载异构边缘SoC（ARM+NPU），并通过硬件在环（HIL）验证了其可行性；其重要性在于为未来智能化卫星的自主任务调度与工具调用提供了可复现的基准实验；局限性在于系统整体延迟较高（全代理执行需数十秒），且摘要明确指出尚未验证模型检测准确率、标定能效及实际飞行就绪状态（Flight Readiness）。
motivation: 卫星星载智能需要在通信和功耗约束下，建立一个能将高层任务意图转化为本地工具调用、暴露执行状态并返回机器可消费构件的任务编排层。
method: 提出了 SAT-Edge-Agent 框架，部署于商业现成 ARM 异构边缘 SoC 上。通过浏览器工作区和 FastAPI 代理，协调本地兼容 OpenAI 的大语言模型服务与类 YOLO 定向目标检测端点，生成基于 FAIR1M 元数据的结构化结果，并利用 HIL 实验进行 20 次重复验证与性能剖析。
results: 单图和串行双图工作负载各重复20次均100%成功完成。全代理平均延迟分别为29.353秒和60.937秒（P95分别为31.166秒和66.882秒），而检测器执行时间仅占总时间的2.93%和2.48%，表明绝大部分延迟源于检测器之外的代理编排与语言服务过程。平均CPU利用率约20.5%~20.8%。
conclusion: 研究建立了用于可观测卫星边缘代理编排的可复现硬件在环（HIL）边界，但尚未确立检测器准确率、新地理定位方法、标定能源效率或飞行就绪状态。

title: GPTKB 2.0: Direct Construction of Disambiguated Knowledge Bases from Large Language Models
authors: Yujia Hu, Tuan-Phong Nguyen, Simon Razniewski
abstract: Automated Knowledge Base Construction (AKBC) is a core NLP task, and recent work proposes generating knowledge bases directly from large language models (LLMs), treating the model itself as the knowledge source. However, LLMs natively possess no representation of entities, leading to duplicate entries as well as conflations. We propose GPTKB 2.0, a methodology for constructing disambiguated KBs directly from LLMs. GPTKB 2.0 incorporates on-the-fly disambiguation of entities, relations and classes, and is meticulously designed to satisfy both scalability and disambiguation accuracy. We analyze the central design decisions and characterize the trade-offs between accuracy, scale, and cost. We execute GPTKB 2.0 at scale, obtaining a materialized KB containing over 1M disambiguated entities and 38.4M triples. This represents the first million-scale LLM-native KB with explicit internal canonicalization of entities, relations, and classes, a significant departure from prior Wikimedia-centric works. GPTKB 2.0 is available at https://gptkb.org/.
zh_title: GPTKB 2.0：直接从大型语言模型构建消歧知识库
translation: 自动知识库构建（AKBC）是自然语言处理的一项核心任务，近期的研究提出直接从大语言模型（LLM）生成知识库，将模型本身视为知识源。然而，LLM 本身并不具备实体的内在表示，这会导致条目重复以及概念混淆。我们提出了 GPTKB 2.0，这是一种直接从 LLM 构建消除歧义知识库的方法。GPTKB 2.0 集成了实体、关系和类的即时消歧，并经过精细设计以同时满足可扩展性和消歧准确率。我们分析了核心设计决策，并刻画了准确率、规模与成本之间的权衡。我们大规模运行了 GPTKB 2.0，获得了一个包含超过 100 万个消歧实体和 3840 万个三元组的实体化知识库。这代表了首个对实体、关系和类具有显式内部规范化的百万级 LLM 原生知识库，显著偏离了以往以维基媒体为中心的工作。GPTKB 2.0 现已发布于 https://gptkb.org/。
tldr: GPTKB 2.0提出了一种直接从LLM构建消歧知识库的方法，成功创建了包含超100万实体和3840万三元组的百万级LLM原生知识库。
ai_comments:
1. 创新性：提出了首个无需依赖维基媒体（Wikimedia）等外部数据源对齐、完全基于LLM原生能力的消歧知识库构建框架，实现了实体、关系和分类的即时内部规范化。
2. 重要性：成功构建并开源了首个百万级LLM原生消歧知识库（含100万+实体和3840万+三元组），为自动化知识库构建（AKBC）提供了全新的范式。
3. 局限性：直接依赖LLM进行知识抽取和消歧在面对大规模数据时可能带来较高的计算与API调用成本，且需要谨慎平衡准确率与扩展规模。
motivation: 直接将大语言模型（LLM）作为知识源生成知识库时，由于LLM原生缺乏显式的实体表示能力，容易导致生成的知识库中出现大量的重复条目和概念混淆。
method: 提出了GPTKB 2.0方法，引入了针对实体、关系和分类的即时（on-the-fly）消歧机制，并在设计上对构建准确率、扩展规模以及经济成本之间的权衡进行了深入分析与优化。
results: 规模化运行GPTKB 2.0后，成功构建了一个包含超过100万个消歧实体和3840万个三元组的实体化知识库。
conclusion: GPTKB 2.0代表了首个对实体、关系和类具有显式内部规范化的百万级LLM原生知识库，开创了摆脱传统以维基媒体为中心的知识库构建新范式。

title: CARE-Bench: Benchmarking Patient-Facing LLM Triage
authors: Yining Hua, Hongbin Na, Cyrus Ayubcha
abstract: Patient-facing medical LLMs and agents increasingly answer symptom questions before clinician contact, where the key safety question is what action the user should take next. We introduce CARE-Bench, a source-grounded benchmark that evaluates sequential patient-facing triage as a four-label per-turn current-action task. CARE-Bench contains 500 cases and 1,059 evaluated patient-disclosure prefixes reconstructed from medical dialogue, consultation, and follow-up-question sources. We evaluate 11 models on 269 held-out rounds under unprompted and minimally prompted open-ended protocols, using a fixed GPT-5.5 mapper to code each response into the four-label action space. Unprompted macro-F1 remains low, ranging from 31.2 to 50.4. Prompting improves 10 of 11 models, with prompted macro-F1 ranging from 46.9 to 63.4, but substantial threshold errors remain. Prompted models often recommend care before needed clarification is obtained; when the correct action was to ask for more information, only 33.5% of prompted outputs preserved the step. The persistence of these errors after prompting suggests that patient-facing triage is not a simple prompting problem and supports explicit evaluation of action timing before deployment.
comment: Code and data are available at GitHub and Hugging Face. Submitted as a preprint
zh_title: CARE-Bench：面向患者的大语言模型分诊评估基准
translation: 面向患者的医疗大语言模型和智能体在患者接触临床医生之前回答症状问题的应用日益增多，其中关键的安全问题在于用户下一步应该采取什么行动。我们推出了CARE-Bench，这是一个基于源数据的基准，将连续的面向患者分诊评估为单轮四标签的当前行动任务。CARE-Bench包含从医疗对话、问诊和追问来源重构的500个案例和1059个评估患者披露前缀。我们在无提示和极小提示的开放式协议下，在269个留出轮次上评估了11种模型，并使用固定的GPT-5.5映射器将每个回答编码到四标签行动空间中。无提示下的Macro-F1保持在较低水平（31.2至50.4）。提示改善了11个模型中的10个，提示后的Macro-F1范围为46.9至63.4，但仍存在大量的阈值错误。提示后的模型经常在获得所需的澄清信息之前就推荐医疗护理；当正确的行动是询问更多信息时，只有33.5%的提示输出保留了这一追问步骤。提示后这些错误的持续存在表明，面向患者的分诊并不是一个简单的提示工程问题，这支持在部署前对行动时机进行显式评估。
tldr: CARE-Bench基准评估了11种医疗LLM的多轮分诊安全性，发现模型常在未追问足够关键信息前过早给出就医建议，表明LLM分诊安全无法仅靠提示词解决。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了专门针对面向患者的大语言模型（LLM）进行时序分诊安全评估的基准CARE-Bench，关注于“何时采取何种行动”这一关键安全时机问题。研究揭示了现有模型容易在未获得足够澄清信息前便过早给出就医建议（即只有33.5%的模型在需要追问时成功进行了追问），证明了分诊安全并非简单的提示工程问题。局限性在于使用了GPT-5.5作为映射器来将开放式回答归类，可能引入映射偏差，且基准评估的数据集规模相对有限（500个案例）。
motivation: 面向患者的医疗LLM和智能体在患者接触医生前解答症状问题日益增多，其核心安全问题在于准确判断用户下一步应采取何种行动（以及何时采取行动）。然而目前缺乏评估多轮对话中时序分诊行动时机与安全性的基准。
method: 推出了CARE-Bench基准，将多轮面向患者的分诊评估定义为每轮4标签的当前行动任务。该基准包含从医疗对话、咨询及追问来源重构的500个案例和1059个评估前缀。研究使用无提示和极小化提示的开放式协议评估了11种模型（基于269个留出轮次），并利用固定的GPT-5.5映射器将模型回答归类至4标签行动空间。
results: 无提示状态下，模型的Macro-F1仅在31.2至50.4之间；提示词优化使11个模型中的10个性能有所提升（Macro-F1达到46.9至63.4），但仍存在严重的阈值错误。提示后的模型常在尚未获取必要澄清信息前就推荐就医；当正确行动应为追问更多信息时，仅有33.5%的提示后输出保留了追问步骤。
conclusion: 面向患者的大模型分诊并非简单的提示工程即可解决的问题。研究强调了在将医疗大模型实际部署前，必须对其采取行动的时机进行显式评估，以确保患者安全。

title: Failure-Informed Image Self-Augmentation for Multimodal Large Language Model Self-Improvement
authors: Chunyang Jiang, Pingping Zhang, Yuzhi Zhao, Wenao Ma, Zhijian Hou, Mengyang Wu, Yiyang Cai, Senkang Hu, Sitong Cheng, Chi-Min Chan, Wei Xue, Yike Guo
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across vision-language tasks, but their progress depends heavily on large-scale, high-quality multimodal data that are costly to annotate. Self-augmentation offers a promising alternative by enabling models to expand their own training data without external supervision. However, existing MLLM self-augmentation methods are largely text-centric, while image augmentation remains underexplored and typically relies on generic or handcrafted transformations that are weakly aligned with the model's actual incapability. We propose Failure-informed Image Self-Augmentation (\textbf{FISA}), a framework for MLLM self-improvement that constructs augmented images from the model's own failure cases. Our method generates visually challenging yet answer-preserving image complications, verifies their utility through self-examination, and applies dual fidelity filtering to avoid semantic distortion. Experiments on visual question answering benchmarks show that the proposed method consistently improves performance across both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings. Further experiments validate the compatibility of FISA with existing textual self-augmentation approaches, the superior data efficiency of the synthesized samples over generic image augmentation baselines, and the practical effectiveness of the proposed filtering strategy.
zh_title: 基于失败信息的图像自我增强用于多模态大语言模型自我改进
translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉-语言任务中取得了显著成效，但其进步高度依赖于昂贵的高质量多模态数据标注。自我增强提供了一种有前景的替代方案，使模型无需外部监督即可扩展训练数据。然而，现有的MLLM自我增强方法大多以文本为中心，而图像增强仍缺乏探索，且通常依赖与模型实际缺陷弱相关的通用或手工变换。我们提出了基于失败信息的图像自我增强（FISA），这是一种用于MLLM自我改进的框架，能够从模型自身的失败案例中构建增强图像。我们的方法生成了具有视觉挑战性但保留答案的图像复合形态，通过自我审查验证其实用性，并应用双重保真度过滤来避免语义扭曲。在视觉问答基准测试上的实验表明，所提出的方法在分布内和分布外设置下均能一致地提高性能。进一步的实验证实了FISA与现有文本自我增强方法的兼容性、合成样本相比通用图像增强基线的优越数据效率，以及所提过滤策略的实际有效性。
tldr: 提出了FISA框架，通过利用多模态大模型的失败案例生成有挑战性且保留答案的增强图像，并结合双重过滤实现无监督自我改进。
ai_comments: 本论文的创新之处在于改变了以往以文本为中心或依赖通用变换的自我增强模式，首次提出从模型自身的“失败案例”出发进行针对性的图像自我增强（FISA）。通过结合自我审查和双重保真度过滤，有效解决了合成图像容易发生语义扭曲的问题，具有较高的实用价值和数据效率。
motivation: MLLM依赖高成本的高质量多模态标注数据，而现有的自我增强方法大多以文本为中心，图像增强探索不足且通常依赖与模型实际弱点匹配度低的通用变换。
method: 提出基于失败信息的图像自我增强（FISA）框架：1) 从模型的失败案例中构建具有视觉挑战性且保留原答案的增强图像；2) 通过自我审查验证其效用；3) 应用双重保真度过滤（dual fidelity filtering）以防止语义扭曲。
results: 在视觉问答（VQA）基准测试中，FISA在分布内和分布外设置下均一致提升了性能，表现出比通用图像增强基线更高的样本效率，并能与现有的文本自我增强方法良好兼容。
conclusion: FISA框架为多模态大语言模型的自我改进提供了一种高效且无需外部监督的新路径，显著提升了模型在视觉-语言任务中的性能和泛化能力。

title: Dependency Triad: A Metric to Quantify the Dependencies Between Attributes for Local Differential Privacy
authors: Sandaru Jayawardana, Sennur Ulukus, Ming Ding, Kanchana Thilakarathna
abstract: Collecting multidimensional user data is essential for extracting rich insights across various applications. Local Differential Privacy (LDP) has emerged as a de facto standard for mitigating privacy risks in such scenarios. A key challenge in privacy-preserving multidimensional data collection lies in inter-attribute dependencies, as they can inadvertently reveal correlated information and increase privacy vulnerabilities. Therefore, accurately measuring correlation-induced privacy leakage (CPL) is essential for privacy analysis and privacy-utility trade-off. However, existing CPL analysis solutions either require accurate prior knowledge or face scalability challenges for large numbers of attributes and high-cardinality attributes. These limit their practical applicability in real data. To address this research gap, we propose a novel metric, ``Dependency Triad'' (DT), which summarizes the pairwise dependency information relevant to CPL using three parameters and yields a \emph{constant-time} conservative estimator of pairwise CPL. DT explicitly models uncertainty in prior distributional knowledge through its parameters, delivering robust leakage estimates. Moreover, its robustness to sparse distributions makes it particularly suitable for high-cardinality attributes, while the pairwise formulation serves as a tractable building block for assessing total leakage in multidimensional settings. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real datasets demonstrate that DT consistently estimates CPL across diverse dependency regimes and prior uncertainties.
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security (ACM CCS 2026)
zh_title: 依赖三元组：一种用于本地微分隐私中量化属性间依赖关系的度量指标
translation: 收集多维用户数据对于在各种应用中提取丰富见解至关重要。本地微分隐私（LDP）已成为在此类场景中减轻隐私风险的事实标准。隐私保护多维数据收集中的一个关键挑战在于属性间的依赖性，因为它们可能会无意中透露关联信息并增加隐私脆弱性。因此，准确测量关联引发的隐私泄露（CPL）对于隐私分析和隐私-效用权衡至关重要。然而，现有的CPL分析解决方案要么需要准确的先验知识，要么在大规模属性和高基数属性下面临可扩展性挑战，这限制了它们在真实数据中的实际适用性。为填补这一研究空白，我们提出了一种全新的度量指标——“依赖三元组”（DT），它使用三个参数总结与CPL相关的成对依赖信息，并给出成对CPL的常数时间保守估计量。DT通过其参数显式建模先验分布知识中的不确定性，从而提供稳健的泄露估计。此外，它对稀疏分布的稳健性使其特别适用于高基数属性，而成对公式则作为评估多维设置下总泄露的可行基础模块。在合成和真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，DT能够在不同的依赖机制和先验不确定性下一致地估计CPL。
tldr: 本文提出了“依赖三元组”（DT），能够以常数时间稳健地估计本地微分隐私中由属性依赖引起的隐私泄露，适用于高基数和不确定先验场景。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了“依赖三元组”（DT），解决了本地微分隐私（LDP）中关联隐私泄露（CPL）计算复杂度高以及过度依赖精确先验知识的难题。该方法通过常数时间的保守估计和对稀疏高基数数据的强稳健性，显著提升了多维隐私保护数据收集的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的关联隐私泄露（CPL）分析方案依赖准确的先验知识，且在大规模属性或高基数属性场景下存在可扩展性瓶颈，限制了其在真实数据中的实际应用。
method: 提出了“依赖三元组”（Dependency Triad, DT）度量指标，通过三个参数概括与CPL相关的成对依赖信息，提供成对CPL的常数时间（constant-time）保守估计，并显式建模先验概率分布的不确定性。
results: 在合成与真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，DT在多种不同的依赖关系和先验不确定性下均能够一致且稳健地估计关联隐私泄露。
conclusion: “依赖三元组”为评估和优化本地微分隐私下的多维关联隐私泄露提供了一种高效、稳健且可扩展的解决方案。

title: An Actionable Diagnosis of Multilingual, Multi-Agent Planning Failures
authors: Vikas Pahuja, Jonathan Brokman, Omer Hofman, Tamir Nizri, Daniel Vishna, Seraphina Goldfarb-Tarrant, Kelly Marchisio, Hisashi Kojima, Roman Vainshtein
abstract: Multilingual multi-agent systems exhibit substantial degradation beyond English, yet prior work rarely identifies how task-critical information is lost when user requests are converted into executable plans. We study the planner in a multi-agent system as the request-to-action interface and derive an actionable taxonomy of planning-grounding failures from failed real-world task executions. LLM-based analysis shows that these failures constitute an increasing share of unsuccessful executions as language-resource availability declines, with the strongest effects in low-resource languages. To test whether the taxonomy supports mitigation, we introduce TART, Taxonomy-Guided Actionable Representation, that makes the taxonomy's key aspects explicit to the planner and downstream sub-agents. Across multiple languages, three LLM backbones, two datasets, and two agentic configurations, TART consistently improves performance. On multilingual GAIA, it raises a state-of-the-art system's accuracy by 5.6 percentage points averaged across eleven languages spanning low- to high-resource settings.
zh_title: 多语言多智能体规划失败的可操作诊断
translation: 多语言多智能体系统在英语之外的语言中表现出显著的性能衰退，然而先前的研究很少指出用户请求转化为可执行计划时，任务关键信息是如何丢失的。我们将多智能体系统中的规划器视为请求到动作的接口，并从真实世界任务执行失败的案例中推导出了规划-落地（planning-grounding）失败的可操作分类法。基于大语言模型（LLM）的分析表明，随着语言资源可用性的降低，此类失败在未成功执行的案例中所占比例不断上升，且在低资源语言中影响最为显著。为了检验该分类法是否有助于缓解这一问题，我们引入了 TART（分类法引导的可操作表示），它将分类法的关键要素向规划器和下游子智能体显式化。在多种语言、三个 LLM 基座、两个数据集和两种智能体配置下，TART 持续提升了性能。在多语言 GAIA 基准上，它使一个最先进系统在涵盖低资源到高资源设置的 11 种语言上的平均准确率提高了 5.6 个百分点。
tldr: 本文构建了多语言多智能体系统的规划失败分类法，并提出 TART 方法显式指导规划与执行，显著提升了低资源及多语言环境下的任务准确率。
ai_comments:
创新性：系统性地探讨了多语言环境下多智能体系统在“请求-动作”接口（规划器）中的信息丢失问题，并构建了可操作的失败分类法。
重要性：针对低资源语言在多智能体规划中性能显著下降的痛点，提出了简单有效的 mitigation 方法 TART，并在多语言 GAIA 基准上取得了明显的性能提升（平均提升5.6%）。
局限性：由于仅基于摘要分析，具体的分类法层级结构以及 TART 具体的提示词/表征设计细节未在摘要中列出。
motivation: 多语言多智能体系统在非英语场景下性能下降严重，但现有研究缺乏对用户请求转化为可执行计划过程中关键信息丢失机制的系统诊断。
method:
1. 将多智能体系统的规划器定义为“请求-动作”接口，从真实执行失败案例中提炼出“规划-落地（planning-grounding）”失败的可操作分类法。
2. 提出 TART（分类法引导的可操作表示），将分类法的关键维度向规划器和下游子智能体进行显式表达，以指导正确的动作生成。
results:
1. 分析发现随着语言资源下降，规划-落地失败在失败案例中的占比显著上升（低资源语言最严重）。
2. 在多种语言、3种LLM基座、2个数据集和2种智能体配置下，TART均稳定提升性能。
3. 在多语言GAIA基准上，使SOTA系统在跨11种语言（覆盖低至高资源）的平均准确率提高了5.6个百分点。
conclusion: 提出的规划失败分类法成功揭示了多语言多智能体系统的失效根源，而基于该分类法构建的 TART 方法能有效缓解低资源及高资源语言下的规划执行失败问题，显著提升多语言系统的鲁棒性。

title: We Must Have Missed This Comment: Detecting and Repairing Stale Function References in Linux Kernel Comments
authors: Kexin Sun, Yunbo Lyu, Xutong Ma, Hongyu Kuang, Ratnadira Widyasari, He Zhang, Xiaoxing Ma, Julia Lawall, David Lo
abstract: As the Linux kernel evolves, code comments may become outdated, as the functions they reference can be refactored or removed independently without corresponding updates to the comments. Such stale function references can mislead maintainers and thus hinder code comprehension. Prior work on detecting code-comment inconsistency mainly focused on addressing semantic misalignment between Javadoc comments and their directly annotated functions, making them inapplicable to this type of externally induced staleness in the Linux kernel. Therefore, we propose ReCite, a three-stage approach to identify and repair such stale references: (1) detecting unresolved function-form symbols -- symbols in comments that appear to reference functions but for which no matching function can be found in the current codebase, (2) tracing the evolution history of each unresolved symbol through the Git history, and (3) generating LLM-based repair suggestions grounded in the evolution history and current code context. On Linux kernel v6.18-rc1, ReCite detects 869 stale references with generated repair suggestions. A manual evaluation on 200 sampled repairs shows that 178 (89.0%) provide useful repair guidance, with 85 (42.5%) directly applicable. Of our 75 submitted patches, 50 have been accepted. We also empirically study all unresolved function-form symbols.
zh_title: 我们一定漏掉了这条注释：检测与修复 Linux 内核注释中的失效函数引用
translation: 随着 Linux 内核的演变，代码注释可能会变得过时，因为它们引用的函数可能会被独立地重构或删除，而注释却没有得到相应的更新。这种失效的函数引用会误导维护者，从而妨碍代码理解。此前关于检测代码-注释不一致性的工作主要集中于解决 Javadoc 注释与其直接标注的函数之间的语义不匹配问题，这使得它们无法适用于 Linux 内核中这种由外部诱导的过时现象。因此，我们提出了 ReCite，一种包含三个阶段的方法来识别和修复此类失效引用：(1) 检测未解析的函数形式符号——即注释中看起来引用了函数但在当前代码库中找不到匹配函数的符号，(2) 通过 Git 历史追踪每个未解析符号的演化历史，以及 (3) 基于演化历史和当前代码上下文生成基于大语言模型（LLM）的修复建议。在 Linux 内核 v6.18-rc1 上，ReCite 检测到了 869 个带有修复建议的失效引用。对 200 个抽样修复的人工评估表明，178 个（89.0%）提供了有用的修复指导，其中 85 个（42.5%）可以直接应用。在提交的 75 个补丁中，已有 50 个被接受。我们还对所有未解析的函数形式符号进行了实证研究。
tldr: 本文提出了 ReCite，通过结合未解析符号检测、Git 演进历史追溯与 LLM，自动检测并修复 Linux 内核注释中过期的函数引用。
ai_comments: 该论文针对大型开源软件（如 Linux 内核）中普遍存在但容易被忽略的“外部变动导致注释过期”问题，提出了切实有效的解决方案。其创新点在于结合了 Git 演化历史分析与大语言模型（LLM）的上下文理解能力，不仅能定位失配的函数引用，还能生成极具实用价值的修复建议。论文最具说服力的是其落实力——提交给 Linux 内核社区的 75 个补丁中有 50 个被成功合并，体现了极高的工业实用价值。
motivation: Linux 内核在持续演化过程中，被引用的函数常被重构或删除，但相应注释未能同步更新，导致注释中的函数引用失效并误导代码维护者。以往的代码-注释不一致性检测研究多关注 Javadoc 等直接修饰注释，无法解决这种由外部代码变更诱发的失效问题。
method: 提出了名为 ReCite 的三阶段方法：(1) 检测注释中的未解析函数形式符号（看起来引用了函数但在当前代码库中找不到匹配项）；(2) 通过 Git 历史记录追踪该符号的演进与变更过程；(3) 结合演化历史与当前代码上下文，利用大语言模型（LLM）生成修复建议。
results: 在 Linux 内核 v6.18-rc1 上，ReCite 成功检测到 869 个失效引用并生成修复建议。对 200 个抽样修复的人工评估显示，178 个（89.0%）提供了有用的修复指导，85 个（42.5%）可以直接应用。提交给 Linux 内核社区的 75 个补丁中已有 50 个被正式采纳。
conclusion: ReCite 能够有效识别并修复复杂大型项目中由于代码重构或删除导致的注释过期函数引用问题，提升了内核代码的可维护性和可读性。

title: MissClick: Exploiting Digit-Serialized Coordinates to Attack GUI Grounding Models
authors: Yu Ran, Wentao Zhao, Xin Zhang, Yi Pan
abstract: Recent GUI visual grounding models generate screen coordinates as sequences of digit tokens that are parsed into numerical values and mapped to executable clicks. The security implications of this coordinate generation process have been largely overlooked. We observe that each coordinate digit is predicted as a categorical token, yet after parsing, changing a hundreds-place digit by one changes the corresponding numerical coordinate component by 100 units, which can induce a large displacement of the executed click. This observation motivates attack objectives that account for the numerical and place-value structure of coordinate outputs rather than treating them as ordinary text. Moreover, untargeted and targeted attacks impose different success conditions--displacing the click outside the correct region versus into an attacker-specified region--and therefore benefit from different objectives. We propose MissClick, a simple and effective white-box adversarial attack with two goal-specific objectives: MissClick-U maximizes soft-coordinate displacement for untargeted disruption, while MissClick-T minimizes a place-weighted target-digit loss for targeted hijacking. Compared with existing attacks against GUI grounding models on OS-Atlas and UGround across desktop, web, and mobile platforms, MissClick-U achieves untargeted success rates of 75.07\% and 72.93\% (+16.62 and +30.72 pp), and MissClick-T achieves targeted success rates of 44.86\% and 62.67\% (+31.73 and +47.06 pp). Attack objective comparison further shows that soft-coordinate displacement yields the highest untargeted attack success rate, whereas place-weighted target-digit optimization yields the highest targeted attack success rate, revealing distinct objective preferences for the two attack goals.
zh_title: MissClick：利用数字序列化坐标攻击 GUI Grounding 模型
translation: 最近的 GUI 视觉接地（Grounding）模型将屏幕坐标生成为数字 Token 序列，这些 Token 被解析为数值并映射为可执行的点击操作。这种坐标生成过程的安全性隐患在很大程度上被忽视了。我们注意到，虽然每个坐标数字都被预测为一个分类 Token，但在解析后，改变百位上的一个数字就会使相应的数值坐标分量改变 100 个单位，从而导致执行点击的大幅位移。这一观察促使我们提出考虑坐标输出的数值和数位结构的攻击目标，而不是将其视为普通文本。此外，非定向攻击和定向攻击具有不同的成功条件——将点击位移到正确区域之外与将点击位移到攻击者指定的区域内——因此受益于不同的目标函数。我们提出了 MissClick，这是一种简单且有效的白盒对抗攻击，具有两个特定目标的攻击函数：MissClick-U 最大化软坐标位移以实现非定向破坏，而 MissClick-T 最小化加权数位目标数字损失以实现定向劫持。与跨桌面、Web 和移动平台的 OS-Atlas 和 UGround 上现有的针对 GUI 接地模型的攻击相比，MissClick-U 实现了 75.07% 和 72.93% 的非定向攻击成功率（分别提升 +16.62 和 +30.72 个百分点），MissClick-T 实现了 44.86% 和 62.67% 的定向攻击成功率（分别提升 +31.73 和 +47.06 个百分点）。攻击目标对比进一步表明，软坐标位移产生了最高的非定向攻击成功率，而加权数位目标数字优化产生了最高的定向攻击成功率，揭示了这两种攻击目标具有截然不同的优化偏好。
tldr: 针对GUI接地模型将坐标序列化为数字Token的机制，提出了基于数值和数位特性的对抗攻击 MissClick，大幅提升了非定向与定向攻击成功率。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地利用了GUI Grounding模型将屏幕坐标序列化为数字Token这一特性，揭示了Token分类与实际数值/数位权重之间的安全漏洞。针对非定向（破坏）和定向（劫持）攻击分别设计软坐标位移与数位加权损失函数，针对性强且效果显著。主要局限性在于目前方法基于白盒假设，在真实场景中攻击者未必能获取完整模型参数，后续可探讨黑盒攻击与迁移性。
motivation: 现有的GUI Grounding模型将屏幕坐标作为数字Token序列输出并解析为数值。由于每个数字Token对最终坐标数值的影响（位值/数位，如百位与个位）差异极大，忽视这种结构特性的传统文本对抗攻击效果有限。此外，非定向攻击与定向攻击具有不同的成功条件，需设计匹配的攻击优化目标。
method: 提出了白盒对抗攻击方法 MissClick，包含两种特定目标的优化函数：1. MissClick-U（非定向攻击）：最大化软坐标位移（soft-coordinate displacement），促使点击偏离正确区域；2. MissClick-T（定向攻击）：最小化加权数位目标数字损失（place-weighted target-digit loss），引导点击落入攻击者指定的区域。
results: 在OS-Atlas和UGround等跨桌面、Web及移动平台的基准测试中：MissClick-U 的非定向攻击成功率达到 75.07% 和 72.93%（较已有攻击提升 16.62 和 30.72 个百分点）；MissClick-T 的定向攻击成功率达到 44.86% 和 62.67%（较已有攻击提升 31.73 和 47.06 个百分点）。对比分析确认软坐标位移最适合非定向攻击，而加权数位损失最适合定向攻击。
conclusion: 本文证明了针对GUI Grounding模型的攻击应充分考虑坐标输出的数值与数位（位值）结构。针对不同攻击目标（非定向与定向）设计专属的损失函数能够极大地提升攻击成功率，揭示了此类模型在自动化交互中的严重安全隐患。

title: AI-Based Sound Effect Generation: A Narrative Review of Generative Models Across Input Modalities
authors: Sandy Abdo, Bill Kapralos, Priyamvada Tripathi, KC Collins, Adam Dubrowski
abstract: Sound effects play a crucial role in conveying actions, events, and environmental cues across digital applications, often requiring a high degree of variation and contextual adaptability. Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven audio generative models are rapidly growing in popularity and have the potential to transform the way sound is synthesized and used across various applications. In response to this growing momentum, this chapter reviews and analyzes recent AI-based generative models for sound effect synthesis, with a focus on how different input modalities (text, visual, audio, and multimodal) affect the quality, controllability, and contextual relevance of the generated audio. It examines 30 peer-reviewed articles sourced from Google Scholar, IEEE Xplore, and the ACM Digital Library, exploring the evolution of AI generative models over the past five years. The results show that multiple models achieved state-of-the-art performance, producing high-fidelity, semantically aligned, and increasingly temporally coherent sound effects across tasks. However, despite these advances, the review identifies persistent challenges, including limitations in temporal synchronization for complex multi-event scenarios, gaps between objective metrics and human perception, and trade-offs between controllability and generative diversity. Overall, the chapter highlights that AI-driven sound effect generation is progressing toward more adaptive, scalable, and context-aware systems, offering significant implications for future sound design workflows and interactive media applications.
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, to appear in G. A. Tsihrintzis, M. Virvou, N. Bourbakis, and L. C. Jain (Eds.), Advances in Global Applied Artificial Intelligence: Springer, Learning and Analytics in Intelligent Systems Book Series
zh_title: 基于人工智能的音效生成：跨输入模态生成模型的叙述性综述
translation: 音效在数字应用中传递动作、事件和环境线索方面起着至关重要的作用，通常需要高度的变化性和上下文适应性。人工智能（AI）驱动的音频生成模型正迅速普及，并有潜力改变在各种应用中合成和使用声音的方式。为了应对这一日益增长的发展势头，本章回顾并分析了近期用于音效合成的AI生成模型，重点关注不同的输入模态（文本、视觉、音频和多模态）如何影响生成音频的质量、可控性和上下文相关性。本章审查了源自Google Scholar、IEEE Xplore和ACM Digital Library的30篇同行评审论文，探讨了过去五年中AI生成模型的演进。结果表明，多种模型达到了最先进的性能，能够跨任务生成高保真、语义对齐且时间连贯性日益增强的音效。然而，尽管取得了这些进展，该综述仍指出了持续存在的挑战，包括复杂多事件场景下的时间同步局限性、客观指标与人类感知之间的差距，以及可控性与生成多样性之间的权衡。总体而言，本章强调了AI驱动的音效生成正朝着更加自适应、可扩展和具备上下文感知能力的系统迈进，对未来的音效设计工作流程和交互式媒体应用具有重大意义。
tldr: 本综述梳理了近五年30篇文献中AI音效生成模型的发展，分析了不同输入模态对合成效果的影响，并指出了当前面临的同步性与评估等挑战。
ai_comments: 该综述系统梳理了近五年AI音效生成技术在不同输入模态（文本、视觉、音频、多模态）下的发展脉络。论文不仅肯定了高保真度和语义对齐方面的最新突破，还针血地指出了复杂场景下的时间同步、客观指标与主观感知脱节以及可控性与多样性权衡等关键瓶颈，对音效设计和交互媒体领域的后续研究具有重要的参考价值。
motivation: 随着AI驱动的音频生成模型快速发展并展现出重塑音效合成与应用的潜力，有必要深入梳理和分析不同输入模态如何影响生成音频的质量、可控性及上下文适应能力。
method: 本文对来自Google Scholar、IEEE Xplore和ACM Digital Library的30篇同行评审文献进行了叙述性综述，系统探讨了近五年来AI生成模型的发展，并重点分析了文本、视觉、音频及多模态等不同输入模态对音频合成质量、可控性和上下文相关性的影响。
results: 研究表明，多种模型达到了SOTA性能，能够产生高保真、语义对齐且时间连贯性强的音效；然而，领域内仍面临复杂多事件场景的时间同步局限、客观评估指标与人类感知的差距，以及可控性与生成多样性之间的权衡等挑战。
conclusion: 基于AI的音效生成技术正在朝着更加自适应、可扩展和具备上下文感知能力的方向演进，对未来的音效设计工作流程和交互式媒体应用产生了深远影响。

title: When Does Disaggregation Pay? Simulating Prefill--Decode--Attention--FFN Specialization for Agentic LLM Inference
authors: Przemyslaw Forys, Haoran Wu, Can Xiao, Jiayi Nie, Tony Liu, Rika Antonova, Timothy Jones, Robert Mullins, Wayne Luk, Aaron Zhao, George A. Constantinides
abstract: Agentic inference now dominates the LLM inference landscape, requiring LLMs to actively engage in multi-turn interactions with tool-calling capabilities. This introduces a more complex workload for the underlying inference system: serving stages such as prefill and decode exhibit substantially different behaviors and demand distinct compute and memory-bandwidth capabilities. As a result, a single homogeneous GPU system now struggles to support agentic inference, motivating an industry shift toward heterogeneous systems with disaggregated serving capabilities, such as the emerging Vera-Rubin platform with GPUs and Groq LPUs. However, the question of what the optimal hardware should look like for each component in a heterogeneous system remains underexplored. To this end, we propose a novel simulation framework for disaggregated serving, termed \textbf{HeteroPanacea}, that enables system-level simulation across three dimensions: 1) disaggregated quantization, 2) automated intra- and inter-device parallelization scheduling, and 3) PDAF (prefill-decode-attention-FFN) NPU architectural heterogeneity. By combining these three axes, we provide a cross-stack simulation framework for future heterogeneous agentic serving systems. We confirm the benefit of Prefill Decode disaggregation, simulating increased serving throughput by up to 75\% compared to traditional serving with current GPUs and demonstrate 4 way Prefill Decode Attention FFN disaggregation is the most consistent for increasing throughput across different models, assuming custom NPUs. We also investigate the relationship between model architecture and gain from disaggregation by running a set of ablation studies.
zh_title: 拆分计算何时划算？模拟智能体大语言模型推理中的 Prefill--Decode--Attention--FFN 专业化分工
translation: 智能体推理目前主导着大语言模型（LLM）推理领域，要求LLM在具备工具调用能力的同时积极参与多轮交互。这为底层推理系统带来了更复杂的负载：如Prefill（预填充）和Decode（解码）等服务阶段表现出显著不同的行为，并需要截然不同的计算与内存带宽能力。因此，单一的同质化GPU系统如今难以高效支持智能体推理，促使行业转向具备解耦服务能力的异构系统（例如包含GPU和Groq LPU的最新Vera-Rubin平台）。然而，异构系统中每个组件的最优硬件应该是什么样的问题仍未得到充分探索。为此，我们提出了一种用于解耦服务的创新模拟框架HeteroPanacea，能够从三个维度实现系统级模拟：1）解耦量化，2）自动化设备内与设备间并行调度，以及3）PDAF（预填充-解码-注意力-FFN）NPU架构异构性。通过结合这三个轴向，我们为未来的异构智能体服务系统提供了一个跨栈模拟框架。我们验证了Prefill与Decode解耦的优势，在当前GPU上与传统服务相比，模拟的服务吞吐量提升了高达75%，并证明了在假设存在自定义NPU的情况下，Prefill-Decode-Attention-FFN四路解耦在提升不同模型吞吐量方面最为稳定。我们还通过一系列消融实验探讨了模型架构与解耦收益之间的关系。
tldr: 本文提出了HeteroPanacea模拟框架，探索并验证了在智能体LLM推理中实施Prefill-Decode-Attention-FFN四路硬件解耦与异构专用化的显著性能优势。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地提出了PDAF（Prefill-Decode-Attention-FFN）四路解耦与异构NPU硬件集成的跨栈模拟框架HeteroPanacea，针对智能体LLM推理这一新兴复杂负载提出了前瞻性的系统优化方向。其重要性在于为未来大模型推理芯片与异构集群的软硬件协同设计提供了定量分析工具；主要局限在于结果建立在模拟之上，真实集群中的通信延迟与调度开销可能对实际收益产生影响。
motivation: 智能体LLM推理包含复杂的多轮交互与工具调用，预填充（Prefill）与解码（Decode）阶段对计算和内存带宽的需求截然不同，传统的同质化GPU系统难以高效承载，亟需探索异构硬件系统中最优解耦（disaggregated）与专用化设计方案。
method: 提出了跨栈模拟框架HeteroPanacea，包含三个核心维度：1）解耦量化，2）自动化设备内与设备间并行调度，3）Prefill-Decode-Attention-FFN（PDAF）NPU架构异构性。
results: 模拟实验表明，Prefill-Decode解耦相比传统GPU推理服务吞吐量可提升高达75%；在自定义NPU假设下，Prefill-Decode-Attention-FFN四路解耦能够在不同模型间最稳定地提升吞吐量。消融实验进一步揭示了模型架构与解耦收益之间的内在关系。
conclusion: 智能体LLM推理采用服务阶段与算子解耦（尤其是PDAF四路异构解耦）能显著且稳定地提升系统吞吐量，为未来异构大模型推理硬件设计提供了重要指引。

title: AgenticECO: An Agentic Framework for ECO on 3D Integrated Circuits
authors: Shuo Ren, Yaohui Han, Libo Shen, Zhiqiang Jia, Rongliang Fu, Bei Yu, Tsung-Yi Ho
abstract: As Moore's law slows, the industry is turning to three-dimensional integration; yet in merged 3D-IC flows, routed designs expose bond-level defects with no 2D analogue, and post-route engineering change orders (ECO) remain manual, expertise-bound work. Worse, the standard edit-then-fully-reroute practice entangles a repair with router churn, so a signoff number cannot be attributed to the edit that motivated it. We present AgenticECO, an evidence-gated tool-using agent workflow for 3D-IC ECO on the open-source TaiWei flow, paired with EcoRoute, a minimal-disturbance ECO-routing layer that drives the unmodified pinned router so a repair is attributable to its edit. Across nine matched natural defect cases under identical budgets, AgenticECO clears seven versus two for both full reroute and stock repair, at 0.66\% mean disturbance over cleared cases and zero clock nets touched, and a cross-backbone rerun under the same sealed contract clears all nine. Controlled studies show that the repair moves are necessary under preservation, that occupancy-aware choice buys legal landings rather than repair success, and that under tightened clocks minimal disturbance flips accept versus reject. Three preregistered visual studies localize the pixel instrument's edge to contested landing sites, and a preregistered blind diagnostic exactly restores every held-out injected defect, the only arm with zero wrong edits. Every accepted result passes routing, fresh extraction, max/min timing, DRC, and structural-equivalence gates. Code, environment, and per-episode audit artifacts are released as supplementary material.
zh_title: AgenticECO：一种用于3D集成电路ECO的智能体框架
translation: 随着摩尔定律放缓，芯片产业正在转向三维集成（3D-IC）；然而在合并的 3D-IC 流程中，已布线的设计暴露出了在 2D 芯片中不存在的接合级缺陷，且布线后工程变更指令（ECO）仍依赖人工和专业经验。更糟糕的是，标准的“先修改再完全重布线”实践将修复操作与布线器的剧烈变化缠绕在一起，导致最终签核数据无法准确归因于引发该修改的操作。本文提出了 AgenticECO，一种在开源 TaiWei 流程上用于 3D-IC ECO 的证据门控且可使用工具的智能体工作流，并配备了 EcoRoute——一个最小扰动 ECO 布线层，用以驱动未经修改的钉住布线器，从而使修复效果可归因于其修改本身。在相同预算下的 9 个匹配自然缺陷案例中，AgenticECO 解决了 7 个缺陷，而完全重布线和标准修复均仅解决 2 个，已解决案例的平均扰动仅为 0.66% 且零时钟网被触及；在相同密封合同下的跨骨干重运行中则解决了全部 9 个缺陷。对照研究表明，在保持电路稳定的约束下修复移动是必要的，感知占用的选择能获得合法落点而非仅靠修复成功，且在收紧的时钟约束下最小扰动决定了接受还是拒绝。三项预注册的视觉研究将像素仪器的边缘准确定位到了有争议的落点位置，一项预注册盲诊断精确还原了每个保留的注入缺陷，是唯一实现零错误编辑的操作组。每个被接受的结果均通过了布线、全新提取、最大/最小时序、DRC 以及结构等价性门控。代码、环境及每组审计产物均作为补充材料开源。
tldr: AgenticECO 是一个结合最小扰动布线层 EcoRoute 的智能体框架，实现了 3D-IC 布线后 ECO 缺陷的高成功率、低扰动且零错误编辑的自动化修复。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将智能体（Agent）引入 3D-IC 的后布线 ECO 修复中，并提出了 EcoRoute 以解决修复归因性与高扰动难题。实验评估非常严谨，包含了预注册盲诊断和多重签核门控，展示了极高的修复准确度与电路稳定性。局限性在于目前主要依托开源 TaiWei 流程和特定测试案例，在极其复杂的大规模工业级 3D-IC 芯片设计上的拓展性与泛化能力仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 随着 3D 集成电路（3D-IC）的发展，布线后会出现独特的接合级缺陷（bond-level defects），但目前 ECO 修复仍高度依赖人工经验；且传统“编辑后完全重布线”的做法会导致电路剧烈变动，使签核指标无法明确归因于具体的编辑操作。
method: 提出 AgenticECO 智能体工作流，基于开源 TaiWei 流程，通过证据门控（evidence-gated）和工具调用实现自动化 ECO 决策与修复；同时配备 EcoRoute 最小扰动 ECO 布线层，用于驱动未修改的固定布线器（pinned router），确保修复效果可直接归因于具体的修改动作。
results: 在 9 个匹配的自然缺陷案例中，AgenticECO 成功修复 7 个（传统完全重布线和标准修复仅解决 2 个），平均电路扰动仅 0.66% 且未触及任何时钟网；跨骨干重运行成功解决全部 9 个案例；盲诊断测试成功还原所有注入缺陷且达到 0 错误编辑；所有结果均通过了布线、时序、DRC 及结构等价性等多重严格门控。
conclusion: AgenticECO 结合 EcoRoute 成功解决了 3D-IC ECO 修复中依赖人工、过度重布线以及无法归因修复效果的难题，为 3D 集成电路的自动化精密修复提供了高效且可靠的全新方案。

title: Can LLMs Test Terminal User Interfaces?
authors: Chao Peng, Ruida Hu, Ajitha Rajan, Tegawendé F Bissyandé, Jacques Klein, Cuiyun Gao
abstract: Terminal User Interfaces (TUIs) combine the stateful, screen-oriented behaviour of GUIs with terminal deployment and are now common in developer tools. Yet they lack a dedicated testing methodology. We survey 197 real-world TUI applications: only 12% of test code exercises the interface, and 45% of those tests never send input, checking a static frame instead. We turn these applications into a headless benchmark spanning ratatui/Rust, bubbletea/Go, textual/Python, and ink/TypeScript, packaging each as an instrumented Docker image. We record line and widget coverage where reliable, rendered terminal states, and crashes. Under equal wall-clock budgets, we compare four frontier LLMs with random exploration. No model dominates. Random is a strong time-budgeted baseline, but its crash advantage comes from higher throughput: per interaction, LLM guidance is more efficient and uniquely reaches input-gated faults. Automatically deriving launch inputs yields the largest practical gain, enabling applications that otherwise never start. Line coverage poorly predicts crash discovery, weakening it as a proxy for test effectiveness. Automated TUI testing is feasible but far from solved, and honest baselines matter more than model choice. We release the coverage tool tuicov at https://github.com/tui-testing/tuicov and the testing framework tuibot at https://github.com/tui-testing/tuibot.
zh_title: 大语言模型（LLM）能否测试终端用户界面（TUI）？
translation: 终端用户界面（TUI）结合了图形用户界面（GUI）的有状态、面向屏幕的行为与终端部署特性，现已广泛应用于开发者工具中。然而，它们缺乏专门的测试方法学。我们对197个真实世界中的TUI应用进行了调查：只有12%的测试代码覆盖了界面，且其中45%的测试从未发送输入，仅检查静态帧。我们将这些应用转化为跨越 ratatui/Rust、bubbletea/Go、textual/Python 和 ink/TypeScript 的无头（headless）基准，并将每个应用打包为经过打点的 Docker 镜像。我们在可靠的情况下记录了行覆盖率和组件覆盖率、渲染的终端状态以及崩溃情况。在等长的时间预算下，我们将四种前沿大语言模型（LLM）与随机探索进行了对比。结果显示没有模型占据绝对优势。随机探索是一个强有力的基于时间预算的基准线，但其崩溃发现优势源于更高的吞吐量；按单次交互来看，LLM的引导更为高效，且能独家触及需要特定输入的故障。自动推导启动输入带来了最大的实际收益，使原本无法启动的应用得以运行。行覆盖率对崩溃发现的预测效果较差，削弱了其作为测试有效性代理指标的地位。自动化TUI测试是可行的，但远未得到解决，诚实的基准线比模型选择更为重要。我们在 GitHub 上开源了覆盖率工具 tuicov 与测试框架 tuibot。
tldr: 本文构建了多语言TUI自动化测试基准，评估了前沿LLM与随机探索的效果，发现LLM在单次交互效率和深层输入门控故障发现上更有优势，但自动化TUI测试仍面临极大挑战。
ai_comments: 本文填补了终端用户界面（TUI）自动化测试领域的空白，具有很强的实用价值和创新性。文章提出了跨Rust、Go、Python、TypeScript等多语言的Docker无头基准套件，揭示了LLM的高单次交互效率与随机探索的高吞吐量之间的权衡，并指出了传统行覆盖率指标在崩溃预测中的局限性。局限在于LLM自身的推理延迟导致吞吐量较低，未来可探讨结合随机探索与LLM引导的混合测试策略。
motivation: 终端用户界面（TUI）在现代开发者工具中广泛使用，兼具GUI的状态与终端部署的便捷性，但目前极度缺乏专门的自动化测试方法学，大部分真实应用的界面测试仅局限于静态帧检查或无输入测试。
method: 调查197个真实TUI应用现状；构建涵盖Rust(ratatui)、Go(bubbletea)、Python(textual)、TypeScript(ink)多语言TUI框架的Docker无头基准套件；开发tuicov覆盖率工具与tuibot测试框架；在相同时间预算下对比4种前沿LLM与随机探索在覆盖率、渲染状态及崩溃发现上的表现。
results: 在时间预算相同的情况下，无单一LLM占绝对主导；随机探索因极高的吞吐量成为强基准，但按单次交互计算，LLM引导效率更高且能触发需要复杂输入的深层故障；自动推导启动输入能带来最大实际收益；行覆盖率无法很好地预测崩溃发现。
conclusion: 自动化TUI测试具有可行性，但仍是一个远未解决的挑战。在评测LLM测试能力时，诚实且强力的基准线（如随机探索）比模型本身的选择更为重要。

title: Risky Business: Measuring The Faithfulness-Safety Tension
authors: Dominik Meier, Luca Joshua Francis, Marco Bernhard Kaiser, Terry Ruas, Jan Philip Wahle, Bela Gipp
abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning offers a promising window into model monitoring. However, monitoring relies on faithfulness, i.e., the model output strictly derives from its reasoning trace. We identify an alignment tension where a model must be faithful enough to be monitored, yet robust enough to reject unsafe reasoning. We demonstrate that this counterbalance exists in current Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), and show ways in which it can be addressed. We introduce HazMart, a human-written dataset set in an autonomous AI shopkeeper scenario. Unlike prior work that relies on providing hints in prompts to test faithfulness (e.g., "A Stanford professor said it should be Answer A"), we propose a novel replacement-based technique, which we call Targeted Reasoning Replacement (TRR), that directly intervenes in the reasoning chain to substitute in unsafe or illogical thoughts (e.g., "Wait, the answer must be Option B [was Option A] because it is the most fitting"). DeepSeek-R1-Llama-70B exhibits high faithfulness (97.5%) but fails to reject Unsafe Reasoning (12.3%), while QwQ-32B is more robust (73.9% safety) at the cost of lower faithfulness (74.7%). Mechanistic analyses of QwQ-32B reveal that these properties are represented by anti-correlated internal directions peaking at the action-commit token. Finally, we demonstrate that representation steering can independently amplify the safety direction, increasing safe behavior by 9 percentage points while maintaining base capabilities.
zh_title: 冒险之举：衡量忠实性与安全性之间的紧张关系
translation: 思维链（CoT）推理为模型监控提供了一个有前景的窗口。然而，监控依赖于忠实性，即模型输出严格来源于其推理轨迹。我们发现了一种对齐紧张关系，即模型既需要足够忠实以被监控，又需要足够鲁棒以拒绝不安全的推理。我们证明了当前大型推理模型（LRMs）中存在这种制衡关系，并展示了解决该问题的方法。我们引入了HazMart，这是一个设置在自主AI店员场景下的手写数据集。与以往在提示中提供暗示来测试忠实性的工作不同，我们提出了一种新型的基于替换的技术，称为针对性推理替换（TRR），该技术直接干预推理链以替换入不安全或不合逻辑的想法。DeepSeek-R1-Llama-70B表现出极高的忠实性（97.5%），但未能拒绝不安全推理（安全性仅12.3%），而QwQ-32B更鲁棒（安全性为73.9%），代价是忠实性较低（74.7%）。对QwQ-32B的机制分析表明，这些特性由在动作提交标记处达到峰值的反相关内部方向所表征。最后，我们证明表征操控可以独立放大安全方向，在保持基础能力的同时将安全行为提升9个百分点。
tldr: 论文揭示了推理模型中思维链忠实性与安全性之间的反向权衡关系，并提出TRR干预评估法与表征操控提升安全性的解决方案。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于超越了以往仅通过Prompt注入提示评估忠实度的方法，提出了直接介入推理链的“针对性推理替换（TRR）”方法，揭示了大型推理模型中忠实性与安全性之间的内在权衡与反相关机制，并利用表征操控技术成功提升了安全性。局限性在于评估主要基于HazMart这单一的具体自主AI场景，未来可在更多复杂的安全场景中进一步验证。
motivation: 思维链（CoT）推理对于模型监控至关重要，但这依赖于高忠实性（模型输出严格来自推理过程）；同时模型又需要具备足够的安全性以拒绝不安全推理。作者旨在测量并解决忠实性与安全性之间的这种对立/紧张关系。
method: 1. 构建自主AI店员场景的人工编写数据集HazMart；2. 提出针对性推理替换（TRR）技术，直接干预模型的推理链以替换入不安全或不逻辑的思想；3. 对DeepSeek-R1-Llama-70B和QwQ-32B进行对比评估与机制分析；4. 运用表征操控（representation steering）独立放大安全表征方向。
results: 1. DeepSeek-R1-Llama-70B忠实性高（97.5%），但安全性差（仅12.3%）；QwQ-32B安全性更高（73.9%），但忠实性较低（74.7%）。2. 机制分析表明忠实性与安全性在内部表征方向上呈反相关，并在动作提交标记处达到峰值。3. 表征操控使QwQ-32B的安全行为提高了9个百分点，且未损害其基础能力。
conclusion: 大型推理模型（LRM）中存在忠实性与安全性之间的平衡与对立关系。通过机制分析找到表征方向后，可利用表征操控在不损害模型基础能力的前提下独立增强其拒绝不安全推理的安全行为。
