title: Behavioral Grammar: Detecting Adaptive Malware via Tiny Language Model Priors and Second-Order Temporal Analysis
authors: Zihan Luo
abstract: Modern endpoint detection systems face a fundamental tension: signature-based approaches are trivially evaded by polymorphic or adaptive threats, while heavy deep-learning models resist auditability and deployment at scale. This paper presents Behavioral Grammar, a detection architecture that treats host runtime behavior as a structured language and learns its grammar with a compact 0.88M-parameter causal Transformer (TinyGPT). Each system event is discretized into an 8-token representation spanning event type, process, argument skeleton, path category, parent process, user, destination, and inter-event timing. The model learns the conditional distribution of normal behavior in a purely self-supervised manner, and anomaly scores are derived from per-slot negative log-likelihood (NLL) statistics, yielding a mathematically bounded false-positive rate. We augment this prior with prototype learning for known-attack attribution, second-order temporal analysis for cadence-based detection, self-learning pattern extraction, and a five-network fusion pipeline. Against an Adaptive Adversarial Agent (AAA)--a threat that learns survival strategies under defensive pressure, performs behavioral mimicry, and matches host event rates--our system achieves 93% detection at 3.84% onboarding false-positive rate. The strongest discriminative signal arises not from any single event but from the coefficient of variation of inter-event intervals: the AAA stepping cadence exhibits CV=0.310 versus 9.786 for benign sleep intervals, a 30x separation reflecting a fundamental stealth-functionality trade-off. We frame these findings within a coevolutionary economics model, arguing that behavior-grammar detection shifts the evasion cost from rule circumvention (cheap) to distribution matching (expensive), establishing a structural asymmetry favoring the defender.

title: Hierarchical Residual Policy Optimization for Generative Recommendations
authors: Kaifeng Guo, Yiming Yang, Jingtong Gao, Guolei Zeng, Fukang Yang, Yukang Liang, Peng Jiang, Qingpeng Cai, Xiangyu Zhao
abstract: Generative recommenders select items by autoregressively decoding semantic identifiers (SIDs), whose token positions induce a coarse-to-fine hierarchy over the item space. In practice, SID decoders are trained via supervised next-token prediction, which imitates logged trajectories rather than directly optimizing downstream utility. This motivates post-training with outcome feedback to guide decoding toward higher utility. However, logged feedback is only observed for the final exposed item, causing most post-training methods to operate at the item level and broadcast the same terminal signal across all SID tokens. As a result, token-level credit assignment becomes sparse, high-variance, and layer-dependent. To this end, we propose Hierarchical Residual Policy Optimization (HRPO), a post-training framework that converts item-level outcomes into dense, token-aligned learning signals for conservative token-wise improvement. Specifically, HRPO first estimates SID prefix-level utilities via group-wise reward smoothing over feature-based user clusters. It then decomposes these utilities into residual token credits and accumulates them into credit-to-go signals. Finally, Residual-Return Policy Optimization (RRPO) optimizes the residual credits using clipped updates, group-normalized advantages, and KL regularization to preserve stability. Experiments on a public dataset and an online A/B test in a large-scale commercial system show consistent gains in session-level utility and key business metrics. Source code and the archived artifact are available for reproduction.

title: A Protocol for Evaluating the Accessibility of AI-Generated Educational Materials: Prompt Configuration, WCAG-Derived Criteria, and Content Overload
authors: Hector R. Amado-Salvatierra
abstract: Generative AI tools increasingly produce educational materials: documents, slides, images, audio, and video, yet little is known about whether this content meets accessibility requirements. This paper presents a protocol for evaluating the accessibility of AI-generated educational materials against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), across five content types and multiple tools. The protocol compares three conditions applied to the same tool: a generic instruction with no accessibility language; a single prompt explicitly configured with WCAG criteria; and a persistent, reusable accessibility profile loaded once rather than re-specified each time. Evaluation combines a WCAG rubric per content type with heuristic validation by accessibility experts, addressing a known limitation of automated scanners. Prior evidence shows generative AI tools reproduce inaccessible practices by default, and that explicit configuration measurably improves compliance. This paper extends that discussion to a dimension WCAG checklists miss: visual and informational overload common in AI-synthesized content. The main contribution is methodological: a reproducible protocol and open evaluation instrument, with cases documenting the barriers non-configured AI content creates for people with disabilities. A first exploratory application is also reported: a rubric-based compliance score rose from a pooled mean of 24.2% under the generic condition to 96.7% under the WCAG-configured condition, using one model, one artifact per condition and type, and single-evaluator scoring; the persistent-profile condition was not exercised. The protocol is a reusable resource for the community to apply and extend at full benchmark scale. Beyond the protocol, this work aims to raise awareness of accessibility obstacles generative AI can introduce, and encourage creators to consider accessibility when using these tools.

title: NISF++: Geometrically-grounded implicit representations of 3D+time cardiac function from 2D short- and long-axis MR views
authors: Nil Stolt-Ansó, Maik Dannecker, Steven Jia, Julian McGinnis, Daniel Rueckert
abstract: Clinical acquisition in cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging involves obtaining cross-sectional planes of the heart along the radial and longitudinal directions. Despite these planes being 2D cross-sectional images of the heart, radiologists understand the 3D spatial and continuous temporal nature of the organ being imaged. The same can not be said about the conventional deep learning architectures used to process CMR images, which rely on in-plane and grid-based operations, and are hence unable to organically integrate information from all imaging planes. This paper builds upon previous work on neural implicit segmentation functions (NISF) to overcome unaddressed challenges in cardiac function modeling in the CMR domain. For a given subject, our architecture builds a shared 3D+time representations from all available acquisition planes regardless of orientation. By design, predictions along any imaging plane orientation are cross-sections of the same 3D representation, leading to spatio-temporal consistency across all slices. Moreover, our architecture makes the rotation and translation parameters of imaging planes learnable, allowing us to correct for the commonplace respiratory and patient motion between slice acquisitions under a rigid assumption. Furthermore, interpolation of intensities and segmentation can be performed in 4D at any desired resolution. We perform our study on a 120 subject sub-cohort of CMR imaging data from the UK-Biobank. Our in-plane segmentation performance is on-par with existing CMR segmentation methods and explore how the majority of failure cases arise from limitations in the ground-truth segmentation, for which our representations make predictions with better anatomical accuracy than its original training data. We also evaluate our motion-correction capabilities, displaying quantitative and qualitative improvements in slice alignment.

title: Impedance Control via Generalized Output Regulation
authors: Hélio Jacinto Cruz Neto, Victor Shime, Thiago Boaventura
abstract: Achieving a desired impedance during physical interaction remains a central problem in compliant control. In many practical implementations, admittance control combined with linear position controllers is employed, but this structure typically results in only approximate impedance behavior. This paper establishes a rigorous equivalence between the impedance realization problem and the generalized output regulation theory, and shows that, under the admittance architecture and assuming the inner position controller is restricted to linear combinations of commonly used signals, a unique control law exists that achieves exact compliant control. The resulting controller introduces additional terms with respect to a conventional PD formulation, while preserving a simple structure. Numerical simulations are used to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach under nominal conditions and in the presence of model uncertainties, and to compare its performance against a standard PD controller. The results demonstrate improved interaction performance and robustness, supporting the theoretical analysis.

title: Less Is More: Tuning Configurable Systems with Imperfect Fidelity
authors: Yulong Ye, Miqing Li, Tao Chen
abstract: Configuration tuning is essential for optimizing the performance of highly configurable systems, e.g., throughput or runtime, under a given environment. Yet, this is a challenging process as there can be many options to tune, and configuration measurement is often highly expensive. In this paper, we demonstrate the phenomenon of ``less can be more'': system configuration tuning can be greatly improved with much superior budget utilization by partially tuning under the imperfect-fidelity---an environment that is similar, but cheaper to measure, compared with the concerned perfect-fidelity of environment under which the system should be tuned. We codify a conceptual framework of fidelity for configurable systems, drawing on which allows us to propose MFTune, a tuner that proactively explores in the space of $>10^4$ possible imperfect-fidelity settings to approximate a useful one, which strikes for the wideness of tuning. This creates high-quality seeds for the perfect-fidelity, which in turn ensures the tuning depth. Experiment results against $10$ state-of-the-art tuners, obtained from running diverse real-world systems for $19$ months $24 \times 7$, show that MFTune performs considerably better on $83.33$\% cases with up to $19.34\%$ improvement while achieving hours of budget saving in general.

title: Variational Inference Using a Differentiable Multigrid Linear Solver
authors: Andrés Ramírez, Philipp Haim, David Föger, Torsten A. Enßlin, Philipp Frank, Philipp Gschwandtner, Dominik Jüstel, Philipp Mertsch, Vo Hong Minh Phan, Laurin Söding, Hanieh Zandinejad, Ralf Kissmann
abstract: Gradient-based Bayesian inference methods require efficient access to Jacobian and adjoint-Jacobian operators of high-dimensional forward models. While multigrid solvers provide near-optimal complexity for elliptic partial differential equations, they are rarely available in forms compatible with automatic differentiation (AD). We develop a differentiable multigrid solver for steady-state diffusion-absorption problems and derive its adjoint operations analytically through the full multigrid hierarchy. The resulting solver, DMGS, is implemented in C++ and interfaced with JAX to provide efficient Jacobian-vector and vector-Jacobian products for variational inference in the NIFTy framework. We validate the approach on a 3D inverse problem involving diffuse radiative transfer in tissue, reconstructing an effective radiative source from Monte Carlo-simulated data. The reconstruction reproduces the data at a reduced chi-squared of 1.1 and generalizes to 32 independent validation datasets. Benchmarks against a JAX-native multigrid implementation show comparable runtimes and consistently lower peak memory for the hand-derived adjoint, with modest reverse-mode overhead. These results establish differentiable multigrid solvers as practical building blocks for variational inference in PDE-constrained problems.

title: An Analysis of Brent's Insertion Method for Hash Tables
authors: William Kuszmaul
abstract:
In 1968, Richard P.~Brent introduced a new way of building a hash table that, at least empirically, achieves a remarkable property: Even if the hash table is filled to 100\% full, the expected time to query a \emph{random key out of those present} is $O(1)$.
  Despite the simplicity of Brent's method, the guarantees of the method have never been formally analyzed. This is due to the subtle issue of handling \emph{spoiled randomness}. The algorithm will sometimes try to use hash functions $h_j$ on keys $y$ that it has already probed in the past. When the algorithm does this, we cannot treat the hash function as random, because its random bits have already affected the state of the table. This issue makes Brent's method surprisingly subtle to reason about formally.
  In this note, we give a simple and formal analysis of Brent's hash table. The analysis can be taught in a graduate randomized algorithms course, and provides a nice example of how to deal with subtle issues in a probabilistic analysis (namely, the issue of spoiled randomness).

title: CN101 - A Digital Thermodynamic Computer for Generative AI
authors: Lars Holdijk, Denis Melanson, Zier Mensch, Brandon Birchall, Vincent Cheung, Nicholas Lehrter, Maxwell Aifer, Samuel Duffield, Jan Ole Ernst, Rajath Salegame, Antonio J. Martinez, Gavin Crooks, Miranda Cheng, Zach Belateche, Marc Bright, Patrick J. Coles, Faris Sbahi
abstract: Thermodynamic computing is an emerging hardware paradigm, in which stochastic physical dynamics serve as the direct computational primitive. The recent explosion of generative AI has only sharpened the search for alternative approaches to compute, and, as we show in this work, thermodynamic computing turns out to be well suited to this space. An important class of methods realises a function as the stationary expectation of an ergodic stochastic process: the answer is encoded in the time-averaged statistics of an equilibrating trajectory. To date, this equilibration-style class has been formulated exclusively through Langevin dynamics, restricting its implementations to analogue substrates and the engineering challenges those bring. In this work, we propose a substrate-independent formalisation of the equilibration-style formulation, in which the only object of design is the dynamical generator L* of an arbitrary ergodic process. The formalisation makes three hardware-level properties of the formulation explicit: the precision of a result is a knob set by how long the dynamics are run, sample averages decompose across independent trajectories, and dependent stages of a computation operate concurrently rather than serially, a property we call sequential parallelism. We instantiate the formalisation by fabricating a prototype digital thermodynamic computing chip, named CN101, that implements the formulation through discrete accumulator dynamics on standard CMOS using stochastic computing principles. We characterise CN101's success across conventional generative AI workloads in the form of VAEs and flow matching, applied to both image generation and scientific problems. Together, the formalisation and its digital instantiation show that the equilibration-style formulation is substrate-independent, and that its computational properties can be exploited on standard digital hardware.

title: FinDeepIndicator: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents in End-to-End Financial Indicator Construction
authors: Chaoqun Yang, Fengbin Zhu, Xinyu Lin, Long Bai, Xiaoluan Liu, Ke-Wei Huang, Roger Zimmermann, Tat-Seng Chua
abstract: Financial indicators are essential tools for transforming raw financial data into interpretable measures for various downstream tasks, such as valuation, risk assessment, and economic analysis. However, existing financial benchmarks largely focus on answer-level accuracy and often assume that relevant data are already provided, leaving the assessment of the intermediate process of indicator construction underexplored. In this work, we propose FinDeepIndicator, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating Deep Research (DR) agents in end-to-end financial indicator construction. Specifically, FinDeepIndicator evaluates DR agents across four stages in indicator construction: formula specification, data collection, indicator calculation, and answer generation, and covers fundamental, technical, and macroeconomic indicators organized into 21 fine-grained sub-categories. It contains 3,350 curated question-answer (QA) pairs derived from both U.S. and Chinese markets, 10 years of historical financial data, and 800 listed companies. Extensive experiments on search-equipped Large Language Models (LLMs) and DR agents show that, while LLMs generally perform well in formula specification, their accuracy drops substantially during data retrieval and numerical execution. DR agents consistently outperform search-equipped LLMs, yet remain unreliable in realistic financial analysis settings. These findings provide insights for developing more capable and trustworthy DR agents in finance.

title: Continuous Face Authentication on Mobile and Desktop Platforms: A Comparative Study
authors: Miriam Palmetshofer, Rainhard Dieter Findling, Marc Kurz
abstract: Personal devices hold sensitive data and provide access to sensitive services. Conventional personal device authentication verifies users' identity only at the moment access is granted. An unlocked device may be accessed by an unauthorized person if the user stops using the device without locking it, or if another person takes over. Continuous authentication addresses this gap. This paper investigates how device type and usage conditions influence continuous mobile face authentication with an InsightFace-based approach with temporal trust decay. We evaluate the approach with mobile and desktop recordings with different head directions and lighting conditions. We also evaluate recordings from everyday mobile device use without predefined tasks. The results show that device type alone has little impact, while different usage conditions do have impact on the authentication performance. Results also show that everyday mobile device use is in general more challenging for continuous face authentication, where reduced face visibility, including occlusions and faces outside the camera viewport, is a main contributor to false rejections.

title: Hi-TOPS: Hierarchical Topology-aware Scoring Prior for 3D Part Decomposition
authors: Ruoyu Wu, Zhenhong Sun, Xiaoming Gong, Yuxin Xian, Zhi Wang, Yawen Chen, Huadong Mo, Daoyi Dong
abstract: Accurate 3D part decomposition requires separating shapes into structurally meaningful components with precise boundaries while preserving articulation seams and thin attachments. Existing approaches often suffer from a structural-scale mismatch: geometric evidence for separation is most reliable at the meso scale, yet many pipelines operate either too globally to respect joints or too locally to remain robust to noise. We propose Hi-TOPS, a Hierarchical Topology-aware Scoring Prior that aggregates complementary intrinsic cues into a multi-resolution Flow-Freeze field. Flow regions provide expandable support for primitive coverage, while Freeze regions restrict growth near articulations and thin structures. A TSDF-guided body-surface superquadric fitter then captures dominant cores and residual surface structures, followed by SQ-to-mesh assignment for connected, boundary-aligned parts. Across diverse benchmarks, Hi-TOPS delivers stable, editable decompositions without semantic supervision or 2D foundation priors.

title: RAGOCR: Optical Compression of Retrieval-Augmented Text via Visual Representation
authors: Jiayang Yu, Jialun Zhong, Lei Zou
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become essential for knowledge-intensive question answering, yet scaling RAG pipelines remains challenging due to the prohibitive computational cost of processing lengthy retrieved contexts. Existing compression approaches face a fundamental trade-off: hard compression methods operate online in a query-aware fashion but achieve only modest compression rates and typically require fine-tuning the generative model, while soft compression methods attain higher ratios but rely on costly offline encoding that is entirely agnostic to the input query. To bridge this gap, we introduce RAGOCR, a novel framework that compresses retrieved documents into compact visual representations conditioned on the input query. To further balance compression rate and information fidelity, we introduce a query-aware dynamic resolution mechanism that adaptively allocates visual granularity based on each document's estimated relevance and complexity: highly relevant passages are rendered at higher resolution to preserve fine-grained details, while peripheral documents are aggressively compressed at lower resolution. Experiments on five QA benchmarks using the MedOmniKB retrieval corpus demonstrate that RAGOCR surpasses naive RAG by over 15\% in accuracy while requiring only one-eighth the number of input tokens, and consistently outperforms both hard and soft compression baselines across varying retrieval depths.

title: Taming the Search Space: Solving and Generating Hitori and Binairo Puzzles
authors: Lukas Zandomeneghi, Rainhard Dieter Findling, Marc Kurz
abstract: This paper investigates solving and generation techniques for the logic puzzles Hitori and Binairo. Two solving paradigms are compared: backtracking with domain-specific optimizations, and SAT-based solving via conjunctive normal form encodings. An empirical evaluation analyzes runtime, explored search nodes, and branching factor across varying puzzle sizes. To support systematic benchmarking in the evaluation, generators capable of producing valid and uniquely solvable puzzle instances are developed. Results indicate that constraint propagation is the most effective backtracking optimization, substantially reducing the effective branching factor, search tree size, and thus runtime. Heuristic variable ordering and scoring strategies provide additional improvements. For Binairo, the SAT-based approach solves all evaluated instances within low runtime, while optimized backtracking fails to solve difficult puzzle instances within the timeout. For Hitori, propagation-based backtracking achieves the best results, while for the SAT-based approach the iterative connectivity check takes up the majority of the runtime, failing difficult puzzle instances.

title: ORCESTRA: VLM-driven Visual Robot programming in Mixed Reality
authors: Ivan Snegirev, Elizaveta Semenyakina, Mikhail Konenkov, Artem Lykov, Miguel Altamirano Cabrera, Dzmitry Tsetserukou
abstract: ORCESTRA is a mixed-reality system for programming robot digital twins through no-code waypoint teaching and language-guided control. In a passthrough mixed-reality workspace, users place robot twins on real surfaces, teach trajectories, save robot-relative episodes, or issue spoken/typed commands that a vision-language model converts into structured digital-twin plans. Both interaction modes share a backend for metric grounding, embodiment-aware validation, preview, confirmation, and digital-twin execution. The system supports heterogeneous robot embodiments, including fixed-base manipulators, a mobile base, and a humanoid robot, demonstrating MR validation as a safety layer for language-guided robot programming before physical deployment.
zh_title: ORCESTRA：混合现实中基于视觉语言模型驱动的视觉机器人编程
translation: ORCESTRA 是一个混合现实系统，用于通过无代码路标教学和语言引导控制对机器人数字孪生进行编程。在透视混合现实工作空间中，用户将机器人孪生体放置在真实表面上，教授运动轨迹，保存机器人相对情景，或发出口头/键入的指令，视觉语言模型（VLM）将这些指令转换为结构化的数字孪生计划。两种交互模式共享一个后端，用于度量接地、具身感知验证、预览、确认和数字孪生执行。该系统支持包括固定底座机械臂、移动底座和人形机器人在内的异构机器人具身，证明了 MR 验证在物理部署前作为语言引导机器人编程安全层的有效性。
tldr: ORCESTRA 利用混合现实与视觉语言模型，通过无代码教学和语言指令实现异构机器人数字孪生的安全编程与预览。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将透视混合现实（MR）与视觉语言模型（VLM）结合，把数字孪生作为机器人物理部署前的安全中间层，大幅降低了机器人编程门槛并提高了安全性。其对异构机器人（包含人形机器人）的泛化能力具有重要现实意义。局限性在于摘要未具体说明物理机器人的实际部署效果及系统延迟。
motivation: 旨在简化机器人编程流程，并解决语言引导的机器人控制在物理部署前缺乏直观安全验证和多具身适配的问题。
method: 结合透视混合现实工作空间与视觉语言模型（VLM），支持无代码路标轨迹教学以及自然语言指令控制。系统共享统一后端，执行度量接地、具身感知验证、动作预览、确认及数字孪生运行。

conclusion: 混合现实（MR）验证可以作为语言引导机器人编程在物理部署前的有效安全层。

title: Generic Vision and Cross-Attention for Reaction Yield Prediction
authors: Qiwei Han, Chi Zhou
abstract: Traditional reaction yield prediction is constrained by 1D quantum descriptors that lack explicit spatial information. To address this gap, a dual-modal Vision Cross-Attention architecture is proposed, fusing tabular physical-organic data with 2D molecular topologies. Notably, it is demonstrated that a generic computer vision backbone processing simple 2D skeletal structures independently outperforms purely quantum-based baselines. By synergizing both modalities, superior predictive accuracy compared to traditional methodologies is achieved by the optimal cross-attention framework (Test RMSE = 5.27%). Through mechanistic probing, active, descriptor-guided spatial querying is observed, effectively offloading macroscopic steric identification to the visual pathway. Furthermore, a dynamic chemical hierarchy is learned by the network to heavily prioritize critical steric bottlenecks, such as the aryl halide. Concurrently, residual skip connections are utilized to protect non-spatial electronic parameters from destructive attenuation during fusion. Collectively, a scalable and highly interpretable blueprint is provided for augmenting physical chemistry with deep visual learning.
zh_title: 用于化学反应产率预测的通用计算机视觉与交叉注意力机制
translation: 传统化学反应产率预测受限于缺乏显式空间信息的一维量子描述符。为了弥补这一空白，本文提出了一种双模态视觉交叉注意力（Vision Cross-Attention）架构，将表格化物理有机数据与二维分子拓扑结构相结合。值得注意的是，实验证明仅使用通用计算机视觉骨干网络处理简单的二维骨架结构，其表现就独立超越了纯基于量子的基线方法。通过协同这两种模态，最佳的交叉注意力框架取得了比传统方法更优异的预测精度（测试集RMSE = 5.27%）。通过机理探针分析，观察到了以描述符为引导的活性空间查询，有效地将宏观立体阻碍的识别分担给了视觉通路。此外，网络学习到了动态化学层级结构，从而高度优先处理关键的立体位阻瓶颈（如芳基卤化物）。同时，利用残差跳跃连接保护非空间电子参数在融合过程中免受破坏性衰减。总的来说，本研究为利用深度视觉学习增强物理化学研究提供了一个具备可扩展性和高可解释性的蓝图。
tldr: 本文提出了一种融合2D分子图像与物理有机描述符的双模态交叉注意力模型，成功提升了反应产率预测精度（RMSE为5.27%）并具备强可解释性。
ai_comments: 该研究巧妙地将通用计算机视觉模型引入化学反应产率预测领域，证明了简单的2D分子骨架图像比复杂的1D量子描述符能够提供更丰富的空间/立体阻碍信息。结合交叉注意力机制与残差跳跃连接，不仅显著提升了预测精度（RMSE达到5.27%），还赋予了模型高度的可解释性，为AI驱动的化学研究（AI for Science）提供了新颖且有活力的思路。
motivation: 传统化学反应产率预测方法过度依赖1D量子描述符，缺乏显式的三维/空间物理信息，限制了模型对立体阻碍等空间效应的捕获能力。
method: 提出了一个双模态Vision Cross-Attention（视觉交叉注意力）架构，将表格化的物理有机数据与2D分子拓扑结构图像相结合。使用通用计算机视觉骨干网络提取2D骨架图像的空间特征，并通过交叉注意力机制与1D物理化学描述符进行深度融合，同时利用残差跳跃连接保护非空间电子参数。
results: 单纯使用通用CV骨干处理2D骨架结构的效果即超越了纯量子描述符基线；最优的交叉注意力融合模型取得了最高的预测精度（测试集 RMSE = 5.27%）。可解释性分析表明网络能动态关注关键立体位阻瓶颈（如芳基卤化物），并有效分担了宏观立体阻碍识别任务。
conclusion: 该研究成功证明了结合2D分子拓扑图像与表格化物理有机描述符的双模态交叉注意力架构在反应产率预测中的优越性，为利用深度视觉学习增强物理化学研究提供了一个具备可扩展性和高可解释性的蓝图。

title: ChordVideo: One-Step, Training-Free, Temporally Consistent Video Editing via Low-Energy Transport
authors: Zhiqiang Lao
abstract: One-step text-to-image models enable training-free, inversion-free editing with only 1--2 network function evaluations (NFE), while ChordEdit stabilizes such edits through low-energy smoothing along sampling time. Applied independently to video frames, however, it produces temporal flicker and edit-strength drift. We introduce \textbf{ChordVideo}, which extends the same low-energy principle to video time through shared noise, motion-aligned causal aggregation of per-frame Chord fields, and an optional temporally smoothed proximal correction. We derive a warping-error bound that separates motion bias from stochastic flicker and predicts diminishing returns with larger temporal windows. On TGVE/DAVIS with two one-step backbones, ChordVideo reduces warping error by \textbf{78\%} and flicker by \textbf{49\%}, improves CLIP frame consistency by \textbf{9--10 points}, and increases background PSNR by about \textbf{1.5,dB}, while retaining \textbf{2 NFE/frame}. Compared with seven multi-step editors, it achieves competitive temporal consistency and source preservation using \textbf{10--60$\times$ fewer model steps per clip
zh_title: ChordVideo：通过低能量传输实现一步、免训练、时间一致的视频编辑
translation: 单步文本生成图像模型仅需1-2次网络功能评估（NFE）即可实现无需训练和反演的编辑，而ChordEdit通过沿着采样时间的低能量平滑稳定了此类编辑。然而，若将该方法独立应用于视频帧，会产生时间闪烁和编辑强度漂移。我们提出了ChordVideo，通过共享噪声、对每帧Chord场进行基于运动对齐的因果聚合，以及可选的时间平滑近端校正，将相同的低能量原则扩展到视频时间维度。我们推导了一个变形误差界限，将运动偏差与随机闪烁区分开来，并预测了较长时间窗口下收益递减的情况。在包含两个单步骨干网络的TGVE/DAVIS数据集上，ChordVideo将变形误差降低了78%，闪烁降低了49%，CLIP帧一致性提高了9-10分，背景PSNR提高了约1.5 dB，同时每帧保持2 NFE。与七种多步编辑方法相比，它每剪辑使用的模型步骤减少了10-60倍，同时获得了极具竞争力的时间一致性和源视频保持能力。
tldr: ChordVideo将低能量平滑原则引入视频时间轴，以每帧仅需2 NFE的极低计算成本，实现了高效、免训练且时间一致的视频编辑。
ai_comments:
创新性：论文巧妙地将单步图像编辑中的低能量平滑原则拓展至视频时间域，结合运动对齐因果聚合和理论误差界限推导，实现了高效的时间一致性控制。
重要性：将视频编辑的计算开销降低了10-60倍（每帧仅需2 NFE），显著提升了免训练视频编辑的应用价值和实用效率。
局限性：理论推导表明大时间窗口下存在收益递减效应，且依赖运动对齐，在面对极度剧烈或复杂非刚性运动场景时的表现仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 现有的单步文本到图像模型虽能实现快速免训练编辑，但若将针对图像的低能量平滑编辑方法（如ChordEdit）直接独立应用于视频各帧，会导致严重的时间闪烁（temporal flicker）和编辑强度漂移（edit-strength drift）。
method: 提出了ChordVideo方法，将低能量传输原则扩展至视频时间域。主要技术包括：1）共享噪声；2）对每帧Chord场进行基于运动对齐的因果聚合；3）可选的时间平滑近端校正（proximal correction）。此外，论文还推导了区分运动偏差与随机闪烁的变形误差界限（warping-error bound）。
results: 在TGVE和DAVIS数据集上使用两种单步骨干网络评估，ChordVideo使变形误差降低了78%，闪烁减少了49%，CLIP帧一致性提高了9-10分，背景PSNR提升约1.5 dB，同时保持每帧仅需2 NFE。相比7种多步视频编辑方法，单视频剪辑的模型步数减少了10-60倍，同时保持了强竞争力的时间一致性和原视频背景保持能力。
conclusion: ChordVideo成功地在单步生成模型的基础上实现了高效、高质且时间一致的免训练视频编辑，以极低计算成本（每帧2 NFE）达到了与多步编辑方法相当甚至更好的编辑效果。

title: SIPTraj: Map-Free End-to-End Trajectory Prediction via Physics-Guided Scene Interaction
authors: Feifei Liu, Zejun Wei, Haozhe Wang, Yazhi Ye, Yuying Zhang, Jintao Cheng, Chi Man Vong, Xieyuanli Chen, Xiaoyu Tang
abstract: Trajectory prediction of surrounding agents is a prerequisite for safe planning and decision making in autonomous driving. Without high-definition (HD) maps, sensor-derived bird's-eye-view (BEV) features provide no explicit lane topology or drivable-area priors, making it inherently difficult to ground each agent in its surrounding scene context. Moreover, physical feasibility remains difficult to capture through data-driven learning alone, as kinematic constraints on agent motion cannot be explicitly encoded without structured supervision. Existing map-free predictors extract scene context in an agent-agnostic manner through a single fusion step and treat physical constraints only as output-level penalties, leaving both challenges unaddressed. We propose SIPTraj, a map-free trajectory prediction framework that jointly addresses scene grounding and physical feasibility. SIPTraj introduces a Hierarchical Agent-Scene Encoder (HASE) progressively grounding each agent in agent-guided scene evidence and refining inter-agent relations within the scene-grounded space. To tackle physical infeasibility in predicted trajectories, we develop a Physics-Guided Iterative Decoder (PGID). It conditions decoding on instantaneous kinematic states, propagating physical supervision into internal representations rather than output trajectories alone. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 Sensor show that SIPTraj surpasses prior map-free predictors and strong map-based baselines without any HD map at inference. Our code will be released as open-source.
zh_title: SIPTraj：通过物理引导场景交互实现的无地图端到端轨迹预测
translation: 周围智能体的轨迹预测是自动驾驶中安全规划和决策的前提。在没有高精（HD）地图的情况下，基于传感器衍生的鸟瞰图（BEV）特征无法提供明确的车道拓扑或可行驶区域先验，这使得将每个智能体定位到其周围场景上下文中变得固有地困难。此外，由于在没有结构化监督的情况下无法显式编码智能体运动的运动学约束，仅靠数据驱动的学习仍难以捕捉物理可行性。现有的无地图预测器通过单步融合以智能体无关的方式提取场景上下文，并将物理约束仅视为输出层面的惩罚，导致这两个挑战都未得到解决。我们提出了 SIPTraj，这是一个联合解决场景定位和物理可行性的无地图轨迹预测框架。SIPTraj 引入了分级智能体-场景编码器（HASE），逐步将每个智能体定位在智能体引导的场景证据中，并在场景定位空间内精细化智能体间的关系。为了解决预测轨迹中的物理不可行性问题，我们开发了物理引导迭代解码器（PGID）。它以瞬时运动学状态为条件进行解码，将物理监督传播到内部表征中，而不是仅仅施加于输出轨迹。在 nuScenes 和 Argoverse 2 Sensor 上的广泛实验表明，SIPTraj 在推理时无需任何高精地图，超越了以往的无地图预测器和强力的基于地图的基线的性能。我们的代码将开源。
tldr: SIPTraj是一个无地图轨迹预测框架，通过分级智能体-场景编码和物理引导迭代解码，有效解决了无地图场景下的场景定位与轨迹物理可行性难题。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地解决了无地图轨迹预测中的两大核心痛点（场景定位与物理约束）。其突出亮点在于将物理运动学约束深入引入到解码器的内部表征中，而非仅停留在输出层的惩罚；同时提出了分级编码机制以改善智能体与场景上下文的结合。局限在于具体的物理运动学模型及其计算开销在摘要中尚未展开，实际实时部署表现有待进一步验证。
motivation: 无地图轨迹预测缺乏高精地图提供的车道拓扑和可行驶区域先验，导致智能体难以精准定位到周围场景中；同时纯数据驱动方法缺乏显式运动学约束，生成的预测轨迹容易违背物理可行性。现有方法未能在表征层面有效解决这两大挑战。
method: 提出了SIPTraj无地图轨迹预测框架，包含两个核心模块：1）分级智能体-场景编码器（HASE）：以智能体为引导逐步提取场景证据，并在场景定位空间内优化智能体间的交互关系；2）物理引导迭代解码器（PGID）：以瞬时运动学状态为条件进行解码，将物理监督直接传播到内部特征表征中。
results: 在nuScenes和Argoverse 2 Sensor数据集上的实验表明，SIPTraj在推理阶段无需任何高精地图，性能超越了以往的无地图预测方法以及强力的基于高精地图的基线模型。
conclusion: SIPTraj成功联合解决了无地图轨迹预测中的场景定位与物理可行性难题，证明了通过物理引导和渐进式场景交互可以在无需高精地图的前提下实现甚至超越基于地图方法的预测精度。

title: Distill Where You Fail: Recovering Learning Signals of Negative RL-Groups from Adaptive Teacher Guidance
authors: Zhuowen Han, Jinwei Xiao, Zhengxi Lu, Renren Jin, Zhiyuan Yao, Yuxin Liu, Hongyan Hao, Yueqing Sun, Yu Yang, Qi GU, Xunliang Cai, Deyi Xiong
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs). While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely adopted, it suffers from sparse reward signals and loses gradients entirely when all responses within a group receive identical rewards. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a natural remedy by providing dense, token-level supervision from a teacher model. However, naively combining GRPO with OPD leads to degraded performance, due to three underlying causes: not all samples benefit from distillation; fitting too quickly to the teacher undermines the exploratory capacity of RL; and OPD's advantages are asymmetric, suppressing most tokens. To address these challenges, we propose RSTG (Recovering Learning Signals via Adaptive Teacher Guidance), which applies distillation selectively and precisely where it matters most. At the sample level, OPD is restricted to negative zero-variance prompts with each sample weighted by the teacher's confidence score. At the token level, distillation targets only tokens with high student entropy or large teacher-student divergence. We further augment training with SFT on correct trajectories generated by the teacher model, injecting positive gradient signals where RL yields none. Experiments demonstrate that RSTG substantially outperforms naive GRPO+OPD by +4.02% on math and +3.05% on code.
zh_title: 蒸馏于失败处：通过自适应教师指导恢复负RL组的学习信号
translation: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为大语言模型（LLM）后训练的标准范式。尽管组相对策略优化（GRPO）被广泛采用，但它面临奖励信号稀疏的问题，且当组内所有响应获得相同奖励时会完全丢失梯度。On-policy蒸馏（OPD）通过提供来自教师模型的密集Token级监督，提供了一种自然的补救方法。然而，简单地将GRPO与OPD结合会导致性能下降，原因有三个潜在因素：并非所有样本都能从蒸馏中获益；过快拟合教师模型会破坏RL的探索能力；以及OPD的优势具有不对称性，抑制了大多数Token。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了RSTG（通过自适应教师指导恢复学习信号），它在最关键的地方选择性且精准地应用蒸馏。在样本级别，OPD被限制在负零方差的提示上，每个样本由教师的置信度得分加权。在Token级别，蒸馏仅针对学生模型高熵或教师-学生分歧较大的Token。我们还通过教师模型生成的正确轨迹上的SFT来增强训练，在RL无法产生信号的地方注入正梯度信号。实验表明，RSTG在数学任务上比朴素的GRPO+OPD大幅提升了+4.02%，在代码任务上提升了+3.05%。
tldr: 本文提出RSTG方法，通过在样本和Token级别进行自适应蒸馏并补充教师正确轨迹的SFT，解决了GRPO强化学习中负零方差组梯度缺失及与蒸馏结合效果不佳的问题。
ai_comments: 创新性：提出了样本级与Token级双重粒度的自适应蒸馏机制，有效解决了GRPO在负零方差组中梯度消失的问题。重要性：打破了GRPO与On-policy蒸馏简单结合导致性能下降的瓶颈，提升了大模型在数学和代码任务上的后训练效果。局限性：摘要中未提及引入教师模型及生成正确轨迹所带来的额外计算与采样开销。
motivation: 在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，GRPO存在奖励信号稀疏以及组内响应奖励相同（如全错的零方差组）时丢失梯度的问题。虽然On-policy蒸馏（OPD）能提供密集监督，但直接将GRPO与OPD结合会导致性能下降，原因包括并非所有样本适合蒸馏、过快拟合教师会损害RL探索能力，以及OPD的优势不对称性导致大部分Token被抑制。
method: 提出了RSTG（ Recovering Learning Signals via Adaptive Teacher Guidance）方法：1. 样本级选择性蒸馏：仅在负零方差提示上应用OPD，并根据教师模型的置信度得分进行加权；2. Token级精准蒸馏：仅针对学生模型熵较高或教师-学生分歧较大的Token进行蒸馏；3. 正信号注入：结合教师模型生成的正确轨迹进行SFT增强训练，弥补RL无梯度信号的不足。
results: 实验表明，RSTG在数学任务上比朴素的GRPO+OPD提升了4.02%，在代码任务上提升了3.05%。
conclusion: RSTG通过自适应且选择性的教师指导以及选择性SFT，成功解决了GRPO结合On-policy蒸馏时的探索受损和信号缺失问题，大幅提升了大语言模型在推理任务上的性能。

title: Safety Invariants for Agents Orchestrating Irreversible State Transitions: A Four-Dimensional Formalism Evaluated on Public Ledgers
authors: Zhaoming Yin
abstract: Autonomous agents are increasingly asked to produce irreversible effects on external systems - transferring funds, writing to durable storage, actuating hardware. Existing agent frameworks (ReAct, Reflexion, MCP) optimize task success on benchmarks and give little attention to the safety of irreversible side-effects. We formalize one such setting, movement of value across public ledgers, as state transitions in a four-dimensional space indexed by (wallet, chain, address, protocol), and use that formalism to state and prove a guarantee we call execution fidelity: under a fault model admitting planner mis-mapping, ambiguous outcomes, retries, at-least-once delivery, and delegated non-human callers, a session's realized effect on the ledger is either nothing at all or exactly the transition that was rendered to the user, exactly once. The theorem deliberately does not claim that the rendered transition matches the user's intent - no runtime layer can decide that - but it confines that unbounded question to a single predicate over a finite object, which is what makes a preview a sufficient control rather than a formality. Seven safety invariants, derived from the fidelity condition rather than enumerated from experience, discharge the guarantee. Empirically, on a controlled N=60 adversarial suite the stack lifts pass rate by ~74 percentage points over a naive-ReAct baseline on two write-aggressive backing models, but by only ~3 points on a write-cautious one - evidence that single-model evaluations of agent safety stacks are close to unfalsifiable. The system is deployed; 108 production write operations across 8 chains back the failure taxonomy. Although the evaluation setting is public ledgers, the formalism and invariants apply to any probabilistic agent acting on irreversible external state.
zh_title: 编排不可逆状态转移智能体的安全不变性：在公共账本上评估的四维形式化方法
translation: 自主智能体越来越多地被要求对外部系统产生不可逆的影响，例如转移资金、写入持久存储、驱动硬件。现有的智能体框架（ReAct、Reflexion、MCP）侧重于优化基准测试上的任务成功率，很少关注不可逆副作用的安全性。我们将这种场景之一——公共账本上的价值流动，形式化为由（钱包、链、地址、协议）构成的四维空间中的状态转移，并利用该形式化方法提出并证明了一种称为“执行保真度”的保证：在包含规划器错配、模糊结果、重试、至少一次交付以及委托非人类调用者的故障模型下，会话对账本产生的实际效果要么完全没有，要么与呈现给用户的转移完全一致且仅发生一次。该定理特意未主张呈现的转移符合用户的真实意图（没有任何运行时层能够决定这一点），但它将这个无界问题约束在一个有限对象上的单一谓词中，从而使预览成为一种充分的控制手段而非形式主义。从保真度条件中推导出的七个安全不变性（而非根据经验枚举）履行了这一保证。实证方面，在一个包含N=60的受控对抗性测试集上，该技术栈在两个“积极写入”的支撑模型上比原生ReAct基线提高了约74个百分点的通过率，但在一个“谨慎写入”的模型上仅提高了约3个百分点——这证明了对智能体安全栈进行单模型评估几乎是不可伪证的。该系统已部署；跨8条链的108次生产环境写入操作支持了该失效分类法。尽管评估场景是公共账本，但该形式化方法和不变性适用于任何作用于不可逆外部状态的概率型智能体。
tldr: 本文提出了一个用于约束智能体不可逆操作（如区块链转账）的形式化框架与七个安全不变性，确保实际执行效果与向用户展示的预览严格一致或完全不执行。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了针对具有不可逆副作用（如资金转账、硬件驱动等）的AI智能体的形式化安全保障机制，将安全问题约束为有限对象上的确切谓词，具有很强的理论严密性与工程实用价值。论文还揭示了智能体安全评估中“单模型评估几乎不可伪证”的重要洞察。局限性在于该机制依赖于向用户呈现预览（preview），无法解决用户自身意图与呈现内容不符的“意图误解”源头问题。
motivation: 现有的智能体框架（如ReAct、Reflexion、MCP等）主要关注于优化基准测试中的任务成功率，而忽视了智能体对外部系统产生不可逆副作用（如转账、写入持久化存储、驱动硬件）时的安全性问题。
method: 将公共账本上的价值流动形式化为由（钱包、链、地址、协议）索引的四维空间中的状态转移，提出并证明了“执行保真度”保障（即对账本产生的实际效果要么为零，要么与向用户呈现的转移完全一致且仅执行一次），并由此推导出七个安全不变性。
results: 在N=60的对抗测试集上，该框架在两个“积极写入”的基础模型上比原生ReAct基线提高了约74个百分点的通过率，但在“谨慎写入”模型上仅提高了约3个百分点；系统已上线部署，并在8条链上的108次生产环境写入操作中验证了失效分类法。
conclusion: 单模型对智能体安全栈的评估容易产生误导。该形式化方法和安全不变性不仅适用于公共账本，还可推广至任何作用于不可逆外部状态的概率型智能体。

title: HIERA: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Relevance Assessment for Content Discovery Systems
authors: Pritom Saha Akash, Phanideep Gampa, Chao Shen, Ying Chen, Sheikh Muhammad Sarwar
abstract: Content discovery systems depend on relevance judgment for search quality evaluation, but human annotation faces inter-annotator disagreement and scaling costs. While Large Language Models show promise as automated assessors, current approaches rely on flat aggregation strategies: single-step prompting, voting ensembles, or uncoordinated multi-agent pipelines that aggregate independent outputs without integration. We propose HIERA, a hierarchical multi-agent relevance assessment framework with four specialized agents: a Relevance Judge, Query Analyzer, Item Analyzer, and Relation Analyzer. The Judge determines when specialist analysis is needed; the Relation Analyzer then coordinates query and item analyses with external knowledge to establish relevance relationships for final judgment. Ablation studies show that the same agents and external knowledge without hierarchical coordination degrade performance, confirming that the coordination structure itself accounts for the improvement. Evaluation across five datasets (EVS, MSRD, ESCI, WANDS, Home Depot) shows improvements over 11 baselines: 10.2\% on Home Depot, 4.8\% on ESCI, and up to 38\% on EVS ($p < 0.05$). Hierarchical coordination yields 12.7\% improvement over uncoordinated collaboration using identical agents.
zh_title: HIERA：面向内容发现系统的分层多智能体相关性评估框架
translation: 内容发现系统依赖相关性判断来进行搜索质量评估，但人工标注面临标注者之间的分歧和扩展成本问题。虽然大语言模型在作为自动评估员方面展现出前景，但当前方法依赖于扁平的聚合策略：单步提示、投票集成或在没有整合的情况下聚合独立输出的无协调多智能体流水线。我们提出了HIERA，一种分层多智能体相关性评估框架，包含四个专门的智能体：相关性裁判、查询分析器、物品分析器和关系分析器。裁判智能体决定何时需要专家分析；关系分析器随后协调查询和物品分析并结合外部知识，以建立相关性关系用于最终判断。消融实验表明，在没有分层协调的情况下使用相同的智能体和外部知识会导致性能下降，证实了协调结构本身是性能提升的原因。在五个数据集（EVS、MSRD、ESCI、WANDS、Home Depot）上的评估表明，与11个基线相比有所提升：Home Depot提升10.2%，ESCI提升4.8%，EVS上最高提升38%（p < 0.05）。相比使用相同智能体的无协调协作，分层协调带来了12.7%的提升。
tldr: HIERA提出了包含四个专业智能体的分层协调框架，通过按需调用与外部知识整合显著提升了大模型在内容相关性评估上的准确性。
ai_comments: 创新点在于打破了传统的独立多智能体输出扁平聚合模式，引入了基于相关性裁判按需调用的分层协调架构，并通过严谨的消融实验证明了协调结构本身带来的性能增益；局限性在于多智能体协作及外部知识库查询可能会增加推理时延与计算开销。
motivation: 搜索与内容发现系统的人工相关性标注成本高且存在标注分歧，而基于LLM的现存自动评估方法多采用单步提示、投票集成或无协调的扁平多智能体管线，缺乏深度整合与协调。
method: 提出了包含四个专业智能体的分层框架HIERA：相关性裁判负责判断何时需要专家分析；查询分析器与物品分析器提供细粒度解析；关系分析器则协调这两者并结合外部知识库建立相关性关系，最终输出判断结果。
results: 在五个数据集上的评估显示，HIERA击败了11个基线模型（Home Depot提升10.2%，ESCI提升4.8%，EVS最高提升38%）。与使用相同智能体但无协调的方案相比，分层协调带来了12.7%的性能提升。
conclusion: HIERA通过引入分层协调机制，显著提升了基于大语言模型的相关性评估质量，证明了合理的智能体组织架构比简单的扁平聚合更有助于解决复杂的相关性判断问题。

title: Order Auctions with Private Position Preferences
authors: Ruijie Wang, Aviv Yaish
abstract: We study auctions where two positions are sold to unit-demand bidders with private heterogeneous order preferences: some are specialists who value only the first position, while others are generalists who are indifferent between the two. First, we consider a standard first-price rule which allocates the first and second items to the highest and second-highest bidders, respectively. We show that no strategy profile ex-post implements the efficient allocation at every type profile, irrespective of payments, and provide a distribution-free equilibrium welfare guarantee of $\frac{1}{2}$. To augment this result, we prove that for deterministic one-round auctions and discrete bids, the efficient allocation requires each bidder to communicate at least one bit more than its bid's binary representation. We next ask what the same bit accomplishes in winner-pays-bid formats where bidders can also specify specific item preferences. In particular, we show that this strengthens our distribution-free equilibrium welfare guarantee to $1-\frac{1}{e}$. Finally, we discuss our results' applicability to priority service auctions and blockchain transaction sequencing.
zh_title: 具有私有位置偏好的顺序拍卖
translation: 我们研究了将两个位置出售给具有私有异质性顺序偏好的单需求竞价者的拍卖机制：其中一些是仅重视第一个位置的“专家”，而另一些是对两个位置无差异的“通才”。首先，我们考虑标准的最高价规则，该规则分别将第一和第二个物品分配给出价最高和次高的竞价者。我们证明，无论支付规则如何，都没有策略组合能在每个类型组合下事后实现高效分配，并提供了 1/2 的无分布均衡福利保障。为了补充这一结果，我们证明对于确定性单轮拍卖和离散出价，高效分配要求每个竞价者比其出价的二进制表示至少多通信 1 个比特。接着，我们探讨在允许竞价者指定特定物品偏好的“赢家按出价支付”格式中，这额外的 1 个比特能实现什么。特别地，我们证明这将其无分布均衡福利保障增强至 1 - 1/e。最后，我们讨论了我们的结果在优先级服务拍卖和区块链交易排序中的适用性。
tldr: 本文研究了私有位置偏好下的顺序拍卖，证明标准最高价拍卖福利保障仅为 1/2，而允许竞价者额外传递 1 比特偏好信息可将福利保障提升至 1 - 1/e。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于结合了机制设计中的通信复杂度（Communication Complexity）与福利保障（Welfare Guarantees），揭示了仅仅 1 比特的偏好信息表达就能带来显著的福利保障提升（从 1/2 提升至 1 - 1/e）。这对于高频/低通信开销场景（如区块链 MEV 交易排序、优先级服务分发）具有极高的实用价值和理论指导意义。
motivation: 探究在竞价者具有私有异质性位置偏好（如仅重视第一位置的专家与对两个位置无差异的通才）的环境下，顺序拍卖的效率损失与通信限制，并寻求通过改进信息表达机制来提升社会福利保障。
method: 基于博弈论与机制设计理论，分析了标准最高价拍卖的均衡效率；推导了确定性单轮拍卖实现高效分配所需的通信复杂度下界；设计了允许竞价者额外指定具体物品偏好的“赢家按出价支付”拍卖规则。
results: 1. 标准最高价规则无法事后实现高效分配，无分布均衡福利保障仅为 1/2；2. 实现高效分配要求每个竞价者比出价的二进制表示至少多传递 1 比特信息；3. 引入这 1 比特偏好表达后，赢家按出价支付格式的无分布均衡福利保障提升至 1 - 1/e。
conclusion: 通过给出价人增加仅 1 比特的信息通信能力（指定具体偏好），可以显著提升具有私有位置偏好的顺序拍卖中的无分布均衡福利界限，该结论对优先级服务和区块链交易排序等场景有重要应用价值。

title: StochSIPP: Safe Interval Path Planning in Stochastic Dynamic Environments
authors: Ajith Kemisetti, Shahaf S. Shperberg, Yoonchang Sung
abstract: Safe navigation under uncertain time-dependent blockage requires anticipating observations before committing to motion. We present StochSIPP, an exact contingent planner for temporal roadmaps with uncertain edge and vertex statuses revealed locally during execution. StochSIPP uses SIPP to generate certified-safe macro-actions that terminate at the next observation or the goal, and bounded AND/OR search over a cached action--observation graph to select actions for every reachable observation outcome. Optimistic and robust SIPP relaxations provide admissible lower and upper bounds for bounded AND/OR search. When every interval declared deterministically safe is truly safe, sensing is exact, and execution follows the planned timing, the resulting policy is provably collision-free. With correct independent probabilities and complete action and outcome generation, it minimizes expected arrival time within the roadmap and horizon. Experiments on controlled roadmap instances show that StochSIPP preserves the observed success of safe fixed-path baselines while reducing arrival time, and solves gated scenarios in which conservative fixed-path planners return no plan. A scalability study further reveals rapid growth as the number of simultaneously observed uncertain statuses increases.
zh_title: StochSIPP：随机动态环境中的安全区间路径规划
translation: 在不确定的随时间变化的阻塞环境下进行安全导航，需要在做出运动承诺前预测观察结果。我们提出了StochSIPP，这是一种针对时空路线图的精确应急规划器，其中不确定的边和顶点状态会在执行过程中局部揭示。StochSIPP利用SIPP生成保证安全的宏动作（在下一个观察点或目标点终止），并在缓存的动作-观察图上使用带界的AND/OR搜索，为每个可达的观察结果选择动作。乐观和鲁棒的SIPP放松条件为带界的AND/OR搜索提供了可容许的下界和上界。当每个确定性声明安全的区间确实安全、感知精确且执行遵循计划时间时，生成的策略在证明上是无碰撞的。在具有正确的独立概率以及完整的动作和结果生成的情况下，它能最小化路线图和时界内的期望到达时间。在控制路线图实例上的实验表明，StochSIPP在减少到达时间的同时保持了安全固定路径基线的成功率，并解决了保守固定路径规划器无法提供计划的门控场景。一项可扩展性研究进一步揭示了随着同时观察到的不确定状态数量增加，其规模呈快速增长趋势。
tldr: StochSIPP通过将SIPP与带界AND/OR搜索相结合，在不确定的随时间变化的动态环境中生成具有安全保证且期望到达时间最优的应急规划策略。
ai_comments:
创新性：将经典的SIPP（安全区间路径规划）扩展到随机动态环境，结合SIPP生成安全宏动作与AND/OR搜索进行应急规划，构思巧妙且理论严密。
优势：能在不确定性环境下保证碰撞自由（Provably Safe），同时最小化期望到达时间，有效解决了传统保守固定路径规划器在特定门控场景下无解的问题。
局限性：随着同时观察到的不确定状态数量增加，计算规模增长迅速，在极度复杂的多元不确定环境中可能面临可扩展性瓶颈。
motivation: 在随时间变化的阻塞不确定环境下进行安全导航，需要预测观察结果并提前制定策略，而现有保守的固定路径规划算法往往效率低下甚至在门控场景中无法给出可行的路径。
method: 提出StochSIPP算法：结合SIPP生成在下一个观察点或目标点终止的保证安全的宏动作；构建缓存的动作-观察图；在图上使用带界的AND/OR搜索选择最佳动作；利用乐观和鲁棒的SIPP放松条件提供下界和上界估计。
results: 实验表明，StochSIPP在保持安全固定路径基线成功率的同时显著减少了到达时间，并成功解决了保守路径规划器无解的门控场景；扩展性研究表明，其计算开销随同时观察的不确定状态数量增加而迅速增长。
conclusion: 在满足安全区间准确、感知精确且执行定时的条件下，StochSIPP能提供理论上无碰撞且期望到达时间最小化的最优应急策略。

title: DynamicWAM: Dual-Path Motion Conditioning for World-Action Models in Dynamic Manipulation
authors: Yunfan Lou, Hewen Gao, Xiyu Zhu, Zhuoran Qiao, Xuan Han, Yifan Yang, Yifan Ye, Boxian Yao, Zhibo Pang
abstract: Dynamic manipulation requires robots to infer target motion and respond promptly, yet existing World-Action Models (WAMs) typically condition only on the current frame and execute large backbones synchronously, limiting motion awareness and responsive control in dynamic scenes. We propose DynamicWAM, a compact WAM for dynamic object manipulation with dual-path motion conditioning. DynamicWAM introduces history-flow conditioning, encoding temporally aligned optical-flow frames alongside the current observation through a frozen pretrained video VAE to preserve spatial motion structure, while injecting kinematic descriptors of displacement, duration, velocity, and acceleration into the action expert to provide motion magnitude and timing. The two complementary paths are fused through joint world-action attention. A distilled compact backbone and real-time chunking (RTC)-based asynchronous execution further enable responsive control. On DOMINO, DynamicWAM achieves a 38.2% success rate and a 53.2 manipulation score, outperforming all evaluated baselines. Across 12 real-world tasks spanning linear, circular, and compound target motion, it achieves a 46.7% average success rate, exceeding the strongest baseline by 22.9 percentage points.
zh_title: DynamicWAM：基于双路径运动条件约束的动态操作世界-动作模型
translation: 动态操作要求机器人能够推断目标运动并做出迅速响应，然而现有的世界-动作模型（WAM）通常仅以当前帧为条件，并同步执行庞大的骨干网络，从而限制了动态场景中的运动感知和响应控制能力。我们提出了 DynamicWAM，这是一种具有双路径运动条件约束的紧凑型 WAM，用于动态物体操作。DynamicWAM 引入了历史光流条件约束，通过冻结的预训练视频 VAE 将时间对齐的光流帧与当前观察一起编码，以保留空间运动结构；同时将位移、时长、速度和加速度等运动学描述符注入动作专家中，以提供运动幅度与定时信息。这两条互补路径通过联合世界-动作注意力机制进行融合。蒸馏得到的紧凑骨干网络以及基于实时分块（RTC）的异步执行进一步实现了即时响应控制。在 DOMINO 基准测试中，DynamicWAM 实现了 38.2% 的成功率和 53.2 的操作得分，超越了所有评估的基线。在涵盖直线、圆周和复合目标运动的 12 个真实世界任务中，它实现了 46.7% 的平均成功率，比最强的基线高出 22.9 个百分点。
tldr: DynamicWAM 结合历史光流与运动学描述符构成的双路径运动条件，并利用模型蒸馏与异步执行，实现了高效、高响应的机器人动态物体操作。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于巧妙地将视觉层面的空间运动信息（光流）与物理层面的动态参数（速度、加速度等运动学描述符）结合，形成双路径运动条件约束，解决了传统世界-动作模型（WAM）在动态物体操作中运动感知不足的难题；同时通过模型蒸馏与RTC异步执行提升了系统响应速度。局限性在于光流提取与运动学参数的获取可能对复杂遮挡或高噪环境敏感，一定程度上依赖上游感知的准确性。
motivation: 动态物体操作需要机器人能迅速推断目标运动并实时响应，但现有世界-动作模型（WAM）通常仅依赖当前单帧图像，且同步执行庞大的骨干网络，导致动态场景下的运动感知能力受限、控制响应迟钝。
method: 提出了 DynamicWAM 框架，包含三大核心技术：1）双路径运动条件：历史光流条件路径通过预训练视频 VAE 编码时间对齐的光流帧以保留空间运动结构；物理运动学路径将位移、时长、速度和加速度描述符注入动作专家以提供运动幅度与定时；2）特征融合：通过联合世界-动作注意力机制（joint world-action attention）融合两条互补路径；3）实时响应：采用蒸馏后的紧凑骨干网络与基于实时分块（RTC）的异步执行机制。
results: 在 DOMINO 仿真基准上，DynamicWAM 实现了 38.2% 的成功率和 53.2 的操作得分，优于所有对比基线；在包含直线、圆周及复合运动目标的 12 项真实世界动态操作任务中，取得了 46.7% 的平均成功率，超越最强基线 22.9 个百分点。
conclusion: DynamicWAM通过双路径运动条件约束（视觉光流与物理运动学参数）以及轻量化异步执行架构，成功提升了机器人对动态目标的运动感知与即时响应控制能力，显著提高了动态操作的成功率。

title: CADENA: Stepwise CAD Reverse Engineering
authors: Soslan Kabisov, Gennadiy Savrasov, Maksim Elistratov, Antonio Rodriguez, Daniil Ignatiev, Nikita Gavrilov, Rustam Uzdenov, Alexey I. Boyko, Igor Pasechnik, Anton Konushin, Andrey Kuznetsov, Dmitrii Zhemchuzhnikov
abstract: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) underpins modern engineering, yet converting existing shapes into editable models still demands substantial expert effort. Most AI systems emit the entire CAD program in a single pass, never inspecting the intermediate geometry. In contrast, human engineers build a part feature by feature, checking after each operation what remains to be modeled. We introduce CADENA (Spanish for "chain"), a model that reconstructs a 3D mesh as a parametric CAD program, growing its sequence of operations one at a time and comparing the target with the currently predicted geometry at every step. We also address the lack of benchmarks for evaluating reverse-engineering methods on mechanical parts, introducing CADENA-Bench, a benchmark that measures performance across categories of mechanical parts. CADENA outperforms prior methods on CADENA-Bench and on the DeepCAD, Fusion 360, and MCB datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/zhemdi/cadena, model weights at https://huggingface.co/kulibinai/cadena, and CADENA-Bench at https://huggingface.co/datasets/kulibinai/cadena-bench.
zh_title: CADENA：逐步CAD逆向工程
translation: 计算机辅助设计（CAD）支撑着现代工程，然而将现有形状转换为可编辑的模型仍需要专家付出大量努力。大多数AI系统在单次前向传递中输出整个CAD程序，从不检查中间几何形状。相比之下，人类工程师逐特征构建零件，并在每次操作后检查还需要建模的部分。我们推出了CADENA（西班牙语中意为“链”），这是一个将3D网格重建为参数化CAD程序的模型，它逐一扩展其操作序列，并在每一步将目标与当前预测的几何形状进行比较。我们还解决了缺乏评估机械零件逆向工程方法基准的问题，推出了CADENA-Bench，这是一个跨机械零件类别评估性能的基准。CADENA在CADENA-Bench以及DeepCAD、Fusion 360和MCB数据集上均优于先前的方法。代码、模型权重和CADENA-Bench基准均已开源。
tldr: CADENA通过模仿人类逐特征构建并实时对比中间几何形状的过程，实现了高质量的3D网格到参数化CAD程序的逐步逆向工程。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于抛弃了传统的“单次生成全量CAD程序”的范式，转而模拟人类工程师“逐特征构建、每步比对中间几何与最终目标”的增量过程，显著提升了生成准确度。同时，作者推出了专门用于评估机械零件逆向工程的基准数据集CADENA-Bench，填补了该领域评估标准的空白。并且开源了代码和模型权重，具有很高的实用与研究价值。
motivation: 现有的将3D形状转换为可编辑CAD模型的方法需要大量人工专家工作，且大多数AI系统一次性生成整个CAD程序，忽略了中间几何形态；而人类工程师是逐个特征构建零件并在每一步检查剩余形态的。
method: 提出了CADENA模型，将3D网格重建为参数化CAD程序。该方法逐一增加操作序列，并在每一步将目标形状与当前预测的几何形状进行对比。此外，还提出了CADENA-Bench基准，用于跨机械零件类别测量逆向工程性能。
results: CADENA在新建的CADENA-Bench基准以及DeepCAD、Fusion 360和MCB数据集上均超越了现有的逆向工程方法。
conclusion: 通过模仿人类逐步构建并实时比对中间几何形状的建模逻辑，CADENA能够更准确地将3D网格逆向工程为参数化CAD程序，并在多个主流数据集及新基准上取得了领先的性能。

title: Exact Algorithms for Minimum Steiner Point Trees
authors: Eungyu Woo, Donghoon Shin
abstract:
Given distinct terminals $P\subset R^2$ and $R>0$, the Steiner tree problem with minimum number of Steiner points and bounded edge length asks for a straight line tree spanning $P$, with every edge of length at most $R$, that minimizes the number of Steiner points. Length is measured in a fixed $L_p$ metric with $p\in Q_{\ge 1}\cup\{\infty\}$. The optimum $k$ is not bounded by $n$, even in two-terminal case.
  We give a deterministic exact algorithm that computes an optimal implicit representation in $n^{O(n)}$ time, independent of $k$, in the computation model of Section~\ref{subseccomputation}. The representation consists of a full Steiner topology, exact branch coordinates, and a segment count for each topology edge. Subdivision requires additional time $Θ(n+k)$.
  For each full Steiner topology, the feasible segment count vectors are the integer points of a convex projection in $O(n)$ dimensions. A continuous relaxation restricts the integer optimum to $2n-3$ consecutive values. Exact semialgebraic routines and a flatness recursion in integral lattice coordinates decide these values. Together with the parameterized bottleneck algorithm of Bandyapadhyay et al., this gives the value bound $\min\{n^{O(n)}, k^{O(k)}n^{O(1)}\}$ for every fixed metric considered here.
zh_title: 最小斯坦纳点树的精确算法
translation:
给定平面 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 上的离散终端集 $P$ 及 $R>0$，带边长上限的最小斯坦纳点树问题旨在寻找一棵跨越 $P$ 的直线树，使得每条边的长度不超过 $R$，同时最小化斯坦纳点的数量。长度在固定的 $L_p$ 度量（$p\in \mathbb{Q}_{\ge 1}\cup\{\infty\}$）下测量。即使在双终端情况下，最优斯坦纳点数 $k$ 也不受 $n$ 界定。
我们提出了一个确定性精确算法，可在特定计算模型下以 $n^{O(n)}$ 时间计算出最优隐式表示，且该时间独立于 $k$。该表示包含完整的斯坦纳拓扑、精确的分支坐标以及每条拓扑边的段数。显式细分需要额外的 $\Theta(n+k)$ 时间。
对于每个完整的斯坦纳拓扑，可行段数向量是 $O(n)$ 维凸投影中的整数点。连续松弛将整数最优解限制在 $2n-3$ 个连续值内。精确的半代数例程和整数格坐标中的扁平递归可以决定这些值。结合 Bandyapadhyay 等人的参数化瓶颈算法，对于此处考虑的每个固定度量，给出了值界限 $\min\{n^{O(n)}, k^{O(k)}n^{O(1)}\}$。
tldr: 提出了一种求解最小斯坦纳点树问题的确定性精确算法，其计算最优隐式表示的时间复杂度为 $n^{O(n)}$，完全独立于斯坦纳点总数 $k$。
ai_comments:
创新性：提出了与斯坦纳点数 $k$ 无关的 $n^{O(n)}$ 时间复杂度的隐式表示求解算法，巧妙结合了凸投影、连续松弛、半代数几何例程与整数格扁平递归技术。
重要性：克服了最优斯坦纳点数 $k$ 可能远大于终端数 $n$ 导致的传统算法复杂度失控问题，在传感器网络中继节点部署等领域具有重要理论意义。
局限性：$n^{O(n)}$ 的时间复杂度对于较大规模的终端节点数 $n$ 仍然较高，且依赖于特定的计算模型。
motivation: 带边长上限的最小斯坦纳点树问题中，最优斯坦纳点数 $k$ 可能远大于终端点数 $n$（即使在两终端情况下也不受 $n$ 界定），导致现有算法在 $k$ 很大时效率极低。因此需要设计一种复杂度独立于 $k$ 的精确算法。
method: 提出了一个确定性精确算法，通过计算包含完整斯坦纳拓扑、精确分支坐标和段数的隐式表示来求解。利用凸投影与连续松弛将整数最优解限制在 $2n-3$ 个连续值内，并结合精确半代数例程、整数格坐标中的扁平递归（flatness recursion）以及 Bandyapadhyay 等人的参数化瓶颈算法进行决策与求解。
results: 算法能在 $n^{O(n)}$ 时间内（与 $k$ 无关）计算出最优隐式表示，显式细分仅需额外的 $\Theta(n+k)$ 时间。对于所考虑的固定 $L_p$ 度量，综合复杂度达到 $\min\{n^{O(n)}, k^{O(k)}n^{O(1)}\}$。
conclusion: 该研究成功构建了针对带边长上限的最小斯坦纳点树问题的确定性精确算法，不仅实现了复杂度与 $k$ 的解耦，还给出了 $\min\{n^{O(n)}, k^{O(k)}n^{O(1)}\}$ 的统一复杂度界限，推动了计算几何领域中该类 NP-hard 问题的精确求解发展。

title: AIMold: An Autonomous AI-based Pipeline for Complex Mold Design
authors: Pengyun Qiu, Shuo Wang, Zeyuan Chen, Yihao Zhi, Chongjie Ye, Xiaoguang Han
abstract: Injection molding is the cornerstone of mass-producing plastic components. While current algorithms can automate mold design for basic geometries using standard two-piece molds, complex parts featuring undercuts, side holes, or re-entrant features present a significant challenge. These geometries often necessitate auxiliary components beyond the primary upper and lower molds. In practice, designing these intricate assemblies is a laborious process that relies heavily on expert knowledge. Furthermore, the scarcity of public datasets has hindered the development of effective learning-based solutions. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MoldCAD, a curated dataset that pairs complex single-body CAD parts with industry-standard mold assemblies. Each entry includes the upper and lower molds, parting surfaces, demolding orientations, and necessary auxiliary components. The dataset comprises 4,934 CAD models and over 3,850 mold assemblies, totaling more than 23k individual models. Building upon this dataset, we propose a comprehensive pipeline that predicts demolding orientations, identifies auxiliary components, and constructs parting surfaces to derive a complete, manufacturing-ready mold assembly for downstream CAD/CAM workflows. Our results demonstrate a promising path toward fully automated industrial mold design and contribute to the broader advancement of manufacturing-aware CAD generation.
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/tb2-sy/AIMold
zh_title: AIMold：面向复杂模具设计的自主AI流水线
translation: 注塑成型是塑料部件大规模生产的基石。虽然现有算法可以利用标准双板模具实现基本几何形状的模具设计自动化，但包含倒扣、侧孔或重进特征的复杂零部件带来了巨大挑战。这些几何特征通常需要主上下模之外的辅助部件。在实践中，设计这些复杂的组装体是一个极其耗时且高度依赖专家经验的过程。此外，公开数据集的匮乏阻碍了有效的基于学习的解决方案的发展。为了填补这些空白，我们推出了MoldCAD，这是一个将复杂单体CAD零件与工业标准模具组装体配对的精选数据集。每个条目都包含上下模、分型面、脱模方向和必要的辅助部件。该数据集包含4,934个CAD模型和3,850多个模具组装体，总计超过23,000个独立模型。在此数据集的基础上，我们提出了一个全面的流水线，可以预测脱模方向、识别辅助部件并构建分型面，从而为下游CAD/CAM工作流生成完整的、可用于制造的模具组装体。我们的结果展现了一条迈向完全自动化工业模具设计的有前景的道路，并为更广泛的制造感知CAD生成作出了贡献。
tldr: 本文提出了MoldCAD数据集和AIMold AI管线，实现了包含复杂特征（如侧孔、倒扣）的工业注塑模具全自动设计。
ai_comments: 创新性：推出了首个面向复杂注塑模具设计的工业级数据集MoldCAD，并构建了端到端的自动化AI模具生成管线AIMold。重要性：填补了制造领域缺乏复杂模具学习数据集的空白，大幅降低了模具设计对专家经验的依赖，推动了制造感知CAD生成的发展。局限性：摘要中未透露模型的具体AI架构设计及算法细节，且自动化生成的模具在实际工业生产中的加工可行性与物理验证仍待进一步观察。
motivation: 复杂塑料零件的注塑模具设计耗时耗力且高度依赖专家经验，同时缺乏公开数据源，严重阻碍了基于深度学习的自动化模具设计方案的发展。
method: 构建了MoldCAD数据集（包含4,934个CAD模型和3,850多个模具组装体，共计超23,000个模型），并在此基础上开发了AIMold流水线，能够自动预测脱模方向、识别辅助部件并构建分型面。
results: 成功实现了完整且可直接用于制造的注塑模具组装体的自动化生成，完美支持下游CAD/CAM工作流。
conclusion: 该研究展现了迈向全自动工业模具设计的可行路径，为制造感知的CAD生成和工业智能设计做出了重要贡献。

title: Measurement Without Validity: The Compounding Reliability Problem in Agentic AI Evaluation
authors: William Caban
abstract:
Agentic AI systems are evaluated using automated benchmarks whose scores justify deployment decisions, safety certifications, and regulatory compliance claims. We present an empirical analysis demonstrating that these scores are systematically less trustworthy than current practice acknowledges.
  The problem operates at three compounding layers. First, tasks are increasingly generated by language models: audits of ten popular benchmarks found validity flaws in seven and reporting gaps in all ten. Second, human users are replaced by LLM simulators, but calibration studies document inter-simulator variance up to 9 percentage points and systematic directional miscalibration, particularly for non-Standard American English speakers. Third, our structured survey of 55 papers finds that approximately 82% apply structurally mismatched, incomplete, or absent inter-rater reliability (IRR) metrics.
  These failures compound multiplicatively rather than additively. Under independence, a pipeline retaining 70% of valid signal at task generation, 80% at simulation, and 65% at judgment is at most 36% valid against the intended construct; the bound spans 0.22--0.54 across the empirical estimate range. We formalize this as $V_{\text{total}} \leq V_1 \times V_2 \times V_3$ and show it tightens further under correlated failures when the same model family operates across all three layers.
  We derive eight prescriptions grounded in psychometric science: a simulation calibration floor of $\text{ICC}(A,1) \geq 0.70$; domain-stratified reliability thresholds ($α\geq 0.67$ / $0.70$ / $0.80$ by consequence level); structured IRR metric selection rules based on pipeline design; and IRR as a mandatory reporting field. The measurement tools exist; the field's task is to apply them.
comment: 34 pages (review/double-spaced format), 2 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems (Elsevier)
zh_title: 缺乏有效性的测量：智能体 AI 评估中的复合可靠性问题
translation:
智能体 AI 系统通常采用自动化基准测试进行评估，其得分被用来支持部署决策、安全认证和监管合规主张。我们通过实证分析表明，这些得分的系统性可信度远低于当前实践所认知的水平。
该问题在三个复合层面上运行：首先，任务日益由语言模型生成：对十个热门基准的审计发现，有七个存在有效性缺陷，且十个均存在报告缺失；其次，人类用户被 LLM 模拟器取代，但校准研究表明模拟器间方差高达 9 个百分点，并存在系统性的方向性校准偏差（尤其是对于非标准美式英语使用者）；第三，我们对 55 篇论文进行的结构化综述发现，约 82% 的论文应用了结构上不匹配、不完整或缺失的评分者间可靠性（IRR）指标。
这些失效是乘性累积而非加性累积的。在独立性假设下，一个在任务生成层保留 70% 有效信号、在模拟层保留 80%、在判定层保留 65% 的评估流水线，针对预想构念的有效性最高仅为 36%；在实证估计范围内，该上界跨越 0.22–0.54。我们将此公式化为 $V_{\text{total}} \le V_1 \times V_2 \times V_3$，并证明当同一模型家族跨所有三层运行时，在相关失效下该上界会进一步紧缩。
我们导出了基于心理测量学的八项规范：模拟校准底线为 $\text{ICC}(A,1) \ge 0.70$；基于后果等级的领域分层可靠性阈值（$\alpha \ge 0.67$ / $0.70$ / $0.80$）；基于流水线设计的结构化 IRR 指标选择规则；以及将 IRR 作为强制性报告字段。测量工具已经存在；该领域的任务在于应用它们。
tldr: 本文揭示了智能体 AI 评估基准在任务生成、模拟器和判定指标三层中存在严重的复合可靠性危机，导致评估有效性骤降，并提出了基于心理测量学的八项改进规范。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于首次将心理测量学（Psychometric Science）框架系统化地引入智能体 AI 的评估管线中，量化并公式化了“模型生成任务-模型模拟用户-模型评估结果”三层级联误差的乘性累积效应（衰减界限）。其重要性体现在为当前盲目依赖 LLM 自动化 Benchmarks 进行部署和合规决策的现象敲响了警钟，并给出了具体可操作的心理测量学改进标准。局限性在于实证抽样的基准（10个）与论文（55篇）数量相对有限，对同源模型关联失效（correlated failures）的具体量化尚需更广泛的实测数据支持。
motivation: 当前的智能体 AI（Agentic AI）广泛依赖自动化基准测试得分来支持部署决策、安全认证和监管合规，但这些评估流水线在任务生成、用户模拟和结果判定等层面上存在严重的可靠性缺陷，导致评估得分的实际可信度远低于行业认知。
method: 研究采取了三层实证分析方法：1. 对10个热门基准进行审计；2. 针对替代人类用户的 LLM 模拟器开展校准实验；3. 对55篇相关论文的评分者间可靠性（IRR）指标应用情况进行结构化综述；4. 将多层有效性衰减公式化为乘法上界模型（$V_{\text{total}} \le V_1 \times V_2 \times V_3$）并推导改善规范。
results: 1. 任务生成层：审计的10个热门基准中有7个存在有效性缺陷，全部10个均存在报告缺失；2. 用户模拟层：模拟器间方差高达9个百分点，且存在系统性偏向（尤其是针对非标准美式英语使用者）；3. 判定层：约82%的论文使用了结构上不匹配、不完整或完全缺失的 IRR 指标；4. 复合效应：评估管线保留的有效信号在乘性累积下最高仅为36%（估计范围0.22–0.54），同源模型跨层使用时失效进一步加剧。
conclusion: 论文提出了基于心理测量学的八项规范建议（如设定模拟器校准底线 ICC(A,1) ≥ 0.70、按后果等级建立分层可靠性阈值、规范 IRR 指标选择及强制报告 IRR），呼吁 AI 评估领域应用已有的科学测量工具以重建基准测试的信度与效度。

title: SoniSpeech: A Large-Scale Open-Vocabulary Tri-Modal Dataset for Wearable Silent Speech Interfaces
authors: Ruidong Zhang, Jiacheng Liu, François Guimbretière, Cheng Zhang
abstract: Wearable silent speech interfaces (SSIs) are limited to small, closed vocabularies. Approaches achieving larger vocabularies require obtrusive hardware such as facial electrodes. We present SoniSpeech, the first large-scale, open-vocabulary, trimodal dataset for wearable SSI using acoustic-sensing eyewear. It contains 34 hours across 18,000 utterances with three synchronized modalities: ultrasound echo profiles, voiced audio, and frontal video, in both voiced and silent modes. The corpus draws from the SODA dialogue dataset, providing contemporary conversational English with 5,356 unique words and full phoneme coverage. A CTC-based ResNet-34 baseline achieves 26.3% word error rate (WER) on open-vocabulary silent speech recognition, the first benchmark for this task. Dataset is available at https://doi.org/10.7298/xjjr-9m85
zh_title: SoniSpeech：用于可穿戴无声语音接口的大规模开放词汇三模态数据集
translation: 可穿戴无声语音接口（SSI）目前局限于小型封闭词汇表。而实现更大词汇量的方法通常需要诸如面部电极等显眼或具有侵入性的硬件。本文提出了 SoniSpeech，这是首个用于基于声学传感眼镜的可穿戴 SSI 的大规模、开放词汇、三模态数据集。它包含 34 小时、共 18,000 个语句，涵盖三种同步模态：超声回波剖面、有声音频和前置视频，包含有声和无声两种模式。该语料库抽取自 SODA 对话数据集，提供了包含 5,356 个独立词汇和全音素覆盖的现代英语对话。基于 CTC 的 ResNet-34 基线模型在开放词汇无声语音识别上实现了 26.3% 的词错误率（WER），建立了该任务的首个基准。数据集获取地址为：https://doi.org/10.7298/xjjr-9m85。
tldr: 提出了首个基于声学传感眼镜的大规模开放词汇三模态无声语音数据集SoniSpeech，并建立了首个开放词汇识别基准。
ai_comments:
创新性：首次结合声学传感眼镜推出了开放词汇的三模态（超声回波、音频、视频）无声语音数据集，克服了传统设备硬件侵入性强或词汇量受限的弊端。
重要性：填补了大词汇量可穿戴无声语音交互数据集的空白，并建立了首个开放词汇无声语音识别基准，有助于推动人机交互与无障碍通信的发展。
局限性：基线模型的词错误率（26.3%）仍有较大下降空间，且声学传感眼镜在实际复杂环境中的鲁棒性仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 现有的可穿戴无声语音接口（SSI）通常局限于小型封闭词汇表，而扩展词汇量的方法通常需要使用面部电极等具有侵入性或较为显眼的硬件设备，限制了其实用性。
method: 构建了首个利用声学传感眼镜采集的开放词汇三模态数据集SoniSpeech，包含34小时、18,000个语句，整合了超声回波剖面、有声音频和前置视频三种同步模态，语料源自SODA对话数据集（包含5,356个独立词汇及全音素覆盖）；并使用了基于CTC的ResNet-34网络构建评估基线。
results: 基于CTC的ResNet-34基线模型在开放词汇无声语音识别任务上取得了26.3%的词错误率（WER）。
conclusion: 成功构建并开源了首个基于声学传感眼镜的大规模开放词汇三模态无声语音数据集，并为开放词汇无声语音识别任务建立了首个基准。

title: Hardware-rooted attestation for AI-agent evidence: composing IETF RATS with action evidence packages
authors: Anton Sokolov
abstract: An action evidence package (AEP) is a signed, append-only record of what an AI agent did, who or what authorised the action, and what the outcome was. It is a software-layer artefact: it tells a verifier the story of an action as the agent's own runtime reports it. This note argues that software attestation of this kind is necessary but not sufficient. When a verifier's question shifts from "what does the agent claim it did?" to "did the specific model version the operator claims to have deployed actually produce this output, on unmodified hardware?", the AEP alone cannot answer. The missing element is a hardware root of trust: an attestation that the measured boot and runtime state of the platform match an endorsed reference. The IETF Remote Attestation Procedures (RATS) architecture (RFC 9334) and Veraison, an open-source RATS Verifier implementation (Confidential Computing Consortium / Linux Foundation), supply exactly this. We propose a composite attestation: hardware Evidence appraised under RATS, bound to a software AEP. We map a small verifier vocabulary (Authorised / Unauthorised / Indeterminate / Attested / Contested / Expired) onto RATS appraisal outcomes, and demonstrate feasibility with a small executed experiment: on a software Trusted Platform Module (TPM; the swtpm emulator), an output-binding protocol folds the hash of an AEP outcome and a fresh appraiser nonce into an attestation-key-signed quote, with a model-artefact measurement carried in a platform register. A minimal RATS-Verifier stand-in resolves the three platform outcomes as designed -- Attested for a good, fresh quote; Contested when the model measurement is swapped; Expired when a stale quote is replayed -- and rejects a forged AEP outcome bound to a valid quote. The result is a feasibility demonstration on emulated hardware, not a hardware-rooted guarantee.
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Technical note. Also deposited at Zenodo: doi:10.5281/zenodo.20818671
zh_title: 针对AI Agent证据的基于硬件根证明：将IETF RATS与行动证据包组合
translation: 行动证据包（AEP）是一个已签名、仅追加的记录，记载了AI Agent做了什么、由谁或什么授权了该行动以及结果如何。它是一个软件层面的工件：向验证者讲述Agent运行时自身报告的行动过程。本文认为，这种软件证明是必要的但还不够。当验证者的问题从“Agent声称它做了什么？”转变为“运营商声称部署的具体模型版本是否真的在未被篡改的硬件上产生了此输出？”时，仅凭AEP无法回答。缺失的要素是硬件信任根：即证明平台的测量启动和运行时状态符合背书的参考标准。IETF远程证明程序（RATS）架构（RFC 9334）和Veraison（机密计算日光基金会/Linux基金会下的开源RATS验证器实现）恰好提供了这一点。我们提出了一种复合证明：在RATS下评估的硬件证据，与软件AEP相结合。我们将一个简短的验证者词汇表（授权/未授权/未确定/已证明/有争议/已过期）映射到RATS评估结果上，并通过一个小型的执行实验演示了可行性：在软件可信平台模块（TPM；swtpm模拟器）上，输出绑定协议将AEP结果的哈希值和新鲜的评估者随机数折叠到由证明密钥签名的quote中，平台寄存器中则包含模型工件的度量。一个最小的RATS验证器替代实现按设计解析了三种平台结果——良好且新鲜的quote解析为Attested（已证明）；当模型度量被替换时解析为Contested（有争议）；当重放陈旧quote时解析为Expired（已过期）——并拒绝与有效quote绑定的伪造AEP结果。其结果是在模拟硬件上的可行性演示，而不是基于硬件根的保障。
tldr: 本文提出将基于硬件信任根的IETF RATS远程证明与软件层AI Agent行动证据包（AEP）相结合的复合证明框架，并在模拟TPM硬件上成功验证了其可行性。
ai_comments:
创新点：首次将IETF RATS标准的硬件远程证明与AI Agent的软件行动证据包（AEP）相结合，解决了仅靠软件层报告无法验证底层模型与硬件真实性的痛点。
重要性：为安全AI Agent审计与机密计算环境中的AI行为验证提供了软硬件结合的标准化可信架构思路。
局限性：目前仅在软件模拟TPM（swtpm）上完成了可行性演示，尚未在真实物理硬件或可信执行环境（TEE）中进行验证。
motivation: 软件层的行动证据包（AEP）只能反映AI Agent自身的运行报告，无法回答部署的具体模型版本是否确实在未被篡改的硬件上输出了该结果。因此需要引入硬件信任根以提供底层平台真实性的证明。
method: 提出复合证明方案，将基于IETF RATS架构评估的硬件证据与软件AEP相绑定。在软件TPM（swtpm模拟器）上设计输出绑定协议，将AEP结果哈希与新鲜随机数折叠到TPM签名quote中，平台寄存器携带模型工件度量，并将验证词汇映射到RATS评估结果进行实验验证。
results: 在模拟TPM实验中，最小RATS验证器成功区分了正常新鲜quote（Attested）、模型度量被替换（Contested）和陈旧quote重放（Expired）三种情况，并有效拒绝了绑定在合法quote上的伪造AEP结果。
conclusion: 研究成功在模拟硬件上证明了将硬件信任根（IETF RATS）与软件AEP结合进行复合证明的可行性，为AI Agent行为及底层部署的验证提供了切实有效的软硬件结合方案。

title: AgentSLABench: Evaluating and Benchmarking Agentic Systems Under Resource Constraints
authors: Meher Bhaskar Madiraju, Meher Sai Preetam Madiraju
abstract: We present AgentSLABench, a resource-aware evaluation framework for autonomous AI agents that measures correctness alongside latency, cost, compute, memory, and network usage under declared resource budgets. Unlike standard benchmarks that report only accuracy, AgentSLABench produces a multi-dimensional profile per agent per task - the same way systems profilers (perf, pprof, cProfile) measure resource consumption of code, but extended with task correctness as a first-class dimension. AgentSLABench provides 16 task environments across 6 categories (5 core: multi-hop QA, retail substitution, code generation, web shopping, travel planning; 11 extended) with isolated Docker containers, declared CPU/memory/time/network budgets, sealed test sets with SHA256 hashes, and a standardized profiling protocol. We profile 5 general-purpose baseline agents (ReAct, PlanAndSolve, Reflexion, CoT, Random) plus 4 task-specialized agents, finding that specialized agents achieve 100% success on 3/5 core tasks (fact_qa, web_shopping, travel_planning) and 66.7-83.3% on retail and code_gen, while general baselines fail entirely on 4/5 domain tasks. Crucially, we report the Efficiency-Adjusted Success Rate (EASR) - success weighted by resource consumption relative to declared budgets - revealing that high accuracy at unbounded cost is not production-viable. We release the full infrastructure, sealed test sets, and profiling results to enable reproducible, resource-aware agent evaluation.
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Code, sealed test sets, and profiling artifacts available at: https://github.com/MeherBhaskar/agentslabench
zh_title: AgentSLABench：资源约束下的智能体系统评估与基准测试
translation: 我们提出了 AgentSLABench，这是一个面向自主 AI 智能体的资源感知评估框架，可在声明的资源预算下测量正确性以及延迟、成本、计算、内存和网络使用情况。与仅报告准确率的标准基准不同，AgentSLABench 为每个智能体在每个任务上生成多维分析图谱——就像系统分析器（perf、pprof、cProfile）测量代码的资源消耗一样，但将任务正确性扩展为第一级维度。AgentSLABench 提供了跨 6 个类别的 16 个任务环境（5 个核心类：多跳问答、零售替代、代码生成、网络购物、旅行规划；11 个扩展类），配有隔离的 Docker 容器、声明的 CPU/内存/时间/网络预算、带 SHA256 哈希的密封测试集以及标准化的分析协议。我们对 5 个通用基线智能体（ReAct、PlanAndSolve、Reflexion、CoT、Random）和 4 个任务专用智能体进行了性能分析，发现专用智能体在 3/5 的核心任务（fact_qa、web_shopping、travel_planning）上达到了 100% 的成功率，在零售和代码生成上达到了 66.7-83.3%，而通用基线在 4/5 的领域任务上完全失败。至关重要的是，我们报告了效率调整成功率（EASR）——即根据相对于声明预算的资源消耗进行加权的成功率——这揭示了在无界成本下的高准确率在生产中是不可行的。我们发布了完整的基础设施、密封测试集和分析结果，以实现可复现的、资源感知的智能体评估。
tldr: AgentSLABench提出了一个在CPU/内存/时间/网络等资源约束下评估AI智能体的框架，引入了综合考虑资源消耗与准确率的EASR指标。
ai_comments:
创新性：将传统系统工程中的资源分析（Profiling）方法引入AI智能体评估，提出了结合资源消耗加权的EASR指标，开创了资源受限下Agent评估的新范式；
重要性：弥补了现有基准仅关注准确率而忽视实际生产部署成本（如延迟、内存、网络和API费用）的不足，对Agent落地应用具有重要指导意义；
局限性：评估环境依赖特定的Docker容器与硬件预算，在不同异构硬件环境下的推广与测量一致性可能面临一定挑战。
motivation: 现有的智能体基准测试通常只关注任务准确率，忽略了延迟、成本、计算、内存和网络等资源消耗。而在无界资源成本下获得高准确率在实际生产环境中是不可行的。
method: 提出了AgentSLABench框架，结合系统级Profiling与任务正确性，提供包含Docker隔离容器、SHA256密封测试集和标准化协议的16个任务环境（6个类别）。引入效率调整成功率（EASR），在CPU、内存、时间和网络等严格资源预算下量化智能体表现。
results: 对5个通用基线智能体和4个专用智能体分析表明：专用智能体在3/5的核心任务上达到了100%成功率，其余任务达66.7%-83.3%；而通用基线在4/5的领域任务上完全失败。EASR评估进一步揭示了高成本高准确率方案缺乏生产可行性。
conclusion: AgentSLABench填补了资源感知下AI智能体评估的空白，证明了高准确率若缺乏资源效率则无法落地生产，为未来可复现、关注实用性的智能体评估奠定了基础。

title: New Results Towards the Characterization of Service Rate Region of Reed-Muller Codes
authors: Chenyang Yu, Luopeng Sun, Yiwei Zhang
abstract: The Service Rate Region (SRR) serves as a critical metric for evaluating the concurrent service capacity of distributed storage systems. While several works have characterized the SRR for MDS codes and first order Reed-Muller codes, for high-order Reed-Muller codes the problem becomes way more complicated and only partial results were given by Ly, Soljanin, and Lalitha [IEEE ISIT 2025]. In this paper, we refine the SRR analysis by explicitly characterizing the intersection patterns of recovery sets for high-order Reed-Muller codes, deriving the exact region for the case m=r+1 and providing new types of strictly tighter constraints to bridge the gap between existing approximations and the exact SRR polytope.
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, accepted by IEEE International Symposium on Information Theory 2026 (ISIT 2026)
zh_title: 关于Reed-Muller码服务速率区域表征的新结果
translation: 服务速率区域（SRR）是评估分布式存储系统并发服务能力的关键指标。尽管已有研究刻画了MDS码和一阶Reed-Muller码的SRR，但对于高阶Reed-Muller码，该问题变得要复杂得多，此前Ly、Soljanin和Lalitha [IEEE ISIT 2025] 仅给出了部分结果。在本文中，我们通过明确刻画高阶Reed-Muller码恢复集的相交模式来精细化SRR分析，推导了在m=r+1情况下的精确区域，并提供了新型严格更紧的约束，以弥合现有近似与精确SRR多面体之间的差距。
tldr: 本文精细刻画了高阶Reed-Muller码恢复集的相交模式，推导出m=r+1时的精确服务速率区域，并提供了更紧致的约束条件。
ai_comments: 本文在高阶Reed-Muller码的分布式存储服务能力表征方面取得了重要进展。其核心创新在于对恢复集相交模式的精细化几何/组合刻画，这不仅解决了m=r+1这一特定重要情形的精确求解，还提出了新的严格更紧约束，极大地缩小了现有近似与真实SRR多面体之间的理论差距，对优化分布式存储系统的并发调配具有重要的理论价值。
motivation: 高阶Reed-Muller码的服务速率区域（SRR）表征非常复杂，现有工作仅给出了部分结果或粗糙近似，与精确的SRR多面体之间存在较大差距。
method: 通过显式刻画高阶Reed-Muller码恢复集（recovery sets）的相交模式进行精细化分析，推导出m=r+1参数下的精确区域，并引入新型且严格更紧的约束条件。
results: 成功推导出m=r+1情形下高阶Reed-Muller码的精确SRR，并提出了能够进一步紧致界限的新型约束条件。
conclusion: 本文改进并深化了高阶Reed-Muller码服务速率区域的理论表征，缩小了近似界与精确多面体之间的差距，推进了分布式存储系统中编码服务能力的研究。

title: OoO-Spec: Out-of-Order Semantic Speculation for Fast Tool Calling
authors: Zhiheng Zhang, Mujie Xu, Feiyu Sun, Zhixin Zhang
abstract: LLMs generate tool calls token by token, even though the function choice and argument values can often be predicted in parallel from the request and tool schema. ToolSpec reduces this cost by drafting schema tokens and retrieving earlier calls, but cannot propose request-specific values absent from either source. We present OoO-Spec, which computes these missing semantics out of order. At request arrival, a Qwen3-0.6B sidecar predicts the function choice and all schema-defined argument slots in one parallel request-level wave while the target begins ToolSpec decoding. The runtime joins the slot values, renders the resulting call as text, and exposes it to subsequent candidate-construction rounds. The target polls without blocking, re-tokenizes a ready hint with its own tokenizer, and remains the sole verifier and commit authority. The sidecar is trained once with LoRA on Qwen2.5-32B teacher traces and used unchanged across Qwen2.5, Qwen3, and Llama targets, without target-specific drafter training. Across seven fully ranked targets and three benchmarks under greedy batch-one decoding, OoO-Spec is fastest among all evaluated methods in all 21 target-benchmark cells, reaching 2.46x-5.34x over autoregressive decoding with an unweighted mean of 3.89x, versus 2.95x for ToolSpec. It also outperforms every evaluated released learned drafter in each comparable cell. Across Qwen3-4B, 8B, 14B, and 32B targets, the same sidecar improves on ToolSpec by 34.1% on average. Its compact semantic payload averages 85 bytes per request excluding protocol metadata, supporting effective split-GPU overlap.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables; supplementary material included
zh_title: OoO-Spec：用于快速工具调用的乱序语义投机
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）逐 token 生成工具调用，尽管函数选择和参数值通常可以从请求和工具模式（schema）中并行预测。ToolSpec 通过起草模式 token 和检索早期调用减少了这一开销，但无法提出这两种来源中均不存在的请求特定值。我们提出了 OoO-Spec，它乱序计算这些缺失的语义。在请求到达时，一个 Qwen3-0.6B 旁侧模型在单个并行请求级波次中预测函数选择和所有模式定义的参数槽位，而目标模型开始 ToolSpec 解码。运行时拼接槽位值，将结果调用渲染为文本，并将其暴露给后续的候选构建轮次。目标模型非阻塞地轮询，用自己的分词器重新对就绪的提示进行分词，并保持作为唯一的验证和提交权威。旁侧模型使用 LoRA 在 Qwen2.5-32B 教师轨迹上训练一次，并在 Qwen2.5、Qwen3 和 Llama 目标模型中保持不变地使用，无需针对特定目标进行草稿模型训练。在贪婪批次为一的解码下，跨 7 个完全排名的目标和 3 个基准测试，OoO-Spec 在所有 21 个目标-基准测试单元中均为最快方法，相比自回归解码达到了 2.46 倍至 5.34 倍（未加权平均 3.89 倍），而 ToolSpec 为 2.95 倍。在每个可比单元中，它也优于所有评估的已发布已训练草稿模型。在 Qwen3-4B、8B、14B 和 32B 目标模型中，同一个旁侧模型比 ToolSpec 平均提高了 34.1%。其紧凑的语义有效载荷平均每个请求 85 字节（不包括协议元数据），支持有效的分割 GPU 重叠。
tldr: OoO-Spec 通过轻量级通用旁侧模型并行预测工具调用的参数值，实现乱序语义投机加速，相比自回归解码取得最高 5.34 倍的加速。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将计算体系结构中的“乱序执行”概念引入 LLM 投机解码中，克服了以往方法无法预测请求特有参数的局限性。其核心亮点在于：1）旁侧模型（Sidecar）一次训练即可跨多个不同的目标模型（如 Qwen2.5、Qwen3、Llama）通用，无需针对特定目标模型重训；2）通信开销极小（平均仅 85 字节），非常适合多 GPU 或分布式部署。局限在于目前实验主要集中于单批次（batch-one）贪婪解码场景，在高并发大批次下的性能表现有待进一步评估。
motivation: 大语言模型在生成工具调用时通常采用逐 token 的自回归方式，效率较低。虽然函数选择和参数值往往可以从请求和工具 Schema 中并行预测，现有的 ToolSpec 等方法能够起草 Schema token 或检索历史调用，但无法预测不存在于这两者中的“请求特定”参数值（request-specific values）。
method: 提出了 OoO-Spec 框架。在请求到达时，利用一个轻量级且通用的 Qwen3-0.6B 旁侧模型（Sidecar），在单个并行波次中预测函数选择和所有模式（Schema）定义的参数槽位；同时目标模型开始运行 ToolSpec 解码。系统将预测的槽位值渲染为文本提示（Hint），目标模型通过非阻塞轮询获取该提示，使用自身分词器重新 Token 化后作为唯一的验证权威进行验证和提交。旁侧模型仅通过 LoRA 在 Qwen2.5-32B 教师轨迹上训练一次，即可跨不同模型族直接复用。
results: 在 7 个目标模型和 3 个基准测试的全部 21 个实验单元中，OoO-Spec 的速度均超越所有对比方法。相比自回归解码实现了 2.46 倍至 5.34 倍（平均 3.89 倍）的加速，显著优于 ToolSpec（2.95 倍）。在 Qwen3 系列（4B 至 32B）模型上比 ToolSpec 平均提升 34.1%。此外，其语义有效载荷极小（平均仅 85 字节），非常利于跨 GPU 的并行重叠计算。
conclusion: OoO-Spec 证明了乱序语义投机能够显著突破传统自回归和基于模板的投机解码瓶颈，在无需针对目标模型重训草稿模型的前提下，实现了大幅度的推理加速，为高效 LLM 工具调用提供了实用且高效的新方案。

title: Paris as a 15-Minute City: An Explainable AI Perspective
authors: András J. Molnáar, Csaba I. Sidló, Rita Rónai, Domonkos Rózsay
abstract:
The 15-minute city promotes access to everyday services within a short walk or bicycle ride, but its relationship with observed mobility remains difficult to quantify. We investigate this relationship in the Paris metropolitan area using mobility trajectories from the NetMob 2025 Data Challenge, enriched with INSEE sociodemographic data and OpenStreetMap points of interest (POIs), yielding approximately 70,000 trip segments after stop-based segmentation and data cleaning.
  We construct walking- and cycling-based indicators of local service availability and examine their associations with trip duration, transport mode, and short-trip car use. Higher POI availability is associated with less private motorized travel and more active mobility, although this relationship is substantially weaker in the outer agglomeration. Gradient-boosted tree models interpreted with explainable machine-learning methods consistently identify trip purpose, home--work distance, local service availability, vehicle ownership, public-transport subscription, and sociodemographic context as important predictors. For short trips, high POI density is associated with lower car use, while car ownership and driving-licence availability are associated with higher predicted car use; where services are sparse, public-transport subscription is associated with lower predicted car dependence. Finally, explainable AI (XAI) methods are used to examine how feature attributions change under alternative assumed variable orderings.
  The results are consistent with central assumptions of the 15-minute city while revealing substantial spatial and demographic heterogeneity. They also demonstrate how explainable machine-learning methods can complement accessibility indicators and identify locally relevant hypotheses for urban-mobility policy.
comment: 17 pages, 16 figures. Extended report of a poster presented at the NetMob 2025 conference on 8 October 2025
zh_title: 15分钟城市视角下的巴黎：基于可解释人工智能的分析
translation:
15分钟城市倡导在短途步行或骑行范围内获取日常服务，但其与观察到的实际出行行为之间的关系仍难以定量评估。我们在巴黎大都会区展开研究，使用了来自NetMob 2025数据挑战赛的出行轨迹数据，并结合INSEE社会人口学数据和OpenStreetMap兴趣点（POI）数据，在经过基于停留点的分割和数据清洗后，获得了约7万条行程段。
我们构建了基于步行和骑行的本地服务可用性指标，并探讨了它们与出行时长、交通工具类型以及短途汽车使用之间的联系。较高的POI可用性与更少的私家机动车出行和更多的主动出行相关，尽管这种关系在外围城区明显减弱。通过可解释机器学习方法进行解释的梯度提升树模型一致表明，出行目的、职住距离、本地服务可用性、车辆拥有量、公共交通订阅以及社会人口学背景是重要的预测特征。对于短途出行，高POI密度与较低的 Predicted 汽车使用率相关，而拥有车辆和驾驶执照则与较高的 Predicted 汽车使用率相关；在服务稀缺的地区，公共交通订阅与较低的 Predicted 汽车依赖度相关。最后，研究利用可解释人工智能（XAI）方法探讨了在不同假设的变量排序下特征归因的变化。
研究结果与15分钟城市的核心假设一致，同时揭示了显著的空间和人口异质性。研究还展示了可解释机器学习方法如何补充传统的可达性指标，并为城市交通政策提出本地相关的假设。
tldr: 本研究利用多源数据与可解释人工智能（XAI）评估了巴黎15分钟城市建设对居民出行模式的影响，验证了其减少私家车依赖的作用并揭示了空间异质性。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将可解释人工智能（XAI）方法引入15分钟城市理念的评估中，结合了大数据轨迹、POI与社会人口学数据，不仅验证了服务密度对减少汽车依赖和促进主动出行的积极作用，还揭示了外围城区的空间异质性，为差异化的城市规划与交通政策制定提供了有力的证据支持。
motivation: 15分钟城市理念旨在让居民通过短途步行或骑行即可获取日常服务，但该理念与实际观察到的居民出行行为之间的定量关系仍难以准确评估。
method: 基于NetMob 2025数据挑战赛的出行轨迹数据（清洗后约7万条行程段），结合INSEE社会人口学数据和OpenStreetMap兴趣点（POI）数据，构建步行和骑行本地服务可用性指标。采用梯度提升树模型（GBDT）结合可解释人工智能（XAI）方法，分析各特征对出行时长、交通方式选择及短途汽车使用的影响，并探讨特征归因的变化。
results: 高的POI可用性与减少私家车出行及增加主动出行（步行/骑行）显著相关，但这种关系在外围郊区明显减弱；出行目的、职住距离、本地服务可用性、车辆拥有量、公共交通订阅及社会人口背景是重要预测因子；在短途出行中，高POI密度降低了汽车使用率，而在服务稀缺地区，公共交通订阅有助于降低汽车依赖度。
conclusion: 研究结果印证了15分钟城市的核心假设，同时揭示了显著的空间与人口异质性。研究还展示了可解释机器学习方法如何补充传统的可达性指标，并为城市交通政策提出具有本地针对性的假设。

title: Turning Interaction History into Execution State: A Runtime Layer for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
authors: Zehao Wang, Yisen Xu, Chenglin Li, Chao Peng, Bram Adams, Ahmed E. Hassan, Tse-Hsun, Chen
abstract: Long-horizon coding agents accumulate hundreds of actions and observations in their trajectories, yet nothing in this record indicates which observations still describe the repository as it currently stands. Before every decision, the model must implicitly infer the execution status from raw history, and when this inference falls short, the agent acts on outdated file contents or re-executes work whose results are still valid. We propose Ledger, a deterministic runtime layer that distills an agent's completed interactions into an explicit execution state: what has been observed, what has been modified, and what has been attempted. Ledger keeps this state in an online execution ledger and applies it at two boundaries of every step.
